28\. The same is called Kāśikā, the excellent holy centre. It is the seat of salvation shining over and above everything.

## \|\| 2.6.29 \|\|

*tābhyāṃ ca ramamāṇābhyāṃ ca tasminkṣetre manorame \|*  
*paramānaṃdarūpābhyāṃ paramānandarūpiṇī \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. The holy centre is of the nature of extreme Bliss inasmuch as the primordial lovers, supremely Blissful, made that beautiful holy centre their perpetual abode.

## \|\| 2.6.30 \|\|

*mune pralayakālepi na tatkṣetraṃ kadācana \|*  
*vimuktaṃ hi śivābhyāṃ yadavimuktaṃ tato viduḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. O sage, that holy centre is never, even at the time of Great Dissolution, free from Śiva and Śivā (Śakti). Hence it is called Avimukta.

## \|\| 2.6.31 \|\|

*asyānandavanaṃ nāma purākāri pinākinā \|*  
*kṣetrasyānaṃdahetutvādavimuktamanaṃtaram \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Since the holy centre is the cause of Bliss, the Pināka-bearing lord (Śiva) called it “the blissful forest” and later “Avimukta”.

## \|\| 2.6.32 \|\|

*athānandavane tasmiñcchivayo ramamāṇayoḥ \|*  
*icchetyabhūtsurarṣe hi sṛjyaḥ kopyaparaḥ kila \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. O celestial sage, the blissful, two deities thus sporting in the forest wished, it is said, for another Being to be created.

## \|\| 2.6.33-38 \|\|

*yasminyasya mahābhāramāvāṃ svasvairacāriṇau \|*  
*nirvāṇadhāraṇaṃ kurvaḥ kevalaṃ kāśiśāyinau \|\| 33 \|\|*

*sa eva sarvaṃ kurutāṃ sa eva paripātu ca \|*  
*sa eva saṃvṛṇotvaṃ te madanugrahatassadā \|\| 34 \|\|*

*cetassamudramākuṃcya ciṃtākallolalolitam \|*  
*sattvaratnaṃ tamogrāhaṃ rajovidrumavallitam \|\| 35 \|\|*

*yasya prasādāttiṣṭhāvassukhamānaṃdakānane \|*  
*parikṣiptamanovṛttau bahiściṃtāture sukham \|\| 36 \|\|*

*saṃpradhāryyeti sa vibhustayā śaktyā pareśvaraḥ \|*  
*savye vyāpārayāṃcakre daśameṃ'gesudhāsavam \|\| 37 \|\|*

*tataḥ pumānāvirāsīdekastrailokyasuṃdaraḥ \|*  
*śāṃtassattvaguṇodrikto gāṃbhīryyāmitasāgaraḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

33-38. Śiva thought within Himself like this—“Another being shall be created by me. Let him create everything, protect it and in the end let him dissolve it with my blessing. Having entrusted everything to him we two, remaining in Kāśī shall roam as we please keeping only the prerogative of conferring salvation. We can stay happily in this blissful forest being free from worries (of creation). With the consent of Śiva the supreme lord spread the liquorine essence of nectar on His left side, on the tenth limb, nectar which was the outcome of churning the ocean of His mind wherein Thoughts were the waves, the Sattva Guṇa was the precious gem, Rajas being coral and Tamas—crocodile. Thereupon a person came into being who was the most charming one in the three worlds, who was calm with Sattva Guṇa being prominent, and who appeared to be the ocean of immeasurable majesty.

## \|\| 2.6.39 \|\|

*tathā ca kṣamayā yukto mune'labdhopamo 'bhavat \|*  
*indranīladyutiḥ śrīmānpuṇḍarīkottamekṣaṇaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. O sage, he was endowed with patience. There was no one comparable to him. He had the lustre of sapphire. He was glorious with his excellent eyes shining like a lotus.

## \|\| 2.6.40 \|\|

*suvarṇakṛtibhṛcchreṣṭha dukūlayugalāvṛtaḥ \|*  
*lasatpracaṃḍadordaṇḍayugalohyaparājitaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. He was having a golden form and features. He wore two excellent silk garments of golden colour. His were browny and brilliant. He was indefatigable.

## \|\| 2.6.41 \|\|

*tatassa puruṣaśśaṃbhuṃ praṇamya parameśvaram \|*  
*nāmāni kuru me svāminvada karmaṃ jagāviti \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. He bowed to Śiva Parameśvara and said—“O lord give me names and assign me my task.”

## \|\| 2.6.42 \|\|

*tacchrutvā vacanamprāha śaṃkaraḥ prahasanprabhuḥ \|*  
*puruṣaṃ taṃ maheśāno vācā meghagabhīrayā \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. On hearing it Lord Śiva laughed. With words thunderlike in resonance, Lord Śiva addressed the person thus.

## \|\| 2.6.43 \|\|

*śiva uvāca \|*  
*viṣṇvitivyāpakatvātte nāma khyātaṃ bhaviṣyati \|*  
*bahūnyanyāni nāmāni bhaktasaukhyakarāṇi ha \|\| 43 \|\|*

Śiva said:—

43\. “You will be famous as Viṣṇu by name as you are all-pervasive. You will have many other names conferring happiness on devotees.

## \|\| 2.6.44 \|\|

*tapaḥ kuru dṛḍho bhūtvā paramaṃ kāryasādhanam \|*  
*ityuktvā śvāsamārgeṇa dadau ca nigamaṃ tataḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Perform penance highly conducive to the achivement of the matter in hand, Be firm in it.” Saying so, the lord bestowed on him the Vedas through his nostrils.

## \|\| 2.6.45 \|\|

*tato'cyutaśśivaṃ natvā cakāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ \|*  
*aṃtarddhānaṃ gataśśaktyā salokaḥ parameśvaraḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Śiva vanished accompanied by Śakti and his attendants. After due obeisance to Śiva, Viṣṇu began his great penance.

## \|\| 2.6.46 \|\|

*divyaṃ dvādaśa sāhasraṃ varṣaṃ taptvāpi cācyutaḥ \|*  
*na prāpa svābhilaṣitaṃ sarvadaṃ śaṃbhudarśanam \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Even after performing the penance for twelve thousand divine years, Viṣṇu could not achieve his desire, the vision of Śiva that confers everything.

## \|\| 2.6.47 \|\|

*tattatsaṃśayamāpannaściṃtitaṃ hṛdi sādaram \|*  
*mayādya kiṃ prakartavyamiti viṣṇuśśivaṃ smaran \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. He became suspicious and respectfully meditating on Śiva pondered “What shall I do now?”

## \|\| 2.6.48 \|\|

*etasminnaṃtare vāṇī samutpannā śivācchubhā \|*  
*tapaḥ punaḥ prakarttavyaṃ saṃśayasyāpanuttaye \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. In the meantime the auspicious voice of Śiva was heard. “Perform penance again for removing your doubts.

## \|\| 2.6.49 \|\|

*tatastena ca tacchrutvā tapastaptaṃ sudāruṇam \|*  
*bahukālaṃ tadā brahmadhyānamārgapareṇa hi \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. On hearing it Viṣṇu performed a terrible penance, for a long time, following the path of meditation.

## \|\| 2.6.50 \|\|

*tatassa puruṣo viṣṇuḥ prabuddho dhyānamārgataḥ \|*  
*suprīto vismayaṃ prāptaḥ kiṃ yattava mahā iti \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. That Being Viṣṇu became enlightened, following the path of meditation. He was delightfully surprised. “O what is that True entity?”

## \|\| 2.6.51 \|\|

*pariśramavatastasya viṣṇoḥ svāṅgebhya eva ca \|*  
*jaladhārā hi saṃyātā vividhāśśivamāyayā \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. From the body of Viṣṇu who thus exerted himself, water-currents of various sorts began to flow as a result of Śiva’s Māyā.

## \|\| 2.6.52 \|\|

*abhivyāptaṃ ca sakalaṃ śūnyaṃ yattanmahāmune \|*  
*brahmarūpaṃ jalamabhūtsparśanātpāpanāśanam \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. O great sage, the Supreme Brahman in the form of divine waters pervaded the entire void. A mere contact with the same is destructive of sins.

## \|\| 2.6.53 \|\|

*tadā śrāṃtaśca puruṣo viṣṇustasmiñjale svayam \|*  
*suṣvāpa parama prīto bahukālaṃ vimohitaḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Viṣṇu, the weary person went to sleep amidst the waters. He was in that blissful state of delusion for a long time.

## \|\| 2.6.54 \|\|

*nārāyaṇeti nāmāpi tasyasīcchrutisaṃmatam \|*  
*nānyatkiṃcittadā hyāsītprākṛtaṃ puruṣaṃ vinā \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. As approved in the Vedas, his name came to be established as Nārāyaṇa (Having water as abode). Excepting for that Primordial Being there was nothing then.

## \|\| 2.6.55 \|\|

*etasminnantare kāle tattvānyāsanmahātmanaḥ \|*  
*tatprakāraṃ śṛṇu prājña gadato me mahāmate \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. In the meantime, the Principles too were evolved out of the Great soul. O wise one of great intellect, listen to my enumeration of the same.

## \|\| 2.6.56 \|\|

*prakṛteśca mahānāsīnmahataśca guṇāstrayaḥ \|*  
*ahaṃkārastato jātastrividho guṇabhedataḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. From Prakṛti came into being the Mahat (cosmic Intellect), from Mahat the three Guṇas. Ahaṃkāra (the cosmic ego) arose therefrom in three forms according to the three Guṇas.

## \|\| 2.6.57 \|\|

*tanmātrāśca tato jātaḥ pañcabhūtāni vai tatā \|*  
*tadaiva tānīndriyāṇi jñānakarmamayāni ca \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. The Essences, the five elements, the senses of knowledge and action too came into being then.

## \|\| 2.6.58-59 \|\|

*tattvānāmiti saṃkhyānamuktaṃ te ṛṣisattama \|*  
*jaḍātmakañca tatsarvaṃ prakṛteḥ puruṣaṃ vinā \|\| 58 \|\|*

*tattadaikīkṛtaṃ tattvaṃ caturviṃśatisaṃkhyakam \|*  
*śivecchayā gṛhītvā sa suṣvāpa brahmarūpake \|\| 59 \|\|*

58-59. O most excellent of sages, I have thus enumerated the principles. All these principles originating from Prakṛti are insentient. but not the Puruṣa. These principles are twenty-four in number. Viṣṇu, the Puruṣa, accepted all these, as was the will of Śiva, and began his sleep in the Brahman.

## Chapter 7 - The dispute between Brahmā and Viṣṇu

## \|\| 2.7.1 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*supte nārāyaṇe deve nābhau paṃkajamuttamam \|*  
*āvirbabhūva sahasā bahava saṃkarecchayā \|\| 1 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

1\. When lord Nārāyaṇa continued to sleep, an excellent lotus of huge size came out of his navel as desired by Śiva.

## \|\| 2.7.2 \|\|

*anaṃtayaṣṭikāyuktaṃ karṇikārasamaprabham \|*  
*anaṃtayojanāyāmamanaṃtocchrāyasaṃyutam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. It was many Yojanas wide and high. It had an endless stalk. The pericarp was of a brilliant hue.

## \|\| 2.7.3 \|\|

*koṭisūryapratīkāśaṃ suṃdara vacasaṃyutam \|*  
*atyadbhutaṃ mahāramyaṃ darśanīyamanuttamam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. It was very beautiful with the brilliance of ten million suns. It was wonderful, excellent and worthy of vision containing Tattvas.

## \|\| 2.7.4 \|\|

*kṛtvā yatnaṃ pūrvavatsa śaṃkaraḥ parameśvaraḥ \|*  
*dakṣiṇāṃgānnijānmāṃ kaisāśīśśaṃbhurajījanat \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Exerting himself as before, Śiva, the great lord, with Pārvatī as his better half created me from His right limb.

## \|\| 2.7.5 \|\|

*sa māyāmohitaṃ kṛtvā māṃ maheśo drutaṃ mune \|*  
*tannābhipaṃkajādāvirbhāvayāmāsa līlayā \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. O sage, having deluded me with His illusion immediately, Śiva in the course of His sport, produced me through the umbilical lotus of Viṣṇu.

## \|\| 2.7.6 \|\|

*eṣa padmāttato jajñe putro'haṃ hemagarbhakaḥ \|*  
*caturmukho raktavarṇastripuḍrāṃkitamastakaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Thus it was that I came to be known as Lotus-born and conceived in a golden womb. I had four faces, red complexion and Tripuṇḍra-marked forehead.

## \|\| 2.7.7 \|\|

*tanmāyāmohitaścāhaṃ nāvidaṃ kamala vinā \|*  
*svadehajanakaṃ tāta pitaraṃ jñānadurbalaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Deluded by His illusion and weakened in knowledge, O dear one, I did not know who the progenitor of my body was, other than the lotus.

## \|\| 2.7.8 \|\|

*kohaṃ vā kuta āyātaḥ kiṃ kārya tu madīyakam \|*  
*kasya putro'hamutpannaḥ kenaiva nirmito'dhunā \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. “Who am I? Whence did I come? What is my duty? To whom was I born a son? By whom have I been created?”

## \|\| 2.7.9-11 \|\|

*iti saṃśayamāpannaṃ buddhirmāṃ samapadyata \|*  
*kimarthaṃ mohamāyāmi tajjñānaṃ sukaraṃ khalu \|\| 9 \|\|*

*etatkamalapuṣpasya patrārohasthalaṃ hyadhaḥ \|*  
*matkartā ca sa vai tatra bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*iti buddhiṃ samāsthāya kamalādavarohayan \|*  
*nāle nālegatastatra varṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ mune \|\| 11 \|\|*

9-11. My intellect became confused with these doubts. Then I thought “Why shall I be under delusion? It is easy to gain that knowledge. The place of growth of this lotus is below. My progenitor will undoubtedly be there.” Thinking thus I descended from the lotus. O sage, for a hundred years the downward trend continued.

## \|\| 2.7.12 \|\|

*na labdhaṃ tu mayā tatra kamalasthānamuttamam \|*  
*saṃśayaṃ ca punaḥ prāptaḥ kamale gantumutsukaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. The source of the lotus was not attained by me. In the doubt-tormented state I became eager to go up on to the top of the lotus.

## \|\| 2.7.13 \|\|

*ārurohātha kamalaṃ nālamārgeṇa vai mune \|*  
*kuḍmalaṃ kamalasyātha labdhavānna vimohitāḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. O sage, I climbed up to the lotus by the stalk.

But the upper part of the lotus I could not reach. I was disappointed.

## \|\| 2.7.14 \|\|

*nālamārgeṇa bhramato gataṃ varṣaśataṃ punaḥ \|*  
*kṣaṇamātra tadā tatra tatastiṣṭhanvimohitaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Another hundred years elapsed in my wandering up the lotus. I stopped a while in that confounded state.

## \|\| 2.7.15 \|\|

*tadā vāṇī samutpannā tapeti paramā śubhā \|*  
*śivecchayā parā vyomno mohavidhvaṃsinī mune \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Then, O sage, by the will of Śiva, an auspicious voice “Perform Penance” was heard from the sky which dispelled my delusion.

## \|\| 2.7.16 \|\|

*tacchrutvā vyomavacanaṃ dvādaśābdaṃ prayatnataḥ \|*  
*punastaptaṃ tapo ghoraṃ draṣṭuṃ svajanakaṃ tadā \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. On hearing the voice of the sky I exerted myself for twelve years in performing a terrible penance in order to see my progenitor.

## \|\| 2.7.17 \|\|

*tadā hi bhagavānviṣṇuścaturbāhussulocanaḥ \|*  
*mayyevānugrahaṃ kartuṃ drutamāvirbabhūva ha \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. At the same time, the four-armed lord Viṣṇu of beautiful eyes suddenly appeared before me in order to bless me.

## \|\| 2.7.18 \|\|

*śaṃkhacakrāyudhakaro gadāpadmadharaḥ paraḥ \|*  
*ghanaśyāmalasarvāṃgaḥ pītāmbaradharaḥ paraḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. The great lord was holding the conch, the discus, the mace and the lotus in his hands. He was wearing the yellow silken cloth and had cloud-blue complexion all over his body.

## \|\| 2.7.19 \|\|

*mukuṭādimahābhūṣaḥ prasannamukhapaṃkajaḥ \|*  
*koṭikaṃdarpasaṃkāśassandaṣṭo mohitena saḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. He had a crown. He was bedecked in great ornaments. His lotus-like face beamed with pleasure. Such was the lord resembling ten million Cupids that I saw still not out of delusion.

## \|\| 2.7.20-21 \|\|

*taddṛṣṭvā sundaraṃ rūpaṃ vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ \|*  
*kālābhaṃ kāṃcanābhaṃ ca sarvātmānaṃ caturbhujam \|\| 20 \|\|*

*tathābhūtamahaṃ dṛṣṭvā sadasanmayamātmanā \|*  
*nārāyaṇaṃ mahābāhu harṣito hyabhavaṃ tadā \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. At the sight of that beautiful form I was struck with wonder. On seeing the four-armed Nārāyaṇa, shining like Kāla, of golden hue, the immanent soul of all in that form, of large arms depicting the Sat and Asat in Himself I became delighted.

## \|\| 2.7.22 \|\|

*māyayā mohitaśśambhostadā līlātmanaḥ prabhoḥ \|*  
*avijñāya svajanakaṃ tamavocaṃ praharṣitaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Deluded by the illusion of Śiva, the sportive lord, I could not recognise my progenitor in him. I addressed him with delight.

## \|\| 2.7.23 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*kastvaṃ vadeti hastena samutthāpya sanātanam \|*  
*tadā hastaprahāreṇa tīvreṇa sudṛḍhena tu \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. “Who are you? Please tell me”, saying this I tried to wake the Eternal Being. \[When he did not wake up\] I tried to wake him up with fiercer and firmer beatings of the hand.

## \|\| 2.7.24 \|\|

*prabuddhyotthāya śayanātsamāsīnaḥ kṣaṇaṃ vaśī \|*  
*dadarśa nidrāviklinnanīrajāmalalocanaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Then the lord who had self-control woke up from his bed and sat. He looked up with his pure eyes resembling a wet lotus, due to sleep.

## \|\| 2.7.25 \|\|

*māmatra saṃsthitaṃ bhāsādhyāsito bhagavānhariḥ \|*  
*āha cotthāya brahmāṇaṃ hasanmāṃ madhuraṃ sakṛt \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. As I stood there quietly, the lord Viṣṇu spread his brilliance over me. Standing up he smiled once and spoke these sweet words.

## \|\| 2.7.26 \|\|

*viṣṇuruvāca \|*  
*svāgataṃ svāgataṃ vatsa pitāmaha mahādyute \|*  
*nirbhayo bhava dāsye'haṃ sarvānkāmānna saṃśayaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Viṣṇu said:—“Welcome, welcome to you, dear child, O Pitāmaha of great brilliance. Do not be afraid. Undoubtedly I shall confer on you all that you desire.

## \|\| 2.7.27 \|\|

*tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā smitapūrvaṃ surarṣabhaḥ \|*  
*rajasā baddhavairaśca tamavocaṃ janārdanam \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. O foremost among gods, on hearing these words uttered with a smile I told Viṣṇu with my inimical attitude roused by the Rajoguṇa.

## \|\| 2.7.28 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*bhāṣase vatsa vatseti sarvasaṃhārakāraṇam \|*  
*māmihāti smitaṃ kṛtvā guruśśiṣyamivānagha \|\| 28 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

28\. “O faultless one, how is it that you speak of me trivially as “Dear child”, me who am the cause of annihilation of everything, as a preceptor addresses his disciple?

## \|\| 2.7.29-30 \|\|

*kartāraṃ jagatāṃ sākṣātprakṛteśca pravartakam \|*  
*sanātanamajaṃ viṣṇuṃ viriṃciṃ viṣṇusaṃbhavam \|\| 29 \|\|*

*viśvātmānaṃ vidhātāraṃ dhātārampaṃkajekṣaṇam \|*  
*kimarthaṃ bhāṣase mohādvaktumarhasi satvaram \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. “I am the creator of worlds, the direct activiser of Prakṛti, unborn, the eternal, all-pervasive Brahmā. I am born of Viṣṇu. I am the soul of universe, the originator, creator, and the lotus-eyed. You must explain to me quickly why you speak like this.

## \|\| 2.7.31 \|\|

*vedo māṃ vakti niyamātsvayaṃbhuvamajaṃ vibhum \|*  
*pitāmahaṃ svarājaṃ ca parameṣṭhinamuttamam \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. The Vedas speak of me invariably as self-born, unborn, all-pervasive, grandfather, self-governed and the excellent supreme Being.

## \|\| 2.7.32-35 \|\|

*ityākarṇya harirvākyaṃ mama kruddho ramāpatiḥ \|*  
*so'pi māmāha jāne tvāṃ kartāramiti lokataḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

*viṣṇuruvāca \|*  
*kartuṃ dharttuṃ bhavānaṃgādavatīrṇo mamāvyayāt \|*  
*vismṛto'si jagannāthaṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam \|\| 33 \|\|*

*puruṣaṃ paramātmānaṃ puruhūtaṃ puruṣṭutam \|*  
*viṣṇumacyutamīśānaṃ viśvasya prabhavodbhavam \|\| 34 \|\|*

*nārāyaṇaṃ mahābāhuṃ sarvavyāpa kamīśvaram \|*  
*mannābhipadmatastvaṃ hi prasūto nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

32-35. On hearing these words of Hari, the lord of Lakṣmī became angry and told me thus:—

## \|\| 2.7.36 \|\|

*tavāparādho nāstyatra tvayi māyākṛtaṃ mama \|*  
*śṛṇu satyaṃ caturvaktra sarvadeveśvaro hyaham \|\| 36 \|\|*

Viṣṇu said:—

“I know you as the creator of the world. For the sake of creation and support you are descended from my undecaying limbs. You have forgotten me, who am a lord of universe, abiding in waters the salubrious, the supreme soul, invoked by many, praised by many, All-pervasive, imperishable, ruler, the source and origin of universe, the longarmed and the ommipresent lord. There is no doubt in this that you are born of the lotus from my umbilicus.

36\. “Of course, it is not your fault. I have exercised my power of illusion over you. O four-faced one, listen to the truth. I am the lord of all Gods.

## \|\| 2.7.37 \|\|

*kartā hartā ca bhartā ca na mayāstisamo vibhuḥ \|*  
*ahameva paraṃ brahma paraṃ tattvaṃ pitāmaha \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. “I am the creator, sustainer and destroyer. There is no powerful person equal to me. O Pitāmaha, I am the supreme Brahman, the greatest Truth.

## \|\| 2.7.38-39 \|\|

*ahameva paraṃ jyotiḥ paramātmā tvahaṃ vibhuḥ \|*  
*adya dṛṣṭaṃ śrutaṃ sarvaṃ jagatyasmiṃścarācaram \|\| 38 \|\|*

*tattadviddhi caturvaktra sarvaṃ manmayamityatha \|*  
*mayā sṛṣṭaṃ purā vyaktaṃ caturviṃśatitattvakam \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. “I am the greatest light. I am the great Ātman. I am the omnipresent. O four-faced one, whatever in seen or heard today in the whole universe, whether mobile or immobile is enveloped by me. It was I who created the twenty-four manifest Tattvas.

## \|\| 2.7.40 \|\|

*nityaṃ teṣvaṇavo baddhāssṛṣṭakrodhabhayādayaḥ \|*  
*prabhāvācca bhavānaṃgānyanekānīha līlayā \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. “I have created the atoms. I have created the qualities of anger, fear etc. Powerful and sportive I have created their parts and limbs.

## \|\| 2.7.41 \|\|

*sṛṣṭā buddhirmayā tasyāmahaṃkārastridhā tataḥ \|*  
*tanmātraṃ paṃkajaṃ tasmānmanodehendriyāṇi ca \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. “I have created the Intellect and the threefold Ego therein. I have evolved the five subtle elements, the mind, the body and the sense-organs.

## \|\| 2.7.42 \|\|

*ākāśādīni bhūtāni bhautikāni ca līlayā \|*  
*iti buddhvā prajānātha śaraṇaṃ vraja me vidhe \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. I have created the elements Ether etc. and all created beings out of sheer sport. Realising this, O Brahmā, the lord of subjects, seek refuge in me.

## \|\| 2.7.43 \|\|

*ahaṃ tvāṃ sarvaduḥkhebhyo rakṣiṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*brahmovāca \|*  
*iti śrutvā vacastasya brahmā krodhasamanvitaḥ \|*  
*ko vā tvamiti saṃbhartsmābruvaṃ māyāvimohitaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. “I shall certainly protect you from all miseries.”

## \|\| 2.7.44 \|\|

*kimarthaṃ bhāṣase bhūri vahvanarthakaraṃ vacaḥ \|*  
*neśvarastvaṃ parabrahma kaścitkartā bhavettava \|\| 44 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

On hearing these words, I, proud of being Brahmā, became angry. Being deluded by illusion in a threatening attitude I asked him “who are you?”

44\. “Why do you talk so much? Your words will bring up disaster. You are neither the lord, nor the supreme Brahman. There must be a creator of yours.”

## \|\| 2.7.45 \|\|

*māyayā mohitaścāhaṃ yuddhaṃ cakre sudāruṇam \|*  
*hariṇā tena vai sārddhaṃ śaṃkarasya mahāprabhoḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Deluded by the illusion created by Śiva the great lord, I fought a terrific battle with Viṣṇu.

## \|\| 2.7.46 \|\|

*evaṃ mama hareścāsītsaṃgaro romaharṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*pralayārṇavamadhye tu rajasā baddhavairayoḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Inimical to each other due to Rajoguṇa, we fought a fierce battle in the middle of that vast expanse of the sea of Dissolution.

## \|\| 2.7.47 \|\|

*etasminnaṃtare liṃgamabhavaccāvayoḥ puraḥ \|*  
*vivādaśamanārthaṃ hi prabodhārthaṃ tathā''vayoḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

4 7. Meanwhile a phallic image appeared before us in order to enlighten us and to settle out dispute.

## \|\| 2.7.48 \|\|

*jlāmālāsahasrāḍhyaṃ kālānalaśatopamam \|*  
*kṣayavṛddhi vinirmuktamādimadhyāṃtavarjitam \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. It had no beginning, middle or end. It had neither decrease nor increase. It was as furious as hundreds of the fire of death with thousands of leaping rows of flames.

## \|\| 2.7.49 \|\|

*anaupamyamanirdeśyamavyaktaṃ viśvasaṃbhavam \|*  
*tasya jvālāsahasreṇa mohito bhagavānhariḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. It was unequalled, inexpressible unmanifest universal Being. The lord Viṣṇu became unconscious by its thousand flames.

## \|\| 2.7.50 \|\|

*mohitaṃ cāha māmatra kimarthaṃ sparddhase'dhunā \|*  
*āgatastu tṛtīyo'tra tiṣṭhatāṃ yuddhamāvayoḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. When I too became senseless, Viṣṇu said to me. Oh, why do you contend with me now? A third person has now come. Let our quarrel cease.

## \|\| 2.7.51 \|\|

*kuta evātra saṃbhūtaḥ parīkṣāvo 'gnisaṃbhavam \|*  
*adho gamiṣyāmyanalastaṃbhasyānupamasya ca \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Whence has this arisen? Let us examine this fire-Being. I shall go down to find the root of this matchless column of fire.

## \|\| 2.7.52 \|\|

*parīkṣārthaṃ prajānātha tasya vai vāyuvegataḥ \|*  
*bhavānūrddhvaṃ prayatnena gaṃtumarhati satvaram \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. “O lord of subjects, with the speed of the wind you will please go up to examine its top.”

Brahmā continues the story:—

## \|\| 2.7.53 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*evaṃ vyāhṛtya viśvātmā svarūpamakarottadā \|*  
*vārāhamahapyāśu haṃsatvaṃ prāptavānmune \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Having said so, Viṣṇu assumed the form of a Boar. O sage, I became a swan immediately.

## \|\| 2.7.54 \|\|

*tadā prabhṛti māmāhurhaṃsahaṃso virāḍiti \|*  
*haṃsahaṃseti yo brūyātsa haṃso'tha bhaviṣyati \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. From that time onwards, people call me Haṃsa-Haṃsa, a supreme Being, Virāṭ, an illustrious Being. He who repeats ‘HaṃsaHaṃsa’, shall become a swan (a symbol of purity and discrimination.

## \|\| 2.7.55 \|\|

*suśve hyanalaprakhyo viśvataḥ pakṣasaṃyutaḥ \|*  
*manonilajavo bhūtvā gatvorddhvaṃ corddhvataḥ purā \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. Very white of complexion and endowed with wings on either side I flew up and up with the speed of the mind and wind.

## \|\| 2.7.56-58 \|\|

*nārāyaṇo'pi viśvātmā suśveto hyabhavattadā \|*  
*daśa yojanavistīrṇaṃ śatayojanamāyatam \|\| 56 \|\|*

*meruparvatavarṣmāṇaṃ gauratīkṣṇogradaṃṣṭriṇam \|*  
*kālādityasamābhāsaṃ dīrghaghoṇaṃ mahāsvanam \|\| 57 \|\|*

*hrasvapādaṃ vicitrāṃgaṃ jaitraṃ dṛḍhamanaupamam \|*  
*vārāhākāramāsthāya gatavāṃstadadhau javāt \|\| 58 \|\|*

56-58. Nārāyaṇa, the soul of the universe too, became white then. His body was ten yojanas wide and a hundred yojanas long, as huge as the mountain Meru. He had white sharp teeth. His brilliance resembled the sun at the time of dissolution. His snort was long and his roar tremendous. His feet were short. His limbs were of diverse colours. His form as the boar was of matchless firmness which assured his eagerness to be victorious, and he went down quickly.

## \|\| 2.7.59 \|\|

*evambarṣasahasraṃ ca caranviṣṇuradho gataḥ \|*  
*tathāprabhṛti lokeṣu śvetavārāhasaṃjñakaḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. For a thousand years his downward course continued. From that time onwards Viṣṇu came to be called “Śvetavārāha” (white Boar) in all the worlds.

## \|\| 2.7.60 \|\|

*kalpo babhūva devarṣe narāṇāṃ kālasaṃjñakaḥ \|*  
*babhrāma bahudhā viṣṇuḥ prabhaviṣṇuradhogataḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. A Kalpa had elapsed according to human calculation when Viṣṇu thus went down and wandered in his eagerness to come out victorious.

## \|\| 2.7.61 \|\|

*nāpaśyadalpamapyasya mūlaṃ liṃgasya sūkaraḥ \|*  
*tāvatkālaṃ gataścorddhvamahamapyarisūdana \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. The Boar did not find even the smallest trace of the root of the Liṅga. O, destroyer of enemies, I too spent the same time in going up.

## \|\| 2.7.62 \|\|

*satvaraṃ sarvayatnena tasyāntaṃ jñātumicchayā \|*  
*śrānto na dṛṣṭvā tasyāṃtamahaṃ kālādadhogataḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. From a desire to know its top as quickly as possible I exerted myself and was exhausted. Unable to see the top I came down after some time.

## \|\| 2.7.63 \|\|

*tathaiva bhagavānviṣṇuścāṃtaṃ kamalalocanaḥ \|*  
*sarvadevanibhastūrṇamutthitassa mahāvapuḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Similarly, lord Viṣṇu, the lotus-eyed, too became weary. Appearing like the lord of everything in his huge body he too rose up.

## \|\| 2.7.64 \|\|

*samāgato mayā sārddhaṃ praṇipatya bhavaṃ muhuḥ \|*  
*māyayā mohitaśśaṃbhostasthau saṃvignamānasaḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. As soon as he came up, we bowed to Śiva again and again. He stood aside with a gloomy mind as he too was deluded by the illusion of Śiva.

## \|\| 2.7.65 \|\|

*pṛṣṭhataḥ pārśvataścaiva hyagrataḥ parameśvaram \|*  
*praṇipatya mayā sārddhaṃ sasmāra kimidaṃ tviti \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. We bowed down to Liṅga at His back, sides and in front. He mused within himself “What can this be?”

## \|\| 2.7.66 \|\|

*anirdeśyaṃ ca tadrūpamanāma karmavarjitam \|*  
*aliṃgaṃ liṃgatāṃ prāptaṃ dhyānamārgepyagocaram \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. “That form can’t be directly expressed. It is without action and name. Without any sex-distinction it has become a liṅga. It is beyond the path of meditation.

## \|\| 2.7.67 \|\|

*svasthaṃ cittaṃ tadā kṛtvā namaskāra parāyaṇo \|*  
*babhūvaturubhāvāvāmahaṃ harirapi dhruvam \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. Both of us, Hari and I, with the peace of our minds, became eager to perform obeisance.

## \|\| 2.7.68 \|\|

*jānīvo na hi te rūpaṃ yo'siyo'si mahāprabho \|*  
*namo'stu te maheśāna rūpaṃ darśaya nau tvaran \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. “We do not know Thy true form, what Thou art Thou art, O great lord. Obeisance be to Thee, O Maheśāna. Please hurry up to reveal Thy form to us.”

## \|\| 2.7.69 \|\|

*evaṃ śaracchatānyāsannamaskāraṃ prakurvatoḥ \|*  
*āvayormuniśārdūla madamāsthitayostadā \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. Thus performing obeisance and prayer to quell our earlier pride, O foremost of sages, we spent a hundred autumns therein.

## Chapter 8 - The description of the body of Śabdabrahman

## \|\| 2.8.1-2 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*evaṃ tayormuniśreṣṭha darśanaṃ kāṃkṣamāṇayoḥ \|*  
*vigarvayośca surayoḥ sadā nau sthitayormune \|\| 1 \|\|*

*dayālurabhavacchaṃbhurdīnānāṃ pratipālakaḥ \|*  
*garviṇāṃ garvahartā ca saveṣāṃ prabhuravyayaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

1-2. O most excellent sage, we were eager to have a vision of the lord. Our haughtiness had been curbed. O sage, we waited there patiently. Śiva, the protector of the distressed, remover of the haughtiness of the haughty and the undecaying lord of everything took mercy on us.

## \|\| 2.8.3 \|\|

*tadā samabhavattatra nādo vai śabdalakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*omomiti suraśreṣṭhātsuvyaktaḥ plutalakṣaṇaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. There arose the sound “Oṃ Oṃ” in the prolated accent. It was very clear. The divine sound in the form of a word came out from the most excellent of Gods.

## \|\| 2.8.4-5 \|\|

*kimidaṃ tviti saṃciṃtya mayā tiṣṭhanmahāsvanaḥ \|*  
*viṣṇussarvasurārādhyo nirvairastuṣṭacetasā \|\| 4 \|\|*

*liṃgasya dakṣiṇe bhāge tathāpaśyatsanātanam \|*  
*ādyaṃ varṇamakārākhyamukāraṃ cottaraṃ tataḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. “What shall be this great sound?” thinking like this I stood perplexed. Viṣṇu who is worthy of respect from all the Gods, who is free from all inimical thoughts, saw with the delightful heart, the eternal being’s manifestation on the right side of the liṅga. First, he saw the syllable “A” and he saw the syllable “U” thereafter.

## \|\| 2.8.6-10 \|\|

*makāraṃ madhyataścaiva nādamaṃte'sya comiti \|*  
*sūryamaṃḍalavaddṛṣṭvā varṇamādyaṃ tu dakṣiṇe \|\| 6 \|\|*

*uttare pāvakaprakhyamukāramṛṣi sattama \|*  
*śītāṃśumaṇḍalaprakhyaṃ makāraṃ tasya madhyataḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*tasyopari tadā'paśyacchuddhasphaṭikasuprabham \|*  
*turīyātītamamalaṃ niṣkalaṃ nirupadravam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*nirdvaṃdvaṃ kevalaṃ śūnyaṃ bāhyābhyaṃtaravarjitam \|*  
*sa bāhyabhyaṃtare caiva bāhyābhyaṃtarasaṃsthitam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*ādimadhyāṃtarahitamānaṃdasyāpikāraṇam \|*  
*satyamānandamamṛtaṃ paraṃ brahmaparāyaṇam \|\| 10 \|\|*

6-10. He saw the syllable “M” in the middle and Nāda (the mystical sound) in the form “Oṃ” in the end. He saw the first syllable on the right like the blazing sphere of the sun. O foremost of sages, thereafter he saw the syllable “U” dazzling like fire. In the middle he saw the syllable “M” glittering like the lunar sphere. Above that what he saw was the supreme Brahman, the greatest refuge. It had the lustre of the pure crystal. It was the pure Being beyond the Fourth (Turīya), the unsullied & free from extraneous harassment. It was free from mutually clashing opposites. It was single (isolated), void, free from exterior and interior though stationed in the exterior and the interior, devoid of beginning, middle and end, the primordial cause of Bliss, the truth, The Bliss and the Nectar.

## \|\| 2.8.11-12 \|\|

*kuta evātra saṃbhūtaḥ parīkṣāvo'gnisaṃbhavam \|*  
*adhogamiṣyāmyanalastaṃbhasyānupamasya ca \|\| 11 \|\|*

*vedaśabdobhayāveśaṃ viśvātmānaṃ vyaciṃtayat \|*  
*tadā'bhavadṛṣistatra ṛṣessāratamaṃ smṛtam \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. Viṣṇu thus meditated on the universal soul enveloped by the two Vedic sounds and wished to examine the source whence the Fire-column arose and to go deep down the unequalled fiery column. Then there came a sage who told him the essence of the truth.

## \|\| 2.8.13 \|\|

*tenaiva ṛṣiṇā viṣṇurjñātavānparameśvaram \|*  
*mahādevaṃ paraṃ brahma śabdabrahmatanuṃ param \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Viṣṇu realised that the sage himself was the great lord and the supreme Brahman embodied in the Śabda Brahman. (i.e. the mystic syllable Om).

## \|\| 2.8.14 \|\|

*ciṃtayā rahito rudro vāco yanmanasā saha \|*  
*aprāpya tannivartaṃte vācyastvekākṣareṇa saḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. The Brahman is Rudra free from worries. The words and the mind are incapable of comprehending it; without reaching it they return. It can be expressed by the single-syllabled mantra “Om”.

## \|\| 2.8.15 \|\|

*ekākṣareṇa tadvākyamṛtaṃ paramakāraṇam \|*  
*satyamānandamamṛtaṃ paraṃ brahma parātparam \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The supreme Brahman, the Truth, the Bliss, the Amṛta, the greatest of the great and the ultimate cause can be expressed by the single-syllabled mantra.

## \|\| 2.8.16 \|\|

*ekākṣarādakārākhyādbhagavānbījakoṇḍajaḥ \|*  
*ekākṣarādukārākhyāddhariḥ paramakāraṇam \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. The single syllable “A” is the source of the lord Brahmā. The single syllable “U” is the source of Viṣṇu, the ultimate cause.

## \|\| 2.8.17 \|\|

*ekākṣarānmakārākhyādbhagavānnīlalohitaḥ \|*  
*sargakartā tvakārākhyo hyukārākhyastu mohakaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. The single syllable “M” is the source of Rudra. The creator is expressed by the letter “A”. The enchanter is expressed by the letter “U”

## \|\| 2.8.18 \|\|

*makārākhyastu yo nityamanugrahakaro'bhavat \|*  
*makārākhyo vibhurbījī hyakāro bīja ucyate \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. The being expressed by the letter “M” blesses always. It is all-pervasive and progenitor; the letter “A” is the seed.

## \|\| 2.8.19 \|\|

*ukārākhyo hariryoniḥ pradhānapuruṣeśvaraḥ \|*  
*bījī ca bījaṃ tadyonirnādākhyaśca maheśvaraḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. The being expressed by the letter “U” is Viṣṇu. It is the source, the receptacle, the lord of primordial nature and primordial being, the progenitor, the seed, source and sound. All these constitute Lord Śiva.

## \|\| 2.8.20 \|\|

*bījī vibhajya cātmānaṃ svecchayā tu vyavasthitaḥ \|*  
*asya liṃgādabhūdbījamakāro bījinaḥ prabhoḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. The progenitor is stationed after dividing itself. From the liṅga of the progenitor, the lord, arose the seed—the syllable “A”

## \|\| 2.8.21 \|\|

*ukārayonau niḥkṣiptamavarddhata samaṃtataḥ \|*  
*sauvarṇamabhavaccāṃḍamāvedya tadalakṣaṇam \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. The Bīja being deposited in the Yoni, the letter “U” began to increase all round. It became a golden egg. It was something known which could not be delineated.

## \|\| 2.8.22 \|\|

*anekābdaṃ tathā cāpsu divyamaṃḍaṃ vyavasthitam \|*  
*tato varṣasahasrāṃte dvidhākṛtamajodbhavam \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. The divine egg floated in the waters for many years. Then at the end of a thousand years, it split into two giving birth to Brahmā.

## \|\| 2.8.23-24 \|\|

*aṃḍamapsu sthitaṃ sākṣādvyāghāteneśvareṇa tu \|*  
*tathāsya suśubhaṃ haimaṃ kapālaṃ corddhvasaṃsthitam \|\| 23 \|\|*

*jajñe sā dyaustadaparaṃ pṛthivī paṃcalakṣaṇā \|*  
*tasmādaṃḍādbhavo jajñe kakārākhyaścaturmukhaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. The egg floating in the waters on being hit by Īśvara split into two. The auspicious golden upper lid became the upper region and the lower one became the Earth of five characteristics. From (the inner part of) the egg was born the four-faced lord (Brahmā) expressed by the letter “KA”

## \|\| 2.8.25 \|\|

*sa sraṣṭā sarvalokānāṃ sa eva trividhaḥ prabhuḥ \|*  
*evamomomiti proktamityāhuryajuṣāṃ varāḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. He is the creator of all the worlds. He alone is the lord manifesting in three forms. Persons well-versed in the Yajurveda call it Oṃ Oṃ.

## \|\| 2.8.26 \|\|

*yajuṣāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā ṛcaḥ samāni sādaram \|*  
*evameva hare brahmannityāhuścāvayostadā \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. On hearing the words of the Yajurveda, both the Ṛgveda and the Sāmaveda respectfully called us then Viṣṇu and Brahmā.

## \|\| 2.8.27 \|\|

*tato vijñāya deveśaṃ yathāvacchaktisaṃbhavaiḥ \|*  
*maṃtraṃ maheśvaraṃ devaṃ tuṣṭāva sumahodayam \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Then realising the lord of the Gods we eulogised, as far as we could, Lord Śiva, the cause of great achievement.

## \|\| 2.8.28 \|\|

*etasminnaṃtare'nyacca rūpamadbhutasundaram \|*  
*dadarśa ca mayā sārddhaṃ bhagavānviśvapālakaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Viṣṇu, the protector of the universe, in the meantime, saw another wonderfully beautiful form, along with me.

## \|\| 2.8.29-30 \|\|

*paṃcavaktraṃ daśabhujaṃ gaurakarpūravanmune \|*  
*nānākāṃti samāyuktaṃ nānābhūṣaṇabhūṣitam \|\| 29 \|\|*

*mahodāraṃ mahāvīryaṃ mahāpuruṣalaṇam \|*  
*taṃ dṛṣṭvā paramaṃ rūpaṃ kṛtārtho'bhūnmayā hariḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. On seeing that wonderful form, Viṣṇu and I became satisfied. The form had five faces, ten arms, and a complexion white as camphor, O sage. It had diverse brilliant features. It was decorated in different ornaments. It was highly liberal and endowed with great prowess. It had all the characteristics of a great man.

## \|\| 2.8.31 \|\|

*atha prasanno bhagavānmaheśaḥ parameśvaraḥ \|*  
*divyaṃ śabdamayaṃ rūpamākhyāya prahasansthitaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Thereafter, the lord Śiva was pleased. Revealing his form embedded in letters He laughingly stood before us.

## \|\| 2.8.32 \|\|

*akārastasya mūrddhā hi lalāṭo dīrgha ucyate \|*  
*ikāro dakṣiṇaṃ netramīkāro vāmalocanam \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. The short letter “A” is His head. The long letter “A” is His forehead. The letter “I” is His right eye and the letter “Ī” His left eye.

## \|\| 2.8.33 \|\|

*ukāro dakṣiṇaṃ śrotramūkāro vāma ucyate \|*  
*ṛkāro dakṣiṇaṃ tasya kapolaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. The letter “U” is His right ear and the letter “Ū” His left ear. The letter “Ṛ” is the right cheek of that great lord.

## \|\| 2.8.34 \|\|

*vāmaṃ kapolamūkāro lṛ lṝ nāsāpuṭe ubhe \|*  
*ekāraścoṣṭha ūrddhvaśca hyaikārastvadharo vibhoḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. “Ṝ” is His left cheek. The two letters “ḷ” “ḹ”, are His nostrils. The letter “E” is His upper lip and the letter “AI” is His lower lip.

## \|\| 2.8.35 \|\|

*okāraśca tathaukāro dantapaṃktidvayaṃ kramāt \|*  
*amastu tālunī tasya devadevasya śūlinaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. The letter “O” and the letter “AU” are respectively the two rows of his teeth. The letters “AṂ” and “AḤ” \[Anusvāra and Visarga\] are his palates.

## \|\| 2.8.36 \|\|

*kādipaṃcākṣarāṇyasya pañca hastāśca dakṣiṇe \|*  
*cādipaṃcākṣarāṇyevaṃ paṃca hastāstu vāmataḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. The five letters beginning with KA \[ie KA, KHA, GA, GHA and ṄA\] are His five hands on the right side. The five letters beginning with CA \[i.e. CA, CH, JA, JHA and ÑA\] are His hands on the left side.

## \|\| 2.8.37 \|\|

*ṭādipaṃcākṣaraṃ pādāstādipaṃcākṣaraṃ tathā \|*  
*pakāra udaraṃ tasya phakāraḥ pārśva ucyate \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Similarly the five letters beginning with ṬA and the five letters beginning with TA constitute His legs. The letter PA is His belly and the letter PHA is His right side.

## \|\| 2.8.38 \|\|

*bakāro vāmapārśvastu bhakāraḥ skaṃdha ucyate \|*  
*makāro hṛdayaṃ śaṃbhormahādevasya yoginaḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. The letter BA is His left side. The letter BHA is His shoulder. The letter MA is the heart of the great yogin Mahādeva.

## \|\| 2.8.39 \|\|

*yakārādisakārāntā vibhorvai saptadhātavaḥ \|*  
*hakāro nābhirūpo hi kṣakāro ghrāṇa ucyate \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. The letters YA, RA, LA, VA, ŚA, ṢA and SA are the seven Dhātus (vital secretions) of the lord. The letter HA is His umbilicus and the letter KṢA is His nose.

## \|\| 2.8.40 \|\|

*evaṃ śabdamayaṃ rūpamaguṇasya guṇātmanaḥ \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā tamumayā sārddhaṃ kṛtārtho'bhūnmayā hariḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Viṣṇu and I became contented on seeing this letter-embedded form of the Saguṇa manifestation of Nirguṇa lord in the company of Umā.

## \|\| 2.8.41 \|\|

*evaṃ dṛṣṭvā maheśānaṃ śabdabrahmatanuṃ śivam \|*  
*praṇamya ca mayā viṣṇuḥ punaścāpaśyadūrddhvataḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. On seeing Lord Śiva in the form of the letter-embedded Brahman, Viṣṇu bowed down along with me and looked up again.

## \|\| 2.8.42-47 \|\|

*oṃkāraprabhavaṃ maṃtraṃ kalāpaṃcakasaṃyutam \|*  
*śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ śubhāṣṭatriṃśadakṣaram \|\| 42 \|\|*

*medhākāramabhūdbhūyassarvadharmārthasādhakam \|*  
*gāyatrīprabhavaṃ maṃtraṃ sahitaṃ vaśyakārakam \|\| 43 \|\|*

*caturviṃśativarṇāḍhyaṃ catuṣkālamanuttamam \|*  
*atha paṃcasitaṃ maṃtraṃ kalāṣṭaka samāyutam \|\| 44 \|\|*

*ābhicārikamatyarthaṃ prāyastriṃśacchubhākṣaram \|*  
*yajurvedasamāyuktaṃ pañcaviṃśacchubhākṣaram \|\| 45 \|\|*

*kalāṣṭakasamā yuktaṃ suśvetaṃ śāṃtikaṃ tathā \|*  
*trayodaśakalāyuktaṃ bālādyaissaha lohitam \|\| 46 \|\|*

*babhūvurasya cotpattivṛddhisaṃhārakāraṇam \|*  
*varṇā ekādhikāḥ ṣaṣṭirasya maṃtravarasya tu \|\| 47 \|\|*

42-47. The mantra beginning with Oṃkāra with its Kalās five in number, consisting of the auspicious thirty-eight syllables, being pure as crystal, increases intelligence and is an effective medium of accomplishing sacred rites. The mantras in the Gāyatrī metre of twenty-four syllables and having four Kalās are conducive to enjoyment. The five-syllabled mantra of eight Kalās consisting of thirty syllables is employed for black magic. Mantras of Yajurveda consisting of twenty-five syllables and eight Kalās are used for conciliatory purpose. The mantra of thirteen Kalās consisting of sixty-one syllables is conducive to outcome, increase and destruction.

## \|\| 2.8.48-49 \|\|

*punarmṛtyuṃjayaṃ mantraṃ pañcākṣaramataḥ param \|*  
*ciṃtāmaṇiṃ tathā maṃtraṃ dakṣiṇāmūrti saṃjñakam \|\| 48 \|\|*

*tatastattvamasītyuktaṃ mahāvākyaṃ harasya ca \|*  
*pañcamaṃtrāṃstathā labdhvā jajāpa bhagavānhariḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

48-49. The lord Viṣṇu secured these five mantras:—Mṛtyuñjaya mantra, five-syllabled mantra, Cintāmaṇi mantra, Dakṣiṇāmūrti mantra and the “tattvamasi” mantra which is Hara’s Mahāvākya. Lord Viṣṇu performed Japa by means of these mantras.

## \|\| 2.8.50-53 \|\|

*atha dṛṣṭvā kalāvarṇamṛgyajussāmarūpiṇam \|*  
*īśānamīśamukuṭaṃ puruṣākhyaṃ purātanam \|\| 50 \|\|*

*aghorahṛdayaṃ hṛdyaṃ sarvaguhyaṃ sadāśivam \|*  
*vāmapādaṃ mahādevaṃ mahābhogīndrabhūṣaṇam \|\| 51 \|\|*

*viśvataḥ pādavantaṃ taṃ viśvatokṣikaraṃ śivam \|*  
*brahmaṇo'dhipati sargasthitisaṃhārakāraṇam \|\| 52 \|\|*

*tuṣṭāva vāgbhiriṣṭābhissāmbaṃ varadamīśvaram \|*  
*mayā ca sahito viṣṇurbhagavāṃstuṣṭacetasā \|\| 53 \|\|*

50-53. The lord Viṣṇu and I being glad at heart eulogised the boon-bestowing lord Śiva with appropriate words,—Śiva who was seen in the form of Kalās, Varṇas (syllables), Ṛk, Yajus, Sāman, Īśāna, Īśa, Purātana Puruṣa (the ancient Being), the merciful, pleasing to the heart, hidden from all, ever auspicious, a great deity, of beautiful feet, bedecked with huge serpents, with legs, eyes and hands extending on all sides, the lord of Brahmā, and the cause of creation, sustenance and destruction of the world.

## Chapter 9 - Description of Śivatattva

## \|\| 2.9.1 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*athākarṇya nurtiviṣṇukṛtāṃ svasya maheśvaraḥ \|*  
*prādurbabhūva suprītassavāmaṃ karuṇānidhiḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

1\. On hearing his own eulogy from the mouth of Viṣṇu, the delighted Śiva, the store-house of kindness, revealed Himself to us along with his consort.

## \|\| 2.9.2-3 \|\|

*paṃcavaktrastrinayano bhālacandro jaṭādharaḥ \|*  
*gauravarṇo viśālākṣo bhasmoddhūlitavigrahaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*daśabāhurnīlagala sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ \|*  
*sarvāṃgasundaro bhasmatripuṇḍrāṃkitamastakaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. He had five faces and three eyes, and the crescent moon on his forehead. He wore matted hair. He was white-complexioned and had wide eyes. His body had been dusted with the ashes. He had ten arms. His neck was blue in colour. He was bedecked with all ornaments. He was very handsome with respect to every limb. Three ash-lines marked His forehead.

## \|\| 2.9.4 \|\|

*taṃ dṛṣṭvā tādṛśaṃ devaṃ savāmaṃ parameśvaram \|*  
*tuṣṭāva punariṣṭābhirvāgbhirviṣṇurmayā saha \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. On seeing lord Śiva accompanied by His beautiful consort, Viṣṇu along with me eulogised Him again with appropriate words.

## \|\| 2.9.5-6 \|\|

*nigamaṃ śvāsarūpeṇa dadau tasmai tato haraḥ \|*  
*viṣṇave ca prasannātmā maheśaḥ karuṇākaraḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*tato jñānamadāttasmai haraye paramātmane \|*  
*paramātmā punarmahyaṃ dattavānkṛpayā mune \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. Śiva, the merciful, who was delighted breathed the Vedas into Viṣṇu and conferred Perfect Knowledge on him, the secret of the supreme Ātman. O sage, thereafter, out of sympathy, the supreme Ātman conferred these on me too.

## \|\| 2.9.7 \|\|

*saṃprāpya nigamaṃ viṣṇuḥ papraccha punareva tam \|*  
*kṛtārthassāṃjalirnatvā mayā saha maheśvaram \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. After receiving the Vedas, Viṣṇu was satisfied and bowing to Him with palms joined in reverence along with me, he asked the lord Śiva.

## \|\| 2.9.8 \|\|

*viṣṇuruvāca \|*  
*kathaṃ ca tuṣyase deva mayā pūjyaḥ kathaṃ prabho \|*  
*kathaṃ dhyānaṃ prakartavyaṃ kathaṃ vrajasi vaśyatām \|\| 8 \|\|*

Viṣṇu said:—

8\. “O Lord, How are you propitiated? How shall I worship you, O lord? How shall I meditate on you? How are you impressed by any one?

## \|\| 2.9.9 \|\|

*kiṃ kartavyaṃ mahādeva hyāvābhyāṃ tava śāsanāt \|*  
*sadāsadājñāpaya nau prītyarthaṃ kuru śaṃkara \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. O Great God, tell us what at Thy bidding shall we ever do? Please command us, O Śiva, do this to favour us.

## \|\| 2.9.10 \|\|

*etatsarvaṃ mahārāja kṛpāṃ kṛtvā'vayoḥ prabho \|*  
*kathanīyaṃ tathānyacca vijñāya svānugau śiva \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. O Great lord, be merciful to tell us all these things. O Śiva, we are your followers. Taking this into mind, you will enlighten us on these and other similar points too.

## \|\| 2.9.11 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*ityetadvacanaṃ śrutvā prasanno bhagavānharaḥ \|*  
*uvāca vacanaṃ prītyā suprasannaḥ kṛpānidhiḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

11\. On hearing these words, the lord Śiva was delighted. The merciful lord then spoke lovingly.

## \|\| 2.9.12 \|\|

*śrīśiva uvāca \|*  
*bhaktyā ca bhavatornūnaṃ prītohaṃ surasattamau \|*  
*paśyataṃ māṃ mahādevaṃ bhayaṃ sarvaṃ vimuṃcatām \|\| 12 \|\|*

Śiva said:—

12\. O foremost among gods, I am delighted by your devotion. Look upon me as a great deity. Cost off all your fears.

## \|\| 2.9.13 \|\|

*mama liṃgaṃ sadā pūjya dhyeyaṃ caitādṛśaṃ mama \|*  
*idānīṃ dṛśyate yadvattathā kāryaṃ prayatnataḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Worship my liṅga and do always meditate upon the form which you see just before you.

## \|\| 2.9.14 \|\|

*pūjito liṃgarūpeṇa prasanno vividhaṃ phalam \|*  
*dāsyāmi sarvalokebhyo manobhīṣṭānyanekaśaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. When I am worshipped in the phallic form I will be delighted and will bestow different benefits upon all people, all that they wish for in their minds.

## \|\| 2.9.15 \|\|

*yadā duḥkhaṃ bhavettatra yuvayossurasattamau \|*  
*pūjite mama liṃge ca tadā syādduḥkhanāśanam \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. O foremost among the deities, whenever any misery befalls you, it shall be destroyed when my liṅga is worshipped.

## \|\| 2.9.16 \|\|

*yuvāṃ prasūtau prakṛtermadīyāyā mahābalau \|*  
*gātrābhyāṃ savyasavyābhyāṃ mama sarveśvarasya hi \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. O strong ones, you two are born of my own Prakṛti, out of my left and right sides. I am the lord of everything.

## \|\| 2.9.17 \|\|

*ayaṃ me dakṣiṇātpārśvādbrahmā lokapitāmahaḥ \|*  
*vāmapārśvācca viṣṇustvaṃ samutpannaḥ parātmanaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. This Brahmā, grandfather for all people, is born of my right side. You, Viṣṇu, are born of my left side. I am the supreme Ātman.

## \|\| 2.9.18-19 \|\|

*prītohaṃ yuvayossamyagvaraṃ dadyāṃ yathepsitam \|*  
*mayi bhaktirdṛḍhā bhūyādyuvayorabhyanujñayā \|\| 18 \|\|*

*pārthivīṃ caiva manmūrtiṃ vidhāya kurutaṃ yuvām \|*  
*sevāṃ ca vividhāṃ prājñau kṛtvā sukhamavāpsyatha \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. Delighted I shall confer on you boons and whatever you desire. May your devotion to me be steady. With my permission you can make my form in clay and perform adoration. After rendering different kinds of service like this sensibly you shall attain happiness.

## \|\| 2.9.20 \|\|

*brahmansṛṣṭiṃ kuru tvaṃ hi madājñāparipālakaḥ \|*  
*vatsa vatsa hare tvaṃ ca pālayaivaṃ carācaram \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. O Brahmā, strictly adhering to my direction you carry on the work of creation. Dear child, dear Hari, you shall sustain the mobile and the immobile beings.

## \|\| 2.9.21 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*ityuktvā nau prabhuratābhyāṃ pūjāvidhimadācchubhām \|*  
*yenaiva pūjitaśśaṃbhuḥ phalaṃ yacchatyanekaśaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

21\. Saying thus, the lord presented to us the auspicious mode of His worship, adored duly by means of which Śiva confers many benefits.

## \|\| 2.9.22 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*ityākarṇya vacaśśaṃbhormayā ca sahito hariḥ \|*  
*pratyuvāca maheśānaṃ praṇipatya kṛtāṃjaliḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. On hearing the words of Śiva along with me, Viṣṇu bowed to Śiva with palms joined in reverence and said.

## \|\| 2.9.23 \|\|

*viṣṇuruvāca \|*  
*yadi prītiḥ samutpannā yadi deyo varaśca nau \|*  
*bhaktirbhavatu nau nityaṃ tvayi cāvyabhicāriṇī \|\| 23 \|\|*

Viṣṇu said:—

23\. “If you are pleased, if a boon is to be given to us, may our devotion to you be perpetual and unstraying.

## \|\| 2.9.24 \|\|

*tvamapyavatarasvādya līlayā nirguṇopi hi \|*  
*sahāyaṃ kuru nau tāta tvaṃ paraḥ parameśvaraḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Although you are Nirguṇa, be pleased to incarnate in the course of your divine sports and help us. Dear lord, you are great lord, the supreme.

## \|\| 2.9.25 \|\|

*āvayordevadeveśa vivādamapi śobhanam \|*  
*ihāgato bhavānyasmādvivādaśamanāya nau \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. O lord of lords, even our dispute has turned out to be auspicious, now that you have come here to suppress the same”.

## \|\| 2.9.26 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā punaḥ prāha haro harim \|*  
*praṇipatya sthitaṃ mūrdhnā kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ svayam \|\| 26 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

26\. On hearing these words Śiva told Viṣṇu who stood there with the head bent down and with palms joined in reverence.

## \|\| 2.9.27 \|\|

*śrīmaheśa uvāca \|*  
*pralayasthitisargāṇāṃ kartāhaṃ saguṇo'guṇaḥ \|*  
*parabrahma nirvikārī saccidānaṃdalakṣaṇaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

Śiva said:—

27\. Although Nirguṇa, I am Saguṇa too and the author of dissolution, maintenance and creation. I am the supreme Brahman without decay and change. Existence, Knowledge and Bliss are my characteristics.

## \|\| 2.9.28 \|\|

*triyā bhinno hyahaṃ viṣṇo brahmaviṣṇuharākhyayā \|*  
*sargarakṣālayaguṇairniṣkalohaṃ sadā hare \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Truly, I am Niṣkala (Nirguṇa) for ever, O Hari. For the activities of creation, maintenance and dissolution I manifest myself in the three forms of Brahmā, Viṣṇu and Hara, O Viṣṇu.

## \|\| 2.9.29 \|\|

*stuto'haṃ yattvayā viṣṇo brahmaṇā me'vatāraṇe \|*  
*prārthanāṃ tāṃ kariṣyāmi satyāṃ yadbhaktavatsalaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. O Viṣṇu, since you, along with Brahmā, have eulogised me and prayed for my incarnation, I shall make that request true, favourably disposed towards my devotees that I am.

## \|\| 2.9.30 \|\|

*madrūpaṃ paramaṃ brahmannīdṛśaṃ bhavadaṃgataḥ \|*  
*prakaṭībhavitā loke nāmnā rudraḥ prakīrtitaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. A great form similar to this, O Brahmā, shall become manifest in the world through your body. He will be called Rudra.

## \|\| 2.9.3 \|\|

*daśabāhurnīlagala sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ \|*  
*sarvāṃgasundaro bhasmatripuṇḍrāṃkitamastakaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3 I. His capacity will never he less, since He will be my own part and parcel. He is I. I am he. In the modes of worship too there in no difference.

## \|\| 2.9.32 \|\|

*yathā ca jyotiṣassaṃgājjalādeḥ sparśatā na vai \|*  
*tathā mamāguṇasyāpi saṃyogādbandhanaṃ na hi \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. As heat etc. in water and other things due to the contact of fire is not permanent in water etc., similarly my Nirguṇa aspect is not affected by the external contact.

## \|\| 2.9.33 \|\|

*śivarūpaṃ mamaitañca rudro'pi śivavattadā \|*  
*na tatra parabhedo vai kartavyaśca mahāmune \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. This form of mine as Śiva is that of Rudra too. O great sage, no one shall make any difference in it.

## \|\| 2.9.34 \|\|

*vastuto hyekarūpaṃ hi dvidhā bhinnaṃ jagatyuta \|*  
*ato na bhedā vijñeyaḥ śive rudre kadācana \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. The same form appears split into two in the universe. Hence Śiva and Rudra shall not be considered different.

## \|\| 2.9.35 \|\|

*suvarṇasya tathaikasya vastutvaṃ naiva gacchati \|*  
*alaṃkṛtikṛte deva nāmabhedo na vastutaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. A piece of gold turned into an ornament does not cease to be gold. There may be difference in name but not in the material content.

## \|\| 2.9.36 \|\|

*tathaikasyā mṛdo bhedo nānāpātre na vastutaḥ \|*  
*kāraṇasyaiva kārye ca sannidhānaṃ nidarśanam \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Just as the difference of clay and the various objects made of it is not a material one, so also in this case.

The presence of the material cause in the effect can be cited as an example.

## \|\| 2.9.37 \|\|

*jñātavyaṃ budhavaryaiśca nirmalajñānibhiḥ surau \|*  
*evaṃ jñātvā bhavabhyāṃ tu na dṛśyaṃ bhedakāra ṇam \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. This shall be known by all scholars and Gods of unsullied knowledge. If you realise this, you will not be seeing the cause of difference.

## \|\| 2.9.38-39 \|\|

*vastuvatsarvadṛśyaṃ ca śivarūpammatammama \|*  
*ahaṃ bhavānajaścaiva rudro yo'yaṃ bhaviṣyati \|\| 38 \|\|*

*ekarūpā na bhedastu bhede vai baṃdhanaṃ bhavet \|*  
*tathāpi ca madīyaṃ hi śivarūpaṃ sanātanam \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. I think that we all should see the from of Śiva as the basic material. Myself, you, Brahmā and Rudra who will be manifesting himself are of the same form. There is no difference. If there had been difference that would have been bondage. Yet the eternal Śiva-form is mine alone.

## \|\| 2.9.40 \|\|

*mūlībhūtaṃ sadoktaṃ ca satyajñānamanaṃtakam \|*  
*evaṃ jñātvā sadā dhyeyaṃ manasā caiva tattvataḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. That pure form is spoken of as the main root, the Truth, the Knowledge, the Endless. Realising this too, it must be meditated upon in the true manner in your mind.

## \|\| 2.9.41 \|\|

*śrūyatāṃ caiva bho brahmanyadgopyaṃ kathyate mayā \|*  
*bhavaṃtau prakṛteryātau nāyaṃ vai prakṛteḥ punaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. O Brahmā, another secret which I am going to unfold to you may be listened to. You two are born of Prakṛti but not this one (Rudra).

## \|\| 2.9.42-43 \|\|

*madājñā jāyate tatra brahmaṇo bhrukuṭeraham \|*  
*guṇeṣvapi yathā proktastāmasaḥ prakṛto haraḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*vaikārikaśca vijñeyo yo'haṃkāra udāhṛtaḥ \|*  
*nāmato vastuto naiva tāmasaḥ paricakṣyate \|\| 43 \|\|*

42-43. My command is carried to that place through Brahmā’s eyebrows. I am therefore spoken of as Tāmasa and Prākṛta, Hara in respect to the Guṇas alone and shall be known as Vaikārika too which is actually the Ahaṃkāra (the Ego). That is called Tāmasa only in name and not in reality.

## \|\| 2.9.44 \|\|

*etasmātkāraṇādbrahmankaraṇīyamidaṃ tvayā \|*  
*sṛṣṭikartā bhava brahmansṛṣṭeśca pālako hariḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. For this reason, O Brahmā, this shall be carried out by you. O Brahmā, you shall be the creator and Hari the protector.

## \|\| 2.9.45 \|\|

*madīyaśca tathāṃ'śo yo layakartā bhaviṣyati \|*  
*iyaṃ yā prakṛtirdevī hyumākhyā parameśvarī \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. My would-be part shall be the cause of dissolution. This goddess Umā, Parameśvarī is the Prakṛti.

## \|\| 2.9.46 \|\|

*tasyāstu śaktirvā devī brahmāṇaṃ sā bhajiṣyati \|*  
*anyā śaktiḥ punastatra prakṛteḥ saṃbhaviṣyati \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Her Śakti, the goddess of speech, shall resort to Brahmā. Another Śakti also will be arising out of the Prakṛti.

## \|\| 2.9.47 \|\|

*samāśrayiṣyati viṣṇuṃ lakṣmīrūpeṇa sā tadā \|*  
*punaśca kālī nāmnā sā madaṃśaṃ prāpsyati dhruvam \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. That Śakti will resort to Viṣṇu in the form of Lakṣmī. Another Śakti Kālī will surely share my part.

## \|\| 2.9.48 \|\|

*jyotī rūpeṇa sā tatra kāryārthe saṃbhaviṣyati \|*  
*evaṃ devyāstathā proktāśśaktayaḥ paramāśśubhāḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. She will be born in the form of Brilliance for effective work. Thus I have told you of the great auspicious Śaktis of the Goddess.

## \|\| 2.9.49 \|\|

*sṛṣṭisthitilayānāṃ hi kāryaṃ tāsāṃ kramāddhruvam \|*  
*etasyāḥ prakṛtteraṃśā matpriyāyāssurauttama \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Their activities are respectively creation, maintenance and dissolution. O foremost among Gods, they are the parts of Prakṛti, my beloved.

## \|\| 2.9.50-53 \|\|

*tvaṃ ca lakṣmīmupāśritya kāryaṃ kartumihārhasi \|*  
*brahmaṃstvaṃ ca girāṃ devīṃ prakṛtyaṃśāmavāpya ca \|\| 50 \|\|*

*sṛṣṭikāryaṃ hṛdā kartummannideśādihārhasi \|*  
*ahaṃ kālīṃ samāśritya matpriyāṃśāṃ parātparām \|\| 51 \|\|*

*rudrarūpeṇa pralayaṃ kariṣye kāryamuttamam \|*  
*caturvarṇamayaṃ lokaṃ tatsarvairāśramai dhruvam \|\| 52 \|\|*

*tadanyairvividhaiḥ kāryaiḥ kṛtvā sukhamavāpsyathaḥ \|*  
*jñānavijñānasaṃyukto lokānāṃ hitakārakaḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

50-53. O Viṣṇu, you shall carry on your activities with the co-operation of Lakṣmī. O Brahmā, with the cooperation of the goddess of speech, the part of Prakṛti, you shall carry on joyfully the activity of creation, according to my direction. I shall have the co-operation of Kālī, the part of my beloved, the greatest of the great and shall carry out the excellent activity of dissolution in the form of Rudra. You shall be happy after the creation of the world consisting of the four VarṇaS and their ancillaries—the four Āśramas (stages of life) and various sorts of other incidental activities. You shall contribute to the welfare of the world making use of your knowledge and perfect wisdom.

## \|\| 2.9.54-55 \|\|

*muktido'tra bhavānadya bhava loke madājñayā \|*  
*maddarśane phalaṃ yadvattadeva tava darśane \|\| 54 \|\|*

*iti datto varastedya satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*mamaiva hṛdaye viṣṇurviṣṇośca hṛdaye hyaham \|\| 55 \|\|*

54-55. O Viṣṇu, be the bestower of salvation too at my bidding. The benefit accruing from your vision will be the same as that from mine. This boon is given to you now. It is the truth, certainly the truth. Viṣṇu is in my heart and I am in Viṣṇu’s heart.

## \|\| 2.9.56 \|\|

*ubhayoraṃtaraṃ yo vai na jānāti mano mama \|*  
*vāmāṃgajo mama harirdakṣiṇāṃgodbhavo vidhiḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. Those who make any distinction between the two do not know my mind. Viṣṇu is born of my left limb. Brahmā is born of my right limb.

## \|\| 2.9.57 \|\|

*mahāpralayakṛdrudro viśvātmā hṛdayodbhavaḥ \|*  
*tridhā bhinno hyahaṃ viṣṇo brahmaviṣṇubhavākhyayā \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. Rudra who causes great dissolution and who is the soul of the universe is born of the heart. I manifest in the three forms, O Viṣṇu, known Brahmā, Viṣṇu and Bhava.

## \|\| 2.9.58 \|\|

*sargarakṣālayakarastriguṇairaja ādibhiḥ \|*  
*guṇabhinnaśśivassākṣātprakṛte puruṣātparaḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. am the author of creation, protection and dissolution by the attributes Rajas etc. But I am different from these Guṇas and directly beyond Prakṛti and Puruṣa.

## \|\| 2.9.59 \|\|

*paraṃ brahmādvayo nityo'nantaḥ pūrṇo niraṃjanaḥ \|*  
*aṃtastamo vahissattvastrijagatpālako hariḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. I am the supreme Brahman, the eternal, the endless, the perfect and the unsullied. Viṣṇu has Tamas within but Sattva outside. He is the protector of the three worlds.

## \|\| 2.9.60 \|\|

*aṃtassattvastamobāhyastrijagallayakṛddharaḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. Hara who causes dissolution of three worlds has Sattva within but Tamas outside.

## \|\| 2.9.61 \|\|

*aṃtarbahīrajāścaiva trijagatsṛṣṭikṛdvidhiḥ \|*  
*evaṃ guṇāstrideveṣu guṇabhinnaḥ śivaḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. Brahmā who creates the three worlds has Rajas both within and without. This is the position of the Guṇas in the three deities. Śiva is spoken of as different from the Guṇas.

## \|\| 2.9.62 \|\|

*viṣṇo sṛṣṭikaraṃ prītyā pālayainaṃ pitāmaham \|*  
*saṃpūjyastriṣu lokeṣu bhaviṣyasi madājñayā \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. O Viṣṇu, guard lovingly this Pitāmaha who is the cause of creation. At my bidding, you will be worthy of respect in the three worlds.

## \|\| 2.9.63 \|\|

*tava sevyo vidheścāpi rudra eva bhaviṣyati \|*  
*śivapūrṇāvatāro hi trijagallayakārakaḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Rudra shall be worshipped by you and Brahmā. The author of dissolution of the three worlds is the complete incarnation of Śiva.

## \|\| 2.9.64 \|\|

*pādme bhaviṣyati sutaḥ kalpe tava pitāmahaḥ \|*  
*tadā drakṣyasi māṃ caiva so'pi drakṣyati padmajaḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. In the Kalpa called Pādma, Pitāmaha will be born as your son. Then you will see me. The lotus-born Brahmā shall also see me.

## \|\| 2.9.65 \|\|

*evamuktvā maheśānaḥ kṛpāṃ kṛtvātulāṃ haraḥ \|*  
*punaḥ provāca suprītyā viṣṇuṃ sarveśvaraḥ prabhuḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. After saying this and conferring unequalled mercy, the great lord Hara again spoke lovingly to Viṣṇu.

## Chapter 10 - Description of Parama Śivatattva

## \|\| 2.10.1 \|\|

*parameśvara uvāca \|*  
*anyacchṛṇu hare viṣṇo śāsanaṃ mama suvrata \|*  
*sadā sarveṣu lokeṣu mānyaḥ pūjyo bhaviṣyasi \|\| 1 \|\|*

Lord Śiva said:—

1\. O Viṣṇu of good rites, O Hari, listen to another pronouncement of mine. You will be worthy of honour and worship in all the worlds for ever.

## \|\| 2.10.2 \|\|

*brahmaṇā nirmite loke yadā dukhaṃ prajāyate \|*  
*tadā tvaṃ sarvaduḥkhānāṃ nāśāya tatparo bhava \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Whenever a misery befalls the world created by Brahmā, you shall be eager for the destruction of all miseries.

## \|\| 2.10.3 \|\|

*sahāyaṃ te kariṣyāmi sarvakārye ca dussahe \|*  
*tava śatrūnhaniṣyāmi dussādhyānparamotkaṭān \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. In all difficult and unbearable activities I shall help you. I shall kill your indefatigable and fierce enemies.

## \|\| 2.10.4 \|\|

*vividhānavatārāṃśca gṛhītvā kīrtimuttamām \|*  
*vistāraya hare loke tāraṇāya paro bhava \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. O Viṣṇu, spread your glory in the worlds far and wide by taking up various incarnations. Strive for their succour. I am always Saguṇa when I become Rudra with this body.

## \|\| 2.10.5 \|\|

*guṇarūpo hyayaṃ rudro hyanena vapuṣā sadā \|*  
*kāryaṃ kariṣye lokānāṃ tavāśakyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Certainly I shall perform your activities for the sake of the worlds if they are impossible for you.

## \|\| 2.10.6 \|\|

*rudradhyeyo bhavāṃścaiva bhavaddhyeyo harastathā \|*  
*yuvayorantarannaiva tava rudrasya kiṃcana \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. You are to be meditated upon by Rudra and Rudra is to be meditated upon by you. There is no difference between you and Rudra.

## \|\| 2.10.7 \|\|

*vastutaścāpi caikatvaṃ varato'pi tathaiva ca \|*  
*līlayāpi mahāviṣṇo satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. O Great Viṣṇu, your identity is due to inherent nature, the boons conferred and your divine sports. True, it is certainly true.

## \|\| 2.10.8 \|\|

*rudrabhakto naro yastu tava niṃdāṃ kariṣyati \|*  
*tasya puṇyaṃ ca nikhilaṃ drutaṃ bhasma bhaviṣyati \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. If any devotee of Rudra were to censure you, he will have all his merits reduced to ashes quickly.

## \|\| 2.10.9 \|\|

*narake patanaṃ tasya tvaddveṣātpuruṣottama \|*  
*madājñayā bhavedviṣṇo satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. O Viṣṇu, the most excellent of all persons, by hating you he will certainly fall into hell. That is my directive. True, it is certainly true.

## \|\| 2.10.10 \|\|

*loke'sminmuktido nṝṇāṃ bhuktidaśca viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*dhyeyaḥ pūjyaśca bhaktānāṃ nigrahānugrahau kuru \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. In this world, be the bestower of worldly pleasures and salvation to men particularly. Worthy of being honoured and worshipped by devotees, perform the activities of curbing and blessing.

## \|\| 2.10.11 \|\|

*ityuktvā māṃ ca dhātāraṃ haste dhṛtvā svayaṃ harim \|*  
*kathayāmāsa duḥkheṣu sahāyo bhava sarvadā \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Saying this and holding me, the creator, and Viṣṇu by the hand He continued—“Always render help in distress.

## \|\| 2.10.12 \|\|

*sarvādhyakṣaśca sarveṣu bhuktimuktipradāyakaḥ \|*  
*bhava tvaṃ sarvathā śreṣṭhassarvakāmaprasādhakaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Be the presiding deity of all. Bestow worldly pleasures and salvation for ever. Be the most excellent accomplisher of the achievement of all desires.

## \|\| 2.10.13 \|\|

*sarveṣāṃ prāṇarūpaśca bhava tvaṃ ca mamājñayā \|*  
*saṃkaṭe bhajanīyo hi sa rudro mattanurhare \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. You will assume the form of the vital airs in everyone at my bidding. O Hari, in the times of distress, Rudra my manifestation, shall be worshipped.

## \|\| 2.10.14 \|\|

*tvāṃ yassamāśrito nūnaṃ māmeva sa samāśritaḥ \|*  
*aṃtaraṃ yaśca jānāti niraye patati dhruvam \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. He who has sought refuge in you has certainly sought refuge in me. He who differentiates will certainly fall into Hell.

## \|\| 2.10.15 \|\|

*āyurbalaṃ śṛṇuṣvādya tridevānāṃ viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*saṃdeho'tra na karttavyo brahmaviṣṇu harātmanām \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Listen to the span of life of the deities—Brahmā, Viṣṇu and Hara. There shall not be any doubt in this respect.

## \|\| 2.10.16 \|\|

*caturyugasahasrāṇi brahmaṇo dinamucyate \|*  
*rātriśca tāvatī tasya mānametatkrameṇa ha \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. A thousand sets of the four-yuga periods constitute one day of Brahmā. The period of night is also similar. Further measurement of time is based on this calculation.

## \|\| 2.10.17 \|\|

*teṣāṃ triṃśaddinermāso dvādaśaistaiśca vatsaraḥ \|*  
*śatavarṣapramāṇena brahmāyuḥ parikīrtitam \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Thirty such days (days and nights) constitute one month and twelve months, one year. The span of life of Brahmā is hundred such years.

## \|\| 2.10.18 \|\|

*brahmaṇo varṣamātreṇa dinaṃ vaiṣṇavamucyate \|*  
*so'pi varṣaśataṃ yāvadātmamānena jīvati \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. One year of Brahmā constitutes one day of Viṣṇu. Viṣṇu lives for hundred years in his own calculation.

## \|\| 2.10.19 \|\|

*vaiṣṇavena tu varṣeṇa dinaṃ raudraṃ bhaveddhruvam \|*  
*haro varṣaśate yāte nararūpeṇa saṃsthitaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. One year of Viṣṇu constitutes one day of Rudra. When a hundred year period passes, Rudra assumes the form of Nara (supreme Man).

## \|\| 2.10.20 \|\|

*yāvaducchvasitaṃ vaktre sadāśivasamudbhavam \|*  
*paścācchaktiṃ samabhyeti yāvanniśvasitaṃ bhavet \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. He stays like that as long as the breath is retained by Sadāśiva. When He exhales he merges into Śakti.

## \|\| 2.10.21-22 \|\|

*niḥśvāsocchvasitānāṃ ca sarveṣāmeva dehinām \|*  
*brahmaviṣṇuharāṇāṃ ca gaṃdharvoragarakṣasām \|\| 21 \|\|*

*ekaviṃśasahasrāṇi śataiḥ ṣaḍbhiśśatāni ca \|*  
*ahorātrāṇi coktāni pramāṇaṃ surasattamau \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. In the case of all living beings, Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Hara, Gandharvas, serpents, Rākṣasas, etc., twenty one thousand six hundred respirations constitute the period of one day and one night, O foremost among Devas.

## \|\| 2.10.23-24 \|\|

*ṣaḍbhicchavāsaniśvāsaiḥ palamekaṃ pravartitam \|*  
*ghaṭī ṣaṣṭi palāḥ proktā sā ṣaṣṭyā ca dinaṃ niśā \|\| 23 \|\|*

*niśvāsocchvāsitānāṃ ca parisaṃkhyā na vidyate \|*  
*sadāśivasamutthānametasmātso'kṣayaḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. Six respirations constitute the period of time one Pala. Sixty such Palas constitute one Ghaṭī. Sixty Ghaṭīs constitute one day and one night. (6 x 60 x 60 = 21600). There is no limit to the number of respirations of Sadāśiva. Hence He is undecaying.

## \|\| 2.10.25 \|\|

*itthaṃ rūpaṃ tvayā tāvadrakṣaṇīyaṃ mamājñayā \|*  
*tāvatsṛṣṭeśca kāryaṃ vai kartavyaṃ vividhairguṇaiḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. It is my directive that you should preserve this form and maintain all the activities of the created worlds by means of these different Guṇas so long.”

## \|\| 2.10.26 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*ityākarṇya vacaśśaṃbhormayā ca bhagavānhariḥ \|*  
*praṇipatya ca viśveśaṃ prāha maṃdataraṃ vaśī \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. On hearing these words of Śiva the lord Viṣṇu, of controlled senses, spoke slowly to Śiva after duly bowing to Him.

## \|\| 2.10.27 \|\|

*viṣṇuruvāca \|*  
*śaṃkara śrūyatāmetatkṛpāsiṃdho jagatpate \|*  
*sarvametatkariṣyāmi bhavadājñāvaśānugaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

Viṣṇu said:—

27\. “O Sankara, the ocean of mercy, the lord of the universe, be pleased to hear. I shall do all these things strictly adhering to your behests.

## \|\| 2.10.28 \|\|

*mama dhyeyassadā tvaṃ ca bhaviṣyasi na cānyathā \|*  
*bhavatassarvasāmarthyaṃ labdhaṃ caiva purā mayā \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. I shall always meditate upon you. I would not act otherwise. Your omnipotency has already been experienced by me.

## \|\| 2.10.29 \|\|

*kṣaṇamātramapi svāmiṃstava dhyānaṃ paraṃ mama \|*  
*cetaso dūrato naiva nirgacchatu kadācana \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. O lord, let not the meditation of your form be ever far removed from my mind even for a moment.

## \|\| 2.10.30 \|\|

*mama bhaktaśca yaḥ svāmiṃstava niṃdā kariṣyati \|*  
*tasya vai niraye vāsaṃ prayaccha niyataṃ dhruvam \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. O lord, if anyone of my devotees were to censure you, you will please assign perpetual residence in hell to him.

## \|\| 2.10.31 \|\|

*tvadbhakto yo bhavetsvāminmama priyataro hi saḥ \|*  
*evaṃ vai yo vijānāti tasya muktirna durlabhā \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. O lord, whoever be your devotee shall also be my favourite. He who knows and realises this shall not find salvation inaccessible to him.

## \|\| 2.10.32 \|\|

*mahimā ca madīyodya varddhito bhavatā dhruvam \|*  
*kadācidaguṇaścaiva jāyate kṣamyatāmiti \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. My greatness has been further heightened by you certainly. If ever I am found deficient in qualities I may be excused.

## \|\| 2.10.33 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*tadā śaṃbhustadīyaṃ hi śrutvā vacanamuttamam \|*  
*uvāca viṣṇuṃ suprītyā kṣamyā te'guṇatā mayā \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. (Brahmā said:—) Then, on hearing the excellent words of Viṣṇu, Śiva said to him “Of course the deficiency shall be excused lovingly.”

## \|\| 2.10.34 \|\|

*evamuktvā hariṃ nau sa karābhyāṃ parameśvaraḥ \|*  
*pasparśa sakalāṃgeṣu kṛpayā tu kṛpānidhiḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. After saying this mercifully the lord, the ocean of mercy, stroked us all over the body with His hands.

## \|\| 2.10.35 \|\|

*ādiśya vividhāndharmānsarvaduḥkhaharo haraḥ \|*  
*dadau varānanekāṃścāvayorhitacikīrṣayā \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. With a desire to do what is wholesome to us He instructed us in various sacred rites and conferred on us many boons.

## \|\| 2.10.36 \|\|

*tatassa bhagavāñchaṃbhuḥ kṛpayā bhaktavatsalaḥ \|*  
*dṛṣṭayā saṃpaśyato śīghraṃ tatraivāṃtaradhīyataḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Even as we were watching, the lord Śiva, favourably disposed towards devotees, vanished immediately.

## \|\| 2.10.37 \|\|

*tadā prakṛti loke'smiṃlliṃgapūjāvidhiḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*liṃge pratiṣṭhitaśśaṃbhurbhuktimuktipradāyakaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. The rite of the worship of the liṅga is instituted ever since in the world. Śiva installed in the liṅga bestows worldly pleasures and salvation.

## \|\| 2.10.38 \|\|

*liṃgavedirmahādevī liṃgaṃ sākṣānmaheśvaraḥ \|*  
*layanālliṃgamityuktaṃ tatraiva nikhilaṃ jagat \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. The great goddess is the pedestal for the liṅga. The liṅga is Lord Śiva Himself. Since the whole universe finally merges into in, it is called Liṅga.

## \|\| 2.10.39 \|\|

*yastu laiṃgaṃ paṭhennityamākhyānaṃ liṃgasannidhau \|*  
*ṣaṇmāsācchivarūpo vai nātra kāryā vicāraṇā \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. He who reads regularly this anecdote of the Liṅga in the vicinity of the liṅga assumes the form of Śiva within six months. There need be no hesitation in this respect.

## \|\| 2.10.40 \|\|

*yastu liṃgasamīpe tu kāryaṃ kiṃcitkaroti ca \|*  
*tasya puṇyaphalaṃ vaktuṃ na śaknomi mahāmune \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. O great sage, I cannot adequately express the blessedness accruing to the person who carries on any activity whatsoever in the vicinity of the liṅga.

## Chapter 11 - The mode of worshipping Śiva

## \|\| 2.11.1 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ \|*  
*sūtasūta mahābhāga vyāsaśiṣya namostu te \|*  
*śrāvitādyādbhutā śaivakathā paramapāvanī \|\| 1 \|\|*

The sages said:—

1\. O Sūta the fortunate, O Sūta the disciple of Vyāsa, obeisance be to you. This wonderfully sanctifying story of Śiva has been narrated to-day.

## \|\| 2.11.2 \|\|

*tatrādbhutā mahādivyā liṃgotpattiḥ śrutā śubhā \|*  
*śrutvā yasyāḥ prabhāvaṃ ca duḥkhanāśo bhavediha \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. The wonderful and highly divine origin of the liṅga has been heard. Listening to its efficacy causes destruction of misery.

## \|\| 2.11.3 \|\|

*brahmanāradasaṃvādamanusṛtya dayānidhe \|*  
*śivārcanavidhiṃ brūhi yena tuṣṭo bhavecchivaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. O store house of mercy, please tell us the mode of the worship of Śiva, in accordance with the conversation of Brahmā and Nārada whereby Śiva becomes satisfied

## \|\| 2.11.4 \|\|

*brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyairvaiśyaiḥ śūdrairvā pūjyate śivaḥ \|*  
*kathaṃ kāryaṃ ca tad brūhi yathā vyāsamukhācchrutam \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Brahmins, Kṣatriyas, Vaiṣyas and Śudras worship Śiva. How shall the worship be performed? Please tell us in accordance with what you have heard from Vyāsa.

## \|\| 2.11.5 \|\|

*tacchrutvā vacanaṃ teṣāṃ śarmadaṃ śrutisaṃmatam \|*  
*uvāca sakalaṃ prītyā muni praśnānusārataḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. On hearing their words, Sūta narrated everything in answer to the question of the sages, everything conducive to welfare and in accordance with the Vedas.

## \|\| 2.11.6 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ bhavadbhiśca tadrahasyaṃ munīśvarāḥ \|*  
*tadahaṃ kathayāmyadya yathābuddhi yathāśrutam \|\| 6 \|\|*

Sūta said:—

6\. O lordly sages, your enquiry covers a very great secret topic. I shall explain it as far as my own intellect can penetrate it and in accordance with what I have heard.

## \|\| 2.11.7-8 \|\|

*bhavadbhiḥ pṛcchayate tadvattathā vyāsena vai purā \|*  
*pṛṣṭaṃ sanatkumārāya tacchrutaṃ hyupamanyunā \|\| 7 \|\|*

*tato vyāsena vai śrutvā śivapūjādikaṃ ca yat \|*  
*mahyaṃ ca pāṭhitaṃ tena lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. Formerly Vyāsa had asked the same question of Sanatkumāra as you have asked now. Upamanyu learnt it from him. Vyāsa heard it from him and taught me the mode of worship etc. of Śiva from a desire for the benefit of all the worlds.

## \|\| 2.11.9 \|\|

*tacchrutaṃ caiva kṛṣṇena hyupamanyormahātmanaḥ \|*  
*tadahaṃ kathayiṣyāmi yathā brahmāvadatpurā \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. It was directly heard from Upamanyu, the noble soul, by Kṛṣṇa (i.e. Kṛṣṇadvaipāyaṇa or Vyāsa). That I shall tell you in the some way as Brahmā had said before.

## \|\| 2.11.10 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi saṃkṣepālliṃgapūjanam \|*  
*vaktuṃ varṣaśatenāpi na śakyaṃ vistarānmune \|\| 10 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

10\. O sage Nārada I shall explain briefly the worship of the liṅga (the phallic image). It is impossible to explain it in detail even in a hundred years.

## \|\| 2.11.11 \|\|

*evaṃ tu śāṃkaraṃ rūpaṃ mukhaṃ svacchaṃ sanātanam \|*  
*pūjayetparayā bhaktyā sarvakāmaphalāptaye \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. In order to achieve the fulfilment of all desires one should worship with great devotion the pure and eternal form of Śiva thus.

## \|\| 2.11.12 \|\|

*dāridryaṃ rogaduḥkhaṃ ca pīḍanaṃ śatrusaṃbhavam \|*  
*pāpaṃ caturvidhaṃ tāvadyāvannārcayate śivam \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Poverty, sickness, harassment from enemies and the four sorts of sins trouble one only as long as one does not worship Siva.

## \|\| 2.11.13 \|\|

*sampūjite śive deve sarvaduḥkhaṃ vilīyate \|*  
*saṃpadyate sukhaṃ sarvaṃ paścānmuktiravāpyate \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. When Śiva is worshipped, all miseries merge into the lord; all happiness is secured and salvation is attained thereafter.

## \|\| 2.11.14 \|\|

*ye vai mānuṣyamāśritya mukhyaṃ saṃtānatassukham \|*  
*tena pūjyo mahādevaḥ sarvakāryārthasādhakaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Śiva who secures the achievement of all matters shall be worshipped by the person who considers a continuous series of human pleasures very important.

## \|\| 2.11.15 \|\|

*brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāśśūdrāśca vidhivatkramāt \|*  
*śaṃkarārcāṃ prakurvaṃtu sarvakāmārthasiddhaye \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Whether they are brahmins, Kṣatriyas, Vaiśyas or Śūdras, they shall perform the worship of Śiva duly and regularly for the achievement of all desired objects.

## \|\| 2.11.16-18 \|\|

*prātaḥkāle samutthāya muhūrte brahmasaṃjñake \|*  
*gurośca smaraṇaṃ kṛtvā śaṃbhoścaiva tathā punaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*tīrthānāṃ smaraṇaṃ kṛtvā dhyānaṃ caiva harerapi \|*  
*mamāpi nirjarāṇāṃ vai munyādīnāṃ tathā mune \|\| 17 \|\|*

*tataḥ stotraṃ śubhaṃ nāma gṛhṇīyādvidhipūrvakam \|*  
*tatotthāya malotsargaṃ dakṣiṇasyāṃ careddiśi \|\| 18 \|\|*

16-18. One shall get up early in the morning during the Brāhma Muhūrta (about an hour before dawn). He shall remember the preceptor and Śiva. O sage, he shall then remember the holy centres and meditate on Hari. Thereafter he shall remember me, the deities and the sages. Then he shall recite a prayer in the name of Śiva duly. Then he shall get up and evacuate his bowels in southern quarter.

## \|\| 2.11.19 \|\|

*ekānte tu vidhiṃ kuryānmalotsargassa yacchrutam \|*  
*tadeva kathayāmyadya śṛṇvādhāya mano mune \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. The evacuation of the bowels shall be done in an isolated place. What I have heard (in this respect) I am mentioning now. O sage, please listen attentively.

## \|\| 2.11.20 \|\|

*śuddhāṃ mṛdaṃ dvijo lipyātpaṃcavāraṃ viśuddhaye \|*  
*kṣatriyaśca caturvāraṃ vaiśyo varatrayaṃ tathā \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. A brahmin shall use earth for cleaning purposes five times; a Kṣatriya for four times and a Vaiśya for three times.

## \|\| 2.11.21 \|\|

*śūdro dvivāraṃ ca mṛdaṃ gṛhṇīyādvidhiśuddhaye \|*  
*gude vātha sakṛlliṃge vāramekaṃ prayatnataḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. A Śūdra shall use the earth twice for cleaning purposes. Or he shall cleanse the rectum once and the penis once assiduously.

## \|\| 2.11.22 \|\|

*daśavāraṃ vāmahaste saptavāraṃ dvayostathā \|*  
*pratyekampādayostāta trivāraṃ karayoḥ punaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. He shall then wash the left hand ten times. He shall then wash each of the feet seven times and both the hands three times once again.

## \|\| 2.11.23 \|\|

*strībhiśca śūdravatkāryaṃ mṛdāgrahaṇamuttamam \|*  
*hastau pādau ca prakṣālya pūrvavanmṛdamāharet \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Women shall perform these cleansing activities with earth like Śudras. They shall first wash the hands and feet, then make use of the earth as before.

## \|\| 2.11.24 \|\|

*daṃtakāṣṭhaṃ tataḥ kuryātsvavarṇakramato naraḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. They shall clean the teeth using the tooth brush twig according to their castes.

## \|\| 2.11.25-26 \|\|

*vipraḥ kuryāddaṃtakāṣṭhaṃ dvādaśāṃgulamānataḥ \|*  
*ekādaśāṃgulaṃ rājā vaiśyaḥ kuryāddaśāṃgulam \|\| 25 \|\|*

*śūdro navāgulaṃ kuryāditi mānamidaṃ smṛtam \|*  
*kāladoṣaṃ vicāryyaiva manudṛṣṭaṃ vivarjayet \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. The tooth brush twig of a brahmin shall be twelve aṅgulas long. A king (a Kṣatriya) shall take one eleven aṅgulas long and a Vaiśya one ten aṅgulas long. The tooth brush of a Śūdra shall be nine aṅgulas in length. This is in accordance with Smṛtis. What is enjoined by Manu shall be disobeyed only in emergencies.

## \|\| 2.11.27 \|\|

*ṣaṣṭyādyāmāśca navamī vratamastaṃ raverdinam \|*  
*tathā śrāddhadinaṃ tāta niṣiddhaṃ radadhāvane \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. On Ṣaṣṭī (sixth), Navamī (ninth) and new-moon days, on sundays and days of sacred rites and Śrāddhas, cleaning the teeth with tooth-brush twig is prohibited.

## \|\| 2.11.28 \|\|

*snānaṃ tu vidhivatkāryaṃ tīrthādiṣu krameṇa tu \|*  
*deśakālaviśeṣeṇa snānaṃ kāryaṃ samaṃtrakam \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. The daily ablutions shall be performed duly and those in holy centres shall be performed with mantras in accordance with the time and place.

## \|\| 2.11.29 \|\|

*ācamya prathamaṃ tatra dhautavastreṇa cādharet \|*  
*ekānte susthale sthitvā saṃdhyāvidhimathācaret \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Performing the Ācamana first, wearing washed cloth, he shall perform the Sandhyā prayer in a good isolated place.

## \|\| 2.11.30 \|\|

*yathāyogyaṃ vidhiṃ kṛtvā pūjāvidhimathārabhet \|*  
*manastu susthiraṃ kṛtvā pūjāgāraṃ praviśya ca \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. After observing the preliminaries duly he shall enter the chamber of worship keeping the mind steady and begin the rites of worship.

## \|\| 2.11.31 \|\|

*pūjāvidhiṃ samādāya svāsane hyupaviśya vai \|*  
*nyāsādikaṃ vidhāyādau pūjayetkramaśo haram \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Sitting on a good seat and performing Nyāsa etc. in accordance with the prescribed rules of worship, he shall perform the worship of Śiva duly.

## \|\| 2.11.32 \|\|

*prathamaṃ ca gaṇādhīśaṃ dvārapālāṃstathaiva ca \|*  
*dikpālāṃśca susaṃpūjya paścātpīṭhaṃ prakalpayet \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Gaṇeśa, the attendants at the threshold of the Temple, the guardians of the quarters etc., shall be worshipped and thereafter the pedestal shall be arranged.

## \|\| 2.11.33-36 \|\|

*atha vā'ṣṭadalaṃ kṛtvā pūjādravyaṃ samīpataḥ \|*  
*upaviśya tatastatra upaveśya śivam prabhum \|\| 33 \|\|*

*ācamanatrayaṃ kṛtvā prakṣālya ca punaḥ karau \|*  
*prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā madhye dhyāyecca tryambakam \|\| 34 \|\|*

*paṃcavaktraṃ daśabhujaṃ śuddhasphaṭikasannibham \|*  
*sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ vyāghracarmottarīyakam \|\| 35 \|\|*

*tasya sārūpyatāṃ smṛtvā dahetpāpaṃ narassadā \|*  
*śivaṃ tataḥ samutthāpya pūjayetparameśvaram \|\| 36 \|\|*

33-36. Or he shall make the mystical diagram of the lotus of eight petals and install Śiva in its middle. He himself shall sit near all the materials of worship around him. He shall perform Ācamana thrice and wash the hands. He shall then perform suppression of breath (Prāṇāyāma) thrice. Then Tryaṃbaka (three-eyed Śiva) shall be meditated upon in the following manner.
