37\. Viṣṇu who was kept stunned by Vīrabhadra of eloquent words who was the lord of the Gaṇas, remained motionless like a mountain.

## \|\| 3.37.38 \|\|

*tato viṣṇuḥ staṃbhito hi vīrabhadreṇa nārada \|*  
*yajvopamaṃtraṇamanā nīrastaṃbhanakārakam \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. O Nārada, when he became benumbed and stunned, Viṣṇu repeated formulas for redemption from torpidity.

## \|\| 3.37.39 \|\|

*tatasstaṃbhananirmuktaḥ śārṅgadhanvā rameśvaraḥ \|*  
*śārṅgaṃ jagrāha sa kruddhaḥ svadhanussaśaraṃ mune \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. O sage, becoming freed from the stunned state, Viṣṇu became infuriated and took up his bow and arrows.

## \|\| 3.37.40 \|\|

*tribhiśca dharṣito bāṇaistena śārṅgaṃ dhanurhareḥ \|*  
*vīrabhadreṇa tattāta tridhābhūttatkṣaṇānmune \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. O dear sage, Viṣṇu’s bow was attacked with three arrows by Vīrabhadra whereupon it split into three in a trice.

## \|\| 3.37.41 \|\|

*atha viṣṇurmayā vāṇyā bodhitastaṃ mahāgaṇam \|*  
*asahyavarcasaṃ jñātvā hyaṃtardhātuṃ mano dadhe \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Then Viṣṇu was enlightened by the great voice that the great Gaṇas were invincible. He therefore thought of vanishing from the scene.

## \|\| 3.37.42 \|\|

*jñātvā ca tatsarvamidaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ satīkṛtaṃ duṣprasahaṃ pareṣām \|*  
*gatāḥ svalokaṃ svagaṇānvitāstu smṛtvā śivaṃ sarvapatiṃ svataṃtram \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. On coming to know that all this was bound to happen brought about by Satī, so unbearable to all others, all of us went to our respective worlds after duly remembering Śiva, the independent lord of all.

## \|\| 3.37.43 \|\|

*satyalokagataścāhaṃ putra śokena pīḍitaḥ \|*  
*aciṃtayaṃ suduḥkhārto mayā kiṃ kāryamadya vai \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. When I returned to Satyaloka the grief of my son afflicted me much. In my miserable plight I pondered over what shall be done by me.

## \|\| 3.37.44 \|\|

*viṣṇau mayi gate caiva devāśca munibhissaha \|*  
*vinirjitā gaṇaissarve ye te yajñopajīvinaḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. When Viṣṇu and I had gone, accompanied by Devas and sages, all those who were left there, those who maintained themselves through sacrifices, were utterly defeated by the Gaṇas.

## \|\| 3.37.45 \|\|

*samupadravamālakṣya vidhvastaṃ ca mahāmakham \|*  
*mṛgasvarūpo yajño hi mahābhīto'pi dudruve \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. On seeing the disorder and utter destruction of the great sacrifice, the sacrifice itself being afraid assumed the form of a deer and fled.

## \|\| 3.37.46 \|\|

*taṃ tadā mṛgarūpeṇa dhāvaṃtaṃ gaganaṃ prati \|*  
*vīrabhadrassamādāya viśiraskamathākarot \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Vīrabhadra seized it as it, was fleeing up the sky in the form of a deer and beheaded it.

## \|\| 3.37.47-48 \|\|

*tataḥ prajāpatiṃ dharmaṃ kaśyapaṃ ca pragṛhya saḥ \|*  
*ariṣṭaneminaṃ vīro bahupatramunīśvaram \|\| 47 \|\|*

*munimāṃgirasaṃ caiva kṛśāśvaṃ ca mahāgaṇaḥ \|*  
*jaghāna mūrdhni pādena dattaṃ ca munipuṃgavam \|\| 48 \|\|*

47-48. Then the heroic Mahāgaṇa Vīrabhadra caught hold of Prajāpati, Dharma, Kaśyapa Ariṣṭanemin the sage with many sons, the sages Aṅgiras and Kṛśāśva and the great sage Datta and kicked all of them on their heads.

## \|\| 3.37.49 \|\|

*sarasvatyāśca nāsāgraṃ devamāstu tathaiva ca \|*  
*ciccheda karajāgreṇa vīra bhadraḥ pratāpavān \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. With the tip of his fingers he cut off the tip of the nose of Sarasvatī and of Aditi the mother of devas. Vīrabhadra showed his exploits thus.

## \|\| 3.37.50 \|\|

*tatonyānapi devādīn vidārya pṛthivītale \|*  
*pātayāmāsa soyaṃ vai krodhākrāṃtātilocanaḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Similarly the infuriated Vīrabhadra with eyes blazing, cut off the other devas too and threw them on the ground.

## \|\| 3.37.51 \|\|

*vīrabhadro vidāryyāpi devānmukhyānmunīnapi \|*  
*nābhūcchāṃto drutakrodhaḥ phaṇirāḍiva maṃḍitaḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Even after mutilating the chief devas and sages, he never became calm like the king of serpents whose anger had been aroused.

## \|\| 3.37.52 \|\|

*vīrabhadroddhṛtārātiḥ kesarīva vanadvipān \|*  
*diśo vilokayāmāsa kaḥ kutrāstītyanukṣaṇam \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. After uprooting his enemies, like a lion the elephants of the forest, Vīrabhadra surveyed all the quarters frequently to know “who is where”.

## \|\| 3.37.53 \|\|

*vyapothayadbhṛguṃ yāvanmaṇibhadraḥ pratāpavān \|*  
*padākramyorasi tadā'kārṣīttacchmaśruluṃcanam \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. He struck and smashed Bhṛgu while the valorous Maṇibhadra kicked him on his chest and plucked off his moustaches.

## \|\| 3.37.54 \|\|

*caṃḍaścotpāṭayāmāsa pūṣṇo daṃtān pravegataḥ \|*  
*śapyamāne hare pūrvaṃ yo'hasaddarśayandataḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. Caṇḍa forcibly plucked off the teeth of Pūṣan, who had formerly laughed and showed his teeth while Śiva was being cursed.

## \|\| 3.37.55 \|\|

*nandī bhagasya netre hi pātitasya ruṣā bhuvi \|*  
*ujjahāra sa dakṣokṣṇā yaśśapaṃtamasūsucat \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. Nandin plucked out the eyes of Bhaga who was felled over the ground with anger because it was he who winked at Dakṣa while cursing.

## \|\| 3.37.56 \|\|

*viḍaṃbitā svadhā tatra sā svāhā dakṣiṇā tathā \|*  
*maṃtrāstaṃtrāstathā cānye tatrasthā gaṇanāyakaiḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. Svadhā, Svāhā, Dakṣiṇā Mantras and Tantras, all those who were there were molested and mortified by the leaders of Gaṇas.

## \|\| 3.37.57 \|\|

*vavṛṣuste purīṣāṇi vitānā'gnau ruṣā gaṇāḥ \|*  
*anirvācyaṃ tadā cakrurgaṇā vīrāstamadhvaram \|\| 57 \|\|*

57 The Gaṇas furiously showered filth and rubbish on the sacrificial fire. The heroic Gaṇas made the sacrifice inexpressibly impure.

## \|\| 3.37.58 \|\|

*aṃtarvedyaṃtaragataṃ nilīnaṃ tadbhayādbalāt \|*  
*ānināya samājñāya vīrabhadreḥ svabhūścutam \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. After coming to know that Dakṣa had hidden himself behind the altar due to his fright, Vīrabhadra dragged him out with force.

## \|\| 3.37.59 \|\|

*kapole'sya gṛhītvā tu khaḍgenopahṛtaṃ śiraḥ \|*  
*abhedyamabhavattasya tacca yogaprabhāvataḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. He was caught hold of by his cheeks, his head and was struck with the sword. Due to the yogic power of Dakṣa it could not be split.

## \|\| 3.37.60 \|\|

*abhedyaṃ tacchiro matvā śastrāstraiśca tu sarvaśaḥ \|*  
*kareṇa troṭayāmāsa padbhyāmākramya corasi \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. Thinking that his head could not be pierced or cut with weapons he kicked his chest with the foot and wrested the head with his hand.

## \|\| 3.37.61 \|\|

*tacchirastasya duṣṭasya dakṣasya haravairiṇaḥ \|*  
*agnikuṃḍe pracikṣepa vīrabhadro gaṇāgraṇīḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. Vīrabhadra the leader of the Gaṇas threw the head of the wicked Dakṣa, the enemy of Śiva, into the fire-pit.

## \|\| 3.37.62 \|\|

*reje tadā vīrabhadrastriśūlaṃ bhrāmayankare \|*  
*kruddhā raṇākṣasaṃvartāḥ prajvālya parvatopamāḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. Vīrabhadra whirling the trident in his hand looked splendid indeed. The angry Raṇākṣa and Saṃvarta looked like the blazing mountains.

## \|\| 3.37.63 \|\|

*anāyāsena hatvaitān vīrabhadrastato'gninā \|*  
*jvālayāmāsa sakrodho dīptāgniśśalabhāniva \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. After killing them without difficulty Vīrabhadra in his fury burnt them in the fire like a blazing conflagration consuming moths.

## \|\| 3.37.64 \|\|

*vīrabhadrastato dagdhāndṛṣṭvā dakṣapurogamān \|*  
*aṭṭāṭṭahāsamakarotpūrayaṃśca jagattrayam \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. Seeing Dakṣa and others entirely burnt, he laughed boisterously filling the three worlds with the sound.

## \|\| 3.37.65 \|\|

*vīraśriyā vṛtastatra tato nandanasaṃbhavā \|*  
*puṣpavṛṣṭirabhūddivyā vīrabhadre gaṇānvite \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. He was surrounded by heroic glory. Then a divine shower of flowers originating from the celestial park fell over Vīrabhadra accompanied by his Gaṇas.

## \|\| 3.37.66 \|\|

*vavurgaṃdhavahāśśītāssugandhāssukhadāḥ śanaiḥ \|*  
*devaduṃdubhayo nedussamameva tataḥ param \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. Cool breezes blew gently fragrant and pleasing. Divine drums sounded simultaneously.

## \|\| 3.37.67 \|\|

*kailāsaṃ sa yayau vīraḥ kṛtakāryyastataḥ param \|*  
*vināśitadṛḍhadhvāṃto bhānumāniva satvaram \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. The hero who had accomplished his duties went to Kailāsa quickly like the sun who quells darkness.

## \|\| 3.37.68 \|\|

*kṛtakāryaṃ vīrabhadraṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃtuṣṭamā nasaḥ \|*  
*śaṃbhurvīragaṇādhyakṣaṃ cakāra parameśvaraḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. On seeing Vīrabhadra who had fulfilled his task, lord Śiva was pleased and he made him the presiding officer of his Gaṇas.

## Chapter 38 - The dialogue between Kṣuva and Dadhīca

## \|\| 3.38.1 \|\|

*\|\| sūta uvāca \|*  
*ityākarṇya vacastasya vidheramitadhīmataḥ \|*  
*papraccha nāradaḥ prītyā vismitastaṃ dvijottamaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

Sūta said:—

1\. After hearing these words of Brahmā of immeasurable intellect, Nārada the brahmin was surprised and he lovingly asked him thus.

## \|\| 3.38.2 \|\|

*\|\| nārada uvāca \|*  
*śivaṃ vihāya dakṣasya surairyajñaṃ harirgataḥ \|*  
*hetunā kena tad brūhi yatrāvajñā' bhavattataḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

Nārada said:—

2\. Please tell me for what reason did Viṣṇu go to the sacrifice of Dakṣa along with the devas but leaving off Śiva, for there so much of ignominy was in store for him?

## \|\| 3.38.3 \|\|

*jānāti kiṃ sa śaṃbhuṃ no hariḥ pralayavikramam \|*  
*raṇaṃ kathaṃ ca kṛtavān tadgaṇairabudho yathā \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Does not Viṣṇu know Śiva who has the power of dissolution? Why did he fight with his Gaṇas like a foolish insensible man?

## \|\| 3.38.4 \|\|

*eṣa me saṃśayo bhūyāṃstaṃ chiṃdhi karuṇānidhe \|*  
*caritaṃ brūhi śaṃbhostu cittotsāhakaraṃ prabho \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. O Merciful one, this is my great doubt. Please clarify it O lord, narrate the story of Śiva to us that heightens the enthusiasm in our mind.

## \|\| 3.38.5 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*dvijavarya śṛṇu prītyā caritaṃ śaśimaulinaḥ \|*  
*yatpṛcchate kurvataśca sarvasaṃśayahārakam \|\| 5 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

5\. O excellent brahmin, listen with pleasure to the story of the moon-crested lord which dispels our doubts.

## \|\| 3.38.6 \|\|

*dadhīcasya muneḥ śāpādbhraṣṭajñāno hariḥ purā \|*  
*sāmaro dakṣayajñaṃ vai gataḥ kṣuvasahāyakṛt \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. O sage, formerly Viṣṇu lost his knowledge by the curse of Dadhīca. He, therefore, went to Dakṣa’s sacrifice along with the devas in order to help Kṣuva.

## \|\| 3.38.7 \|\|

*\|\| nārada uvāca \|*  
*kimarthaṃ śaptavānviṣṇuṃ dadhīco munisattamaḥ \|*  
*kopākāraḥ kṛtastasya hariṇā tatsahāyinā \|\| 7 \|\|*

Nārada said:—

7\. Why did the excellent sage Dadhīca curse Viṣṇu? What harm was done by Viṣṇu to Dadhīca by helping Kṣuva?

## \|\| 3.38.8 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*samutpanno mahātejā rājā kṣuva iti smṛtaḥ \|*  
*abhūnmitraṃ dadhīcasya munīndrasya mahāprabhoḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

8\. There was a king of great splendour named Kṣuva. He was the friend of Dadhīca, the sage of very great potentiality.

## \|\| 3.38.9 \|\|

*cirāttapaḥprasaṃgādvai vādaḥ kṣuvadadhīcayoḥ \|*  
*mahānarthakaraḥ khyātastrilokeṣvabhavatpurā \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Formerly a great dispute, well known in the three worlds, took place between Kṣuva and Dadhīca in the context of their penance. This caused great disaster.

## \|\| 3.38.10 \|\|

*tatra trivarṇataḥ śreṣṭho vipra eva na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*iti prāha dadhīco hi śivabhaktastu vedavit \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Dadhīca, a great devotee of Śiva and a Vedic scholar said—A brahmin alone is the noble person in the three higher Varṇas. There is no doubt.

## \|\| 3.38.11 \|\|

*tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya dadhīcasya mahāmune \|*  
*kṣuvaḥ prāheti nṛpatiḥ śrīmadena vimohitaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. O great sage, on hearing the words of Dadhīca, the king Kṣuva deluded by his pride due to wealth and glory said thus:—

## \|\| 3.38.12 \|\|

*kṣuva uvāca \|*  
*aṣṭānāṃ lokapālānāṃ vapurdhārayate nṛpaḥ \|*  
*tasmānnṛpo variṣṭho hi varṇāśramapatiḥ prabhuḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

Kṣuva said:—

12\. A king holds in his body parts of the eight guardians of the worlds. Hence a king is the most excellent lord of all Varṇas and Āśramas. He is the supreme lord.

## \|\| 3.38.13 \|\|

*sarvadevamayorājā śruti prāheti tatparā \|*  
*mahatī devatā yā sā sohameva tato mune \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. The Vedas say clearly that the king consists of all devas. Hence, O sage, I am that great deity.

## \|\| 3.38.14 \|\|

*tasmādviprādvaro rājā cyavaneya vicāryatām \|*  
*nāvamaṃtavya evātaḥ pūjyo'haṃ sarvathā tvayā \|\| 14 \|\|*

14 Hence a king is nobler than a brahmin. Take the example of Cyavana. Hence I am not to be disrespected by you. I am to be honoured always.

## \|\| 3.38.15 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*śrutvā tathā mataṃ tasya kṣuvasya munisattamaḥ \|*  
*śrutismṛtiviruddhaṃ taṃ cukopātīva bhārgavaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

15\. On hearing that opinion of Kṣuva, O excellent sage, which went contrary to Vedas and Smṛtis, Śukra became angry.

## \|\| 3.38.16 \|\|

*atha kruddho mahātejā gauravāccātmano mune \|*  
*atāḍayatkṣuvaṃ mūrdhni dadhīco vāmamuṣṭitaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Dadhīca of great splendour became angry because it affected his prestige, O sage. With his left fist he hit Kṣuva on his head.

## \|\| 3.38.17 \|\|

*vajreṇa taṃ ca ciccheda dadhīcaṃ tāḍitaḥ kṣuvaḥ \|*  
*jagarjātīva saṃkruddho brahmāṃḍādhipatiḥ kudhīḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Kṣuva on being hit struck Dadhīca with the thunderbolt. The king of evil mind became angry and roared loudly.

## \|\| 3.38.18 \|\|

*papāta bhūmau nihato tena vajreṇa bhārgavaḥ \|*  
*śukraṃ sasmāra kṣuvakṛdbhārgavasya kulaṃdharaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Dadhīca on being struck by the thunderbolt remembered Śukra who was one of his ancestors.

## \|\| 3.38.19 \|\|

*śukrotha saṃdhayāmāsa tāḍitaṃ ca kṣuvena tu \|*  
*yogī dadhīcasya tadā dehamāgatya sadrutam \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Śukra of Yogic powers approached the body of Dadhīca who was hit by Kṣuva and rejoined the broken limbs.

## \|\| 3.38.20 \|\|

*saṃdhāya pūrvavaddehaṃ dadhīcasyāha bhārgavaḥ \|*  
*śivabhaktāgraṇīrbhṛtyaṃ jayavidyāpravartakaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. After rejoining the organs as before of Dadhīca, Śukra a leading devotee of Śiva, the initiator of Mṛtyuñjayavidyā said.

## \|\| 3.38.21 \|\|

*śukra uvāca \|*  
*dadhīca tāta saṃpūjya śivaṃ sarveśvaraṃ prabhum \|*  
*mahāmṛtyuṃjayaṃ maṃtraṃ śrautamagryaṃ vadāmi te \|\| 21 \|\|*

Śukra said:—

21\. Dear Dadhīca, after worshipping Śiva the lord of everyone, I am going to tell you the highly potential Vedic mantra Mahāmṛtyuñjaya.

## \|\| 3.38.22 \|\|

*tryambakaṃ yajāmahe trailokyaṃ pitaraṃ prabhum \|*  
*trimaṃḍalasya pitaraṃ triguṇasya maheśvaram \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. We worship the three-eyed lord Śiva, the lord of the three worlds, the father of the three spheres, the lord of the three guṇas.

## \|\| 3.38.23-25 \|\|

*tritattvasya trivahneśca tridhābhūtasya sarvataḥ \|*  
*tridivasya tribāhośca tridhābhūtasya sarvataḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*tridevasya mahādevassugaṃdhi puṣṭivarddhanam \|*  
*sarvabhūteṣu sarvatra triguṇeṣu kṛtau yathā \|\| 24 \|\|*

*indriyeṣu tathānyeṣu deveṣu ca gaṇeṣu ca \|*  
*puṣpe sugaṃdhivatsūrassugaṃdhimamareśvaraḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

23-25. Lord Śiva is the essence, the fragrance of the three Tattvas, three fires, of every thing that is trichotomised, of the three worlds, of the three arms and of the trinity. He is the nourisher. In all living beings, everywhere, in the three Guṇas, in the creation, in the sense-organs, in the devas and Gaṇas, he is the essence as the fragrance in a flower. He is the lord of devas.

## \|\| 3.38.26-27 \|\|

*puṣṭiśca prakṛteryasmātpuruṣādvai dvijottama \|*  
*mahadādiviśeṣāṃtavikalpaścāpi suvrata \|\| 26 \|\|*

*viṣṇoḥ pitāmahasyāpi munīnāṃ ca mahāmune \|*  
*indriyasya ca devānāṃ tasmādvai puṣṭivarddhanaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. O excellent brahmin of good rites, He is called the nourisher because it is from Him the supreme Puruṣa Śiva that the Prakṛti, the different Tattvas from Mahat to the different Indriyas, Viṣṇu, Brahmā, the sages, Indra and the devas derive their nourishment.

## \|\| 3.38.28-29 \|\|

*taṃ devamamṛtaṃ rudraṃ karmaṇā tapasāpi vā \|*  
*svādhyāyena ca yogena dhyānena ca prajāpate \|\| 28 \|\|*

*satyenānyena sūkṣmāgrānmṛtyupāśādbhavaḥ svayam \|*  
*vaṃdhamokṣakaro yasmādurvārukamiva prabhuḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

28-29. Worship that immortal deity Śiva with sacred rites, penance, self-study of the Vedas, yogic practices, meditation, observance of truth and other means. You will be freed from the noose of Yama. The lord is the cause of both bondage and salvation.

## \|\| 3.38.30-31 \|\|

*mṛtasaṃjīvanīmantro mama sarvottamaḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*evaṃ japaparaḥ prītyā niyamena śivaṃ smaran \|\| 30 \|\|*

*japtvā hutvābhimaṃtryaiva jalaṃ piba divāniśam \|*  
*śivasya sannidhau dhyātvā nāsti mṛtyubhayaṃ kvacit \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. In my opinion this Mṛtasañjīvanī mantra is the most excellent of all. Repeat these mantras regularly remembering Śiva with devotion. After Japa, Homa and recitation of the mantras observe fast, but you can drink water day and night. If the meditation is conducted in the presence of Śiva there is no fear of death from anywhere.

## \|\| 3.38.32-33 \|\|

*kṛtvā nyāsādikaṃ sarvaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivacchivam \|*  
*saṃvidhāyedaṃ nirvyagraśśaṃkaraṃ bhaktavatsalam \|\| 32 \|\|*

*dhyānamasya pravakṣyāmi yathā dhyātvā japanmanum \|*  
*siddha mantro bhaveddhīmān yāvacchaṃbhuprabhāvataḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

32-33. Nyāsa and other ritualistic rites shall be observed. Śiva shall be worshipped duly. Śiva who is favourably disposed to his devotees shall be propitiated. I shall also mention the observance of meditation. It is after this meditation that the mantra shall be repeated as long as the purpose is realised due to Śiva’s power.

## \|\| 3.38.34 \|\|

*hastāṃbhojayugasthakuṃbhayugalāduddhṛtyatoyaṃ śirassiṃcaṃtaṃ karayoryugena dadhataṃ svāṃkebhakuṃbhau karau \|*  
*akṣasraṅmṛgahastamaṃbujagataṃ mūrddhasthacandrasravatpīyūṣārdratanuṃ bhaje sagirijaṃ tryakṣaṃ ca mṛtyuṃjayam \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. I worship the three-eyed Lord Śiva, the conqueror of death who is accompanied by (Pārvatī); who pours water on his head from two vessels held in his lotus-like hands, by means of the other pair of hands; who has placed the two hands with the pots on the lap; who usually holds in his hands the Rudrākṣa garland and a deer and whose body is rendered cool and wet by the nectar exuding from the moon worn on the head.

## \|\| 3.38.35 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*upadiśyeti śukraḥ svaṃ dadhīciṃ munisattamam \|*  
*svasthānamagamattāta saṃsmarañ śaṃkaraṃ prabhum \|\| 35 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

35\. After instructing the excellent sage Dadhīca thus and remembering lord Śiva, O dear, Śukra returned to his abode.

## \|\| 3.38.36 \|\|

*tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā dadhīco hi mahāmuniḥ \|*  
*vanaṃ jagāma tapase mahāprītyā śivaṃ smaran \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. On hearing his words, the great sage Dadhīca went to the forest for penance thinking upon Śiva with great pleasure.

## \|\| 3.38.37 \|\|

*tatra gatvā vidhānena mahāmṛtyuṃjayābhidham \|*  
*taṃ manuṃ prajapan prītyā tapastepe śivaṃ smaran \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Going there he performed penance repeating the mantra named Mahāmṛtyuñjaya in accordance with the rules and remembering Śiva with great pleasure.

## \|\| 3.38.38 \|\|

*tanmanuṃ suciraṃ japtvā tapasārādhya śaṃkaram \|*  
*śivaṃ saṃtoṣayāmāsa mahāmṛtyuṃjayaṃ hi saḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. After repeating the mantra for a long time and propitiating Śiva with penance, he delighted Śiva named Mahāmṛtyuñjaya—the conqueror of great death.

## \|\| 3.38.39 \|\|

*atha śaṃbhuḥ prasannātmā tajjapādbhaktavatsalaḥ \|*  
*āvirbabhūva puratastasya prītyā mahāmune \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. O great sage, Śiva who is favourably disposed towards his devotees became delighted by that Japa and appeared before him lovingly.

## \|\| 3.38.40 \|\|

*taṃ dṛṣṭvā svaprabhuṃ śaṃbhuṃ sa mumoda munīśvaraḥ \|*  
*praṇamya vidhivadbhaktyā tuṣṭāva sukṛtāṃjaliḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. On seeing his lord Śiva, the great sage was highly pleased. After bowing to him with devotion and in accordance with rules he eulogised him with palms joined in reverence.

## \|\| 3.38.41 \|\|

*atha prītyā śivastāta prasannaścyāvaniṃ mune \|*  
*varaṃ brūhīti sa prāha suprasannena cetasā \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. O dear one, O sage, Śiva told the son of Cyavana (Dadhīca)—“Please tell me what boon (you require)”

## \|\| 3.38.42 \|\|

*tacchutvā śaṃbhuvacanaṃ dadhīco bhaktasattamaḥ \|*  
*sāṃjalirnatakaḥ prāha śaṃkaraṃ bhaktavatsalam \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. On hearing the words of Śiva, Dadhīca, the most excellent devotee, spoke to Śiva who is favourably disposed to his devotees, with palms joined in reverence and a formal salutation.

Dadhīca said;—

## \|\| 3.38.43 \|\|

*dadhīca uvāca \|*  
*devadeva mahādeva mahyaṃ dehi varatrayam \|*  
*vajrāsthitvādavadhyatvamadīnatvaṃ hi sarvataḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. O great lord, lord of Devas, please give me three boons viz. adamantine bones, impossibility of being killed and absence of distress.

## \|\| 3.38.44 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*taduktavacanaṃ śrutvā prasannaḥ parameśvaraḥ \|*  
*varatrayaṃ dadau tasmai dadhīcāya tathāstviti \|\| 44 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

44\. On hearing the words mentioned by him, the delightful great lord gave Dadhīca the three boons saying “so be it”.

## \|\| 3.38.45 \|\|

*varatrayaṃ śivātprāpya sānaṃdaśca mahāmuniḥ \|*  
*kṣuvasthānaṃ jagāmāśu vedamārge pratiṣṭhitaḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. After securing the three boons from Śiva, the great sage, who strictly followed the Vedic path, was delighted and went immediately to kṣuva’s abode.

## \|\| 3.38.46 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*prāpyāvadhyatvamugrātsa vajrāsthitvamadīnatām \|*  
*atāḍayacca rājendraṃ pādamūlena mūrddhani \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Having secured indestructibility, adamantine bones and absence of distress from Śiva, he kicked the king on the head with the root of his foot.

## \|\| 3.38.47 \|\|

*kṣuvo dadhīcaṃ vajreṇa jaghānorasyatho nṛpaḥ \|*  
*krodhaṃ kṛtvā viśeṣeṇa viṣṇugauravagarvitaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Kṣuva, the king who was haughty by the favour of Viṣṇu, became angry and hit Dadhīca on his chest with his thunderbolt.

## \|\| 3.38.48 \|\|

*nābhūnnāśāya tadvajraṃ dadhīcasya mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*prabhāvātparameśasya dhātṛputro visismiye \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. The thunderbolt was incompetent to destroy Dadhīca the noble-souled, thanks to the power of lord Śiva. The son of the creator (Kṣuva) was greatly surprised.

## \|\| 3.38.49 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvāpyavadhyatvamadīnatāṃ ca vajrasya cātyaṃtaparaprabhāvam \|*  
*kṣuvo dadhīcasya munīśvarasya visismiye cetasi dhātṛputraḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. On thus seeing the indestructibility, absence of distress and adamantine bones of Dadhīca the great sage, Kṣuva, the son of the creator, became surprised at heart.

## \|\| 3.38.50 \|\|

*ārādhayāmāsa hariṃ mukundamindrānujaṃ kānanamāśu gatvā \|*  
*prapannapālaśca parājito hi dadhīcamṛtyuṃjayasevakena \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Defeated thus by Dadhīca who was the server of Mṛtyuñjaya and who resorted to Śiva, Kṣuva went to the forest immediately and propitiated Viṣṇu, the younger brother of Indra.

## \|\| 3.38.51 \|\|

*pūjayā tasya santuṣṭo bhagavān madhusūdanaḥ \|*  
*pradadau darśanaṃ tasmai divyaṃ vai garuḍadhvajaḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. The lord Viṣṇu satisfied with his worship revealed himself to him in the divine form of the Garuḍa-bannered deity.

## \|\| 3.38.52 \|\|

*divyena darśanenaiva dṛṣṭvā devaṃ janārdanam \|*  
*tuṣṭāva vāgbhiriṣṭābhiḥ praṇamya garuḍadhvajam \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. On seeing the lord with his divine vision, he bowed and eulogised him with pleasing words.

## \|\| 3.38.53 \|\|

*sampūjya caivaṃ tridaśeśvarādyaiḥ stutaṃ devamajeyamīśam \|*  
*vijñāpayāmāsa nirīkṣya bhaktyā janārdanāya praṇipatya mūrdhnā \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. After worshipping and eulogising the invincible lord, lauded by Indra and others, he devoutly bowed down his head and submitted thus to him.

## \|\| 3.38.54 \|\|

*rājovāca \|*  
*bhagavan brāhmaṇaḥ kaściddadhīca iti viśrutaḥ \|*  
*dharmavettā vinītātmā sakhā mama purābhavat \|\| 54 \|\|*

The king said:—

54\. O Holy lord, formerly I had a humble friend, a certain brahmin renowned as Dadhīca who knew all virtuous acts.

## \|\| 3.38.55 \|\|

*avadhyassarvadā sarvaiśśaṃkarasya prabhāvataḥ \|*  
*tamārādhya mahādevaṃ mṛtyuṃjayamanāmayam \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. He cannot be killed by anyone at any time due to the power of Śiva. He got this boon after propitiating Śiva, the conqueror of death who is free from sickness.

## \|\| 3.38.56 \|\|

*sāvajñaṃ vāmapādena mama mūrdhni sadasyapi \|*  
*tāḍayāmāsa vegena sa dadhīco mahātapāḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. In the open assembly, that Dadhīca of great penance, contemptuously kicked me with his left leg on my head.

## \|\| 3.38.57 \|\|

*uvāca taṃ ca garveṇa na bibhemīti sarvataḥ \|*  
*mṛtyuṃjayāpta suvaro garvito hyatulaṃ hariḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. O Viṣṇu, he told me haughtily—“I am not afraid of anybody”. Having obtained favours from Mṛtyuñjaya he is incomparably haughty.

## \|\| 3.38.58 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*atha jñātvā dadhīcasya hyavadhyatvaṃ mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*sasmārāsya maheśasya prabhāvamatulaṃ hariḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

58\. On coming to know of the indestructibility of Dadhīca of noble soul, Viṣṇu thought upon the unrivalled power of lord Śiva.

## \|\| 3.38.59 \|\|

*evaṃ smṛtvā hariḥ prāha kṣuvaṃ vidhisutaṃ drutam \|*  
*viprāṇāṃ nāsti rājendra bhayamaṇvapi kutracit \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. Having thus remembered Śiva, Viṣṇu told Kṣuva the son of Brahmā immediately—“O noble king, brahmins need not be afraid of anything even a bit.”

## \|\| 3.38.60 \|\|

*viśeṣādrudrabhaktānāṃ bhayaṃ nāsti ca bhūpate \|*  
*duḥkhaṃ karoti viprasya śāpārthaṃ sasurasya me \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. O king, especially the devotees of Śiva have no fear at all. He would curse me along with the devas and trouble me.

## \|\| 3.38.61 \|\|

*bhavitā tasya śāpena dakṣayajñe sureśvarāt \|*  
*vināśo mama rājendra punarutthānameva ca \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. O noble king, my destruction will also take place from the leader of Gaṇas at Dakṣa’s sacrifice due to his curse. Of course I will be rising up again.

## \|\| 3.38.62 \|\|

*tasmātsametya rājendra sarvayajño na bhūyate \|*  
*karomi yatnaṃ rājendra dadhīcavijayāya te \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. O leader of kings, the completion of the sacrifice will not take place. Of course O king, I shall strive for your victory over Dadhīca.

## \|\| 3.38.63 \|\|

*śrutvā vākyaṃ kṣuvaḥ prāha tathāstviti harernṛpaḥ \|*  
*tasthau tatraiva tatprītyā tatkāmotsukamānasaḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. On hearing the words of Viṣṇu, the king Kṣuva said—“So be it”. He remained there alone, eager to achieve his desire.

## Chapter 39 - Description of the fight between Viṣṇu and Dadhīca

## \|\| 3.39.1 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*kṣuvasya hitakṛtyena dadhīcasyāśramaṃ yayau \|*  
*viprarūpamathāsthāya bhagavān bhaktavatsalaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

1\. In order to do something beneficent to Kṣuva, the lord Viṣṇu who is favourably disposed to his devotees assumed the form of a brahmin and went to the hermitage of Dadhīca.

## \|\| 3.39.2 \|\|

*dadhīcaṃ prāha viprarṣimabhivaṃdya jagadguruḥ \|*  
*kṣuvakāryyārthamudyuktaśśaivendraṃ chalamāśritaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. The Preceptor of the Universe Viṣṇu resorting to deception for the realisation of Kṣuva’s purpose, bowed to the brahminical sage Dadhīca, the leader of devotees of Śiva, and spoke these words.

## \|\| 3.39.3 \|\|

*viṣṇuruvāca \|*  
*bho bho dadhīca viprarṣe bhavārcanaratāvyaya \|*  
*varamekaṃ vṛṇe tvattastadbhavān dātumarhati \|\| 3 \|\|*

Viṣṇu said:—

3\. O Dadhīca, O brahminical sage, engrossed in the worship of Śiva, O unchanging one, I am soliciting a boon from you, which you will please grant.

## \|\| 3.39.4 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*yācito devadevena dadhīcaśśaivasattamaḥ \|*  
*kṣuvakāryārthinā śīghraṃ jagāda vacanaṃ harim \|\| 4 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

4\. Dadhīca, the most excellent of the devotees of Śiva, thus requested by the lord of Devas on behalf of Kṣuva, immediately replied thus.

## \|\| 3.39.5 \|\|

*dadhīca uvāca \|*  
*jñātaṃ tavepsitaṃ vipra kṣuvakāryārthamāgataḥ \|*  
*bhagavān viprarūpeṇa māyī tvamasi vai hariḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

Dadhīca said:—

5\. O brahmin, your purpose has been understood by me. You have come here on behalf of Kṣuva. You are the lord Viṣṇu in the form of a brahmin due to your illusion.

## \|\| 3.39.6 \|\|

*bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ deveśa vartamānaṃ janārdana \|*  
*jñānaṃ prasādādrudrasya sadā traikālikaṃ mama \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. O lord of Devas, O Viṣṇu, thanks to the grace of Śiva, the past, future and present, everything in the three periods of time is known to me.

## \|\| 3.39.7 \|\|

*tvāṃ jānehaṃ hariṃ viṣṇuṃ dvijatvaṃ tyaja suvrata \|*  
*ārādhito'si bhūpena kṣuveṇa khalabuddhinā \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. I know you to be Viṣṇu, O observer of good rites, leave off your disguise of brahminhood. You have been propitiated by king Kṣuva of wicked intellect.

## \|\| 3.39.8 \|\|

*jāne tavaiva bhagavan bhaktavatsalatāṃ hare \|*  
*chalaṃ tyaja svarūpaṃ hi svīkuru smara śaṃkaram \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. O lord Viṣṇu, I know your favouritism towards your devotees. Cast off this deception. Assume your own real form. Remember Śiva.

## \|\| 3.39.9 \|\|

*asti cetkasyacidbhītirbhavārcanaratasya me \|*  
*vaktumarhasi yatnena satyadhāraṇapūrvakam \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. If any one is afraid of me in view of my being engrossed in the worship of Śiva, you will please tell me bearing in mind the true state of things.

## \|\| 3.39.10 \|\|

*vadāmi na mṛṣā kvāpi śivasmaraṇasaktadhīḥ \|*  
*na bibhemi jagatyasmindevadaityādikādapi \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. With my mind drawn to the memory of Śiva, I never tell a lie. I am not afraid of devas or demons in the whole universe.

## \|\| 3.39.11 \|\|

*viṣṇuruvāca \|*  
*bhayaṃ dadhīca sarvatra naṣṭaṃ ca tava suvrata \|*  
*bhavārcanarato yasmādbhavānsarvajña eva ca \|\| 11 \|\|*

Viṣṇu said:—

11\. “O Dadhīca of good rites, all sorts of fear are at an end for you. Since you are actively engaged in the worship of Śiva you are omniscient.

## \|\| 3.39.12 \|\|

*bibhemīti sakṛdvaktumarhasi tvaṃ namastava \|*  
*niyogānmama rājendra kṣuvāt pratisahasya ca \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. You will please say for once that you are afraid. Obeisance to you. At my behest please bear with Kṣuva the leader of kings”.

## \|\| 3.39.13 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*evaṃ śrutvāpi tadvākyaṃ viṣṇossa tu mahāmuniḥ \|*  
*vihasya nirbhayaḥ prāha dadhīcaśśaivasattamaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

Brahmā said:

13\. Even after hearing this request of Viṣṇu, the great sage Dadhīca, the most excellent of the devotees of Śiva, laughed and said fearlessly:—

## \|\| 3.39.14 \|\|

*dadhīca uvāca \|\| \|*  
*na bibhemi sadā kvāpi kutaścidapi kiṃcana \|*  
*prabhāvāddevadevasya śaṃbhossākṣātpinākinaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

Dadhīca said:—

14\. “I am not at all afraid of anything anywhere at any time, thanks to the power of the Pināka-wielding Śiva, the lord of Devas”.

## \|\| 3.39.15 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*tatastasya muneḥ śrutvā vacanaṃ kupito hariḥ \|*  
*cakramudyamya saṃtasthau didhakṣumunisattamam \|\| 15 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

15\. Then, on hearing the words of the sage, Viṣṇu became angry. He lifted his discus and stood as if he would burn the excellent sage.

## \|\| 3.39.16 \|\|

*abhavatkuṃṭhitaṃ tatra vipre cakraṃ sudāruṇam \|*  
*prabhāvācca tadīśasya nṛpatessaṃnidhāvapi \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. When hurled upon the brahmin, the terrible discus became blunted in the presence of the king, thanks to the power of Śiva.

## \|\| 3.39.17 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā taṃ kuṃṭhitāsyaṃ taccakraṃ viṣṇuṃ jagāda ha \|*  
*dadhīcassasmitaṃ sākṣātsadasadvyakti kāraṇam \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. On seeing the discus blunted at the edges, Dadhīca smilingly spoke to Viṣṇu, the cause of discrimination between the existent and the non-existent.

## \|\| 3.39.18 \|\|

*dadhīca uvāca \|*  
*bhagavan bhavatā labdhaṃ purātīva sudāruṇam \|*  
*sudarśanamiti khyātaṃ cakraṃ viṣṇoḥ prayatnataḥ \|*  
*bhavasya tacchubhaṃ cakraṃ na jighāṃsati māmiha \|\| 18 \|\|*

Dadhīca said:—

18\. O lord Viṣṇu, formerly the famous terrible discus Sudarśana was secured by you with great effort.

## \|\| 3.39.19 \|\|

*bhagavānatha kruddho'smai sarvāstrāṇi kramāddhariḥ \|*  
*brahmāstrādyaiḥ śaraiścāstraiḥ prayatnaṃ kartumarhasi \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. That is the auspicious discus of Śiva. It does not kill me here. O lord Viṣṇu, furious at me you can endeavour to hurl all the weapons such as Brahmāstra at me one by one.

## \|\| 3.39.20 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*sa tasya vacanaṃ śrutvā dṛṣṭvā ni्rvīryyamānuṣam \|*  
*sasarjātha krudhā tasmai sarvāstrāṇi kramāddhariḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

20\. Viṣṇu, on hearing his words, thought that he was only a man devoid of virility and hence hurled at him all the weapons.

## \|\| 3.39.21 \|\|

*cakrurdevāstatastasya viṣṇossāhāyyamādarāt \|*  
*dvijenaikena saṃyoddhuṃ prasṛtasya vibuddhayaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Thereupon the devas of crooked intellect rendered help to Viṣṇu who was engaged in fighting with a single brahmin.

## \|\| 3.39.22 \|\|

*cikṣipuḥ svāni svānyāśu śastrāṇyastrāṇi sarvataḥ \|*  
*dadhīcopari vegena śakrādyā haripākṣikāḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Indra and others, partisans of Viṣṇu, hurled with force their own different weapons from all round on Dadhīca.

## \|\| 3.39.23 \|\|

*kuśamuṣṭimathādāya dadhīcassaṃsmaran śivam \|*  
*sasarja sarvadevebhyo vajrāsthi sarvato vaśī \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Taking a fistful of Kuśa grass and remembering Śiva, Dadhīca of adamantine bones and self-control discharged it against all the Gods.

## \|\| 3.39.24 \|\|

*śaṃkarasya prabhāvāttu kuśamuṣṭirmunerhi sā \|*  
*divyaṃ triśūlamabhavat kālāgnisadṛśaṃ mune \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. O sage, thanks to the power of Śiva, the fistful Kuśa grass of the sage became the divine trident equal in potentiality to the fire of the god of death.

## \|\| 3.39.25 \|\|

*dagdhuṃ devān matiṃ cakre sāyudhaṃ saśikhaṃ ca tat \|*  
*prajvalatsarvataśśaivaṃ yugāṃtāgryadhikaprabham \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. That trident of Śaiva nature blazing around with the lustre exceeding the fire at the close of the Yugas wanted to burn the armed Gods.

## \|\| 3.39.26 \|\|

*nārāyaṇendumukhyaistu devaiḥ kṣiptāni yāni ca \|*  
*āyudhāni samastāni praṇemustriśikhaṃ ca tat \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. All the weapons hurled by the devas of whom Nārāyaṇa and Indra were the most important, bowed down in reverence to that trident.

## \|\| 3.39.27 \|\|

*devāśca dudruvussarve dhvastavīryā divaukasaḥ \|*  
*tasthau tatra harirbhītaḥ kevalaṃ māyināṃ varaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Bereft of their virility, the heaven-dwelling devas fled. Viṣṇu, alone, the foremost of those who make use of Māyā, remained there but he was afraid.

## \|\| 3.39.28 \|\|

*sasarja bhagavān viṣṇuḥ svadehātpuruṣottamaḥ \|*  
*ātmanassadṛśān divyān lakṣalakṣāyutān gaṇān \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Viṣṇu, the lord, created out of his body millions of divine beings like himself.

## \|\| 3.39.29 \|\|

*te cāpi yuyudhustatra vīrā viṣṇugaṇāstataḥ \|*  
*muninaikena devarṣe dadhīcena śivātmanā \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. O celestial sage, those Viṣṇugaṇas of heroic power fought with the single sage Dadhīca identical with Śiva.

## \|\| 3.39.30 \|\|

*tato viṣṇugaṇān tānvai niyudhya bahuśo raṇe \|*  
*dadāha sahasā sarvān dadhī caśśaiva sattamaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Then withstanding the entire hosts of Viṣṇugaṇas, Dadhīca, the most excellent of the devotees of Śiva, burnt them all in the battle.

## \|\| 3.39.31 \|\|

*tatastadvismayāthāya dadhīcesya munerhariḥ \|*  
*viśvamūrtirabhūcchīghraṃ mahāmāyāviśāradaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Then, in order to confound the sage Dadhīca, Viṣṇu, clever in the use of illusion, became multi-formed.

## \|\| 3.39.32 \|\|

*tasya dehe hareḥ sākṣādapaśyaddvijasattamaḥ \|*  
*dadhīco devatādīnāṃ jīvānāṃ ca sahasrakam \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. In that body of Viṣnu, the most excellent brahmin Dadhīca saw thousands of devas and living beings.

## \|\| 3.39.33 \|\|

*bhūtānāṃ koṭayaścaiva gaṇānāṃ koṭayastathā \|*  
*aṃḍānāṃ koṭayaścaiva viśvamūtastanau tadā \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. There were crores of Bhūtas, crores of Gaṇas and crores of universes in the body of multiformed Viṣṇu then.

## \|\| 3.39.34 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvaitadakhilaṃ tatra cyāvanissatataṃ tadā \|*  
*viṣṇumāha jagannāthaṃ jagatstu vamajaṃ vibhum \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. On seeing all things spread there, Dadhīca, the son of Cyavana spoke to Viṣṇu, the all-pervading, unborn, lord of the universe, eulogised by the whole universe.

## \|\| 3.39.35 \|\|

*dadhīca uvāca \|*  
*māyāṃ tyaja mahābāho pratibhāso vicārataḥ \|*  
*vijñātāni sahasrāṇi durvijñeyāni mādhava \|\| 35 \|\|*

Dadhīca said:—

35\. O long-armed one, cast-off this illusion. On consideration, this is only a sham appearance. O Viṣṇu, thousands of inscrutable things are known to me also.

## \|\| 3.39.36 \|\|

*mayi paśya jagatsarvaṃ tvayā yuktamataṃdritaḥ \|*  
*brahmāṇaṃ ca tathā rudraṃ divyāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ dadāmi te \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. I shall give you a divine vision. You will see in me the entire universe including you, Brahmā and Rudra. You shall then be alert.

## \|\| 3.39.37 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*ityuktvā darśayāmāsa svatanau nikhilaṃ muniḥ \|*  
*brahmāṃḍaṃ cyāvaniśśaṃbhutejasā pūrṇadehakaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

37\. After saying so, the saintly son of Cyavana, of body fully infused with the brilliance of Śiva, showed the entire universe in his body.

## \|\| 3.39.38 \|\|

*dadāha viṣṇuṃ deveśaṃ dadhīcaśśaivasattamaḥ \|*  
*saṃsmarañ śaṃkaraṃ citte vihasan vibhayassudhīḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Remembering Śiva in his mind and laughing fearlessly, the intelligent Dadhīca, the most excellent of the devotees of Śiva spoke to Viṣṇu, the lord of Devas, thus.

## \|\| 3.39.39 \|\|

*dadhīca uvāca \|*  
*māyayā tvanayā kiṃ vā maṃtraśaktyātha vā hare \|*  
*satkāmāyāmimāṃ tasmādyoddhumarhasi yatnataḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

Dadhīca said:—

39\. O Viṣṇu, of what avail is this illusion of yours or the power of Mantra. You shall give up this illusion and fight in a straight manner.

## \|\| 3.39.40 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*etacchutvā munestasya vacanaṃ nirbhayastadā \|*  
*śaṃbhutejomayaṃ viṣṇuścukopātīva taṃ munim \|\| 40 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

40\. On hearing the words of the sage, the fearless Viṣṇu became angry with the sage who had been infused with the brilliance of śiva.

## \|\| 3.39.41 \|\|

*devāśca dudruvurbhūyo devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ ca tam \|*  
*yoddhukāmāśca muninā dadhīcena pratāpinā \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. The gods also rushed to the aid of lord Viṣṇu who was desirous of fighting with the sage Dadhīca of great valour.

## \|\| 3.39.42-43 \|\|

*etasminnaṃtare tatrāgamanmatsaṃgataḥ kṣuvaḥ \|*  
*avārayaṃtaṃ niśceṣṭaṃ padmayoniṃ hariṃ surān \|\| 42 \|\|*

*niśamya vacanaṃ me hi brāhmaṇo na vinirjitaḥ \|*  
*jagāma nikaṭaṃ tasya praṇanāma muniṃ hariḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

42-43. In the meantime, Kṣuva of noble contact, came there. He prevented the motionless Brahmā, Viṣṇu and the gods from fighting. Even after hearing my words, the defeated Viṣṇu did not go near the sage, nor bowed to her.

## \|\| 3.39.44 \|\|

*kṣuvo dīnataro bhūtvā gatvā tatra munīśvaram \|*  
*dadhīcamabhivādyaiva prārthayāmāsa viklavaḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Kṣuva who became agitated and distressed went near Dadhīca the great sage, bowed to him and requested thus.

## \|\| 3.39.45 \|\|

*kṣuva uvāca \|*  
*prasīda muniśārdūla śivabhaktaśiromaṇe \|*  
*prasīda parameśāna durlakṣye durjanaissaha \|\| 45 \|\|*

Kṣuva said:—

45\. O leader of sages, foremost of the devotees of Śiva, be pleased. Be pleased with Lakṣmī’s consort who is difficult to be perceived by the wicked people.

## \|\| 3.39.46 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*ityākarṇya vacastasya rājñassuragaṇasya hi \|*  
*anujagrāha taṃ vipro dadhīcastapasāṃ nidhiḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

46\. On hearing the words of the king on behalf of the devas, the brahmin Dadhīca, the storehouse of penance, blessed him.

## \|\| 3.39.47 \|\|

*atha dṛṣṭvā rameśādīn krodhavihvalito muniḥ \|*  
*hṛdi smṛtvā śivaṃ viṣṇuṃ śaśāpa ca surānapi \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Then, on seeing the lord of Lakṣmī Viṣṇu and others, the sage was angry. Remembering Śiva, he cursed Viṣṇu and the devas.

## \|\| 3.39.48 \|\|

*dadhīca uvāca \|*  
*rudrakopāgninā devāssadeveṃdrā munīśvarāḥ \|*  
*dhvastā bhavaṃtu devena viṣṇunā ca samaṃ gaṇaiḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

Dadhīca said:—

48\. Let the gods with Indra, the sages and the lord Viṣṇu be burnt in the fire of the anger of Rudra.

## \|\| 3.39.49 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*evaṃ śaptvā surān prekṣya kṣuvamāha tato muniḥ \|*  
*devaiśca pūjyo rājendra nṛpaiścaiva dvijottamaḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

49\. After cursing them he looked at Kṣuva and said—“O leader of kings, a brahmin is worthy of being respected by devas, kings and the best of other castes.

## \|\| 3.39.50 \|\|

*brāhmaṇā eva rājendra balinaḥ prabhaviṣṇavaḥ \|*  
*ityuktvā sa sphuṭa vipraḥ praviveśa nijāśramam \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. O leader of kings, only brahmins are powerful, and influential”. After saying thus clearly the brahmin entered his hermitage.

## \|\| 3.39.51 \|\|

*dadhīcamabhivaṃdyaiva kṣuvo nijagṛhaṃ gataḥ \|*  
*viṣṇurjagāma svaṃ lokaṃ suraissaha yathāgatam \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. After venerating Dadhīca, Kṣuva returned to his abode. Viṣṇu also returned to his region and the devas to their respective places.

## \|\| 3.39.52 \|\|

*tadevaṃ tīrthamabhavat sthāneśvara iti smṛtam \|*  
*sthāneśvaramanuprāpya śivasāyujyamāpnuyāt \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. That place became a sanctified holy centre named Sthāneśvara. Persons making pilgrimage to Sthāneśvara will attain the Sāyujya salvation with Śiva.

## \|\| 3.39.53 \|\|

*kathitastava saṃkṣepādvādaḥ kṣuvadadhīcayoḥ \|*  
*nṛpāptaśāpayostāta brahmaviṣṇvoḥ śivaṃ vinā \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Thus I have briefly narrated the dispute between Kṣuva and Dadhīca and also the story of Brahmā and Viṣṇu who were cursed for being without the support of Śiva.

## \|\| 3.39.54 \|\|

*ya idaṃ kīttayennityaṃ vādaṃ kṣuvadadhīcayoḥ \|*  
*jitvāpamṛtyuṃ dehānte brahmalokaṃ prayāti saḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. Whoever recites this portion containing the discord between Kṣuva and Dadhīca can conquer premature death. After death he attains Brahmā’s region.

## \|\| 3.39.55 \|\|

*raṇe yaḥ kīrtayitvedaṃ praviśettasya sarvadā \|*  
*mṛtyubhītibhavennaiva vijayī ca bhaviṣyati \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. If a person recites this section and enters the battle, he need not be afraid of death at all. He will come out victorious.

## Chapter 40 - Journey to Kailāsa and the vision of Śiva

## \|\| 3.40.1 \|\|

*\|\| nārada ucāca \|*  
*vidhe vidhe mahāprājñā śaivatattvapradarśaka \|*  
*śrāvitā ramaṇīprāyā śivalīlā mahādbhutā \|\| 1 \|\|*

Nārada said:—

1\. O Brahmā of great intellect, who are the guide for Śiva cult, you have narrated to me the wonderfully beautiful story of Śiva’s sport.

## \|\| 3.40.2 \|\|

*vīreṇa vīrabhadreṇa dakṣayajñaṃ vināśya vai \|*  
*kailāsādrau gate tāta kimabhūttadvadādhunā \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. After destroying the sacrifice of Dakṣa when the heroic Vīrabhadra went to Kailāsa what happened there? O dear, please tell me now.

## \|\| 3.40.3 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*atha devagaṇāssarve munayaśca parājitāḥ \|*  
*rudrānīkairvibhinnāṃgā mama lokaṃ yayustadā \|\| 3 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

3\. Defeated and mutilated by Śiva’s armies the gods and the sages came to my region.

## \|\| 3.40.4 \|\|

*svayaṃbhuve namaskṛtya mahyaṃ saṃstūya bhūriśaḥ \|*  
*tatsvakleśaṃ viśeṣeṇa kārtsyenaiva nyavedayan \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. After making obeisance to me who am self-born, and eulogising me in various ways, they explained their distress entirely.

## \|\| 3.40.5 \|\|

*tadākarṇya tatohaṃ vai putraśokena pīḍitaḥ \|*  
*acintayamativyagro dūyamānena cetasā \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. On hearing that, I was extremely pained for my son Dakṣa. In that mental anguish I thought.

## \|\| 3.40.6 \|\|

*kiṃ kāryyaṃ kāryamadyāśu mayā devasukhāvaham \|*  
*yena jīvatu dakṣāsau makhaḥ pūrṇo bhavetsuraḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. “What step shall I take to please the devas, whereby Dakṣa can be restored to life and whereby the sacrifice also be completed?”

## \|\| 3.40.7 \|\|

*evaṃ vicārya bahudhā nālabhaṃ śamahaṃ mune \|*  
*viṣṇuṃ tadā smaran bhaktyā jñānamāptaṃ tadocitam \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. O sage, even after thinking a lot I did not attain any peace of mind. Remembering lord Viṣṇu with devotion I knew what I shall do.

## \|\| 3.40.8 \|\|

*atha devaiśca munibhirviṣṇorlokamahaṃ gataḥ \|*  
*natvā nutvā ca vividhaisstavairduḥkhaṃ nyavedayam \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Then I went to the world of Viṣṇu along with the gods and the sages. After bowing to and eulogising him with various hymns I informed him of my misery.

## \|\| 3.40.9 \|\|

*yathādhvaraḥ prapūrṇaḥ syāddeva yajñakaraśca saḥ \|*  
*sukhinassyussurāssarve munayaśca tathā kuru \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Please make arrangements so that the sacrifice shall be completed, the gods and the sages be happy. As you know he was performing a sacrifice.

## \|\| 3.40.10 \|\|

*deva deva ramānātha viṣṇo devasukhāvaha \|*  
*vayaṃ tvaccharaṇaṃ prāptāssadevamunayo dhruvam \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. O lord of Lakṣmī, lord of gods, bestower of happiness to the gods, we, including the devas and the sages, have sought refuge in you.

## \|\| 3.40.11 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*ityākarṇya vaco me hi brahmaṇassa rameśvaraḥ \|*  
*pratyuvāca śivaṃ smṛtvā śivātmā dīnamānasaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

11\. On hearing my words, the lord of Lakṣmī with his soul set on Śiva and mind free from distress, replied after duly remembering Śiva.

## \|\| 3.40.12 \|\|

*\|\| viṣṇuruvāca \|*  
*tejīyasi na sā bhūtā kṛtāgasi bubhūṣatām \|*  
*tatra kṣemāya bahudhā bubhūṣā hi kṛtāgasām \|\| 12 \|\|*

Viṣṇu said:—

12\. An aggression against a powerful person neither befits a weak aggressor nor leads to his welfare.

## \|\| 3.40.13 \|\|

*kṛtapāpāssurā sarve śive hi parameśvare \|*  
*parādaduryajñabhāgaṃ tasya śaṃbhorvidhe yataḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Thus, O Brahman, the gods have committed sin and offended Śiva, since they had partaken of His share in the sacrifice.

## \|\| 3.40.14 \|\|

*prasādayadhyaṃ sarve hi yūyaṃ śuddhena cetasā \|*  
*athāparaprasādaṃ taṃ gṛhītāṃghriyugaṃ śivam \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. You shall propitiate Śiva by falling at his feet, with pure mind.

## \|\| 3.40.15 \|\|

*yasmin prakupite deve vinaśyatyakhilaṃ jagat \|*  
*salokapālayajñasya śāsanājjīvitaṃ drutam \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. At the bidding of the protector of the world whose fury annihilates everything, the resuscitation is certain and immediate.

## \|\| 3.40.16 \|\|

*tamāśu devaṃ priyayā vihīnaṃ ca duruktibhiḥ \|*  
*kṣamāpayadhvaṃ hṛdviddhaṃ dakṣeṇa sudurātmanā \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. That lord has been wounded in the heart by the wicked Dakṣa by harsh words. Crave the forgiveness of that lord who has lost his beloved now.

## \|\| 3.40.17 \|\|

*ayameva mahopāyastacchāṃtyai kevalaṃ vidhe \|*  
*śaṃbhossaṃtuṣṭaye manye satyamevoditaṃ mayā \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. O Brahman, this is the only remedy for tranquilising him, I think and also for pleasing him. I have mentioned that truth.

## \|\| 3.40.18 \|\|

*nāhaṃ na tvaṃ surāścānye munayopi tanūbhṛtaḥ \|*  
*yasya tattvaṃ pramāṇaṃ ca na vidurbalavīryayoḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Neither I nor you, nor the gods, nor the sages, nor any embodied being knows the reality and the extent of his strength and power.

## \|\| 3.40.19 \|\|

*ātmataṃtrasya tasyāpi parasya paramātmanaḥ \|*  
*ka upāyaṃ vidhitsedvai paraṃ mūḍhaṃ virodhinam \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Who else can lay down a remedy for Śiva who is independent and the greatest self—a remedy that quells delusion?

## \|\| 3.40.20 \|\|

*caliṣyehamapi brahman sarvaiḥ sārddha śivālayam \|*  
*kṣamāpayāmi giriśaṃ kṛtāgāśca śive dhuvam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. I too have offended Śiva. I shall also come, O Brahmā, to Śiva’s abode along with you all and crave the forgiveness of Śiva.

## \|\| 3.40.21 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*itthamādiśya viṣṇurmāṃ brahmāṇaṃ sāmarādikam \|*  
*sārddhaṃ devermatiṃ cakre tadgirau gamanāya saḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

21\. After commanding thus, me, Brahmā and the gods, Viṣṇu desired to go to his mountain along with the devas.

## \|\| 3.40.22 \|\|

*yayau svadhiṣṇya nilayaṃ śivasyādrivaraṃ śubham \|*  
*kailāsaṃ sāmaramuniprajeśādimayo hariḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Accompanied by the gods, sages, Brahmā and others Viṣṇu went to Kailāsa, the auspicious excellent mountainous abode of Śiva.

## \|\| 3.40.23 \|\|

*atipriyaṃ prabhornityaṃ sujuṣṭaṃ kinnarādibhiḥ \|*  
*naretarairapsarobhiryogasiddhaimahonnatam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. It was a favourite abode of the lord where Kinnaras, Apsaras, Siddhas and other divine beings stayed. It was very high.

## \|\| 3.40.24 \|\|

*nānāmaṇimayaiśśṛṃgaiḥ śobhamānaṃ samaṃtataḥ \|*  
*nānādhātuvicitraṃ vai nānādrumalatākulam \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. It was brilliant with many peaks full of precious gems all round. It was of variegated colour due to diverse minerals. It contained different trees and creepers.

## \|\| 3.40.25-26 \|\|

*nānāmṛgagaṇākīrṇaṃ nānāpakṣisamanvitam \|*  
*nānājalaprasravaṇairamaraissiddhayoṣitām \|\| 25 \|\|*

*ramaṇaivāharaṃtīnāṃ nānākaṃdara sānubhiḥ \|*  
*drumajātibhiranyābhī rājitaṃ rājataprabham \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. Many kinds of deer roamed and many kinds of birds hovered there. The celestial and Siddha damsels sported about in different springs and pools along with their husbands and lovers. It contained many caves and ridges. It shone with various kinds of trees and had a silver lustre.

## \|\| 3.40.27 \|\|

*vyāghrādibhirmahāsattvairnirghuṣṭaṃ krūratojjhitam \|*  
*sarvaśobhānvitaṃ divyaṃ mahāvismayakārakam \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. It was infested with big animals, tigers and others who were free from cruelty. It was of divine nature endowed with shining brilliance. It inspired great surprise and wonder.

## \|\| 3.40.28 \|\|

*paryastaṃ gaṃgayā satyā sthānapuṇyatarodayā \|*  
*sarvapāvanasaṃkartryā viṣṇupadyā sunirmalam \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. The river Gaṅgā originating from the holy abode of Satī, sanctifying everything flowed there and so the place was very clean.

## \|\| 3.40.29 \|\|

*evaṃvidhaṃ giriṃ dṛṣṭvā kailāsākhyaṃ śivapriyam \|*  
*yayuste vismayaṃ devā viṣṇvādyāssamunīśvarāḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. On seeing this mountain named Kailāsa, a great favourite of Śiva, Viṣṇu and other devas were surprised along with the excellent sages.

## \|\| 3.40.30 \|\|

*tassamīpe'lakāṃ ramyāṃ dadṛśurnāma te purīm \|*  
*kuberasya mahādivyāṃ rudramitrasya nirjarāḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Near it, the gods saw Alakā, the beautiful and divine city of Kubera—a friend of Rudra.

## \|\| 3.40.31 \|\|

*vanaṃ saugaṃdhikaṃ cāpi dadṛśustatsamīpataḥ \|*  
*sarvadrumānvitaṃ divyaṃ yatra tannādamadrutam \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Near that they saw the sylvan park Saugandhika which contained all kinds of trees. The sound originating from it was surprisingly divine.

## \|\| 3.40.32 \|\|

*tadbāhyatastasya divye saritāvatipāvane \|*  
*naṃdā cālakanaṃdā ca darśanātpāpahārike \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Outskirting it are the two holy rivers Nandā and Alakanandā that quelled sins by their mere sight.

## \|\| 3.40.33 \|\|

*papuḥ surastriyo nityamavagūhya svalokataḥ \|*  
*vigāhya puṃbhistāstatra krīḍaṃti ratikarśitāḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. The celestial damsels descending to them from their world drank their waters. Emaciated for their sexual dalliance with their menfolk they entered them for their sports.

## \|\| 3.40.34 \|\|

*hitvā yakṣeśvarapurīṃ vanaṃ saugaṃdhikaṃ ca yat \|*  
*gacchaṃtaste surā ārāddadṛśuśśāṃkaraṃ vaṭam \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. After going beyond Alakā, the capital of the king of Yakṣas and the Saugandhika park, they saw the fig-tree of Śiva.

## \|\| 3.40.35 \|\|

*paryak kṛtācalacchāyaṃ pādona viṭapāya tam \|*  
*śatayojana kotsedhaṃ nirnīḍaṃ tāpavarjjitam \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. The fig tree had steady shade all round. It had a number of suspended branches without hanging roots. Its height was a hundred Yojanas. It had no nests on it. It afforded protection from heat.

## \|\| 3.40.36 \|\|

*mahāpuṇyavatāṃ dṛśyaṃ suramyaṃ cātipāvanam \|*  
*śaṃbhuyogasthalaṃ divyaṃ yogisevyaṃ mahottamam \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. It was the place where Śiva practised Yoga. It was divine. It was resorted to by other Yogins. It was great and excellent. It could be seen only by the excessively meritorious persons. It was beautiful and sacred.

## \|\| 3.40.37 \|\|

*mumukṣuśaraṇe tasmin mahāyogamaye vaṭe \|*  
*āsīnaṃ dadṛśussarve śivaṃ viṣṇvādayassurāḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Beneath that Vaṭa of yogic potentialities, Viṣṇu and other devas saw Śiva seated. The Vaṭa was the refuge of those seeking salvation.

## \|\| 3.40.38 \|\|

*vidhiputrairmahāsiddhaiśśiva bhaktirataissadā \|*  
*upāsyamānaṃ sumudā śāṃtaissaṃśāṃtavigrahaiḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Śiva was being served and venerated by Brahmā’s sons, the great Siddhas engrossed in devotion to Śiva joyously. They were calm. Their very physical body inspired calmness.

## \|\| 3.40.39 \|\|

*tathā sakhyā kubereṇa bhartrā guhyakarakṣasām \|*  
*sevyamānaṃ viśeṣeṇa svagaṇairjñātibhissadā \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. He was being attended upon by his friend Kubera, the lord of Guhyakas and Rakṣas and particularly by his attendants and kinsmen.

## \|\| 3.40.40 \|\|

*tāpasābhīṣṭasadrūpaṃ bibhrataṃ parameśvaram \|*  
*vātsalyādviśvasuhṛdaṃ bhasmādisuvirājitam \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Lord Śiva had the divine form liked by the sages. His fond love befriended everyone. He shone with the ashes smeared over his body.

## \|\| 3.40.41 \|\|

*mune tubhyaṃ pravocaṃtaṃ pṛcchate jñānamuttamam \|*  
*kuśāsane sūpaviṣṭaṃ sarveṣāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ satām \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. O sage (Nārada), (you were present there and while) you were asking him questions, he was explaining wise and excellent things to you, whereas the other saintly men were listening. He was seated on a seat made of Kuśa grass.

## \|\| 3.40.42 \|\|

*kṛtvorau dakṣiṇe savyaṃ caraṇaṃ caiva jānuni \|*  
*bāhuprakoṣṭhākṣamālaṃ sthitaṃ sattarkamudrayā \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. He had put his left leg over his right thigh and knee. The Rudrākṣa garland was suspended from his wrist. He was showing the Tarkamudrā (with his hand).

## \|\| 3.40.43 \|\|

*evaṃvidhaṃ śivaṃ dṛṣṭvā tadā viṣṇvādayassurāḥ \|*  
*praṇemustvaritaṃ sarve karau badhvā vinamrakāḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. On seeing Śiva like this, Viṣṇu and other devas humbly bowed to him immediately after joining their palms.

## \|\| 3.40.44 \|\|

*upalabhyāgataṃ rudro mayā viṣṇuṃ satāṃ gatiḥ \|*  
*utthāya cakre śirasābhivaṃdanamapi prabhuḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Lord Śiva, the refuge of saintly men, stood up and approaching Viṣṇu who had gone there along with me he performed obeisance with his head.

## \|\| 3.40.45 \|\|

*vaṃditāṃghristadā sarvairdivyairviṣṇvādibhiśśivaḥ \|*  
*nanāmātha yathā viṣṇuṃ kaśyapaṃ lokasadgatiḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Viṣṇu and the devas made obeisance at His feet as Viṣṇu, the goal of the world, would bow to Kaśyapa.

## \|\| 3.40.46 \|\|

*surasiddhagaṇādhīśamaharṣisu namaskṛtam \|*  
*samuvāca surairviṣṇuṃ kṛtasannatimādarāt \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Viṣṇu and the devas performed obeisance and spoke to Śiva who was revered by the lords of devas, siddhas, Gaṇas and the sages.

## Chapter 41 - Devas eulogise Śiva

## \|\| 3.41.1 \|\|

*viṣṇvādaya ūcuḥ \|*  
*devadeva mahādeva laukikācārakṛtprabho \|*  
*brahma tvāmīśvaraṃ śaṃbhuṃ jānīmaḥ kṛpayā tava \|\| 1 \|\|*

Viṣṇu and others said:—

1\. O great lord, the lord of the gods and the prescriber of worldly conventions, we know you to be Śiva and Brahman, thanks to your favour.

## \|\| 3.41.2 \|\|

*kiṃ mohayasi nastāta māyayā parayā tava \|*  
*durjñeyayā sadā puṃsāṃ mohinyā parameśvara \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. O lord Śiva, why do you delude us by your illusion which is inscrutable and which deludes people always.

## \|\| 3.41.3 \|\|

*prakṛtaḥ puruṣasyāpi jagato yonibījayoḥ \|*  
*parabrahma parastvaṃ ca manovācāmagocaraḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. You are the supreme Brahman, greater than Prakṛti and Puruṣa, the material and activating cause of the universe. You are incomprehensible and inexpressible.

## \|\| 3.41.4 \|\|

*tvameva viśvaṃ sṛjasi pāsyatsi nijataṃtrataḥ \|*  
*svarūpāṃ śivaśaktiṃ hi krīḍannūrṇapaṭo yathā \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. You alone create, sustain and annihilate the universe under your control like a spider (weaving its web). You sport about with Śivaśakti—your own manifestation.

## \|\| 3.41.5 \|\|

*tvameva kratumīśāna sasarjitha dayāparaḥ \|*  
*dakṣeṇa sūtreṇa vibho sadā trayyabhipattaye \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. O Śiva, merciful that you are, you alone created the sacrifice through Dakṣa for the fulfilment of the Vedas.

## \|\| 3.41.6 \|\|

*tvayaiva lokevasitāssetavo yān dhṛtavratāḥ \|*  
*śuddhān śraddadhate viprā vedamārgavicakṣaṇāḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. The delimitations which brahmins, experts in the Vedic path and rituals, believe in, end with you in the world.

## \|\| 3.41.7 \|\|

*kartustvaṃ maṃgalānāṃ hi svaparaṃ tu mukhe vibho \|*  
*amaṃgalānāṃ ca hitaṃ miśraṃ vātha viparyayam \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. O lord, the activities of auspicious nature result in happiness to the doer whereas inauspicious activities end in adverse, or in partially good and bad results.

## \|\| 3.41.8 \|\|

*sarvakarmaphalānāṃ hi sadā dātā tvameva hi \|*  
*sarve hi proktā hi yaśastatpatistvaṃ śrutiśrutaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. You alone are the bestower of the fruits of all actions. You are the lord of glorious things according to the Vedas.

## \|\| 3.41.9 \|\|

*pṛthagdhiyaḥ karmadṛśo'ruṃtudāśca durāśayāḥ \|*  
*vitudaṃti parānmūḍhā duruktairmatsarānvitāḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Vulgar persons who observe sacrificial rites alone are acrimonious and wicked. With harsh words and jealousy these deluded persons inflict pain on others.

## \|\| 3.41.10 \|\|

*teṣāṃ daivavadhānāṃ bho bhūyāttvacca vadho vibho \|*  
*bhagavanparameśāna kṛpāṃ kuru paraprabho \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. O lord, let not the destruction of these gods be carried out by you. O lord, great god, be merciful.

## \|\| 3.41.11 \|\|

*namo rudrāya śāṃtāya brahmaṇe paramātmane \|*  
*kapardine maheśāya jyotsnāya mahate namaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Obeisance to Śiva who is calm, the supreme and the highest soul, of matted hair, great lord and the bright one.

## \|\| 3.41.12 \|\|

*tvaṃ hi viśvasṛjāṃ sraṣṭā dhātā tvaṃ prapitāmahaḥ \|*  
*triguṇātmā nirguṇaśca prakṛteḥ puruṣātparaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. You are the creator of the creators of the universe. You are the sustainer and the forefather, possessed of three attributes and attributeless. You are greater than primordial nature and the supreme Being.

## \|\| 3.41.13 \|\|

*namaste nīlakaṃṭhāya vedhase paramātmane \|*  
*viśvāya viśvabījāya jagadānaṃdahetave \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Obeisance to Thee the blue-necked, the creator, the supreme soul, the universe, the speed \[seed?\] of the universe and the cause of the bliss of the universe.

## \|\| 3.41.14 \|\|

*oṃkārastvaṃ vaṣaṭkārassarvāraṃbhapravartakaḥ \|*  
*haṃtakāssvadhākāro havyakavyānnabhuk sadā \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. You are Oṃkāra, Vaṣaṭkāra,\[1\] the initiator of enterprises, Hantakāra, Svadhākāra and the partaker of Havya and Kavya offerings always.

## \|\| 3.41.15 \|\|

*kṛtaḥ kathaṃ yajñabhaṃgastvayā dharmaparāyaṇa \|*  
*brahmaṇyastvaṃ mahādeva kathaṃ yajñahano vibho \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. O righteous one, how is it that the sacrifice has been broken by you? O great God, you are a benefactor of brahmins. O lord, how can you be a destroyer of sacrificers?

## \|\| 3.41.16 \|\|

*brāhmaṇānāṃ gavāṃ caiva dharmasya pratipālakaḥ \|*  
*śaraṇyosi sadānaṃtyaḥ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ prabho \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. You are the protector of virtue, brahmins and cows. O lord, you are the shelter for all living beings and worthy of being bowed to.

## \|\| 3.41.17 \|\|

*namaste bhagavan rudra bhāskarāmitatejase \|*  
*namo bhavāya devāya rasāyāṃbumayāya te \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Obeisance to you, O lord, having the splendour of innumerable suns. Obeisance to you, the Bhava, the lord in the form of flavour and fluid.

## \|\| 3.41.18 \|\|

*śarvāya kṣitirūpāya sadā surabhiṇe namaḥ \|*  
*rudrāyāgnisvarūpāya mahātejasvine namaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Obeisance to you who are every thing, who are in the form of fragrant earth. Obeisance to Him of great splendour, Him in the form of fire.

## \|\| 3.41.19 \|\|

*īśāya vāyave tubhyaṃ saṃsparśāya namonamaḥ \|*  
*paśūnāṃpataye tubhyaṃ yajamānāya vedhase \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Obeisance to Śiva who is wind in the subtle form of the principal of touch. Obeisance to you, the lord of individual souls, the priest presiding over sacrifice; and Vedhas (the creator).

## \|\| 3.41.20 \|\|

*bhīmāya vyomarūpāya śabdamātrāya te namaḥ \|*  
*mahādevāya somāya pravṛttāya namostu te \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Obeisance to you the terrible in the form of Ether with the principle of sound Obeisance to the great lord Moon, or, one accompanied by Umā; obeisance to the Active.

## \|\| 3.41.21 \|\|

*ugrāya sūryarūpāya namaste karmayogine \|*  
*namaste kālakālāya namaste rudra manyave \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Obeisance to Ugra in the form of Sun; obeisance to you the detached performer of actions, the slayer of Kāla, and the furious Rudra.

## \|\| 3.41.22 \|\|

*namaśśivāya bhīmāya śaṃkarāya śivāya te \|*  
*ugrosi sarva bhūtānāṃ niyaṃtā yacchivosi naḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Obeisance to Śiva, Bhīma, Ugra, the controller of living beings; you are Śiva to us.

## \|\| 3.41.23 \|\|

*mayaskarāya viśvāya brahmaṇe hyārtināśine \|*  
*ambikāpataye tubhyamumāyāḥ pataye namaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Obeisance to the giver of pleasure to all-pervasive universal soul, the destroyer of distress; the consort of Umā.

## \|\| 3.41.24 \|\|

*śarvāya sarvarūpāya puruṣāya parātmane \|*  
*sadasadvyaktihīnāya mahataḥ kāraṇāya te \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Obeisance to the annihilator, the supreme Being in the form of all objects, the great soul who is indistinguishable from the existent and the non-existent, and is the cause of intellect.

## \|\| 3.41.25 \|\|

*jātāya bahudhā loke prabhūtāya namonamaḥ \|*  
*nīlāya nīlarudrāya kadrudrāya pracetase \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Obeisance, obeisance to one who is omniformed and the plentiful; obeisance to Nīla, Nīlarudra, Kadrudra and Pracetas.

## \|\| 3.41.26 \|\|

*mīḍhuṣṭamāya devāya śipiviṣṭāya te namaḥ \|*  
*mahīyase namastubhyaṃ haṃtre devāriṇāṃ sadā \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Obeisance to the most bounteous lord who is pervaded by rays, who is the greatest, and the destroyer of the enemies of the gods.

## \|\| 3.41.27 \|\|

*tārāya ca sutārāya taruṇāya sutejase \|*  
*harikeśāya devāya maheśāya namonamaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Obeisance to Tāra (star), Sutāra (one that enables others to cross), Taruṇa (the ever young), and the brilliant.

## \|\| 3.41.28 \|\|

*devānāṃ śaṃbhave tubhyaṃ vibhave paramātmane \|*  
*paramāya namastubhyaṃ kālakaṃṭhāya te namaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Obeisance to Śiva who is beneficent to the gods, the lord, the great soul, Obeisance to you the great; obeisance to you, the dark-necked God.

## \|\| 3.41.29 \|\|

*hiraṇyāya pareśāya hiraṇyavapuṣe namaḥ \|*  
*bhīmāya bhīmarūpāya bhīmakarmaratāya ca \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Obeisance to the golden one, the great lord, of golden body; obeisance to Bhīma, Bhīmarūpa, obeisance to one engaged in terrible deeds.

## \|\| 3.41.30 \|\|

*bhasmadigdhaśarīrāya rudrākṣābharaṇāya ca \|*  
*namo hrasvāya dīrghāya vāmanāya namostu te \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Obeisance to one who has smeared his body with ashes, decorated himself with Rudrākṣa; and is of short long dwarfish height.

## \|\| 3.41.31 \|\|

*dūrevadhāya te devā grevadhāya namonamaḥ \|*  
*dhanvine śūline tubhyaṃ gadine haline namaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Obeisance to you, O lord, who can kill at a distance, in front, to one who has a bow, a trident, a mace and a ploughshare.

## \|\| 3.41.32 \|\|

*nānāyudhadharāyaiva daityadānavanāśine \|*  
*sadyāya sadyarūpāya sadyojātāya vai namaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Obeisance to the wielder of many weapons, to the destroyer of Daityas and Dānavas, to Sadya, Sadyarūpa and Sadyojāta.

## \|\| 3.41.33 \|\|

*vāmāya vāmarūpāya vāmanetrāya te namaḥ \|*  
*aghorāya pareśāya vikaṭāya namonamaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Obeisance to Vāma, Vāmarūpa, Vāmanetra, Aghora, the great lord and the Vikaṭa.

## \|\| 3.41.34 \|\|

*tatpuruṣāya nāthāya purāṇapuruṣāya ca \|*  
*puruṣārthapradānāya vratine parameṣṭhine \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Obeisance to Tatpuruṣa, to Nātha, the ancient Puruṣa, the bestower of the four aims of life, Vratin, and Parameṣṭhin.

## \|\| 3.41.35 \|\|

*īśānāya namastubhyamīśvarāya namo namaḥ \|*  
*brahmaṇe brahmarūpāya namassākṣātparātmane \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Obeisance to you, Īśānas, Īśvara, Brahman, of the form of Brahman, the Supreme Soul.

## \|\| 3.41.36 \|\|

*ugrosi sarvaduṣṭānāṃ niyaṃtāsi śivosi naḥ \|*  
*kālakūṭāśine tubhyaṃ devādyavana kāriṇe \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. You are fierce towards all wicked persons; to us you are Śiva the controller. Obeisance to you the swallower of Kālakūṭa poison, the cause of protection of the Gods and others. (?)

## \|\| 3.41.37 \|\|

*vīrāya vīrabhadrāya rakṣadvīrāya śūline \|*  
*mahādevāya mahate paśūnāṃ pataye namaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Obeisance to Vīra, Vīrabhadra, the protector of heroes, the trident-holder, the great lord of mankind.

## \|\| 3.41.38 \|\|

*vīrātmane suvidyāya śrīkaṃṭhāya pinākine \|*  
*namonaṃtāya sūkṣmāya namaste mṛtyumanyave \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Obeisance to Him of the heroic soul of perfect learning, Śrīkaṇṭha, Pinākin, the endless, the subtle, the one whose anger is the cause of death.

## \|\| 3.41.39 \|\|

*parāya parameśāya parātparatarāya te \|*  
*parātparāya vibhave namaste viśvamūrtaye \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Obeisance to the great lord, greater than the greatest, the greatest of the great, the all-pervading omniformed lord.

## \|\| 3.41.40 \|\|

*namo viṣṇukalatrāya viṣṇukṣetrāya bhānave \|*  
*bhairavāya śaraṇyāya tryaṃbakāya vihāriṇe \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Obeisance to Viṣṇukalatra, Viṣṇukṣetra, the sun, Bhairava, the refuge of the refugees, the three-eyed and the sportive.

## \|\| 3.41.41 \|\|

*mṛtyuṃjayāya śokāya triguṇāya guṇātmane \|*  
*candrasūryāgninetrāya sarvakāraṇasetave \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Obeisance to Mṛtyuñjaya, the cause of sorrow, of the form of three attributes, one with the moon, sun and fire as eyes, to the bridge of each and every cause.

## \|\| 3.41.42 \|\|

*bhavatā hi jagatsarvaṃ vyāptaṃ svenaiva tejasā \|*  
*parabrahma nirvikārī cidānaṃdaḥprakāśavān \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. The entire universe is pervaded by you with your own splendour; you are the great Brahman, the unchanging consciousness, bliss and light.

## \|\| 3.41.43 \|\|

*brahmaviṣṇviṃdracandrādipramukhāssakalāssurāḥ \|*  
*munayaścāpare tvattassaṃprasūtā maheśvara \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. O lord Śiva, all the Gods headed by Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Indra, the moon, the sages and others are born of you.

## \|\| 3.41.44 \|\|

*yato bibharṣi sakalaṃ vibhajya tanumaṣṭadhā \|*  
*aṣṭamūrtiritīśaśca tvamādyaḥ karuṇāmayaḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Since you hold everything by dividing your cosmic body into eight you are known as Aṣṭamūrti, you are the primordial Śiva, the merciful.

## \|\| 3.41.45 \|\|

*tvadbhayādvāti vātoyaṃ dahatyagnirbhayāttava \|*  
*sūryastapati te bhītyā mṛtyurdhāvati sarvataḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Afraid of you the wind blows, the fire blazes, the sun shines and death runs all round.

## \|\| 3.41.46 \|\|

*dayāsindho maheśāna prasīda parameśvara \|*  
*rakṣa rakṣa sadaivāsmān yasmānnaṣṭān vicetasaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. O Great Lord, the ocean of mercy, be pleased. Save us for ever, for we are otherwise doomed as we lack in fortitude.

## \|\| 3.41.47 \|\|

*rakṣitāḥ satataṃ nātha tvayaiva karuṇānidhe \|*  
*nānāpadbhyo vayaṃ śaṃbho tathaivādya prapāhi naḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. O merciful lord, we have been protected always by you alone from different miseries. Similaly protect us now.

## \|\| 3.41.48 \|\|

*yajñasyoddharaṇaṃ nātha kuru śīghraṃ prasādakṛt \|*  
*asamāptasya durgeśa dakṣasya ca prajāpateḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. O lord the blesser, O lord of Durgā, revive the incomplete sacrifice of Dakṣa Prajāpati immediately.

## \|\| 3.41.49 \|\|

*bhagokṣiṇī prapadyeta yajamānaśca jīvatu \|*  
*pūṣṇo daṃtāśca rohaṃtu bhṛgoḥ śmaśrūṇi pūrvavat \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Let Bhaga regain his sight, let the initiated Dakṣa be restored to life, let the teeth of Pūṣan grow, let the moustaches of Bhṛgu appear as before.

## \|\| 3.41.50 \|\|

*bhavatānugrahītānāṃ devādīnāṃśca sarvaśaḥ \|*  
*ārogyaṃ bhagnagātrāṇāṃ śaṃkara tvāyudhāśmabhiḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. O Śiva, let the Gods and others whose bodies have been mutilated by weapons and stones, regain their previous normal health under your blessing.

## \|\| 3.41.51-52 \|\|

*pūrṇabhāgostu te nāthāvaśiṣṭe'dhvarakarmaṇi \|*  
*rudrabhāgena yajñaste kalpito nānyathā kvacit \|\| 51 \|\|*

*ityuktvā saprajeśaśca rameśaśca kṛtāṃjaliḥ \|*  
*daṃḍavatpatito bhūmau kṣamāpayitumudyataḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

51-52. O lord, the entire share of yours will be allotted to you. Vasiṣṭha will officiate in the sacrifice, the sacrifice will have the share of Rudra, not otherwise. Saying so, Viṣṇu, the lord of Lakṣmī, along with Brahmā craved Śiva’s forgiveness by prostrating on the ground.

## Chapter 42 - The removal of Dakṣa’s misery

## \|\| 3.42.1 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*śrībrahmeśaprajeśena sadaiva muninā ca vai \|*  
*anunītaśśaṃbhurāsītprasannaḥ parameśvaraḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

1\. Lord Śiva was delighted on being conciliated and cajolled by Viṣṇu, Brahmā and the sages.

## \|\| 3.42.2 \|\|

*āśvāsya devān viṣṇvādīnvihasya karuṇānidhiḥ \|*  
*uvāca parameśānaḥ kurvan paramanugraham \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Consoling Viṣṇu and other devas and laughing, the merciful lord Śiva blessed them and spoke.

## \|\| 3.42.3 \|\|

*śrīmahādeva uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇutaṃ sāvadhānena mama vākyaṃ surottamau \|*  
*yathārthaṃ vacmi vāṃ tāta vāṃ krodhaṃ sarvadāsaham \|\| 3 \|\|*

Lord Śiva said:—

3\. O excellent devas, both of you listen with attention. O dear ones, I shall state the truth. I have always borne your wrath.

## \|\| 3.42.4 \|\|

*nāghaṃ tanau tu bālānāṃ varṇamevānuciṃtaye \|*  
*mama māyābhibhūtānāṃ daṃḍastatra dhṛto mayā \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. I do not take into account the sin committed by my children. I have inflicted punishment on those who are afflicted by my illusion.

## \|\| 3.42.5 \|\|

*dakṣasya yajñabhaṃgoyaṃ na kṛtaśca mayā kvacit \|*  
*paraṃ dveṣṭi pareṣāṃ yadātmanastadbhaviṣyati \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The destruction of the sacrifice of Dakṣa was not done by me. If a person hates another, ultimately it recoils on him alone.

## \|\| 3.42.6 \|\|

*pareṣāṃ kledanaṃ karma na kāryaṃ tatkadācana \|*  
*paraṃ dveṣṭi pareṣāṃ yadātmanastadbhaviṣyati \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. No action that involves the affliction of others will be indulged in by me at any time. If anyone hates another it will recoil on him alone.

## \|\| 3.42.7 \|\|

*dakṣasya yajñaśīrṣṇo hi bhavatvajamukhaṃ śiraḥ \|*  
*mitranetreṇa saṃpaśyedyajñabhāgaṃ bhagassuraḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Let the head (the sacrificial head) of Dakṣa be that of a goat. Let the god Bhaga receive his share in the sacrifice in conjunction with the sun.

## \|\| 3.42.8 \|\|

*pūṣābhidhassurastātau dadbhiryajñasupiṣṭabhuk \|*  
*yājamānairbhagnadaṃtassatyametanmayoditam \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. O dear ones, the god Pūṣan who used to grip the cooked offerings in a sacrifice with his teeth has been rendered broken-toothed and will remain as such. I have spoken the truth.

## \|\| 3.42.9 \|\|

*bastaśmaśrurbhavedeva bhṛgurmama virodha kṛt \|*  
*devāḥ prakṛtisarvāṃgā ye ma ucchedanaṃ daduḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Bhṛgu who opposed me shall become goat-bearded. The gods who tried to uproot me shall have their physical bodies.

## \|\| 3.42.10 \|\|

*bāhubhyāmaśvinau pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ kṛtavāhakau \|*  
*bhavaṃtvadhvaryavaścānye bhavatprītyā mayoditam \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Let the Adhvaryu priests be borne through the arms of Aśvins and the hands of Pūṣan. I have spoken thus out of love for you.

## \|\| 3.42.11 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*ityuktvā parameśāno virarāma dayānvitaḥ \|*  
*carācarapatirdevaḥ samrāṭ vedānusārakṛt \|\| 11 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

11\. Saying thus, the lord Śiva though merciful, yet of imperial nature, the lord of the mobile and immobile and the follower of Vedic injunctions, stopped.

## \|\| 3.42.12 \|\|

*tadā sarva surādyāste śrutvā śaṃkarabhāṣitam \|*  
*sādhusādhviti saṃprocuḥ parituṣṭāḥ saviṣṇvajāḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. On hearing his speech, Viṣṇu and other gods were delighted and sent out cries of approbation.

## \|\| 3.42.13-14 \|\|

*tataśśaṃbhuṃ samāmaṃtrya mayā viṣṇussurarṣibhiḥ \|*  
*bhūyastaddevayajanaṃ yayau ca parayā mudā \|\| 13 \|\|*

*evaṃ teṣāṃ prārthanayā viṣṇuprabhṛtibhissuraiḥ \|*  
*yayau kanakhalaṃ śaṃbhuryajñavāṭaṃ prajāpateḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. Then at the invitation of Viṣṇu and other gods, Śiva went to Kanakhala at the sacrificial altar of Dakṣa Prajāpati. The celestial sages and I too accompanied him there.

## \|\| 3.42.15 \|\|

*rudrastadā dadarśātha vīrabhadreṇa yatkṛtam \|*  
*pradhvaṃsaṃ taṃ kratostatra devarṣīṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Then Rudra saw the extent of destruction carried out by Vīrabhadra, of the sacrifice and of the celestial sages.

## \|\| 3.42.16-17 \|\|

*svāhā svadhā tathā pūṣā tuṣṭirdhṛtiḥ sarasvatī \|*  
*tathānye ṛṣayassarve pitaraścāgnayastathā \|\| 16 \|\|*

*ye'nye ca bahavastatra yakṣagaṃdhavarrākṣasāḥ \|*  
*troṭitā luṃcitāścaiva mṛtāḥ kecidraṇājire \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. Svāhā, Svadhā, Pūṣan, Tuṣṭi, Dhṛti, Sarasvatī, the sages, the manes, Agnis, many others like Yakṣas, Gandharvas, Rākṣasas who were mutilated, wounded or killed in the battle were seen by him laughingly.

## \|\| 3.42.18 \|\|

*yajñaṃ tathāvidhaṃ dṛṣṭvā samāhūya gaṇādhipam \|*  
*vīrabhadraṃ mahāvīramuvāca prahasan prabhuḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. On seeing this destruction of the sacrifice, He called the chieftain of Gaṇas, Vīrabhadra of great virility and spoke to him.

## \|\| 3.42.19 \|\|

*vīrabhadra mahābāho kiṃ kṛtaṃ karma te tvidam \|*  
*mahāndaṃḍo dhṛtastāta devarṣyādiṣu satvaram \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. O Vīrabhadra of powerful arms, what is it that you have done? O dear, in your hurry you have inflicted very severe punishment on the celestial sages and others.

## \|\| 3.42.20 \|\|

*dakṣamānaya śīghraṃ tvaṃ yenedaṃ kṛtamīdṛśam \|*  
*yajño vilakṣaṇastāta yasyedaṃ phalamīdṛśam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Bring Dakṣa here quickly. O dear, he performed a sacrifice contrary to rules, whence this result arose.

## \|\| 3.42.21 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*evamuktaśśaṃkareṇa vīrabhadrastvarānvitaḥ \|*  
*kabaṃdhamānayitvāgre tasya śaṃbhorathākṣipat \|\| 21 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

21\. Thus commanded by Śiva, Vīrabhadra, hastened to bring the headless body of Dakṣa which he threw in front of Śiva.

## \|\| 3.42.22-23 \|\|

*viśiraskaṃ ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā śaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ \|*  
*vīrabhadramuvācāgre vihasanmunisattama \|\| 22 \|\|*

*śiraḥ kutreti tenokte vīrabhadro'bravītprabhuḥ \|*  
*mayā śiro hutaṃ cāgnau tadānīmeva śaṃkara \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. O excellent sage, on seeing the headless body, Śiva, the benefactor of the worlds, spoke laughingly to Vīrabhadra—“Where is the head of Dakṣa?”, Vīrabhadra replied—“O lord Śiva, at that time itself, the head was consigned to fire by me.”

## \|\| 3.42.24-26 \|\|

*iti śrutvā vacastasya vīrabhadrasya śaṃkaraḥ \|*  
*devān tathājñapatprītyā yaduktaṃ tatpurā prabhuḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

*vidhāya kārtsnyena ca tadyadāha bhagavān bhavaḥ \|*  
*mayā viṣṇvādayaḥ sarve bhṛgvādīnatha satvaram \|\| 25 \|\|*

*atha prajāpatestasya savanīyapaśośśiraḥ \|*  
*bastasya saṃdadhuśśaṃbhoḥ kāyenāraṃ suśāsanāt \|\| 26 \|\|*

24-26. On hearing the words of Vīrabhadra, Śiva commanded the gods in the manner as mentioned before. After doing in accordance with what lord Śiva had said, Viṣṇu, the gods and I acquainted Bhṛgu with the same quickly. At the bidding of Śiva, they immediately joined the head of the sacrificial animal, the goat, with the body of Dakṣa.

## \|\| 3.42.27 \|\|

*saṃdhīyamāne śirasi śaṃbhusaddṛṣṭivīkṣitaḥ \|*  
*sadyassupta ivottasthau labdhaprāṇaḥ prajāpatiḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. When the head was joined and Śiva looked at it, Dakṣa regained his life and awoke as if from sleep.

## \|\| 3.42.28 \|\|

*utthitaścāgrataśśaṃbhuṃ dadarśa karuṇānidhim \|*  
*dakṣaḥ prītamatiḥ prītyā saṃsthitaḥ suprasannadhīḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. On waking up he saw Śiva, the merciful, in front of him. Dakṣa stood there happy and joyful.

## \|\| 3.42.29 \|\|

*purā hara mahādveṣakalilātmābhavaddhi saḥ \|*  
*śivāvalokanātsadyaśśaraccandra ivāmalaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Formerly his mind had been contaminated and affected by a great hatred towards Śiva. But now immediately after seeing him, his mind became pure like the autumnal moon.

## \|\| 3.42.30 \|\|

*bhavaṃ stotumanā sotha nāśaknodanurāgataḥ \|*  
*utkaṃṭhāvikalatvācca saṃparetāṃ sutāṃ smaran \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. He wanted to eulogise Śiva but could not do so because of his affection, emotional disturbance and anxiety for his deceased daughter.

## \|\| 3.42.31 \|\|

*atha dakṣaḥ prasannātmā śivaṃ lajjāsamanvitaḥ \|*  
*tuṣṭāva praṇato bhūtvā śaṃkaraṃ lokaśaṃkaram \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Then after regaining composure and peace of mind, the ashamed Dakṣa bowed and eulogised Śiva, the benefactor of the worlds.

## \|\| 3.42.32 \|\|

*dakṣa uvāca \|*  
*namāmi deva varadaṃ vareṇyaṃ maheśvaraṃ jñānanidhiṃ sanātanam \|*  
*namāmi devādhipatīśvaraṃ haraṃ sadāsukhāḍhyaṃ jagadekabāṃdhavam \|\| 32 \|\|*

Dakṣa said:—

32\. I bow to the great lord, the supreme being, the bestower of boons, the store of knowledge, the eternal. I bow to Śiva, the lord of the chief of Gods, always conferring happiness and the sole kinsman of the universe.

## \|\| 3.42.33 \|\|

*namāmi viśveśvara viśvarūpaṃ purātanaṃ brahmanijātmarūpam \|*  
*namāmi śarvaṃ bhava bhāvabhāvaṃ parātparaṃ śaṃkaramānatomi \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. I bow to the lord of the universe, of cosmic form, the primordial Being and the form of Brahman itself. I bow to Śiva, the conceiver of world’s happiness and the greater than the greatest.

## \|\| 3.42.34 \|\|

*devadeva mahādeva kṛpāṃ kuru namostu te \|*  
*aparādhaṃ kṣamasvādya mama śaṃbho kṛpānidhe \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. O lord, lord of Devas, be merciful. Obeisance to thee. O Śiva, the storehouse of mercy, forgive my faults.

## \|\| 3.42.35 \|\|

*anugrahaḥ kṛtaste hi daṃḍavyājena śaṃkara \|*  
*khalohaṃ mūḍhadhīrdeva jñātaṃ tattvaṃ mayā na te \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. O, Śiva, Thou hast blessed me under the pretext of punishing me. O lord, I have been wicked and foolish. Thy real nature I could not understand.

## \|\| 3.42.36 \|\|

*adya jñātaṃ mayā tattvaṃ sarvopari bhavānmataḥ \|*  
*viṣṇubrahmādibhissevyo vedavedyo maheśvaraḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Today I have realised the truth. Thou art above all. Thou art served by Viṣṇu, Brahmā and others. Thou art the supreme Being known only through the Vedas.

## \|\| 3.42.37 \|\|

*sādhūnāṃ kalpavṛkṣastvaṃ duṣṭānāṃ daṃḍadhṛksadā \|*  
*svataṃtraḥ paramātmā hi bhaktābhīṣṭavarapradaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Thou art the wish-yielding Kalpa tree to the good. Thou punishest the wicked always. Thou art the independent great soul. Thou art the bestower of desired boons on the devotees.

## \|\| 3.42.38 \|\|

*vidyātapovratadharānasṛjaḥ prathamaṃ dvijā \|*  
*ātmatattvaṃ samāvettuṃ mukhataḥ parameśvaraḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Thou hast created the brahmins first who uphold learning, penance and sacred rites, in order to realise the reality of the soul, O great lord, from thy mouth.

## \|\| 3.42.39 \|\|

*sarvāpadbhyaḥ pālayitā gopatistu paśūniva \|*  
*gṛhītadaṃḍo duṣṭāṃstān maryādāparipālakaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Just as the master of cowherds protects the cows from adversities, so also thou art the saviour of the good. Thou art the watch and ward of Social Conventions. Thou punishest the wicked.

## \|\| 3.42.40 \|\|

*mayā duruktaviśikhaiḥ praviddhaḥ parameśvaraḥ \|*  
*amarānatidīnāśān madanugrahakārakaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. The great lord has been wounded by me by the shafts of piercing harsh words. I have made the gods, who conferred blessings on me, very dejected.

## \|\| 3.42.41 \|\|

*sa bhavān bhagavān śaṃbho dīnabaṃdho parātparaḥ \|*  
*svakṛtena mahārheṇa saṃtuṣṭo bhaktavatsala \|\| 41 \|\|*
