34\. O Dharma, you are the ever present witness of all activities. O lord, why did you deign to deceive me to know my mind?

## \|\| 4.35.35 \|\|

*yattatsarvaṃ kṛtaṃ brahman nāparādho babhūva me \|*  
*tvañca śapto mayā'jñānātstrīsvabhā vādvṛthā vṛṣa \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. O Dharma, what has been done already does not amount to any guilt on my part. You have been cursed in vain by me but it was due to my ignorance and innate nature of woman.

## \|\| 4.35.36 \|\|

*kā vyavasthā bhavettasya cintayāmīti sāmpratam \|*  
*citte sphuratu sā buddhiryayā śaṃ saṃllabhāmi vai \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. I am now thinking as to what shall be done about it. May that idea strike me whereby I may get peace.

## \|\| 4.35.37 \|\|

*ākāśosau diśassarvā yadi naśyantu vāyavaḥ \|*  
*tathāpi sādhvīśāpastu na naśyati kadācana \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. This sky, these quarters and the winds may get destroyed but the curse of a chaste lady will never be destroyed.

## \|\| 4.35.38 \|\|

*satye pūrṇaścatuṣpādaḥ paurṇa māsyāṃ yathā śaśī \|*  
*virājase devarāja sarvakālaṃ divāniśam \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. In the Satyayuga you shine with all the legs, O king of gods, on all occasions, day or night, like the moon on a full moon night.

## \|\| 4.35.39 \|\|

*tvañca naṣṭo bhavasi cetsṛṣṭināśo bhavettadā \|*  
*iti kartavyatāmūḍhā vṛthāpi ca vadāmyaham \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. If you are destroyed, the annihilation of all creations will occur. But a sense of helpless despair is unnecessary. So I shall explain.

## \|\| 4.35.40 \|\|

*pādakṣayaśca bhavitā tretāyāṃ ca surottama \|*  
*pādopare dvāpare ca tṛtīyo'pi kalau vibho \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. In the Tretāyuga, one leg shall be defunct, O excellent god. Another leg too shall be defunct in Dvāpara and the third one in the Kali age, O lord.

## \|\| 4.35.41 \|\|

*kaliśeṣe'khilāśchinnā bhaviṣyanti tavāṃghrayaḥ \|*  
*punassatye samāyāte paripūrṇo bhaviṣyasi \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. In the latter half of Kali, all the legs will be chopped off. Again in the Satyayuga you will attain perfection.

## \|\| 4.35.42 \|\|

*satye sarvavyāpakastvaṃ tadanyeṣu ca ku tracit \|*  
*yugavyavasthayā sa tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi tathā tathā \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. In the Satyayuga you will be all-pervasive and in the other Yugas partially so. Thus in accordance with the Yugas, you will be maintaining your position.

## \|\| 4.35.43 \|\|

*ityevaṃ vacanaṃ satyaṃ mamāstu sukhadaṃ tava \|*  
*yāmyahaṃ patisevāyai gaccha tvaṃ svagṛhaṃ vibho \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Let these words of mine be true and pleasing to you. I am now going to serve my husband. O lord, you return to your abode.

## \|\| 4.35.44 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*ityākarṇya vacastasyāssantuṣṭobhūdvṛṣassa vai \|*  
*tadevaṃvādinīṃ sādhvīmuvāca vidhinandana \|\| 44 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

44\. On hearing her words Dharma became delighted. Then Dharma, the son of Brahmā, spoke to the chaste lady who had been speaking to him.

## \|\| 4.35.45-46 \|\|

*dharma uvāca \|*  
*dhanyāsi patibhaktāsi svasti testu pativrate \|*  
*varaṃ gṛhāṇa tvatsvāmī tvatparitrāṇakāraṇāt \|\| 45 \|\|*

*yuvā bhavatu te bhartā ratiśūraśca dhārmikaḥ \|*  
*rūpavān guṇavānvāgmī saṃtatasthirayauvanaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

Dharma said:—

45-46. O chaste lady, you are blessed, you are devotedly attached to your husband. Hail to you. Take this boon. Your husband is the cause of your great protection. Let him be a young man with sexual vigour and righteousness. He shall be comely in appearance, good in conduct, eloquent in speech and perpetually stable in youth.

## \|\| 4.35.47 \|\|

*cirañjīvī sa bhavatu mārkaṇḍeyātpa raśśubhe \|*  
*kuberāddhanavāṃścaiva śakrādaiśvaryyavānapi \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Let him enjoy more longevity than Mārkaṇḍeya. Let him be richer than Kubera. Let him enjoy more prosperity and power than Indra.

## \|\| 4.35.48 \|\|

*śivabhakto harisamassiddhastu kapilātparaḥ \|*  
*buddhyā bṛhaspatisamassamatvena vidhessamaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Let him be a devotee of Śiva on a par with Viṣṇu. Let him be a greater Siddha than Kapila. Let him vie with Bṛhaspati in intelligence and with Brahmā in equanimity.

## \|\| 4.35.49 \|\|

*svāmisaubhāgyasaṃyuktā bhava tvaṃ jīvanāvadhi \|*  
*tathā ca subhage devi tvaṃ bhava sthirayauvanā \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. You will be blessed with all the fortunes of your master as long as you live. Also you will be perpetually young.

## \|\| 4.35.50 \|\|

*mātā tvaṃ daśaputrāṇāṃ guṇināṃ cirajīvinām \|*  
*svabharturadhikānāṃ ca bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Undoubtedly you will become the mother of ten sons who will be greater than your husband, they will have all good qualities and live long.

## \|\| 4.35.51 \|\|

*gṛhā bhavantu te sādhvi sarvasampatsama nvitāḥ \|*  
*prakāśamantassatataṃ kuberabhavanādhikāḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. O chaste lady, let your abode be endowed with all riches, brightly illuminated always and superior to even the abode of Kubera.

## \|\| 4.35.52 \|\|

*\|\| vasiṣṭha uvāca \|*  
*ityevamuktā santasthau dharmassa girisattama \|*  
*sā taṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya praṇamya svagṛhaṃ yayau \|\| 52 \|\|*

Vasiṣṭha said:—

52\. O excellent mountain, after saying thus, Dharma stood quiet there. She circumambulated him, bowed to him and returned to her house.

## \|\| 4.35.53 \|\|

*dharmastathāśiṣo datvā jagāma nijamandiram \|*  
*praśaśaṃsa ca tāṃ prātyā padmāṃ saṃsadi saṃsadi \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Bestowing blessings upon her, Dharma returned to his abode. He praised Padmā lovingly in every assembly he visited.

## \|\| 4.35.54 \|\|

*sā reme svāminā sārddhaṃ yūnā rahasi santatam \|*  
*paścādbabhūvu'ssatputrāstadbharturadhikā guṇaiḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. She sported about in secret with her husband who became a young man. She gave birth to sons who surpassed her husband in their good qualities.

## \|\| 4.35.55 \|\|

*babhūva sakalā sampaddampatyoḥ sukhavarddhinī \|*  
*sarvānandavṛddhikarī paratreha ca śarmaṇe \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. All kinds of riches were granted to the couple increasing their happiness. They were conducive to the prosperity here and hereafter.

## \|\| 4.35.56 \|\|

*śailendra kathitaṃ sarvamitihāsaṃ purātanam \|*  
*dampatyośca tayoḥ prītyā śrutaṃ te paramādarāt \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. O lord of mountains, this ancient story of the couple has been narrated to you. You have heard the story with pleasure and respect.

## \|\| 4.35.57 \|\|

*buddhvā tattvaṃ sutāṃ dehi pārvatīmīśvarāya ca \|*  
*kuruṣaṃ tyaja śailendra menayā svastriyā saha \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. Knowing the real situation give your daughter Pārvatī to Śiva. Cast off sins, O lord of mountains, in the company of your wife Mena.

## \|\| 4.35.58-61 \|\|

*saptāhe samatīte tu durlabheti śubhe kṣaṇe \|*  
*lagnādhipe ca lagnasthe candresvatnayānvite \|\| 58 \|\|*

*mudite rohiṇīyukte viśuddhe candratārake \|*  
*mārgamāse candravāre sarvadoṣavivarjite \|\| 59 \|\|*

*sarvasadgrahasaṃsṛṣṭa'sadgrahadṛṣṭivarjite \|*  
*sadapatyaprade jīve patisaubhāgyadāyini \|\| 60 \|\|*

*jagadambāṃ jagatpitre mūlaprakṛtimīśvarīm \|*  
*kanyāṃ pradāya girijāṃ kṛtī tvaṃ bhava parvata \|\| 61 \|\|*

58-61. After a week there is a very auspicious hour very rare to meet with. The presiding planet of the lagna is in the lagna. The moon is in conjunction with his son, Mercury as well as the constellation Rohiṇī. The moon and the stars occupy pure positions. The month is Mārgaśīrṣa and the day is Monday free from all defects. All the planets are in auspicious conjunction. They are not aspected by the evil planets. The Jupiter is in a position that is conducive to the birth of a good child and all good fortune to the bridegroom. O lord of mountains, give your daughter Pārvatī, the mother of the universe, the primordial Being to Śiva, the father of the universe. You will then get quiet and contentment.

## \|\| 4.35.62 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*ityuktvā muniśārdūlo vasiṣṭho jñānisattamaḥ \|*  
*virarāma śivaṃ smṛtvā nānālīlākaraṃ prabhum \|\| 62 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

62\. After saying this, the excellent sage Vasiṣṭha, most excellent of wise men, stopped after remembering lord Śiva, the creator of divine sports of diverse varieties.

## Chapter 36 - The statements of the seven sages

## \|\| 4.36.1 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*vasiṣṭhasya vacaḥ śrutvā sagaṇopi himālayaḥ \|*  
*vismito bhāryyayā śailānuvāca sa girīśvaraḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

1\. On hearing the words of the seven sages, Himācala, his wife and attendants were very much surprised. The lord of the mountains spoke to the other mountains.

## \|\| 4.36.2 \|\|

*himālaya uvāca \|*  
*he mero girirāṭ sahya gandhamādana mandara \|*  
*maināka vindhya śailendrāssarve śṛṇuta madvacaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

Himācala said:—

2\. O lord of mountains—Meru,\[1\] O Sahya\[2\] O Gandhamādana,\[3\] O Mandara,\[4\] O Maināka,\[5\] O Vindhya, all of you listen to my words.

## \|\| 4.36.3 \|\|

*vasiṣṭho hi vadatyevaṃ kiṃ me kāryyaṃ vicāryyate \|*  
*yathā tathā ca śaṃsadhvaṃ nirṇīya manasākhilam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Vasiṣṭha says like this. It is to be considered what I shall do now. You consider well, decide and let me know.

## \|\| 4.36.4 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*tacchutvā vacanaṃ tasya sumerupramukhāśca te \|*  
*procurhimālayaṃ prītyā sunirṇīya mahīdharāḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

4\. On hearing his words, Sumeru and other mountains decided carefully and spoke to Himalaya lovingly.

## \|\| 4.36.5 \|\|

*śailā ūcuḥ \|*  
*adhunā kiṃ vimarśena kṛtaṃ kāryyaṃ tathaiva hi \|*  
*utpanneyaṃ mahābhāga devakāryārthameva hi \|\| 5 \|\|*

The mountains said:—

5\. Of what avail is a long discussion and deliberation now? What should be done is only that. She is born only for the purpose of the gods.

## \|\| 4.36.6 \|\|

*pradātavyā śivāyeti śivasyārthevatāriṇī \|*  
*anayārādhito rudro rudreṇa yadi bhāṣitā \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Incarnating for the sake of Śiva, she shall be given to Śiva. Śiva has been propitiated by her and Śiva has also spoken to her.

## \|\| 4.36.7 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*etacchrutvā vacasteṣāmmervādīnāṃ himācalaḥ \|*  
*suprasannatarobhūdvai jahāsa girijā hṛdi \|\| 7 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

7\. On hearing the words of Meru and others, Himācala was greatly pleased and Pārvatī laughed within herself.

## \|\| 4.36.8 \|\|

*arundhatī ca tāṃ menāṃ bodhayāmāsa kāraṇāt \|*  
*nānāvākyasamūhenetihāsairvividhairapi \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Arundhatī too convinced Menā with reasoned statements and examples from various mythological legends.

## \|\| 4.36.9 \|\|

*atha sā menakā śailapatnī buddhvā prasannadhīḥ \|*  
*munīnarundhatīṃ śailaṃ bhojayitvā bubhoja ca \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Then the wife of the mountain too was delightedly convinced. She entertained Arundhatī, the sages and the mountain with a grand feast and then took food herself.

## \|\| 4.36.10 \|\|

*atha śailavaro jñānī susaṃsevya munīṃśca tām \|*  
*uvāca sāñjaliḥ prītyā prasannātmāgatabhramaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Then the chief of mountains, freed from wrong notions and grown wise, spoke with palms joined in reverence and mind extremely delighted.

## \|\| 4.36.11 \|\|

*himācala uvāca \|*  
*saptarṣayo mahābhāgā vacaḥ śṛṇuta māmakam \|*  
*vismayo me gatassarvaśśivayoścaritaṃ śrutam \|\| 11 \|\|*

Himācala said:—

11\. O fortunate sages, please listen to my words. All my bewilderment has vanished since I have heard the story of Śiva and Śiva.

## \|\| 4.36.12 \|\|

*madīyaṃ ca śarīramvai patnī menā sutāssutā \|*  
*ṛddhissiddhiśca cānyadvai śivasyaiva na cānyathā \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Everything that I possess, my body, wife, Menā, sons, daughter, assets and achievements and other things belong to Śiva and not otherwise.

## \|\| 4.36.13-14 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*ityuktvā sa tadā putrīṃ dṛṣṭvā tatsādaraṃ ca tām \|*  
*bhūṣayitvā tadaṅgāni ṛṣyutsaṃge nyaveśayet \|\| 13 \|\|*

*uvāca ca punaḥ prītyā śailarāja ṛṣīṃstadā\|\| \|*  
*ayaṃ bhāgo mayā tasmai dātavya iti niścitam \|\| 14 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

13-14. After saying so, he bedecked his daughter with various ornaments. Then he took them all and placed them on the lap of the sage saying “These are the presents I have to give her.”

## \|\| 4.36.15 \|\|

*\|\| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ \|*  
*śaṃkaro bhikṣukastetha svayaṃ dātā bhavān gire \|*  
*bhaikṣyañca pārvatī devī kimataḥ paramuttamam \|\| 15 \|\|*

The sages said:—

15\. O mountain, you are the donor, Śiva is the mendicant, and the alms goddess Pārvatī. What else can be better than this ?

## \|\| 4.36.16 \|\|

*himavan śikharāṇānte yaddhetossadṛśī gatiḥ \|*  
*dhanyastvaṃ sarvaśailānāmadhipassarvato varaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Since the course of your summits is befitting, you are blessed, you are the chief of all mountains, you are great in every respect.

## \|\| 4.36.17 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*evamuktvā tu kanyāyai munayo vimalāśayāḥ \|*  
*āśiṣaṃ dattavantaste śivāya sukhadā bhava \|\| 17 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

17\. After saying thus, the sages of pure mind offered their blessings to the girl—“Be pleasing to Śiva.”

## \|\| 4.36.18 \|\|

*spṛṣṭvā kareṇa tāṃ tatra kalyāṇaṃ te bhaviṣyati \|*  
*śuklapakṣe yathā candro varddhantāṃ tvadguṇāstathā \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. They touched her with their hands and continued—“Everything will be well with you. As the moon in the bright half of the month, may your qualities increase.”

## \|\| 4.36.19 \|\|

*ityuktvā munayassarve dattvā te giraye mudā \|*  
*puṣpāṇi phalayuktāni pratyayaṃ cakrire tadā \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. After saying thus and offering fruits and flowers to the lord of mountains, the sages made him believe that the alliance was a settled fact.

## \|\| 4.36.20 \|\|

*arundhatī tadā tatra menāṃ sā susukhī mudā \|*  
*guṇaiśca lobhayāmāsa śivasya paramā satī \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. The great chaste lady Arundhatī tempted Menā further with Śiva’s good qualities.

## \|\| 4.36.21 \|\|

*haridrākuṃkumaiśśailaśmaśrūṇi pratyamārjayat \|*  
*laukikācāramādhāya maṃgalāyanamuttamam \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. According to the worldly convention they smeared the moustache of the mountain with powdered turmeric and saffron as an auspicious custom.

## \|\| 4.36.22 \|\|

*tataśca te caturthehni saṃdhāryya lagnamuttamam \|*  
*parasparaṃ ca santuṣya saṃjagmuśśivasannidhim \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. After fixing the auspicious Lagna for the marriage and congratulating and complimenting one another the sages came to Śiva’s abode on the fourth day.

## \|\| 4.36.23 \|\|

*tatra gatvā śivaṃ natvā stutvā vivi dhasūktibhiḥ \|*  
*ūcuḥ sarve vasiṣṭhādyā munayaḥ parameśvaram \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. After reaching the place, Vasiṣṭha and other sages bowed to Śiva and eulogised Him with different hymns. They then spoke to lord Śiva.

## \|\| 4.36.24 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ \|*  
*devadeva mahādeva parameśa mahāprabho \|*  
*śṛṇvasmadvacanaṃ prītyā yatkṛtaṃ sevakaistava \|\| 24 \|\|*

The sages said:—

24\. O lord Śiva, lord of the gods, O great lord Śiva, please listen lovingly to the narration of what we, your attendants, have done.

## \|\| 4.36.25 \|\|

*bodhito girirājaśca menā vividhasūktibhiḥ \|*  
*setihāsaṃ maheśāna prabuddhosau na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. O great lord, the lord of mountains and Menā have been urged with different kinds of statements and examples from mythological legends. Undoubtedly he is enlightened.

## \|\| 4.36.26 \|\|

*vākyadattā girīndreṇa pārvatī te hi nānyathā \|*  
*udvāhāya pragaccha tvaṃ gaṇairdevaiśca saṃyutaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Pārvatī has been betrothed to you by the lord of mountains. It is not otherwise. Now please start for the marriage with your attendants and the gods.

## \|\| 4.36.27 \|\|

*gaccha śīghraṃ mahādeva himācalagṛhaṃ prabho \|*  
*vivāhaya yathā rītiḥ pārvatīmātmajanmane \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. O great god, O lord, go to the abode of Himācala and marry Pārvatī in accordance with the customs for the sake of a son.

## \|\| 4.36.28 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*tacchrutvā vacanaṃ teṣāṃ laukikācāratatparaḥ \|*  
*prahṛṣṭātmā maheśānaḥ prahasyedamuvāca saḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

28\. On hearing their words, lord Śiva who was delighted and who loved to follow worldly conventions laughed and said:—

## \|\| 4.36.29 \|\|

*maheśa uvāca \|*  
*vivāho hi mahābhāgā na dṛṣṭo na śruto mayā \|*  
*yathā purā bhavadbhistadvidhiḥ procyo viśeṣataḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

Lord Śiva said:—

29\. O fortunate one, a marriage ceremony has never been witnessed nor even heard of by me before. The details of the same shall be mentioned by you all, specifically.

## \|\| 4.36.30 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*tadākarṇya maheśasya laukikaṃ vacanaṃ śubham \|*  
*pratyūcuḥ prahasantaste devadevaṃ sadāśivam \|\| 30 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

30\. On hearing these words in a worldly vein uttered by Śiva they laughingly replied to Sadāśiva, lord of the gods.

## \|\| 4.36.31-33 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ \|*  
*viṣṇumāhūya vai śīghraṃ sasamājaṃ viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*brahmāṇaṃ sasutaṃ prītyā tathā devaṃ śatakratum \|\| 31 \|\|*

*tathā ṛṣigaṇānsarvān yakṣagandharvakinnarān \|*  
*siddhān vidyādharāṃścaiva tathā caivāpsarogaṇān \|\| 32 \|\|*

*etāṃścānyānprabho sarvānānaya sveha sādaram \|*  
*sarvaṃ saṃsādhayiṣyanti tvatkāryyaṃ te na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

The sages said:—

31-33. Please invite and summon Viṣṇu with his retinue, Brahmā with his sons, lord Indra,70 all the sages, Yakṣas, Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Siddhas, Vidyādharas, heavenly nymphs and others. All of them will jointly accomplish everything for you. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 4.36.34 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*ityuktvā sapta ṛṣayastadājñāṃ prāpya te mudā \|*  
*svadhāma prayayussarve śaṃsantaḥ śaṅkarīṃ gatim \|\| 34 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

34\. Saying this and taking His permission the seven sages joyfully returned to their abodes praising the way of Śiva.

## Chapter 37 - The letter of betrothal is dispatched

## \|\| 4.37.1 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*tāta prājña vadedānīṃ saptarṣiṣu gateṣu ca \|*  
*kimakārṣīddhimagiristanme kṛtvā kṛpāṃ prabho \|\| 1 \|\|*

Summary: The letter of betrothal is despatched, the requisites for the celebration are gathered and the mountain-invitees arrive.

Nārada said:—

1\. Dear wise father, when the seven sages returned what did Himācala do? Please tell me, O lord.

## \|\| 4.37.2 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*gateṣu teṣu muniṣu saptasvapi munīśvara \|*  
*sārundhatīṣu himavān yadakārṣīdbravīmi te \|\| 2 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

2\. O great sage, I shall tell you what Himācala did, when the seven sages and Arundhatī left.

## \|\| 4.37.3 \|\|

*tata āmantrya svabhrātṝn mervādīn sasutapriyaḥ \|*  
*mahāmanāssa mumude himavān parvateśvaraḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Bidding farewell to his brothers, Meru and others Himācala, the lord of mountains, rejoiced in the company of his sons, daughter and wife.

## \|\| 4.37.4 \|\|

*tadājñaptastataḥ prītyā himavān lagna patrikām \|*  
*lekhayāmāsa suprītyā gargeṇa svapurodhasā \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Urged by them lovingly, Himācala caused the letter of betrothal to be written by Garga, his priest.

## \|\| 4.37.5 \|\|

*atha prasthāpayāmāsa tāṃ śivāya sa patrikām \|*  
*nānāvidhāstu sāmagryaḥ svajanairmuditātmabhiḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. He despatched the letter of betrothal to Śiva along with articles of homage through his kinsmen.

## \|\| 4.37.6 \|\|

*te janāstatra gatvā ca kailāse śivasannidhim \|*  
*daduśśivāya tatpatraṃ tilakaṃ samvidhāya ca \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Those people arrived at Kailāsa and handed over the letter to Śiva after applying the holy mark on his forehead.

## \|\| 4.37.7 \|\|

*sanmānitā viśeṣeṇa prabhuṇā ca yathocitam \|*  
*sarve te prītimanasa ājagmuśśailasannidhim \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. After being duly honoured by the lord, they returned highly delighted to the penance of the mountain.

## \|\| 4.37.8 \|\|

*sanmānitānviśeṣeṇa maheśenāgatāñjanān \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā suharṣitāñcchailo mumodātīva cetasi \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. On seeing those people who had been highly honoured by lord Śiva and who had returned excessively delighted, the mountain rejoiced much.

## \|\| 4.37.9 \|\|

*tato nimantraṇaṃ cakre svabandhūnāṃ pramoditaḥ \|*  
*nānādeśasthitānāñca nikhilānāṃ sukhāspadam \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Then he extended his invitation highly pleasing to his kinsmen stationed in different places with great delight.

## \|\| 4.37.10 \|\|

*tatassa kārayāmāsa svarṇasaṃgrahamādarāt \|*  
*nānāvidhāśca sāmagrīrvivāhakaraṇocitāḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Then he began collecting foodstuffs and other requisite articles intended for the performance of the marriage.

## \|\| 4.37.11 \|\|

*taṇḍulānāṃ bahūñchailān pṛthukānāṃ tathaiva ca \|*  
*guḍānāṃ śarkarāṇāñca lavaṇānāṃ tathaiva ca \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Mountainous masses of rice, beaten rice, jaggery, sugar candies and salt were heaped up.

## \|\| 4.37.12 \|\|

*kṣīrāṇāṃ ca ghṛtānāñca dadhnāṃ vāpīścakāra saḥ \|*  
*yavādidhānyapiṣṭānāṃ laḍḍukānāṃ tathaiva ca \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. He caused huge tanks and receptacles built for milk, ghee and curds as well as for fried flour cakes of barley and other grains and ball-like sweets.

## \|\| 4.37.13 \|\|

*śaṣkulīnāṃ svastikānāṃ śarkarāṇāṃ tathaiva ca \|*  
*amṛtekṣurasānāṃ ca tatra vāpīścakāra saḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Big tanks and receptacles were made for the nectar, sugarcane juice, baked cakes, and the sugar candies.

## \|\| 4.37.14 \|\|

*bahvīrhaiyaṃgavānāñca hyāsavānāṃ tathaiva ca \|*  
*nānā pakvānnasaṃghāṃśca mahāsvādurasāṃstathā \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Tanks were built for butter, spirituous beverages, sweet juices of various kinds and rice preparations of various sorts.

## \|\| 4.37.15 \|\|

*nānā vyañjanavastūni gaṇadevahitāni ca \|*  
*amūlyanānāvastrāṇi vahniśaucāni yāni ca \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Different kinds of pickles and side dishes were prepared that might appeal to Śiva’s Gaṇas and the gods. Different kinds of valuable garments purified in fire were kept ready.

## \|\| 4.37.16 \|\|

*maṇiratnaprakārāṇi suvarṇarajatāni ca \|*  
*dravyāṇyetāni cānyāni saṃgṛhya vidhipūrvakam \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Gems and jewels of different kinds, gold, silver and other articles were gathered duly.

## \|\| 4.37.17 \|\|

*maṃgalaṃ kartumārebhe girirmaṃgalakṛddine \|*  
*saṃskāraṃ kārayāmāsuḥ pārvatyāḥ parvatastriyaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Auspicious rites were started by the mountain on an auspicious day. The womenfolk of the mountain performed the purificatory ceremony for Pārvatī.

## \|\| 4.37.18 \|\|

*tā maṃgalaṃ mudā cakrurbhūṣitā bhūṣaṇaiḥ svayam \|*  
*puradvijastriyo dṛṣṭvā lokācāraṃ pracakrire \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Women bedecked in ornaments performed auspicious rites. The delighted brahmin women of the city did everything in accordance with the tradition and custom.

## \|\| 4.37.19 \|\|

*sotsavaṃ vividhaṃ tatra sumaṃgalapurassaram \|*  
*himālayo'pi hṛṣṭātmā kṛtvācāraṃ sumaṃgalam \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Great festivities and holy auspicious rites were performed by the delighted Himavat too.

## \|\| 4.37.20-21 \|\|

*sarvabhāvena suprīto bandhuvargāgamotsukaḥ \|*  
*etasminnantare tasya bāndhavāśca nimantritāḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*ājagmussastriyo hṛṣṭāssasutāssaparicchadāḥ \|*  
*tadaiva śṛṇu devarṣe giryyāgamanamādṛtaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. Delighted in every respect and eagerly awaiting the arrival of his kinsmen he was excited with various emotions. The invitees came there along with their wives, children and attendants. O celestial sage, listen to a detailed narration of the arrival of those mountains.

## \|\| 4.37.22-24 \|\|

*varṇayāmi samāsena śivaprītivivṛddhaye \|*  
*devālaya giriryo hi divyarūpadharo mahān \|\| 22 \|\|*

*nānāratnaparibhrājatsamājassaparicchadaḥ \|*  
*nānāmaṇimahāratnasāramādāya yatnataḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*suveṣālaṃkṛtaḥ śrīmān jagāma sa himālayam \|*  
*mandarassarvaśobhāḍhyassanārītanayo giriḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

22-24. In order to increase the devotion to Śiva I shall explain in brief. Mandara, the chief mountain in heaven came to Himavat in a divine form. He was highly refulgent. He was accompanied by his wife and children. His company shone brilliantly. He had brought with him many gems and jewels.

## \|\| 4.37.25 \|\|

*sūpāyanāni saṃgṛhya jagāma vividhāni ca \|*  
*astācalopi divyātmā sopāyana udāradhīḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Bringing with him many articles of presentation, the liberal Western mountain reached there in a divine form.

## \|\| 4.37.26 \|\|

*bahuśobhāsamāyukta ājagāma mudānvitaḥ \|*  
*udayācala ādāya sadratnāni maṇīnapi \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. The Eastern mountain came there with brilliant gems and jewels. He looked delighted and extremely brilliant,

## \|\| 4.37.27 \|\|

*atyutkṛṣṭaparīvāra ājagāma mahāsukhī \|*  
*malayo girirājo hi saparīvāra ādṛtaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. The highly venerable lord of mountains, Malaya, came there with his followers. He was happy with his excellent followers.

## \|\| 4.37.28 \|\|

*sudivyaracanāyukta āyayau bahusadbalaḥ \|*  
*sadyo darduranāmā ca muditassakalatrakaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. The mountain Dardura\[3\] came along with his wife. He was exquisitely dressed. He was delighted. He had many attendants with him.

## \|\| 4.37.29 \|\|

*bahuśobhānvitastātaḥ yayau himagirergṛham \|*  
*niṣadopi prahṛṣṭātmā saparicchada āyayau \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. O dear, the delighted mountain Niṣadha came along with his attendants. He was very brilliant.

## \|\| 4.37.30 \|\|

*sasutastrīgaṇaḥ prītyā yayau himagirergṛham \|*  
*ājagāma mahābhāgyo bhūdharo gandhamādanaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. The fortunate mountain Gandhamādana came with great pleasure along with his children and womenfolk.

## \|\| 4.37.31 \|\|

*karavīrastathaivāpi mahāvibhava saṃyutaḥ \|*  
*mahendraḥ parvataśreṣṭha ājagāma himālayam \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Mountains Karavīra\[5\] and Mahendra of great wealth and prosperity also came there.

## \|\| 4.37.32 \|\|

*sagaṇassasutastrīko bahuśobhāsamanvitaḥ \|*  
*pāriyātro hi hṛṣṭātmā maṇi ratnākarassayut \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Pāriyātra came with attendants, children and womenfolk. He was brilliant and delighted. He had brought many gems and jewels with him.

## \|\| 4.37.33 \|\|

*sagaṇassaparīvāra āyayau himabhūdharam \|*  
*krauñcaḥ parvatarājo hi mahābalaparicchadaḥ \|*  
*ājagāma giriśreṣṭhassa mupāyana ādṛtaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Krauñca the chief of mountains, came with a large army of attendants. He had articles of presentation with him. He was accompanied by his kinsmen and relatives.

## \|\| 4.37.34 \|\|

*puruṣottamaśailopi saparicchada ādṛtaḥ \|*  
*mahopāyanamādāyājagāma himabhūdharam \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Puruṣottama mountain came with many presentation articles. He was highly honoured along with his followers.

## \|\| 4.37.35 \|\|

*nīlaḥ salīlassa sutassastrīko dravyasaṃyutaḥ \|*  
*ājagāma himāgasya gṛhamānandasaṃyutaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. The mountain Nīla with plenty of wealth came along with his sons and womenfolk.

## \|\| 4.37.36 \|\|

*trikūṭaścitrakūṭopi veṃkaṭaḥ śrīgiristathā \|*  
*gokāmukhī nāradaśca himagehamupāgamat \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. The mountains Trikūṭa,\[11\] Citrakūṭa,\[12\] Veṅkaṭa,\[13\] Śrīgiri,\[14\] Gokāmukha\[15\] and Nārada came also.

## \|\| 4.37.37 \|\|

*vindhyaśca parvataśreṣṭho nānāsampatsamanvitaḥ \|*  
*ājagāma prahṛṣṭātmā sadāratanayaśśubhaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. The excellent mountain Vindhya possessing many riches, came there delightedly along with his wife and sons.

## \|\| 4.37.38 \|\|

*kālaṃjaro mahāśailo bahuharṣasamanvitaḥ \|*  
*bahubhassagaṇaḥ prītyājagāmahimabhūdharam \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. The mountain Kālañjara, highly resplendent and extremely delighted came along with his attendants.

## \|\| 4.37.39 \|\|

*kailāsastu mahāśailo mahāharṣasamanvitaḥ \|*  
*ājagāma kṛpāṃ kṛtvā sarvopari lasatprabhuḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. The mountain Kailāsa favouring every one because of brilliant lord Śiva came there delighted.

## \|\| 4.37.40 \|\|

*anyepi bhūbhṛto ye hi dvīpeṣvanyeṣvapi dvija \|*  
*ihāpi ye'calāssarve āyayuste himālayam \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. All other mountains from several continents, O brahmin, assembled together in the abode of Himavat.

## \|\| 4.37.41 \|\|

*nimantritā nagāstatra tena pūrvaṃ mudā mune \|*  
*āyayurnikhilāḥ prītyā vivāhaśśivayoriti \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. O sage, all these mountains, invited by Himavat came there to attend the marriage of Śiva and Śivā.

## \|\| 4.37.42 \|\|

*tadā sarve samāyātāśśoṇabhadrādayaḥ khalu \|*  
*bahuśobhā mahāprītyā vivāhaśśivayoriti \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. The brilliant rivers, Śoṇabhadra and others came delightfully to be present at the marriage of Śiva and Śivā.

## \|\| 4.37.43 \|\|

*nadyassarvāssamāyātā nānālaṃkārasaṃyutāḥ \|*  
*divya rūpadharāḥ prītyā vivāhaśśivayoriti \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. All the rivers bedecked in ornaments came lovingly in divine forms at the marriage of Śiva and Śivā.

## \|\| 4.37.44 \|\|

*godāvarī ca yamunā brahmastrīrveṇikā tathā \|*  
*āyayau himaśailamvai vivāhaśśivayoriti \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. The rivers Godāvarī\[20\] Yamunā\[21\] Brahmastrī\[22\] and Veṇikā came to attend the marriage of Śiva and Śivā.

## \|\| 4.37.45 \|\|

*gaṃgā tu sumahāprītyā nānālaṃkārasaṃyutā \|*  
*divyarūpā yayau prītyā vivāhaśśivayoriti \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. With great pleasure Gaṅgā too, assuming a divine form and fully bedecked in ornaments came to attend the marriage of Śiva and Śivā.

## \|\| 4.37.46 \|\|

*narmadā tu mahāmodā rudrakanyā saridvarā \|*  
*mahāprītyā jagāmāśu vivāhaśśivayoriti \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. The best of rivers Narmadā, daughter of Rudra, came joyfully and quickly to attend the marriage of Śiva and Śivā.

## \|\| 4.37.47 \|\|

*āgataistaistataḥ sarvaissarvato himabhūdharam \|*  
*saṃkulāsītpurī divyā sarvaśobhāsamanvitā \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. The entire city of Himavat was full of excitement and ardent fervour when the invitees gathered there together.

## \|\| 4.37.48 \|\|

*mahotsavā lasatketudhvajātoraṇakādhikā \|*  
*vitānavinivṛttārkā tathā nānālasatprabhā \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Great festivities went on in the city. Banners, flags and festoons shone everywhere. The canopies hid the sunlight.

## \|\| 4.37.49 \|\|

*himālayopi suprītyādareṇa vividhena ca \|*  
*teṣāṃ cakāra sanmānaṃ tāsāṃ caiva yathāyatham \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Himavat welcomed them with great delight and reverence. The mountains and the rivers, the gents and the ladies were duly received.

## \|\| 4.37.50 \|\|

*sarvānnivāsayāmāsa susthāneṣu pṛthak pṛthak \|*  
*sāmagrībhiranekābhistoṣayāmāsa kṛtsnaśaḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. He housed them suitably in separate places. They were gratified with the amenities provided by Himavat.

## Chapter 38 - Description of the dais (maṇḍapa)

## \|\| 4.38.1 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*atha śaileśvaraḥ prīto himavānmuni sattama \|*  
*svapuraṃ racayāmāsa vicitraṃ paramotsavam \|\| 1 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

1\. Then the lord of mountains, O excellent sage, attended to the decoration of the entire city befitting the great festivities ahead.

## \|\| 4.38.2 \|\|

*siktamārgaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ ca śobhitaṃ paramarddhibhiḥ \|*  
*dvāri dvāri ca rambhādi maṅgalaṃ dravyasaṃyutam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. The roads were watered and swept clean. At every door, stumps of plantain trees and other auspicious symbols were fixed.

## \|\| 4.38.3 \|\|

*prāṃgaṇaṃ racayāmāsa rambhāstaṃbhasamanvitam \|*  
*paṭṭasūtraissaṃnibaddharasālapallavānvitam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. The courtyard was embellished with plantain trees tied with silken cords. There were festoons of mango leaves.

## \|\| 4.38.4 \|\|

*mālatīmālyasaṃyuktaṃ lasattoraṇasuprabham \|*  
*śobhitammaṃgaladravyaiścaturdikṣu sthitaiśśubhaiḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Festoons with garlands of jasmine flowers shone, everywhere. Other articles of auspicious portent were fixed in every quarter.

## \|\| 4.38.5 \|\|

*tathaiva sarvaṃ parayā mudānvitaścakre girīndrassvasutārthameva \|*  
*gargampuraskṛtya mahāprabhāvaṃ prastāvayogyaṃ ca sumaṃgalaṃ hi \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. These and other things were carried out by Himavat for the sake of his daughter. Every activity was supervised by Garga of great ability. Everything auspicious worth mentioning found a place there.

## \|\| 4.38.6 \|\|

*āhūya viśvakarmāṇaṃ kārayāmāsa sādaram \|*  
*maṇḍapaṃ ca suvistīrṇaṃ vedikādimanoharam \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. He called Viśvakarman and requested him to erect a large and spacious dais beautiful with side rostrums, altars etc.

## \|\| 4.38.7 \|\|

*ayutena surarṣe tadyojanānāṃ ca vistṛtam \|*  
*anekalakṣaṇopetaṃ nānāścaryyasamanvitam \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. The dais, O celestial sage, was ten thousand Yojanas wide. It was wonderfully constructed and had all the characteristic features.

## \|\| 4.38.8 \|\|

*sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ sarvaṃ sadṛśantairmanoharam \|*  
*sarvato'dbhutasarvatvaṃ nānāvastucamatkṛtam \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. All the mobile and immobile objects of the world were represented there with realistic appearance. Everything was wonderfully portrayed.

## \|\| 4.38.9 \|\|

*jaṃgamaṃ vijitantatra sthāvareṇa viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*jaṃgamena ca tatrāsījjitaṃ sthāvarameva hi \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. The mobile objects presented there surpassed the immobile ones and the immobile ones surpassed the mobile ones in excellence.

## \|\| 4.38.10 \|\|

*payasā ca jitā tatra sthalabhūmirna cānyathā \|*  
*jalaṃ kiṃ hi sthalaṃ kiṃ hi na viduḥ ke'pi kovidāḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. The watery places presented there excelled the solid grounds. Even experts could not distinguish what was water and what was solid ground.

## \|\| 4.38.11 \|\|

*kvacitsiṃhāḥ kṛtrimāśca kvacitsārasapaṃktayaḥ \|*  
*kvacicchikhaṇḍinastatra kṛtrimāśca manoharāḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. There were artificial lions. There were rows of storks. There were artificial peacocks, but very beautiful in appearance.

## \|\| 4.38.12 \|\|

*kvacitstriyaḥ kṛtrimāśca nṛtyantyaḥ puruṣaissaha \|*  
*mohayantyo janānsarvānpaśyantyaḥ kṛtrimāstathā \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Artificial women were represented as dancing with artificial men casting wistful glances at them and enchanting them.

## \|\| 4.38.13 \|\|

*tathā tenaiva vidhinā dvārapālā manoharāḥ \|*  
*hastairdhanūṃṣi coddhṛtya sthāvarā jaṃgamopamāḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Beautiful representations of gatekeepers with uplifted bows in their hands appeared like real originals.

## \|\| 4.38.14 \|\|

*dvāri sthitā mahālakṣmīḥ kṛtrimā racitādbhutā \|*  
*sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktā gatāḥ sākṣatpayorṇavāta \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. The statue of Mahālakṣmī at the main entrance appeared like the goddess just emerged from the milk-ocean. It was because all the characteristics were complete.

## \|\| 4.38.15 \|\|

*gajāścālaṅkṛtā hyāsankṛtrimā akṛtopamāḥ \|*  
*tathāśvāḥ na sādibhiścaiva gajāśca gajasādibhiḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Elephants with their mahouts and horses with their riders were so natural that none would say that they were artificial.

## \|\| 4.38.16 \|\|

*rathā rathibhirākṛṣṭā mahāścaryasamanvitāḥ \|*  
*vāhanāni tathānyāni pattayaḥ kṛtrimāstathā \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Chariots were driven by charioteers, other vehicles by other drivers. There were foot-soldiers too. All of them were artificial.

## \|\| 4.38.17 \|\|

*evaṃ vimohanārthantu kṛtaṃ vai viśvakarmaṇā \|*  
*devānāṃ ca munīnāṃ ca tena prītātmanā mune \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. O sage, Viśvakarman was so delighted that he made all these things to fascinate the visiting dignitaries, the gods and the sages.

## \|\| 4.38.18 \|\|

*mahādvāri sthitau nandī kṛtrimaśca kṛto mune \|*  
*śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśo yathā nandī tathaiva saḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. O sage, the statue of Nandin, at the portals, of crystalline purity and brilliance, was a prototype of the real Nandin.

## \|\| 4.38.19 \|\|

*tasyopari mahādivyampuṣpakaṃ ratnabhūṣitam \|*  
*rājitaṃ pallavaiśśubhraścāmaraiśca suśobhitam \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Above that there was the celestial chariot Puṣpaka decorated with sprouts. It shone with gods represented therein.

## \|\| 4.38.20 \|\|

*vāmapārśve gajau dvau ca śuddhakāśmīrasannibhau \|*  
*caturdanto ṣaṣṭivarṣau bhedamānau mahāprabhau \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. On the left side there were two huge saffron coloured elephants with four tusks and appearing to be of sixty years in age. They shone lustrously.

## \|\| 4.38.21 \|\|

*tathaivārkanibhau tena kṛtau cāśvau mahāprabhau \|*  
*cāmarālaṃkṛtau divyau divyālaṅkārabhūṣitau \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. There were two horses too, brilliant like the sun. They were bedecked in divine ornaments and other necessary embellishments.

## \|\| 4.38.22 \|\|

*daṃśitā vararatnāḍhyā lokapālāstathaiva ca \|*  
*sarve devā yathārthaṃ vai kṛtā vai viśvakarmaṇā \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. The guardians of the quarters were shown as adorned with great gems. All the gods were portrayed by Viśvakarman realistically.

## \|\| 4.38.23 \|\|

*tathā hi ṛṣayassarve bhṛgvādyāśca tapodhanāḥ \|*  
*anye hyupasurāstadvatsiddhāścānye'pi vai kṛtāḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Bhṛgu and other sages, secondary gods, Siddhas and others were represented by Viśvakarman.

## \|\| 4.38.24 \|\|

*viṣṇuśca pārṣadaissarvairgaruḍākhyaissamanvitaḥ \|*  
*kṛtrimo nirmitastadvatparamāścaryarūpavān \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. A wonderful image of Viṣṇu with his attendants, Garuḍa and others was created by him with wonderful features.

## \|\| 4.38.25 \|\|

*tathaivāhaṃ sutaivedaissiddhaiśca parivāritaḥ \|*  
*kṛtrimo nirmitastadvatpaṭhansūktāni nārada \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. I too was portrayed as surrounded by my sons, Vedas and Siddhas. O Nārada, I was represented as reciting the hymns.

## \|\| 4.38.26 \|\|

*airāvatagajārūḍhaśśakrassvadalasaṃyutaḥ \|*  
*kṛtrimo nirmitastadvatparipūrṇendusaṃnibhaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. An artificial image of Indra seated on Airāvata and accompanied by his attendants was made by him looking as beautiful as the full moon.

## \|\| 4.38.27 \|\|

*kiṃ bahūktena devarṣe sarvo vai viśvakarmaṇā \|*  
*himāgapreritenāśu klṛptassurasamājakaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. O celestial sage, of what avail is a long-drawn description? The gods were drawn by Viśvakarman as desired by Himavat.

## \|\| 4.38.28 \|\|

*evaṃbhūtaḥ kṛtastena maṇḍapo divyarūpavān \|*  
*anekāścaryasambhūto mahāndevavimohanaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. The Altar was erected by him with wonderful features, fascinating the gods and exquisite in form.

## \|\| 4.38.29 \|\|

*athājñapto girīśena viśvakarmā mahāmatiḥ \|*  
*nivāsārthaṃ surādīnāṃ tattallokām hi yatnataḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. On being commanded by the lord of mountains, the intelligent Viśvakarman created different abodes for the residence of the gods and others.

## \|\| 4.38.30 \|\|

*tatraiva ca mahāmañcāḥ suprabhāḥ paramādbhutāḥ \|*  
*racitāssukhadā divyā steṣāṃ vai viśvakarmaṇā \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Great couches of wonderful brilliance very cosy and exquisite were made by Viśvakarman for their sake.

## \|\| 4.38.31 \|\|

*tathāptasaptalokaṃ vai virece kṣaṇato'dbhutam \|*  
*dīptyā paramayā yuktaṃ nivāsārthaṃ svayambhuvaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. For the residence of Brahmā, seven wonderful abodes were created in a trice. They had great brilliance.

## \|\| 4.38.32 \|\|

*tathaiva viṣṇostvaparaṃ vaikuṇṭhākhyaṃ mahojjvalam \|*  
*virece kṣaṇato divyaṃ nānāścaryasamanvitam \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. A brilliant abode of Viṣṇu called Vaikuṇṭha, with wonderful features, was created in a trice.

## \|\| 4.38.33 \|\|

*amareśagṛhandivyaṃ tathaivādbhutamuttamam \|*  
*virece viśvakarmāsau sarvaiśvaryasamanvitam \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Viśvakarman created a wonderfully divine palace for the lord of gods endowed with all riches.

## \|\| 4.38.34 \|\|

*gṛhāṇi lokapālānāṃ virece sundarāṇi ca \|*  
*tadvatsa prītito divyānyadbhutāni mahānti ca \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Wonderful mansions for the guardians of the quarters were erected by Viśvakarman. They were beautiful and large.

## \|\| 4.38.35 \|\|

*anyeṣāmamarāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ kramaśastathā \|*  
*sadanāni vicitrāṇi racitāni ca tena vai \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Mansions of various kinds were built by him for other gods too.

## \|\| 4.38.36 \|\|

*viśvakarmā mahābuddhiḥ prāptaśambhumahāvaraḥ \|*  
*virece kṣaṇataḥ sarvaṃ śivatuṣṭyarthameva ca \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. The highly intelligent Viśvakarman built everything very quickly for the propitiation of Śiva from whom he had secured great favours.

## \|\| 4.38.37 \|\|

*tathaiva citraṃ paramaṃ mahojjvalaṃ mahāprabhandevavaraissupūjitam \|*  
*girīśacihnaṃ śivalokasaṃsthitaṃ suśobhitaṃ śambhugṛhaṃ cakāra \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Similarly he erected Śiva’s mansion of various shapes and of great brilliance. Having the symbol of Śiva it was designated as Śivaloka. It was admired by all the gods.

## \|\| 4.38.38 \|\|

*evambhūtā kṛtā tena racanā viśvakarmaṇā \|*  
*vicitrā śivatuṣṭyarthaṃ parāścaryā mahojjvalā \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Thus for propitiating Śiva, wonderful and very brilliant structures were erected by Viśvakarman.

## \|\| 4.38.39 \|\|

*evaṃ kṛtvākhilaṃ cedaṃ vyavahāraṃ ca laukikam \|*  
*paryyaikṣiṣṭa mudā śambhvāgamanaṃ sa himācalaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Making all arrangements in accordance with worldly conventions, Himavat awaited eagerly for the arrival of Śiva.

## \|\| 4.38.40 \|\|

*iti proktamaśeṣeṇa vṛttāntampramudāvaham \|*  
*himālayasya devarṣe kimbhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Thus, O divine sage, I have narrated the pleasing story of Himavat entirely. What else do you wish to hear?

## Chapter 39 - The gods arrive at Kailāsa on invitation and Śiva prepares to start

## \|\| 4.39.1 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*vidhe tāta mahāprājña viṣṇuśiṣya namo'stu te \|*  
*adbhuteyaṃ kathāśrāvi tvatto'smābhiḥ kṛpānidhe \|\| 1 \|\|*

Nārada said:—

1\. O dear father Brahmā, O intelligent disciple of Viṣṇu, obeisance be to you. O merciful one, this wonderful story has been heard by us from you.

## \|\| 4.39.2 \|\|

*idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi caritaṃ śaśimaulinaḥ \|*  
*vaivāhikaṃ sumāṅgalyaṃ sarvāghaughavināśanam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Now I wish to hear the story of the auspicious marriage of the moon-crested lord that dispels all sins.

## \|\| 4.39.3 \|\|

*kiṃ cakāra mahādevaḥ prāpya maṅgalapatrikām \|*  
*tāṃ śrāvaya kathāndivyāṃ śaṅkarassaparātmanaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. What did lord Śiva do on receiving the auspicious letter of betrothal. Please narrate that story of Śiva, the supreme soul.

## \|\| 4.39.4 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*śṛṇu vatsa mahāprājña śāṅkaramparamaṃ yaśaḥ \|*  
*yaccakāra mahādevaḥ prāpya maṅgalapatrikām \|\| 4 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

4\. Dear child of great intellect, listen to the glory of Śiva, what lord Śiva did on receiving the auspicious letter,

## \|\| 4.39.5 \|\|

*atha śambhurgṛhītvā tāṃ mudā maṃgalapatrikām \|*  
*vijahāsa prahṛṣṭātmā mānanteṣāṃ vyadhādvibhuḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. On reading the auspicious letter with joy, Śiva laughed in delight. The lord honoured them duly.

## \|\| 4.39.6 \|\|

*vācayitvā ca tāṃ samyagsvīcakāra vidhānataḥ \|*  
*tajjananyāpayāmāsa bahusammānya cādṛtaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Causing the letter to be read aloud, He duly accepted the proposal. Honouring the messengers He informed them.

## \|\| 4.39.7 \|\|

*uvāca sunivargāṃstānkāryyaṃ samyak kṛtaṃ śubham \|*  
*āgantavyaṃ vivāhe me vivāhassvīkṛto mayā \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. He told the sages—“Every thing is auspicious and well done. All of you shall grace the celebration of my marriage. The marriage proposal has been accepted by me”.

## \|\| 4.39.8 \|\|

*ityākarṇya vacaśśambhoḥ prahṛṣṭāste praṇamya tam \|*  
*parikramya yayurdhāma śaṃsantaḥ svaṃ vidhimparam \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. On hearing these words of Śiva, they were delighted. After bowing to and circumambulating Him they returned joyful of their great luck and grace.

## \|\| 4.39.9 \|\|

*atha deveśvaraśśambhussāmarastvāṃ mune drutam \|*  
*laukikācāramāśritya mahālīlākaraḥ prabhuḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Then Śiva, the lord of the gods, the lord indulging in divine sports, remembered you, O sage, in accordance with worldly conventions.

## \|\| 4.39.10-11 \|\|

*tvamāgataḥ paraprītyā praśaṃsaṃstvaṃ vidhimparam \|*  
*praṇamaṃśca nataskandho vinītātmā kṛtāñjaliḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*astaussujayaśabdānhi samuccārya muhurmuhuḥ \|*  
*nideśaṃ prārthayaṃstasya praśaṃsaṃstvaṃ vidhimmune \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. You came there praising your good luck. Bowing to Him humbly with palms joined in reverence and with stooping shoulders you eulogised Him with the utterances of words “hail to Thee”. O sage, you requested Him for his behest.

## \|\| 4.39.12 \|\|

*tataśśaṃbhuḥ prahṛṣṭātmā darśayaṃllaukikīṃ gatim \|*  
*uvāca munivarya tvāṃ prīṇayañchubhayā girā \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Then the delighted Śiva, heightening your pleasure with sweet speech and evincing interest in worldly conventions told you thus, O excellent sage.

## \|\| 4.39.13 \|\|

*śiva uvāca \|*  
*prītyā śṛṇu muniśreṣṭha hyasmatto'dya vadāmi te \|*  
*bruve tattvāṃ priyo me yadbhaktarājaśiromaṇiḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

Śiva said:—

13\. O excellent sage, listen to us lovingly. I am speaking to you because you are the crest-jewel of my devotees.

## \|\| 4.39.14 \|\|

*kṛtaṃ mahattapo devyā pārvatyā tava śāsanāt \|*  
*tasyai varo mayā dattaḥ patitve toṣitena vai \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. At your bidding a great penance has been performed by Pārvatī. Propitiated by her I have granted her the boon of my being her husband.

## \|\| 4.39.15 \|\|

*kariṣye'haṃ vivāhaṃ ca tasyā vaśyo hi bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*saptarṣibhissādhitaśca tallagnaṃ śodhitaṃ ca taiḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Being subservient to her by her devotion I shall marry her. The auspicious hour free of defects has been fixed by the seven sages.

## \|\| 4.39.16 \|\|

*adyatassaptame cāhni tadbhaviṣyati nārada \|*  
*mahotsavaṃ kariṣyāmi laukikīṃ gatimāśritaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. O Nārada, the marriage will take place after seven days from today. Following the worldly conventions I shall make a grand festival of the same.

## \|\| 4.39.17 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*iti śrutvā vacastasya śaṃkarasya parātmanaḥ \|*  
*prasannadhīḥ prabhuṃ natvā tāta tvaṃ vākyamabravīḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

17\. O dear one, on hearing these words of Śiva, the supreme soul, you were delighted and you spoke after bowing to the lord.

## \|\| 4.39.18 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*bhavatastu vratamidambhaktavaśyo bhavānmataḥ \|*  
*samyak kṛtaṃ ca bhavatā pārvatīmānasepsitam \|\| 18 \|\|*

Nārada said:—

18\. This is your sacred rite. You have been considered subservient to your devotees. You have carried out the desire of Pārvatī.

## \|\| 4.39.19 \|\|

*kāryaṃ matsadṛśaṃ kiñcitkathanīyantvayā vibho \|*  
*matvā svasevakaṃ māṃ hi kṛpāṃ kuru namo'stu te \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. O lord, a task befitting my capacity must be mentioned by you. Considering me your own servant please be kind to me. Obeisance to you.

## \|\| 4.39.20 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*ityuktastu tvayā śambhuśśaṃkaro bhaktavatsalaḥ \|*  
*pratyuvāca prasannātmā sādaraṃ tvāṃ munīśvara \|\| 20 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

20\. O great sage, Śiva, favourably disposed to His devotees, on being thus requested by you replied very delightedly to you.

## \|\| 4.39.21 \|\|

*śiva uvāca \|*  
*viṣṇuprabhṛtidevāṃśca munīnsiddhānapi dhruvam \|*  
*tvannimantraya madvāṇyā mune'nyānapi sarvataḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

Śiva said:—

21\. O sage, on my behalf, invite all the gods beginning with Viṣṇu, and sages, Siddhas and others.

## \|\| 4.39.22 \|\|

*sarva āyāntu sotsāhāssarvaśobhāsamanvitāḥ \|*  
*sastrīsutagaṇāḥ prītyā mama śāsanagauravāt \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Giving due weightage to my bidding, may all of them come here enthusiastically, in all their splendour along with their women and children.

## \|\| 4.39.23 \|\|

*nāgamiṣyanti ye tvatra madvivāhotsave mune \|*  
*te svakīyā na mantavyā mayā devādayaḥ khalu \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. O sage, those who do not take part in the celebration of my marriage, are not my people, even if they are the gods.

## \|\| 4.39.24 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*itīśājñāṃ tato dhṛtvā bhavāñchaṅkaravallabhaḥ \|*  
*sarvānnimantrayāmāsa taṃ taṃ gatvā drutaṃ mune \|\| 24 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

24\. Paying heed to this behest of Śiva, O sage, you, a great favourite of Śiva, invited all of them approaching everyone severally.

## \|\| 4.39.25 \|\|

*śambhūpakaṇṭhamāgatya drutaṃ munivaro bhavān \|*  
*taddūtyāttatra santasthau tadājñāmprāpya nārada \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. O Nārada, after carrying out your duties as his emissary you, the great sage, returned to Śiva and remained there with His permission.

## \|\| 4.39.26 \|\|

*śivo'pi tasthau sotkaṇṭhastadāgamanalālasaḥ \|*  
*svagaṇaissotsavaissaveṃrnṛtyadbhissarvatodiśam \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Śiva too waited there eagerly expecting their arrival while his attendants were celebrating great festivities by dance and songs.

## \|\| 4.39.27 \|\|

*etasminneva kāle tu racayitvā svaveṣakam \|*  
*ājagāmācyutaśśīghraṃ kailāsaṃ saparicchadaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. At the same time, Viṣṇu, along with his retinue, came there suitably dressed.

## \|\| 4.39.28 \|\|

*śivampraṇamya sadbhaktyā sadārassadalo mudā \|*  
*tadājñāmprāpya santasthau susthāne prītamānasaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Accompanied by his wife and followers he bowed to Śiva with great devotion and joy, and with his permission stayed there in a good abode.

## \|\| 4.39.29 \|\|

*tathāhaṃ svagaṇairāśu kailāsamagamaṃ mudā \|*  
*prabhumpraṇamyātiṣṭhaṃ vai sānandassvagaṇānvitaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. I too accompanied by my attendants went to Kailāsa. After bowing to the lord, I too waited there with pleasure along with my followers.

## \|\| 4.39.30 \|\|

*indrādayo lokapālā āyayussaparicchadāḥ \|*  
*tathaivālaṃkṛtāssarve sotsavāssakalatrakāḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Indra and other guardians of the quarters came there with their retinue and womenfolk richly decorated and in festive mood.

## \|\| 4.39.31 \|\|

*tathaiva munayo nāgāssiddhā upasurā stathā \|*  
*āyayuścāpare'pīha sotsavāssunimantritāḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Similarly the sages, the Nāgas, the Siddhas, the secondary gods and others who had been duly invited came there in jovial mood.

## \|\| 4.39.32 \|\|

*maheśvarastadā tatrāgatānāṃ ca pṛthak pṛthak \|*  
*sarveṣāmamarādyānāṃ satkāraṃ vyadadhānmudā \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Lord Śiva duly received and welcomed all those gods and others severally.

## \|\| 4.39.33 \|\|

*athotsavo mahānāsītkailāse paramodbhutaḥ \|*  
*nṛtyādikantadā cakruryathāyogyaṃ surastriyaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Then a great festival was celebrated at Kailāsa. It was very wonderful. The celestial damsels danced in a befitting manner.

## \|\| 4.39.34 \|\|

*etasminsamaye devā viṣṇvādyā ye samāgatāḥ \|*  
*yātrāṃ kārayituṃ śambhostatroṣuste'khilā mune \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. O sage, in the meantime Viṣṇu and other gods who had arrived there desired to make Śiva’s procession to start.

## \|\| 4.39.35 \|\|

*śivājñaptāstadā sarve madīyamiti yantritāḥ \|*  
*śivakāryamidaṃ sarvaṃ cakrire śivasevanam \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. At the bidding of Śiva, all of them performed service to Śiva considering His work as their own.

## \|\| 4.39.36 \|\|

*mātarassapta tāstatra śivabhūṣāvidhimparam \|*  
*cakrire ca mudā yuktā yathāyogyantathā punaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. The seven Mothers performed the rites of bedecking Śiva in a fitting manner very joyously.

## \|\| 4.39.37 \|\|

*tasya svābhāviko veṣo bhūṣāvivirabhūttadā \|*  
*tasyecchayā muniśreṣṭha parameśasya suprabho \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Even the very natural dress and features of Śiva assumed the work of ornamentation, O excellent sage, at the will of lord Siva.

## \|\| 4.39.38 \|\|

*candraśca mukuṭasthāne sānnidhyamakarottadā \|*  
*locanaṃ sundaraṃ hyāsīttṛtīyantilakaṃ śubham \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. The moon took the place of the crown. The third eye became the beautiful ornament on the forehead.

## \|\| 4.39.39 \|\|

*karṇābharaṇarūpau ca yau hi sarpau prakīrtitau \|*  
*kuṇḍale'bhavatāntasya nānāratnānvite mune \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. O sage, the serpents that had been embellishing His ears before became the ear-rings studded with various gems.

## \|\| 4.39.40 \|\|

*anyāṃgasaṃsthitāssarpāstadaṃgābharaṇāni ca \|*  
*babhūvuratiramyāṇi nānāratnamayāni ca \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. The serpents in the other parts became the befitting ornaments of those parts, very beautiful and studded with gems.

## \|\| 4.39.41 \|\|

*vibhūtiraṃgarāgo'bhūccandanādisamudbhavaḥ \|*  
*taddukūlamabhūddivyaṃ gajacarmādi sundaram \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. The ashes became the sweet unguent smeared over his body. The elephant hide etc. became the beautiful silken cloth.

## \|\| 4.39.42 \|\|

*īdṛśaṃ sundaraṃ rūpaṃ jātaṃ varṇātiduṣkaram \|*  
*īśvaro'pi svayaṃ sākṣādaiśvaryaṃ labdhavānsvataḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. The form assumed a beauty beyond description. Lord Śiva seemed to have acquired from Himself all the riches.

## \|\| 4.39.43 \|\|

*tataśca sarve surapakṣadānavā nāgāḥ pataṃgāpsaraso maharṣayaḥ \|*  
*sametya sarve śivasannidhiṃ tadā mahotsavāḥ procuraho mudānvitāḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Then all the gods, demons, Nāgas, Pataṅgas, Apsarasas, sages and others approached Śiva and proclaimed jovially.

## \|\| 4.39.44 \|\|

*sarvai ūcuḥ \|*  
*gaccha gaccha mahādeva vivāhārthaṃ maheśvara \|*  
*girijāyā mahādevyāḥ sahāsmābhiḥ kṛpāṃ kuru \|\| 44 \|\|*

All of them said:—

44\. O lord, start on journey for wedding the great goddess, the daughter of the mountain, accompanied by us. Be merciful.

## \|\| 4.39.45 \|\|

*tato viṣṇuruvācedaṃ prastāvasadṛśaṃ vacaḥ \|*  
*praṇamya śaṃkaraṃ bhaktyā vijñānaprītamānasaḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Then the omniscient Viṣṇu of joyful mind spoke befitting the occasion after bowing to Śiva with devotion.

## \|\| 4.39.46 \|\|

*\|\| viṣṇuruvāca \|*  
*deva deva mahādeva śaraṇāgatavatsala \|*  
*kāryakarttā svabhaktānāṃ vijñaptiṃ śṛṇu me prabho \|\| 46 \|\|*

Viṣṇu said:—

46\. O lord of the gods, favourite of those who seek refuge in you, please carry out the task of your devotees. O lord, please listen to my submission.

## \|\| 4.39.47 \|\|

*gṛhyoktavidhinā śambho svavivāhasya śaṃkara \|*  
*girīśasutayā devyā karma kartumihārhasi \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. O Śiva, let the rites of your marriage with the daughter of the lord of mountains be performed according to the laws laid down in the Gṛhya Sūtras.

## \|\| 4.39.48 \|\|

*tvayā ca kriyamāṇe tu vivāhasya vidhau hara \|*  
*sa eva hi tathā loke sarvassukhyātimāpnuyāta \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. The rites followed in your marriage, O Śiva, will become famous and be followed in the world.

## \|\| 4.39.49 \|\|

*maṇḍapasthāpanannāndīmukhantatkuladharmataḥ \|*  
*kāraya prītito nātha loke svaṃ khyāpayan yaśaḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Please cause the construction of the altar and the Nāndīmukha according to family tradition. Thus you will be spreading your glory in the world, O lord.

## \|\| 4.39.50 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*evamuktastadā śambhurviṣṇunā parameśvaraḥ \|*  
*laukikācāranirato vidhinā taccakāra saḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

50\. Lord Śiva thus requested by Viṣṇu, and being himself eager to follow worldly conventions performed the same duly.

## \|\| 4.39.51 \|\|

*ahaṃ hyadhikṛtastena sarvamabhyudayocitam \|*  
*akurvaṃ munibhiḥ prītyā tatra tatkarma cādarāt \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Authorised by Him, I performed all the rites conducive to prosperity, assisted by the sages.

## \|\| 4.39.52-55 \|\|

*kaśyapo'trirvaśiṣṭhaśca gautamo bhāgurirguruḥ \|*  
*kaṇvo bṛhaspatiśśaktirjamadagniḥ parāśaraḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*mārkaṇḍeyaśśilāpāko'ruṇapālo'kṛtaśramaḥ \|*  
*agastyaścyavano gargaśśilādo'tha mahāmune \|\| 53 \|\|*

*dadhīcirupamanyuśca bharadvājo'kṛtavraṇaḥ \|*  
*pippalādo'tha kuśikaḥ kautso vyāsaḥ saśiṣyakaḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

*ete cānye ca bahava āgatāśśivasannidhim \|*  
*mayā sunoditāstatra cakruste vidhivatkriyām \|\| 55 \|\|*

52-55. The sages Kaśyapa, Atri, Vasiṣṭha, Gautama, Bhāguri, Bṛhaspati, Kaṇva, Śakti, Jamadagni, Parāśara, Mārkaṇḍeya, Śilāpāka, Aruṇapāla, Akṛtaśrama, Agastya, Cyavana, Garga, Śilāda, Dadhīci, Upamanyu, Bharadvāja, Akṛtavraṇa, Pippalāda, Kuśika, Kautsa, Vyāsa, with his disciples, and other sages came to Śiva. Urged by me they performed the sacred rites duly.

## \|\| 4.39.56 \|\|

*vedoktavidhinā sarve vedavedāṃgapāragāḥ \|*  
*rakṣāṃ cakrurmaheśasya kṛtvā kautukamaṃgalam \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. All of them who had mastered the Vedas and Vedāṅgas performed the safety rites for Śiva and tied the auspicious thread round his wrist.

## \|\| 4.39.57 \|\|

*ṛgyajussāmasūktaistu tathā nānāvidhaiḥ paraiḥ \|*  
*maṃgalāni ca bhūrīṇi cakruḥ prītyarṣayo'khilāḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. By reciting hymns from Ṛk, Yajus, and Sāman they performed the holy rites. All the sages were greatly pleased.

## \|\| 4.39.58 \|\|

*grahāṇāṃ pūjanaṃ prītyā cakruste śambhunā mayā \|*  
*maṇḍalasthasurāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ vighnaśāntaye \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. In order to ward off obstacles they performed the adoration of the planets under my instruction. They worshipped the gods stationed in the altar.

## \|\| 4.39.59 \|\|

*tataśśivastu santuṣṭaḥ kṛtvā sarvaṃ yathocitam \|*  
*laukikaṃ vaidikaṃ karma nanāma ca mudā dvijān \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. After performing the social and Vedic rites in a fitting manner Śiva became pleased and bowed to the brahmins joyously.

## \|\| 4.39.60 \|\|

*atha sarveśvaro viprāndevānkṛtvā purassarān \|*  
*nissasāra mudā tasmātkailāsātparvatottamāt \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. Then the lord of all started from the excellent mountain Kailāsa keeping the brahmins and the gods ahead.

## \|\| 4.39.61 \|\|

*bahiḥ kailāsakudharācchambhustasthau mudānvitaḥ \|*  
*devaissaha dvijaiścaiva nānāsvīkārakaḥ prabhuḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. Outside the mountain Kailāsa, Śiva stopped for a while along with the gods and brahmins receiving different ovations.

## \|\| 4.39.62 \|\|

*tadotsavo mahānāsīttatra devādibhiḥ kṛtaḥ \|*  
*santuṣṭyarthaṃ maheśasya gānavādyasunṛtyakaḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. Then a great jovial festival was celebrated by the gods and others in order to propitiate Śiva. Songs were sung. Instruments were played. Dances were held.

## Chapter 40 - The Marriage Procession of Śiva

## \|\| 4.40.1 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*atha śambhuḥ samāhūya nandyādīn sakalāngaṇān \|*  
*ājñāpayāmāsa mudā gantuṃ svena ca tatra vai \|\| 1 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

1\. Then Śiva called Nandin and other Gaṇas and ordered them to accompany Him.

## \|\| 4.40.2 \|\|

*\|\| śiva uvāca \|*  
*api yūyaṃ saha mayā saṃgacchadhvaṃ gireḥ puram \|*  
*kiyadgaṇānihāsthāpya mahotsavapurassaram \|\| 2 \|\|*

Śiva said:—

2\. Station a few Gaṇas here and the rest of you accompany me to the city of the mountain in a jovial mood.

## \|\| 4.40.3 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*atha te samanujñaptā gaṇeśā niryayurmudā \|*  
*svaṃsvaṃ balamupādāya tān kathaṃcidvadāmyaham \|\| 3 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

3\. Then the lords of Gaṇas thus ordered took their armies and started joyously. I shall explain it in general terms.

## \|\| 4.40.4 \|\|

*abhyagācchaṃkhakarṇaśca gaṇakoṭyā gaṇeśvaraḥ \|*  
*śivena sārddhaṃ saṃgantuṃ himācalapuramprati \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. The lord of Gaṇas, Śaṅkhakarṇa started with a crore of Gaṇas to the city of Himavat along with Śiva.

## \|\| 4.40.5 \|\|

*daśakoṭyā kekarākṣo gaṇānāṃ samahotsavaḥ \|*  
*aṣṭakoṭyā ca vikṛto gaṇānāṃ gaṇanāyakaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Kekarākṣa took ten crores of Gaṇas with gaiety. Vikṛta, the leader of Gaṇas, took eight crores of Gaṇas.

## \|\| 4.40.6 \|\|

*catuṣkoṭyā viśākhaśca gaṇānāṃ gaṇanāyakaḥ \|*  
*pārijātaśca navabhiḥ koṭibhirgaṇapuṃgavaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Viśākha took four crores and Pārijāta took nine crores of Gaṇas.

## \|\| 4.40.7 \|\|

*ṣaṣṭissarvāntakaḥ śrīmāntathaiva vikṛtānanaḥ \|*  
*gaṇānāndundubhoṣṭābhiḥ koṭikoṭibhirgaṇanāyakaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. The glorious Sarvāntaka and Vikṛtānana took sixty crores. Dundubha took eight crores.

## \|\| 4.40.8 \|\|

*pañcabhiśca kapālākhyo gaṇeśaḥ koṭibhistathā \|*  
*ṣaḍbhissandārako vīro gaṇānāṃ koṭibhirmune \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. O sage, Kapāla took five crores and the heroic Sandāraka took six crores of Gaṇas.

## \|\| 4.40.9 \|\|

*koṭikoṭibhireveha kandukaḥ kuṇḍakastathā \|*  
*viṣṭambho gaṇapo'ṣṭābhirgaṇānāṃ koṭibhistathā \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Kanduka and Kuṇḍaka took a crore of the Gaṇas. Viṣṭambha took eight crores.

## \|\| 4.40.10 \|\|

*sahasrakoṭyā gaṇapaḥ pippalo mudito yayau \|*  
*tathā saṃnādako vīro gaṇeśo munisattama \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. The leader Pippala joyously went with a thousand crores. O excellent sage, Sanādaka the hero also took so many.

## \|\| 4.40.11 \|\|

*āveśanastathāṣṭābhiḥ koṭibhirgaṇanāyakaḥ \|*  
*mahākeśassahasreṇa koṭīnāṃ gaṇapo yayau \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Āveśana went with eight crores. Mahākeśa took a thousand crores.

## \|\| 4.40.12 \|\|

*kuṇḍo dvādaśakoṭyā hi tathā parvatako mune \|*  
*aṣṭābhiḥ koṭibhirvīrassamagāccandratāpanaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. O sage, Kuṇḍa and Parvataka each took twelve crores of Gaṇas with him. The heroic Candratāpana went with eight crores.

## \|\| 4.40.13 \|\|

*kālaśca kālakaścaiva mahākālaśśatena vai \|*  
*koṭīnāṃ gaṇanātho hi tathaivāgnikanāmakaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Kāla, Kālaka and Mahākāla each went with hundred crores of Gaṇas. The leader of Gaṇas named Agnika went with a crore.

## \|\| 4.40.14 \|\|

*koṭyagnimukha evāgād gaṇānāṃ gaṇanāyakaḥ \|*  
*ādityamūrddhā koṭyā ca tathā caiva ghanāvahaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Agnimukha, the leader of Gaṇas, went with a crore. Ādityamūrdhā and Ghanāvaha each went with a crore of Gaṇas.

## \|\| 4.40.15 \|\|

*sannāhaśśatakoṭyā hi kumudo gaṇapastathā \|*  
*amoghaḥ kokilaścaiva śatakoṭyā gaṇādhipaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Sannāha and Kumuda went with hundred crores. So also Amogha and Kokila each went with hundred crores.

## \|\| 4.40.16 \|\|

*sumantraḥ koṭikoṭyā ca gaṇānāṃ gaṇānāyakaḥ \|*  
*kākapādodaraḥ koṭiṣaṣṭyā santānakastathā \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Sumantra, the leader of Gaṇas, went with a crore of Gaṇas. Kākapādodara and Santānaka went each with six crores of Gaṇas.

## \|\| 4.40.17 \|\|

*mahābalaśca navabhirmadhupiṃgaśca kokilaḥ \|*  
*nīlo navatyā koṭīnāṃ pūrṇabhadrastathaiva ca \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Mahābala, Madhupiṅga and Kokila each went with nine crores. Nīla and Pūrṇabhadra each went with ninety crores of Gaṇas.

## \|\| 4.40.18 \|\|

*saptakoṭyā caturvaktraḥ karaṇo viṃśakoṭibhiḥ \|*  
*yayau navatikoṭyā tu gaṇeśāno hi romakaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Caturvaktra with seven crores, Karaṇa with twenty crores and the leader of Gaṇas Ahiromaka went with ninety crores.

## \|\| 4.40.19 \|\|

*yajvāśaśśatamanyuśca meghamanyuśca nārada \|*  
*tāvatkoṭyā yayussarve gaṇeśā hi pṛthakpṛthak \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. O Nārada, Yajvākṣa, Śatamanyu and Meghamanyu each of these leaders too went with so many crores.

## \|\| 4.40.20 \|\|

*kāṣṭhāṅguṣṭhaścatuṣṣaṣṭyā koṭīnāṃ gaṇanāyakaḥ \|*  
*virūpākṣassukeśaśca vṛṣābhaśca sanātanaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Kāṣṭhāgūḍha, the leader of Gaṇas, went with sixtyfour crores. So too Virūpākṣa, Sukeśa, Vṛṣabha and Sanātana.

## \|\| 4.40.21 \|\|

*tālaketuḥ ṣaḍāsyaśca cañcvāsyaśca sanātanaḥ \|*  
*samvartakastathā caitro lakulīśassvayamprabhuḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Similarly Tālaketu, Ṣaḍāsya, the eternal Cañcvāsya Saṃvartaka, Caitra and the lord Lakulīśa himself.

## \|\| 4.40.22-23 \|\|

*lokāntakaśca dīptātmā tathā daityāntako mune \|*  
*devo bhṛṃgiriṭiśśrīmāndevadevapriyastathā \|\| 22 \|\|*

*aśanirbhānukaścaiva catuṣṣaṣṭyā sahasraśaḥ \|*  
*yayuśśivavivāhārthaṃ śivena sahasotsavāḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. The brilliant Lokāntaka, Daityāntaka, lord Bhṛṅgiriṭi, the glorious Devapriya, Aśani and Bhānuka went with sixtyfour crores. Others in jovial mood went in thousands with Śiva to attend his marriage, O sage.

## \|\| 4.40.24 \|\|

*bhūtakoṭisahasreṇa pramathāḥ koṭibhistribhiḥ \|*  
*vīrabhadraścatuṣṣaṣṭyā romajānāntrikoṭibhiḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. A thousand crores of Bhūtas aud three crores of Pramathas went. Vīrabhadra went with sixtyfour crores of Gaṇas and three crores of Romajas.

## \|\| 4.40.25 \|\|

*koṭikoṭisahasrāṇāṃ śatairviṃśatibhirvṛtāḥ \|*  
*tatra jagmuśca nandyādyā gaṇapāśśaṃkarotsave \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. In the marriage procession of Śiva, Nandin and other leaders of Gaṇas went surrounded by hundreds and twenties of crores of Gaṇas.

## \|\| 4.40.26 \|\|

*kṣetrapālo bhairavaśca koṭikoṭigaṇairyutaḥ \|*  
*udvāhaśśaṃkarasyetyāyayau prītyā mahotsave \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Knowing delightedly that it was Śiva’s marriage, Bhairava the Kṣetrapāla went jovially with crores and crores of Gaṇas.

## \|\| 4.40.27 \|\|

*ete cānye ca gaṇapā asaṅkhyātā mahābalāḥ \|*  
*tatra jagmurmahāprītyā sotsāhāśśaṃkarotsave \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. These and other leaders of Gaṇas of great strength and multitudinous in number joined the procession with joy and enthusiasm.

## \|\| 4.40.28 \|\|

*sarve sahasrahastāśca jaṭāmukuṭadhāriṇaḥ \|*  
*candrarekhāvataṃsāśca nīlakaṇṭhāstrilocanāḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. They had a thousand hands. They wore matted hair and crowns. They were bedecked with streaks of the moon. They had three eyes and blue necks (like lord Śiva).

## \|\| 4.40.29 \|\|

*rudrākṣābharaṇāssarve tathā sadbhasmadhāriṇaḥ \|*  
*hārakuṇḍalakeyūramukuṭādyairalaṃkṛtāḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. All of them wore garlands of Rudrākṣa beads. They had the holy ashes smeared over the body. They had the ornaments of necklaces, earrings, bracelets, crowns etc.

## \|\| 4.40.30 \|\|

*brahmaviṣṇvindrasaṃkāśā aṇimādiguṇairyutāḥ \|*  
*sūryyakoṭipratīkāśāstatra rejurgaṇeśvarāḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. The leaders were as refulgent as Brahmā, Viṣṇu and Indra, Aṇimā and other Energies. They were as brilliant and lustrous as crores of suns.

## \|\| 4.40.31 \|\|

*pṛthivīcāriṇaḥ kecit kecitpātālacāriṇaḥ \|*  
*kecidvyomacarāḥ kecitsaptasvargacarā mune \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. O sage, some of them belonged to this terrestrial world, some came through nether worlds, some came through the sky and some came through seven heavens.

## \|\| 4.40.32 \|\|

*kimbahūktena devarṣe sarvalokanivāsinaḥ \|*  
*āyayussvagaṇāśśambhoḥ prītyā vai śaṅkarotsave \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Of what avail is this talk? O celestial sage, Śiva’s own Gaṇas living in all the worlds came and joined the procession of Śiva, with pleasure.

## \|\| 4.40.33 \|\|

*itthaṃ devairgaṇaiścānyaissahitaśśaṅkaraḥ prabhuḥ \|*  
*yayau himagiripuraṃ vivāhārthaṃ nijasya vai \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Thus, lord Śiva, accompanied by his Gaṇas, gods and others, went to the city of Himagiri for the celebration of His marriage.

## \|\| 4.40.34 \|\|

*yadājagāma sarveśo vivāhārthe surādibhiḥ \|*  
*tadā tatra hyabhūdvṛttaṃ tacchṛṇu tvaṃ munīśvara \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. O great sage, listen to another incident that happened when Śiva, the lord of all, went for his marriage along with the gods and others.

## \|\| 4.40.35 \|\|

*rudrasya bhaginī bhūtvā caṇḍī sūtsavasaṃyutā \|*  
*tatrājagāma suprītyā pareṣāṃ suṃbhayāvahā \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Rudra’s sister Caṇḍī assuming a great festive mood came there with great pleasure but inspiring terror in others.

## \|\| 4.40.36 \|\|

*pretāsanasamārūḍhā sarpābharaṇabhūṣitā \|*  
*pūrṇaṃ kalaśamādāya haimaṃ mūrdhni mahāprabham \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. She was riding on a ghost. She was bedecked in the ornaments of serpents. A gold pot filled (with water) shone over her head.

## \|\| 4.40.37 \|\|

*svaparīvārasaṃyuktā dīptāsyā dīptalocanā \|*  
*kutūhalamprakurvantī jātaharṣā mahābalā \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. She was accompanied by her attendants. Her face was beaming. Her eyes dazzled. She was enthusiastic and glad. She was strong.

## \|\| 4.40.38 \|\|

*tatra bhūtagaṇā divyā virūpaḥ koṭiśo mune \|*  
*virājante sma bahuśastathā nānāvidhāstadā \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. The divine Bhūta attendants were crores and crores in number. They shone in diverse forms.

## \|\| 4.40.39 \|\|

*taissametāgrataścaṇḍī jagāma vikṛtānanā \|*  
*kutūhalānvitā prītā prītyupadrava kāriṇī \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Accompanied by them Caṇḍī of deformed face went ahead gladly and enthusiastically. She was equally competent to please and to harass.

## \|\| 4.40.40 \|\|

*caṇḍyā sarve rudragaṇāḥ pṛṣṭhataśca kṛtāstadā \|*  
*koṭyekādaśasaṃkhyākā raudrarudrapriyāśca te \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. All the Gaṇas of Śiva numbering to eleven crore s, terrible but favourites of Śiva were kept by her far behind.

## \|\| 4.40.41 \|\|

*tadā ḍamarunirghoṣairvyāptamāsījjagattrayam \|*  
*bherījhaṃkāraśabdena śaṃkhānāṃ ninadena ca \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. The loud sounds of Ḍamarus, the Jhaṅkāra sound of the Bherīs and the sound of the conches pervaded all the three worlds.

## \|\| 4.40.42 \|\|

*tathā dundubhinirghoṣaiśśabdaḥ kolāhalo'bhavat \|*  
*kurvañjaganmaṃgalaṃ ca nāśayenmaṃgaletarat \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. The tumultuous sound of the Dundubhis rose up in the air blessing the universe auspiciously and destroying everything other than auspicious.

## \|\| 4.40.43 \|\|

*gaṇānāṃ pṛṣṭhato bhūtvā sarve devāssamutsukāḥ \|*  
*anvayussarvasiddhāśca lokapālādikā mune \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. O sage, behind the Gaṇas, the enthusiastic gods, the Siddhas, the guardians of the quarters and others followed.

## \|\| 4.40.44 \|\|

*madhye vrajan rameśo'tha garuḍāsanamāśritaḥ \|*  
*śuśubhe dhriyamāṇena kṣatreṇa mahatā mune \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. O sage, Viṣṇu, seated on Garuḍa and going in the middle of the group shone with the great umbrella held aloft.

## \|\| 4.40.45 \|\|

*cāmarairvījyamāno'sau svagaṇaiḥ parivāritaḥ \|*  
*pārṣadairvilasadbhiśca svabhūṣāvidhibhūṣitaḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. He was surrounded by his attendants who fanned him with Cāmaras. His Pārṣadas too shone well. He was bedecked in all his ornaments.

## \|\| 4.40.46-47 \|\|

*tathā'hamapyaśobhamvai vrajanmārge virājitaḥ \|*  
*vedairmūrtidharaiśśāstraiḥ purāṇairāgamaistathā \|\| 46 \|\|*

*sanakādimahāsiddhaissaprajāpatibhissutaiḥ \|*  
*parivāraissaṃyuto hi śivasevanatatparaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

46-47. I too shone well on the way with the Vedas, Śāstras, Purāṇas and Āgamas personified and along with my sons, Prajāpatis, Sanaka and other Siddhas. I was eager in rendering service to Śiva.

## \|\| 4.40.48 \|\|

*svasainyamadhyagaśśakra airāvatagaja sthitaḥ \|*  
*nāmāvibhūṣito'tyantaṃ vrajan reje sureśvaraḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Going along, seated on the elephant Airāvata in the midst of his armies, Indra, the lord of god, shone well fully decorated in various ways.

## \|\| 4.40.49 \|\|

*tadā tu vrajamānāste ṛṣayo bahavaśca te \|*  
*virejuratisotkaṇṭhaśśivasyodvāhanamprati \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Many other sages enthusiastic about the marriage of Śiva shone well on their way.

## \|\| 4.40.50-51 \|\|

*śākinyo yātudhānāśca vetālā brahmarākṣasāḥ \|*  
*bhūtapretapiśācāśca tathānye pramathādayaḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

*tumbururnārado hāhā hūhūścetyādayo varāḥ \|*  
*gandharvāḥ kinnarā jagmurvādyānādhmāya harṣitāḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

50-51. Śākinīs, Yātudhānas Vetālas, Brahmarākṣasas, Bhūtas, Pretas and Pramathas, Tumburu, Nārada, Hāhā, Hūhū, Gandharvas and Kinnaras went ahead playing on their musical instruments with great delight.

## \|\| 4.40.52-53 \|\|

*jagato mātarassarvā devakanyāśca sarvaśaḥ \|*  
*gāyatrī caiva sāvitrī lakṣmīranyāssurastriyaḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*etāścānyāśca devānāṃ patnayo bhavamātaraḥ \|*  
*udvāhaśśaṃkarasyeti jagmussarvā mudānvitāḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

52-53. The Mothers of the universe, the celestial virgins, Gāyatrī, Sāvitrī, Lakṣmī, the celestial maidens, the wives of the gods, the mothers of the worlds went ahead with great joy, only because it was the marriage of Śiva.

## \|\| 4.40.54-55 \|\|

*śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśo vṛṣabhassarvasundaraḥ \|*  
*yo dharma ucyate vedaiśśāstraissiddhamaharṣibhiḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

*tamārūḍho mahādevo vṛṣabhaṃ dharmavatsalaḥ \|*  
*śuśubhetīva devarṣisevitassakalairvrajan \|\| 55 \|\|*

54-55. Lord Śiva, favourably disposed to virtue, was seated on his bull of crystal purity and beauty—the bull who is called Dharma by the Vedas, Śāstras, Siddhas and sages. Śiva was being served by the gods and sages on his way. He shone well.

## \|\| 4.40.56 \|\|

*ebhissametaissaphalaimaharṣibhirbabhau maheśo bahuśotyalaṃkṛtaḥ \|*  
*himālayāhvasya dharasya saṃvrajan pāṇigrahārthaṃ sadanaṃ śivāyāḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. Accompanied by all these sages and decorated in various ways, lord Śiva was going to the abode of the mountain Himālaya for the marriage with Pārvatī. He shone well.

## \|\| 4.40.57 \|\|

*ityuktaṃ śambhucaritaṃ gamanamparamotsavam \|*  
*himālayapurodbhūtaṃ sadvṛttaṃ śṛṇu nārada \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. Thus the story of Śiva’s grand procession has been narrated to you. O Nārada, listen to the incidents of good portent that happened in the city of Himavat.

## Chapter 41 - Description of the Altar-Structure

## \|\| 4.41.1 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*tatassammantrya ca mithaḥ prāpyājñāṃ śāṃkarīṃ hariḥ \|*  
*mune tvāmpreṣayāmāsa prathamaṃ kudharālayam \|\| 1 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

1\. Then after mutual consultation and getting Śiva’s permission, O sage, Viṣṇu sent you ahead to the abode of the mountain.

## \|\| 4.41.2 \|\|

*atha praṇamya sarveśaṃ gatastvaṃ nāradāgrataḥ \|*  
*hariṇā noditaḥ prītyā himācalagṛhamprati \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Urged by Viṣṇu, O Nārada, you bowed to lord Śiva and went ahead of all to the abode of Himavat.

## \|\| 4.41.3 \|\|

*tvaṃ mune'paśya ātmānaṃ gatvā tadvrīḍayānvitam \|*  
*kṛtrimaṃ racitaṃ tatra vismito viśvakarmaṇā \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. O sage, after going there, you saw your own image made by Viśvakarman and were surprised. You were a bit ashamed too.

## \|\| 4.41.4 \|\|

*śrāntastvamātmanā tena kṛtrimeṇa mahāmune \|*  
*avalokaparasso'bhūccaritaṃ viśvakarmaṇaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. O great sage, tired of seeing the portrayal of yourself, you became engaged in seeing the other builds of Viśvakarman.

## \|\| 4.41.5 \|\|

*praviṣṭo maṇḍapastasya himādre ratnacitritam \|*  
*suvarṇakalaśairjuṣṭaṃ rambhādibahuśobhitam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. You entered the great altar of Himavat, studded with various gems and decorated with gold pots and stumps of plantain trees.

## \|\| 4.41.6 \|\|

*sahasrastambhasaṃyuktaṃ vicitramparamādbhutam \|*  
*vedikāṃ ca tathā dṛṣṭvā vismayaṃ tvaṃ mune hyayāḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. It had a thousand columns. It was wonderful. O sage, you were struck with surprise on seeing the altars.

## \|\| 4.41.7 \|\|

*tadāvocaśca sa mune nārada tvaṃ nageśvaram \|*  
*vismito'tīva manasi naṣṭajñāno vimūḍhadhīḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Then you were a bit confused and greatly bewildered. You spoke to the lord of mountains thus.

## \|\| 4.41.8-9 \|\|

*āgatāste kimadhunā devā viṣṇupurogamāḥ \|*  
*tathā maharṣayassarve siddhā upasurāstathā \|\| 8 \|\|*

*mahādevo vṛṣārūḍho gaṇaiśca parivāritaḥ \|*  
*āgataḥ kiṃ vivāhārthaṃ vada tathyaṃ nageśvara \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. O lord of mountains, tell me the truth. Has lord Śiva seated on his bull and surrounded by his Gaṇas come already for the marriage? Have the gods with Viṣṇu and others at their head, the sages, the Siddhas and the secondary gods come already?”

## \|\| 4.41.10 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*ityevaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā tava vismita cetasaḥ \|*  
*uvāca tvāṃ mune tathyaṃ vākyaṃ sa himavān giriḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

10\. On hearing your words full of surprise, O sage, the mountain Himavat told you the truth.

## \|\| 4.41.11 \|\|

*himavānuvāca \|*  
*he nārada mahāprājñāgato naivādhunā śivaḥ \|*  
*vivāhārthaṃ ca pārvatyāssagaṇassavarātakaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

Himavat said:—

11\. O Nārada, O highly intelligent one, Śiva with the marriage party has not come till now for the purpose of marrying Pārvatī.

## \|\| 4.41.12 \|\|

*viśvakarmakṛtaṃ citraṃ viddhi nārada saddhiyā \|*  
*vismayantyaja devarṣe svastho bhava śivaṃ smara \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. O Nārada, know that all these things have been portrayed by Viśvakarman. O celestial sage, shake off your bewilderment. Be calm. Remember Śiva.

## \|\| 4.41.13 \|\|

*bhuktvā viśramya suprītaḥ kṛpāṃ kṛtvā mamopari \|*  
*mainākādidharaissārddhaṃ gaccha tvaṃ śaṃkarāntikam \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Showing kindness to me you take your food and rest for a while. Then gladly accompany Maināka and others to Śiva’s presence.

## \|\| 4.41.14 \|\|

*ebhissameto giribhirmahāmata saṃprārthya śīghraṃ śivamatra cānaya \|*  
*devaissametaṃ ca maharṣisaṃghaissurāsurairarcitapādapallavam \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Accompanied by these mountains you request Śiva along with the gods, and the great sages, Śiva whose sproutlike feet are worshipped by gods and demons. Bring them here.

## \|\| 4.41.15 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*tatheti coktvāgama āśu hi tvaṃ sadaiva taiśśailasutādibhiśca \|*  
*tatratyakṛtyaṃ suvidhāya bhuktvā mahāmanāstvaṃ śivasa nnidhānam \|\| 15 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

15\. You accepted the suggestion noble-heartedly and performed the duties there. Then accompanied by the sons of the mountain and others you went to Śiva’s presence.

## \|\| 4.41.16 \|\|

*tatra dṛṣṭo mahādevo devādiparivāritaḥ \|*  
*namaskṛtastvayā dīptaśśailaistairbhaktitaśca vai \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. There the brilliant god Śiva surrounded by the gods and others was seen and bowed to by you and the mountains with devotion.

## \|\| 4.41.17 \|\|

*tadā mayā viṣṇunā ca sarve devāssavāsavāḥ \|*  
*papracchustvāṃ mune sarve rudrasyānucarāstathā \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Then all the gods including Indra, Viṣṇu and me and Śiva’s attendants asked you, O sage.

## \|\| 4.41.18 \|\|

*vismitāḥ parvatāndṛṣṭvā sandehākulamānasāḥ \|*  
*mainākasahyamervādyānnānālaṃkārasaṃyutān \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. They had been struck with surprise and suspicion on seeing the mountains Maināka, Sahya, Meru and others bedecked in all kinds of ornaments.

## \|\| 4.41.19 \|\|

*devā ūcuḥ \|*  
*he nārada mahāprājña vismitastvaṃ hi dṛśyase \|*  
*satkṛto'si himāgena kiṃ na vā vada vistarāt \|\| 19 \|\|*

The gods said:—

19\. O Nārada, intelligent one, you appear to be bewildered. Have you been duly honoured by Himavat or not? Tell us in detail.

## \|\| 4.41.20 \|\|

*ete kasmātsamāyātāḥ parvatā iha sattamāḥ \|*  
*mainākasahyamervādyāssupratāpāssvalaṃkṛtāḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Why have these excellent mountains Maināka, Sahya, Meru and others highly bedecked and of great valour, come here?

## \|\| 4.41.21 \|\|

*kanyāṃ dāsyati śailo'sau sa bhave vā na nārada \|*  
*himālayagṛhe tāta kiṃ bhavatyadya tadvada \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. O Nārada, does the mountain really intend to give his daugther to Śiva or not? What is it that is taking place in the abode of Himavat now? Please tell us.

## \|\| 4.41.22 \|\|

*iti sandigdhamanasāmasmākaṃ ca divaukasām \|*  
*vad tvaṃ pṛcchamānānāṃ sandehaṃ hara suvrata \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. We are having doubts in our minds. Hence we, the heaven-dwellers, ask you. Please say everything, O righteous one, and dispel our suspicions.

## \|\| 4.41.23 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*ityākarṇya vacasteṣāṃ viṣṇvādīnāndivaukasām \|*  
*avocastānmune tvaṃ hi vismitastvāṣṭramāyayā \|\| 23 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

23\. On hearing these words of Viṣṇu and other heaven-dwellers, O sage, you who had been fascinated by the magic of Tvaṣṭṛ (Viśvakarman) spoke to them.

## \|\| 4.41.24 \|\|

*ekāntamāśritya ca māṃ hi viṣṇumabhāṣathā vākyamidaṃ mune tvam \|*  
*śacīpatiṃ sarvasureśvaraṃ vai pakṣācchidaṃ pūrvaripundharāṇām \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Going to an isolated place, O sage, you spoke these words to me, to Viṣṇu and also to Indra who is the lord of gods and a former enemy of the mountains, having cut off their wings.

## \|\| 4.41.25 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*tvaṣṭrā kṛtantadvikṛtaṃ vicitraṃ vimohanaṃ sarvadivaukasāṃ hi \|*  
*yenaiva sarvānsa vimohituṃ surānsamicchati premata eva yuktyā \|\| 25 \|\|*

Nārada said:—

25\. The distorted portayal of heaven-dwellers is something enchanting. He desires to delude the gods in a loving but cunning manner.

## \|\| 4.41.26 \|\|

*purā kṛtantasya vimohanantvayā suvismṛtantat sakalaṃ śacīpate \|*  
*tasmādasau tvāṃ vijigīṣureva gṛhe dhuvantasya girermahātmana \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. O lord of Śacī, have you forgotten everything? Formerly you had deluded him. Hence he wishes to surpass you here in the abode of the mountain of noble heart.

## \|\| 4.41.27 \|\|

*ahaṃ vimohitastena pratirūpeṇa bhāsvatā \|*  
*tathā viṣṇuḥ kṛtastena brahmā śakro'pi tādṛśaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. I have been fascinated by my shining portrait. Viṣṇu, Brahmā and Indra have been realistically portrayed by him.

## \|\| 4.41.28 \|\|

*kimbahūktena deveśa sarvadevagaṇāḥ kṛtāḥ \|*  
*kṛtrimāścitrarūpeṇa na kiṃcidavaśeṣitam \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. O lord of gods, why should I talk too much? He has made artificial prototypes of all the gods. No one, not a single detail, has been left out.

## \|\| 4.41.29 \|\|

*vimohanārthaṃ sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*kṛtā māyā citramayī parihāsavikāriṇī \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. It is for the purpose of particularly enchanting the gods that this spell has been employed by him through this caricature.

## \|\| 4.41.30 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*tacchutvā vacanastasya devendro vākyamabravīt \|*  
*viṣṇumprati tadā śīghraṃ bhayākulatanurharim \|\| 30 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—
