24-30. There the gods saw joyously with winkless eyes the bride of dark complexion like the collyrium, and fully bedecked in ornaments in every limb. With a side glance she was respectfully looking at the three-eyed lord avoiding the eyes of others. With a gentle smile playing in her face she appeared very beautiful. Her plaited hair was thickly grown and looked beautiful. Decorative lines over her body were exquisite. She had the Tilaka with musk and saffron. Gemset necklace shone over her chest. Bracelets and bangles of gems and jewels shone brilliantly. With diamond earrings her cheeks appeared brilliant. Her rows of teeth sparkled like diamonds. Red lac applied over her lips which were naturally red like Bimba fruits was exquisite. She had a gemset mirror in her hand. A toy lotus also embellished her. Sandal paste, aguru musk and saffron were smeared over the body by her. Her feet and soles were naturally red. Tinkling anklets added to their beauty.

## \|\| 4.46.31 \|\|

*praṇemuśśirasā devīṃ bhaktiyuktāḥ samenakām \|*  
*sarve surādayo dṛṣṭvā jagadādyāṃ jagatprasūm \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. On seeing the primordial deity, the mother of the universe along with Menakā, the gods and others bowed down their heads with great devotion.

## \|\| 4.46.32 \|\|

*trinetro netrakoṇena tāṃ dadarśa mudānvitaḥ \|*  
*śivaḥ satyākṛtiṃ dṛṣṭvā vijahau virahajvaram \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. The three-eyed deity saw her with the corner of an eye and was glad. On seeing the shapely body of Satī he forgot the pangs of separation.

## \|\| 4.46.33 \|\|

*śivassarvaṃ visasmāra śivāsaṃnyastalocanaḥ \|*  
*pulakāṃcitasarvāṅgo harṣādgaurīvilocanaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. With his eyes riveted to her, he forgot everything else. Hair stood on ends all over his body, as he continued seeing her with delight.

## \|\| 4.46.34 \|\|

*atha kālībahiḥ puryyāṃ gatvā pūjya kulāmbikām \|*  
*viveśa bhavanaṃ ramyaṃ svapitussadvijāṅganā \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Then Pārvatī went out of the city, worshipped the family goddess and returned to her parental abode along with the brahmin women.

## \|\| 4.46.35 \|\|

*śaṅkaropi suraissārddhaṃ hariṇā brāhmaṇā tathā \|*  
*himācalasamuddiṣṭaṃ svasthānamagamanmudā \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Śiva went to the apartments indicated by Himācala, joyously along with the gods, Viṣṇu and Brahmā.

## \|\| 4.46.36 \|\|

*tatra sarve sukhaṃ tasthussevantaśśaṅkaraṃ yathā \|*  
*sammānitā girīśena nānāvidhasusampadā \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. All of them stayed there with joy, attending on Śiva. They were duly honoured by Himavat, the mountainous lord.

## Chapter 47 - The ceremonious entry of Śiva

## \|\| 4.47.1 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*tataḥ śailavaraḥ sopi prītyā durgopavītakam \|*  
*kārayāmāsa sotsāhaṃ vedamantraiśśivasya ca \|\| 1 \|\|*

Summary: The ceremonious entry of Śiva into the inner apartments of the palace of Himavat.

Brahmā said:—

1\. Then the chief of mountains caused the investiture rite with the sacred thread for Pārvatī and Śiva with the Vedic hymns recited enthusiastically.

## \|\| 4.47.2 \|\|

*atha viṣṇvādayo devā munayassakutū halam \|*  
*himācalaprārthanayā viveśāntargṛhaṃ gireḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Then Viṣṇu, the other gods and the sages entered the inner apartments of the palace of the mountain enthusiastically at the request of Himācala.

## \|\| 4.47.3 \|\|

*śrutyācāraṃ bhavācāraṃ vidhāya ca yathārthataḥ \|*  
*śivāmalaṃkṛtāṃ cakruśśivadattavibhūṣaṇaiḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. After performing the conventional rites in accordance with the Vedic injunctions and the social customs they decorated Pārvatī with the ornaments provided by Śiva.

## \|\| 4.47.4 \|\|

*prathamaṃ snāpayitvā tāṃ bhūṣayitvātha sarvaśaḥ \|*  
*nīrājitā sakhībhiśca viprapatnībhireva ca \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. First of all she was bathed, then bedecked with the ornaments. The Nīrājana rites too were also performed by the maids and brahmin women.

## \|\| 4.47.5 \|\|

*ahatāmbarayugmena śobhitā varavarṇinī \|*  
*virarāja mahāśailaduhitā śaṅkarapriyā \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The daughter of the mountain and the beloved of Śiva, the lovely lady shone with the pair of fresh clothes.

## \|\| 4.47.6 \|\|

*kaṃcukī paramā divyā nānāratnānvitādbhutā \|*  
*vidhṛtā ca tayā devyā vilasantyādhikaṃ mune \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. O sage, an exquisite divine jacket studded with various gems was worn by the goddess who shone all the more.

## \|\| 4.47.7 \|\|

*sā babhāra tathā hāraṃ divyaratnasamanvitam \|*  
*valayāni mahārhāṇi śuddhacāmīkarāṇi ca \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. She wore a necklace studded with divine gems. Costly bangles of pure gold were worn by her.

## \|\| 4.47.8 \|\|

*sthitā tatraiva subhagā dhyāyantī manasā śivam \|*  
*śuśubheti mahāśailakanyakā trijagatprasūḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. The lovely lady, the daughter of the great mountain, the mother of the three worlds staying there itself meditated on Śiva and shone thereby.

## \|\| 4.47.9 \|\|

*tadotsavo mahānāsīdubhayatra mudā vahaḥ \|*  
*dānaṃ babhūva vividhaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo vivarṇitam \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Then there was great jubilation delighting both the sides. Different kinds of charitable gifts were distributed among the brahmins.

## \|\| 4.47.10 \|\|

*anyeṣāṃ dravyadānaṃ ca babhūva vividhammahat \|*  
*gītavādyavinodaśca tatrotsavapurassaram \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Monetary gifts were distributed among others. They were diverse. Many songs were sung jubilantly.

## \|\| 4.47.11 \|\|

*atha viṣṇurahaṃ dhātā śakrādyā amarāstathā \|*  
*munayaśca mahāprītyā nikhilāssotsavā mudā \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Then Viṣṇu, I the creator, Indra and other gods as well as the sages joined in jubilation with great pleasure.

## \|\| 4.47.12 \|\|

*supraṇamya śivāṃ bhaktyā smṛtvā śivapadāmbujam \|*  
*samprāpya himagiryyājñāṃ svaṃ svaṃ sthāne samāśritāḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Then after bowing humbly to Pārvatī with devotion and remembering the lotus-like feet of Śiva they returned to their camps obtaining the permission of Himavat.

## \|\| 4.47.13 \|\|

*etasminnantare tatra jyotiḥśāstra viśāradaḥ \|*  
*himavantaṃ girīndraṃ taṃ gargo vākyamabhāṣata \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. In the meantime Garga, a great expert in the science of astrology, spoke to Himavat, the lord of mountains.

## \|\| 4.47.14 \|\|

*\|\| garga uvāca \|*  
*himācala dharādhīśa svāmin kālīpatiḥ prabho \|*  
*pāṇigrahārthaṃ śaṃbhuṃ cānaya tvaṃ nijamaṃdiram \|\| 14 \|\|*

Garga said:—

14\. O Himavat, O lord, O father of Pārvatī, now fetch Śiva to your palace for the marriage rites.

## \|\| 4.47.15 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*atha taṃ samayaṃ jñātvā kanyādānocitaṃ giriḥ \|*  
*niveditaṃ ca gargeṇa musude'tīva cetasi \|\| 15 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

15\. On realising that the auspicious time for the marriage rites had been intimated by Garga, the mountain rejoiced much.

## \|\| 4.47.16 \|\|

*mahīdharāndvijāṃścaiva parānapi tadā giriḥ \|*  
*preṣayāmāsa suprītyā śivānayanakāmyayā \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. With the desire to bring Śiva there, the mountain gladly sent mountains, brahmins and others.

## \|\| 4.47.17 \|\|

*te parvatā dvijāścaiva sarvamaṃgalapāṇayaḥ \|*  
*saṃjagmussotsavāḥ prītyā yatra devo maheśvaraḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. The mountains and brahmins with auspicious holy objects in their hands jubilantly went to the place where lord Śiva stood.

## \|\| 4.47.18 \|\|

*tadā vāditraghoṣeṇa brahmaghoṣeṇa bhūyasā \|*  
*mahotsāho'bhavattatra gītanṛtyānvitena hi \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Then the sound of the Vedic chants, musical instruments, songs and dances jubilantly arose there.

## \|\| 4.47.19 \|\|

*śrutvā vāditranirghoṣaṃ sarve śaṃkarasevakāḥ \|*  
*utthitāstvaikapadyena sadevarṣigaṇā mudā \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. On hearing the loud sound of musical instruments trumpets etc. the attendants of Śiva simultaneously got up joyously along with the gods and sages.

## \|\| 4.47.20 \|\|

*parasparaṃ samūcuste harṣanirbharamānasāḥ \|*  
*atrāgacchaṃti girayaśśivānayanakāmyayā \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. With great joy m their minds they said to one another—“O here come the mountains to take Śiva over there!

## \|\| 4.47.21 \|\|

*pāṇigrahaṇakālo hi nūnaṃ sadyassamāgataḥ \|*  
*mahadbhāgyaṃ hi sarveṣāṃ saṃprāptamahi manmahe \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. The auspicious hour for marriage rites has come. We consider that our fortune is imminent.

## \|\| 4.47.22 \|\|

*dhanyā vayaṃ viśeṣeṇa vivāhaṃ śivayordhruvam \|*  
*drakṣyāmaḥ paramaprītyā jagatāṃ maṃgalālayam \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Indeed we are highly blessed as to witness the marriage ceremony of Śiva and Pārvatī, highly portentous of the good fortune of all the worlds.”

## \|\| 4.47.23 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*evaṃ yāvadabhūtteṣāṃ saṃvādastatra cādarāt \|*  
*tāvatsarve samāyātāḥ parvateṃdrasya maṃtriṇaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

23\. Even as these confabulations were going on, the ministers of the lord of mountains came there.

## \|\| 4.47.24 \|\|

*te gatvā prārthayāṃcakruśśiva viṣṇvādikānapi \|*  
*kanyādānocitaḥ kālo vartate gamyatāmiti \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. They approached Śiva, Viṣṇu and others and made their submission that the time for the celebration of marriage had arrived and that they would please hasten to the palace.

## \|\| 4.47.25 \|\|

*te tacchrutvā surāssarve mune viṣṇvādayo'khilāḥ \|*  
*mumuduścetasātīva jayetyūcurgiriṃ drutam \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. On hearing that, O sage, Viṣṇu and others rejoiced much and cried shouts of victory to the mountain.

## \|\| 4.47.26 \|\|

*śivo'pi mumude'tīva kālīprāpaṇalālasaḥ \|*  
*guptaṃ cakāra taccihnaṃ manasyevādbhutākṛtiḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Śiva too rejoiced much eager that he was approaching Pārvatī but kept the signs of joy within his mind alone in a wonderfully serene manner.

## \|\| 4.47.27 \|\|

*atha snānaṃ kṛtantena maṅgaladravyasaṃyutam \|*  
*śūlinā suprasannena lokānugrahakāriṇā \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Then the ceremonial ablution with the sacred articles of toilet, was performed by the delighted tridentbearing lord eager to bless the worlds.

## \|\| 4.47.28 \|\|

*snātassuvāsasā yuktassarvaistaiḥ parivāritaḥ \|*  
*āropito vṛṣaskandhe lokapālaissusevitaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. The bath being over He wore fine clothes. He was attended upon by the guardians of the quarters and surrounded by several others. He was then seated on the shoulders of the Bull.

## \|\| 4.47.29 \|\|

*puraskṛtya prabhuṃ sarve jagmurhimagirergṛham \|*  
*vādyāni vādayantaśca kṛtavantaḥ kutūhalam \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. With the lord in front, all of them entered the palace of Himavat playing on various musical instruments and exhibiting their eagerness.

## \|\| 4.47.30 \|\|

*himāgapreṣitā viprāstathā te parvatottamāḥ \|*  
*śambhoragracarā hyāsankutūhalasamanvitāḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. The brahmins sent by Himavat and the excellent mountains enthusiastically went ahead of Śiva.

## \|\| 4.47.31 \|\|

*babhau chatreṇa mahatā dhriyamāṇo hi mūrddhani \|*  
*cāmarairvījyamāno'sau savitā no maheśvaraḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. The great royal umbrella was held aloft over the great lord. He was fanned by chowries and a canopy was spread over Him.

## \|\| 4.47.32 \|\|

*ahaṃ viṣṇustathā cendro lokapālā stathaiva ca \|*  
*agragāḥ smātiśobhante śriyā paramayā śritāḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Viṣṇu, Indra, the other guardians of the quarters and I going ahead shone with great brilliance and splendour.

## \|\| 4.47.33 \|\|

*tataśśaṅkhāśca bheryyaśca paṭahānakagomukhāḥ \|*  
*punaḥ punaravādyanta vāditrāṇi mahotsave \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. In that great festivity conches were blown, drums were beaten and the musical instruments, paṭaha, Ānaka and Gomukha were played on, repeatedly.

## \|\| 4.47.34 \|\|

*tathaiva gāyakāssarve jaguḥ paramamaṅgalam \|*  
*nartakyo nanṛtussarvā nānātālasamanvitāḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Musicians sang auspicious songs. Dancing girls danced to the tune.

## \|\| 4.47.35 \|\|

*ebhissameto jagadekabandhuryayau tadānīṃ parameśavarcasā \|*  
*susevyamānassakalaissureśvarairvikīryamāṇaḥ kusumaiśca harṣitaiḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Accompanied by these, attended upon by all important gods and with flowers showered on Him delightedly, the sole kinsman of the universe walked ahead shedding lordly splendour.

## \|\| 4.47.36 \|\|

*sampūjitastadā śambhuḥ praviṣṭo yajñamaṇḍapam \|*  
*saṃstūyamāno bahvībhiḥ stutibhiḥ parameśvaraḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Lord Śiva, eulogised with many hymns of praise, entered the sacrificial altar. He was duly worshipped.

## \|\| 4.47.37 \|\|

*vṛṣāduttārayāmāsurmaheśamparvatottamāḥ \|*  
*ninyurgṛhāntaramprītyā mahotsavapurassaram \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. The excellent mountains jubilantly made Śiva dismount the bull and lovingly took Him within.

## \|\| 4.47.38 \|\|

*himālayo'pi samprāptaṃ sadevagaṇamīśvaram \|*  
*praṇamya vidhivadbhaktyā nīrājanamathākarot \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. After duly bowing to Śiva who arrived there with the gods and Gaṇas, Himavat performed the Nīrājana with great devotion.

## \|\| 4.47.39 \|\|

*sarvānsurānmunīnanyānpraṇamya samahotsavaḥ \|*  
*sammānamakarotteṣāṃ praśaṃsansvavidhimmudā \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Praising his own good luck and bowing to all the gods, sages and others jubilantly he honoured them suitably.

## \|\| 4.47.40 \|\|

*so'gassācyutamīśānaṃ supādyārghyapurassaram \|*  
*sadevamukhyavargaṃ ca nināya svālayāntaram \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. The mountain, after offering Pādya and Arghya to them, took Śiva along with Viṣṇu and the important gods, within.

## \|\| 4.47.41 \|\|

*prāṅgaṇe sthāpayāmāsa ratnasiṃhāsaneṣu tān \|*  
*sarvānviṣṇu ca māmīśaṃ viśiṣṭāṃśca viśeṣataḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. In the quadrangle inside he made us, Viṣṇu, Śiva and other important persons sit on gemset thrones.

## \|\| 4.47.42 \|\|

*sakhībhirmenayā prītyā brāhmaṇastrībhireva ca \|*  
*anyābhiśca purandhībhiścakre nīrājanammudā \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. The Nīrājana rites was then performed by Mena, her maids and the brahmin women as well as other ladies of the city with joy.

## \|\| 4.47.43 \|\|

*purodhasā kṛtyavidā śaṃkarāya mahātmane \|*  
*madhuparkādikaṃ yadyatkṛtyaṃ tattatkṛtaṃ mudā \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. The necessary rites such as offering of Madhuparka etc. to Śiva, the supreme soul, were joyously performed by the priest who knew his duties.

## \|\| 4.47.44-45 \|\|

*mayā sa noditastatra purodhāḥ kṛtavāṃstadā \|*  
*sumaṃgalaṃ ca yatkarma prastāvasadṛśammune \|\| 44 \|\|*

*antarvedyāṃ mahāprītyā sampraviśya himādriṇā \|*  
*yatra sā pārvatī kanyā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā \|\| 45 \|\|*

44-45. O sage, urged by me, the priest carried out

the auspicious rites relevant to the context after entering the enclosure where the altar had been built along with Himavat. Pārvatī. bedecked in all her ornaments was seated as the bride.

## \|\| 4.47.46 \|\|

*vedikopari tanvaṃgī saṃsthitā suvirājitā \|*  
*tatra nīto maddādevo viṣṇunā ca mayā saha \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. She was seated over the raised platform and Śiva was led along with Viṣṇu and me.

## \|\| 4.47.47 \|\|

*lagnannirīkṣamāṇāste vācaspatipurogamāḥ \|*  
*kanyādānocitantatra babhūvuḥ paramotsavāḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Waiting for the auspicious Lagna befitting marriage, Bṛhaspati and others became jubilant.

## \|\| 4.47.48 \|\|

*tatropaviṣṭo gargaśca yatrāsti ghaṭikālayam \|*  
*yāvaccheṣā ghaṭī tāvatkṛtampraṇavabhāṣaṇam \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Garga was seated in the place where the chronometer had been kept. The Oṃkāra Mantra was repeated during the interval before the Lagna.

## \|\| 4.47.49 \|\|

*puṇyāhampravadangargassamādhre'ñjalimmudā \|*  
*pārvvatyakṣatapūrṇaṃ ca vavṛṣe ca śivopari \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Repeating the Puṇyāha mantras, Garga lifted the handful of rice-grains and handing them over to Pārvatī he made her shower it on Śiva.

## \|\| 4.47.50 \|\|

*tayā sampūjito rudro dadhyakṣatakuśāmbubhiḥ \|*  
*paramodāḍhyayā tatra pārvatyā rucirāsyayā \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Śiva was duly worshipped by the joyful and sweetfaced Pārvatī with the rice-grains mixed with curd and Darbha water.

## \|\| 4.47.51 \|\|

*vilokayantī taṃ śambhuṃ yasyārthe paramantapaḥ \|*  
*kṛtampurā mahāprītyā virarāja śivāti sā \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Gazing at Śiva for whom great penance had been performed by her formerly, Pārvatī shone beaming with pleasure.

## \|\| 4.47.52 \|\|

*mayā mune tadoktastu gargādimunibhiśca saḥ \|*  
*samānarca śivāṃ śambhurlaukikācārasaṃrataḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. Requested by me and the sages Garga and others, Śiva, following the worldly conventions worshipped her.

## \|\| 4.47.53 \|\|

*evaṃ parasparaṃ tau vai pārvvatīparameśvarau \|*  
*arcayantau tadānīñca śuśubhāte jaganmayau \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Thus, worshipping each other Śiva and Pārvatī identifying themselves with the universe, shone well.

## \|\| 4.47.54 \|\|

*trailokyalakṣmyā saṃvītau nirīkṣantau parasparam \|*  
*tadā nīrājitau lakṣmyādibhisstrībhirviśeṣataḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. Both of them, enveloped by the glory of the three worlds and gazing at each other, were offered the Nīrājana by Lakṣmī and other ladies particularly.

## \|\| 4.47.55 \|\|

*tathā parā vai dvijayoṣitaśca nīrājayāmāsuratho purastriyaḥ \|*  
*śivāñca śambhuñca vilokayantyo'vāpurmmudantāssakalā mahotsavam \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. The brahmin ladies and the citizen ladies performed the Nīrājana rites. All of them derived great pleasure and gaiety on seeing Śiva and Pārvatī.

## Chapter 48 - Description of Marriage (Śiva and Pārvatī)

## \|\| 4.48.1 \|\|

*\|\|brahmovāca \|*  
*etasminnaṃtare tatra gargācāryyapraṇoditaḥ \|*  
*himavānmenayā sārddhaṃ kanyā dātuṃ pracakrame \|\| 1 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

1\. In the meantime, urged by the priest Garga Himavat started the rite of marriage in the company of Menā.

## \|\| 4.48.2 \|\|

*haimaṃ kalaśamādāya menā cārddhāṃgamāśritā \|*  
*himādreśca mahābhāgā vastrābharaṇabhūṣitā \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Himavat and Menā held the gold pot on either side. Himavat was bedecked in fine clothes and ornaments.

## \|\| 4.48.3 \|\|

*pādyādibhistataḥ śailaḥ prahṛṣṭaḥ svapurohitaḥ \|*  
*taṃ vaṃraṃ varayāmāsa vastracaṃdanabhūṣaṇaiḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. The joyous mountain with the assistance of his priest wooed the bridegroom after offering water, clothes, ornaments, sandal paste etc.

## \|\| 4.48.4 \|\|

*tato himādriṇā proktā dvijāstithyādikīrtane \|*  
*prayogo bhaṇyatāṃ tāvadasminsamaya āgate \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Then the brahmins were requested by Himavat

“May the rite be formally started after narrating the Tithi etc. The auspicious hour has come.”

## \|\| 4.48.5 \|\|

*tatheti coktvā te sarve kālajñā dvijasattamāḥ \|*  
*tithyādikīrtanaṃ cakruḥ prītyā paramanirvṛtāḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. After saying “So be it”, the excellent brahmins who knew the proper time proclaimed the Tithi etc. very delightedly.

## \|\| 4.48.6 \|\|

*tato himācalaḥ prītyā śambhunā prerito hṛdā \|*  
*sūtī kṛtaḥ pareśena vihasañśambhumabravīt \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Then Himācala mentally urged with pleasure by lord Śiva, the cause of great enjoyment, smilingly spoke to Śiva.

## \|\| 4.48.7 \|\|

*svagotraṃ kathyatāṃ śambho pravaraśca kulaṃ tathā \|*  
*nāma vedaṃ tathā śākhāṃ mā kārṣītsamayātyayam \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. “O Śiva, please do not delay. Please mention your genealogy, saintly lineage, family, name and your Veda along with your branch of the Vedas.”

## \|\| 4.48.8 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*ityākarṇya vacastasya himādreśśaṅkarastadā \|*  
*sumukhāvimukhaḥ sadyo'pyaśocyaḥ śocyatāṃ gataḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

8\. On hearing these words of Himavat, Śiva of sweet face, turned His face away. He without sorrow attained a pitiable plight.

## \|\| 4.48.9 \|\|

*evaṃvidhassuravarairmunibhistadānīṃ gandharvayakṣagaṇasiddhagaṇaistathaiva \|*  
*dṛṣṭo niruttaramukho bhagavānmaheśo'kārṣīstu hāsyamatha tatra sa nāradatvam \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. When lord Śiva stood thus unable to say anything in reply and was seen so by the gods, sages, Gandharvas, Yakṣas, and Siddhas, O Nārada, you did something laughable.

## \|\| 4.48.10 \|\|

*vīṇāmavādayastvaṃ hi brahmavijño'tha nārada \|*  
*śivena preritastatra manasā śambhumānasaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Urged by Śiva mentally O Nārada, you, the knower of Brahman with mind fixed in Śiva, played on your Vīṇā.

## \|\| 4.48.11 \|\|

*tadā nivārito dhīmānparvatendreṇa vai haṭhāt \|*  
*viṣṇunā ca mayā devairmunibhiścākhilaistathā \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. You were forbidden strictly by the lord of mountains, Viṣṇu, gods, sages and by me.

## \|\| 4.48.12 \|\|

*na nivṛtto'bhavastvaṃ hi sa yadā śaṅkarecchayā \|*  
*iti prokto'driṇā tarhi vīṇāṃ mā vādayādhunā \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. When at the will of Śiva you did not desist from it, you were again spoken to thus by the mountain then—“Do not play on the Vīṇā now.”

## \|\| 4.48.13 \|\|

*suniṣiddho haṭhāttena devarṣe tvaṃ yadā budha \|*  
*pratyavoco girīśaṃ taṃ susaṃsmṛtya maheśvaram \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. O celestial sage, O wise one, when you were thus strenuously forbidden, you remembered Śiva and spoke to the lord of the mountains.

## \|\| 4.48.14 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*tvaṃ hi mūḍhatvamāpanno na jānāsi ca kiñcana \|*  
*vācye maheśaviṣaye'tīvāsi tvaṃ bahirmukhaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

Nārada said:—

14\. You have been utterly deluded. You do not know anything about Śiva of whom you speak. You have no inner vision.

## \|\| 4.48.15 \|\|

*tvayā pṛṣṭho harassākṣātsvagotrakathanaṃ prati \|*  
*samaye'smiṃstadatyantamupahāsakaraṃ vacaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Śiva was directly asked by you to mention His Gotra. On this occasion these words are utterly ridiculous and derisible.

## \|\| 4.48.16 \|\|

*asya gotraṃ kulaṃ nāma naiva jānanti parvata \|*  
*viṣṇubrahmādayo'pīha pareṣāṃ kā kathā smṛtā \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. O mountain, even Viṣṇu, Brahmā and other gods do not know His Gotra, family and name. What then can be said about others?

## \|\| 4.48.17 \|\|

*yasyaikadivase śaila brahmakoṭirlayaṃ gatā \|*  
*sa eva śaṅkarastedya dṛṣṭaḥ kālītapobalāta \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. It was a result of the severe penance of Pārvatī that Śiva was seen by you, O mountain, in one day according to whose calculation a crore of Brahmās become annihilated.

## \|\| 4.48.18 \|\|

*arūpo'yaṃ parabrahma nirguṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ \|*  
*nirākāro nirvikāro māyādhīśaḥ parātparaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. He is the formless supreme Brahman. He is attributeless. He is greater than Primordial Nature. He has no shape, is free from aberrations He is the master of delusion. He is greater than the greatest.

## \|\| 4.48.19 \|\|

*agotrakulanāmā hi svatantro bhaktavatsalaḥ \|*  
*tadicchayā hi saguṇassutanurbahunāmabhṛt \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. He has no Gotra, family or name. He is independent. He is favourably disposed to His devotees. At

His will He assumes bodies taking many names. He is full of attributes.

## \|\| 4.48.20 \|\|

*sugotrī gotrahīnaśca kulahīnaḥ kulīnakaḥ \|*  
*pārvatītapasā so'dya jāmātā te na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. He is sugotrin (having good gotra) as well as devoid of gotra. He is of noble family as well as devoid of a family. Thanks to Pārvatī’s penance. He has now become your son-in-law, There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 4.48.21 \|\|

*līlāvihāriṇā tena mohitaṃ ca carācaram \|*  
*no jānāti śivaṃ ko'pi prājño'pi girisattama \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. The whole world consisting of the mobile and immobile has been deluded by Him in His divine sport. O excellent mountain, even the wisest of men does not know Him.

## \|\| 4.48.22 \|\|

*liṃgākṛtermaheśasya kena dṛṣṭaṃ na mastakam \|*  
*viṣṇurgatvā hi pātālaṃ tadenaṃ nāpavismitaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. The head of lord Śiva of phallic image was not seen by Brahma. Viṣṇu who went to the nether worlds did not see His foot. How surprised he was.

## \|\| 4.48.23 \|\|

*kiṃbahūktyā nagaśreṣṭha śivamāyā duratyayā \|*  
*tadadhīnāstrayo lokā haribrahmādayopi ca \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. O excellent mountain, of what avail is this talk? Śiva’s magical power is inscrutable. The three worlds, Viṣṇu, Brahmā and others too are subservient to Him.

## \|\| 4.48.24 \|\|

*tasmāttvayā śivā tāta suvicārya prayatnataḥ \|*  
*na kartavyo vimarśo'tra tvevaṃvidhavare manāk \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Hence, O father of Pārvatī, ponder over this deeply. No doubt need be entertained by you even slightly with respect to this bridegroom of your choice.

## \|\| 4.48.25 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*ityuktvā tvaṃ mune jñānī śivecchākāryakārakaḥ \|*  
*pratyavocaḥ punastaṃ vai śailedraṃ harṣayangirā \|\| 25 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

25\. O sage, after saying this, you, of perfect wisdom, who carried out the will of Śiva replied again to the mountain after delighting him with your words.

Nārada said'.—

## \|\| 4.48.26 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu tāta mahāśaila śivājanaka madvacaḥ \|*  
*tacchrutvā tanayāṃ devīṃ dehi tvaṃ śaṃkarāya hi \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. O dear, O great mountain, O father of Pārvatī, listen to my words. After hearing them, give your daughter to Śiva.

## \|\| 4.48.27 \|\|

*saguṇasya maheśasya līlayā rūpa dhāriṇaḥ \|*  
*gotraṃ kulaṃ vijānīhi nādameva hi kevalam \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Know that the divine sound alone is the gotra, and family of Śiva in His divine form, who assumes forms in His divine sport.

## \|\| 4.48.28 \|\|

*śivo nādamayaḥ sattyaṃ nādaśśivamayastathā \|*  
*ubhayorantaraṃ nāsti nādasya ca śivasya ca \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Śiva is identical with Nāda. And Nāda is identical with Śiva. There is no difference between the two—Nāda and Śiva.

## \|\| 4.48.29 \|\|

*sṛṣṭau prathamajatvāddhi līlāsaguṇarūpiṇaḥ \|*  
*śivānnādasya śailendra sarvotkṛṣṭastatassa hi \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. O lord of mountains, Nāda being prior to Śiva in His sportive, attributive form, Nāda is the most excellent of all.

## \|\| 4.48.30 \|\|

*ato hi vāditā vīṇā preritena mayādya vai \|*  
*sarveśvareṇa manasā śaṅkareṇa himālaya \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Hence, O Himācala, mentally urged by Śiva, the lord of all, I played upon my lute.

## \|\| 4.48.31 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*etacchrutvā tava mune vacastattu giriśvaraḥ \|*  
*himādristoṣamāpanno gatavismayamānasaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

31\. O sage, on hearing your words, Himavat, the lord of mountains was satisfied and the bewilderment in his mind vanished.

## \|\| 4.48.32 \|\|

*atha viṣṇuprabhṛtayassurāśca munayastathā \|*  
*sādhusādhviti te sarve procurvigatavismayāḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Then Viṣṇu, the other gods and the sages said “Well done, Well done”. They were freed of all bewilderment.

## \|\| 4.48.33 \|\|

*maheśvarasya gāṃbhīryaṃ jñātvā sarve vicakṣaṇāḥ \|*  
*savismayā mahāmodānvitāḥ procuḥ parasparam \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. The shrewd people realised the majesty of lord Śiva. They were pleasantly surprised and began to say to one another.

## \|\| 4.48.34 \|\|

*yasyājñayā jagadidaṃ ca viśālameva jātaṃ parātparataro nijabodharūpaḥ \|*  
*śarvaḥ svatantragatikṛtparabhāvagamyasso'sau trilokapatiradya ca nassudṛṣṭaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. “Śiva is of the form of knowledge. He is greater than the greatest. It is at His bidding that the vast universe is born. He is of independent movement. He can be realised by the greatest concentration. He, the lord of the three worlds, is now seen by us.”

## \|\| 4.48.35 \|\|

*atha te parvataśreṣṭhā mervādyā jātasaṃbhramāḥ \|*  
*ūcuste caikapadyena himavantaṃ nageśvaram \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Then Meru and the excellent mountains became agitated and simultaneously spoke to Himavat, the lord of mountains.

## \|\| 4.48.36 \|\|

*parvatā ūcuḥ \|*  
*kanyādāne sthīyatāṃ cādya śailanāthoktyā kiṃ kāryanāśastaveva \|*  
*satyaṃ brūmo nātra kāryo vimarśastasmātkanyā dīyatāmīśvarāya \|\| 36 \|\|*

The mountains said:—

36\. O mountain, be firm and stand by your decision to give your daughter. If you say “No”, you stand to lose. We speak the truth. Do not hesitate. Let the girl be given to Śiva.

## \|\| 4.48.37 \|\|

*brahmo vāca \|*  
*tacchutvā vacanaṃ teṣāṃ suhṛdāṃ sa himālayaḥ \|*  
*svakanyādānamakarocchivāya vidhinoditaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

37\. On hearing the words of his friends, Himavat urged by Brahmā gave his daughter to Śiva.

## \|\| 4.48.38 \|\|

*imāṃ kanyāṃ tubhyamahaṃ dadāmi parameśvara \|*  
*bhāryārthe parigṛhṇīṣva prasīda sakaleśvara \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. “O lord Śiva, I am giving this girl, my daughter to you as your wife. O lord of all, be pleased to accept her.”

## \|\| 4.48.39 \|\|

*tasmai rudrāya mahate maṃtreṇānena dattavān \|*  
*himācalo nijāṃ kanyāṃ pārvatīṃ trijagatprasūm \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Himavat gave his daughter Pārvatī, the mother of the three worlds, to Śiva the great, repeating the mantra “Tasmai Rudrāya Mahate”.

## \|\| 4.48.40 \|\|

*itthaṃ śivākaraṃ śailaṃ śivahastenidhāya ca \|*  
*mumodātīva manasi tīrṇakāmamahārṇavaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Placing the hand of Pārvatī in the hand of Śiva the mountain rejoiced much mentally. He had the satisfaction of crossing the ocean of his ambition.

## \|\| 4.48.41 \|\|

*vedamaṃtreṇa giriśo girijākarapaṅkajam \|*  
*jagrāha svakareṇāśu prasannaḥ parameśvaraḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Śiva grasped the lotus-like hand of Pārvatī in his hand repeating the Vedic mantras. Lord Śiva was greatly delighted.

## \|\| 4.48.42 \|\|

*kṣitiṃ saṃspṛśya kāmasya kodāditi manuṃ mune \|*  
*papāṭha śaṅkaraḥ prītyā darśayaṃllaukikīṃ gatim \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Touching the ground and showing the worldly course of action, O sage, Śiva recited the mantra “Kāmasya Kodāt”.

## \|\| 4.48.43 \|\|

*mahotsavo mahānāsītsarvatra pramudāvahaḥ \|*  
*babhūva jayasaṃrāvo divi bhūmyantarikṣake \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. There was a great jubilation everywhere that gladdened everyone. Cries of “Victory” rose up in the heaven, the earth and the sky.

## \|\| 4.48.44 \|\|

*sādhuśabdaṃ namaḥ śabdaṃ cakrussarve'ti harṣitāḥ \|*  
*gaṃdharvāssujaguḥ prītyā nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. The delighted people shouted “Well done” and “Obeisance to you”. The Gandharvas sang sweetly with pleasure. The celestial damsels danced.

## \|\| 4.48.45 \|\|

*himācalasya paurā hi mumudu ścāti cetasi \|*  
*maṃgalaṃ mahadāsīdvai mahotsavapurassaram \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. The citizens, the subjects of Himavat rejoiced in their minds. There was great auspicious jubilation.

## \|\| 4.48.46 \|\|

*ahaṃ viṣṇuśca śakraśca nirjarā munayo'khilāḥ \|*  
*harṣitā hyabhavaṃścāti praphullavadanāmbujāḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Viṣṇu, Indra, I and the gods were delighted, with the faces beaming like full blown lotuses.

## \|\| 4.48.47 \|\|

*atha śailavarassodātsuprasanno himācalaḥ \|*  
*śivāya kanyādānasya sāṅgatāṃ suyathocitām \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Then the gleeful lord of mountains gave the ancillary articles of present to Śiva in a fitting manner.

## \|\| 4.48.48 \|\|

*tato vandhujanāstasya śivāṃ sampūjya bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*daduśśivāya saddravyaṃ nānāvidhividhānataḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Then his kinsmen worshipped Śiva with devotion and gave Pārvatī and monetary presents to Śiva in accordance with the various injunctions of the Śāstras.

## \|\| 4.48.49 \|\|

*himālayastuṣṭamanāḥ pārvatīśi vaprītaye \|*  
*nānāvidhāni dravyāṇi dadau tatra munīśvara \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. O excellent sage, in order to please Śiva and Pārvatī, the delighted Himavat presented many gifts of articles.

## \|\| 4.48.50 \|\|

*kautukāni dadau tasmai ratnāni vividhāni ca \|*  
*cāruratnavikārāṇi pātrāṇi vividhāni ca \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. He gave to Śiva some articles as dowry. Different kinds of gems and gemset vessels were given to him.

## \|\| 4.48.51 \|\|

*gavāṃ lakṣaṃ hayānāṃ ca sajjitānāṃ śataṃ tathā \|*  
*dāsīnāmanuraktānāṃ lakṣaṃ saddravyabhūṣitam \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. He gave a hundred thousand cows, a hundred horses duly fitted up and a hundred thousand servant maids of loving nature and endowed with all necessary articles.

## \|\| 4.48.52 \|\|

*nāgānāṃ śatalakṣaṃ hi rathānāṃ ca tathā mune \|*  
*suvarṇajaṭitānāṃ ca ratnasāravinirmitam \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. O sage, he gave a crore of elephants and chariots inlaid with gold and made beautiful by gems.

## \|\| 4.48.53 \|\|

*itthaṃ himālayo dattvā svasutāṃ girijāṃ śivām \|*  
*śivāya parameśāya vidhinā''pa kṛtārthatām \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Thus Himavat attained perfect satisfaction after giving his daughter Pārvatī to Śiva, the great lord, in accordance with the rules.

## \|\| 4.48.54 \|\|

*atha śailavaro mādhyaṃdinoktastotrato mudā \|*  
*tuṣṭāva parameśānaṃ sadgirā sukṛtāñjaliḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. Then the lord of mountains with palms joined in reverence eulogised lord Śiva joyously with the hymns of the Yajurveda.

## \|\| 4.48.55 \|\|

*tato vedavidā tenājñaptā munigaṇāstadā \|*  
*śiro'bhiṣekaṃ cakruste śivāyāḥ paramotsavāḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. Then at his behest, the sages jubilantly performed the holy ablution over the head of Pārvatī. Being conversant with the Vedas he asked them specially to perform this.

## \|\| 4.48.56 \|\|

*devābhidhānamuccāryya paryyakṣaṇavidhiṃ vyadhuḥ \|*  
*mahotsavastadā cāsīnmahānandakaro mune \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. Repeating the names of lord Śiva, they performed Paryukṣaṇa rite. There was a great jubilation and gaiety, O sage.

## Chapter 49 - The delusion of Brahmā

## \|\| 4.49.1 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*atho mamājñayā vipraissaṃsthāpyānalamīśvaraḥ \|*  
*homaṃ cakāra tatraivamaṅke saṃsthāpya pārvatīm \|\| 1 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

1\. Then at my behest, the lord made the brahmins kindle the sacrificial fire and performed the homa, placing Pārvatī on the lap.

## \|\| 4.49.2 \|\|

*ṛgyajussāmamantraiścāhutiṃ vahnau dadau śivaḥ \|*  
*lājāñjaliṃ dadau kālībhrātā mainākasaṃjñakaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Śiva poured offerings into the fire with Mantras from Ṛk, Yajus and Sāma Vedas. Pārvatī’s brother Maināka offered handfuls of fried grains.

## \|\| 4.49.3 \|\|

*atha kālī śivaścobhau cakraturvidhivanmudā \|*  
*vahnipradakṣiṇāṃ tāta lokācāraṃ vidhāya ca \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Then according to the worldly convention, Pārvatī and Śiva performed the circumambulation round the fire, O dear.

## \|\| 4.49.4 \|\|

*tatrādbhutamalañcakre caritaṃ girijāpatiḥ \|*  
*tadeva śṛṇu devarṣe tavasnehādbravīmyaham \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. The husband of Pārvatī exhibited a wonderful feat. O celestial sage, listen to that. I shall mention it out of love for you.

## \|\| 4.49.5 \|\|

*tasminnavasare cāhaṃ śivamāyāvimohitaḥ \|*  
*apaśyañcaraṇe devyā nakhenduñca manoharam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. On that occasion, deluded by Śiva’s power of illusion I stared at the feet of the goddess as well as the crescentshaped nails.

## \|\| 4.49.6 \|\|

*darśanāttasya ca tadā'bhūvaṃ devamune hyaham \|*  
*madanena samāviṣṭo'tīva kṣubhitamānasaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. On seeing them, O celestial sage, I became overwhelmed by passion. My mind was greatly disturbed.

## \|\| 4.49.7 \|\|

*muhurmuhurapaśyaṃ vai tadaṃgaṃ smaramohitaḥ \|*  
*tatastaddarśanātsadyo vīryaṃ me prācyutadbhuvi \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Deluded by the cupid I stared at her limbs frequently. Then, immediately after staring at them, my semen dropped on the ground.

## \|\| 4.49.8 \|\|

*retasā kṣaratā tena lajjitohaṃ pitāmahaḥ \|*  
*mune vyamarda tacchinnaṃ caraṇābhyāṃ hi gopayan \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. I, the grandfather, was ashamed by the emission of my semen. O sage, I pressed the penis secretly with my feet.

## \|\| 4.49.9 \|\|

*tajjñātvā ca mahādevaścukopātīva nārada \|*  
*hantumaicchattadā śīghraṃ vāṃ vidhiṃ kāmamohitam \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. O Nārada, on coming to know of it, the great God Śiva became furious. He wanted to kill me immediately because I was overwhelmed by lust.

## \|\| 4.49.10 \|\|

*hāhākāro mahānāsīttatra sarvatra nārada \|*  
*janāśca kampire sarvve bhaya māyāti viśvabhṛt \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. O Nārada, there was great hue and cry everywhere. All the people trembled. Even Viṣṇu, the sustainer of the universe, was terrified.

## \|\| 4.49.11 \|\|

*tatastaṃntuṣṭuvuśśambhuṃ viṣṇvādyā nirjarā mune \|*  
*sakopamprajvalantantantejasā hantumudyatam \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. O sage, then Viṣṇu and other gods eulogised Śiva who was blazing furiously and who attempted to kill me.

## \|\| 4.49.12 \|\|

*devā ūcuḥ \|*  
*devadeva jagadvyāpinparameśa sadāśiva \|*  
*jagadīśa jagannātha samprasīda jaganmaya \|\| 12 \|\|*

The gods said:—

12\. O lord of gods, O pervader of the universe, O Sadāśiva, O lord of the universe, O lord of the world or the very world itself, be pleased.

## \|\| 4.49.13 \|\|

*sarveṣāmapi bhāvānāntvamātmā heturīśvaraḥ \|*  
*nirvikāro'vyayo nityo nirvikalpo'kṣaraḥ paraḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. You are the supreme soul, the supreme lord and the cause of all emotions. You are free from aberrations, devoid of wastage. You are eternal, free from suspicions and doubts. You are undying. You are the great god.

## \|\| 4.49.14 \|\|

*ādyantāvasya yanmadhyamidamanyadahambahiḥ \|*  
*yato'vyayaḥ sanaitāni tatsatyambrahma cidbhavān \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. You are Truth, Brahman and Consciousness. You are imperishable, from whom have originated the beginning, the end and the middle of visible worlds, even I too. These visible things are not the true ones.

## \|\| 4.49.15 \|\|

*tavaiva caraṇāmbhojammuktikāmā dṛḍhavratāḥ \|*  
*visṛjyobhayatassaṃgaṃ munayassamupāsate \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The sages, desirous of liberation, worship and meditate upon your lotus feet. They are steady in their resolve. They avoid attachment on either side.

## \|\| 4.49.16 \|\|

*tvambrahma pūrṇamamṛtaṃ viśokaṃ nirguṇamparam \|*  
*ānaṃdamātramavyagramavikāramanātmakam \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. You are the perfect Brahman, the nectar, free from grief, devoid of attributes and the great one. You are the sole bliss, free from excitement, aberrations and even static and insentient.

## \|\| 4.49.17 \|\|

*viśvasya heturudayasthitisaṃyamanasya hi \|*  
*tadapekṣatayātmeśo'napekṣassarvadā vibhuḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. You are the cause of production, sustenance and dissolution of the universe Śiva, the lord of souls, is greater than the universe. He is free from the necessity of its aid. He is always pervasive.

## \|\| 4.49.18 \|\|

*ekastvameva sadasadvayamadvayameva ca \|*  
*svarṇaṃ kṛtākṛtamiva vastubhedo na caiva hi \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. You are the One, both Sat and Asat. You are non-dual. Gold whether as the basic metal or as the ready made ornament does not alter in its basic and intrinsic essence.

## \|\| 4.49.19 \|\|

*ajñānatastvayi janairvikalpo vidito yataḥ \|*  
*tasmādbhramapratīkāro nirupādherna hi svataḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. People have doubts in you by their ignorance. The remedy for illusion lies in thinking on your Nirguṇa aspect, not by itself.

## \|\| 4.49.20 \|\|

*dhanyā vayaṃ maheśāna tava darśanamātrataḥ \|*  
*dṛḍhabhaktajanānandapradaśśambho dayāṃ kuru \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. O supreme lord, we are blessed by your very vision. O Śiva, you are the bestower of supreme bliss to the people who are steady in their devotion. Have mercy.

## \|\| 4.49.21 \|\|

*tvamādistvamanādiśca prakṛtestvaṃ paraḥ pumān \|*  
*viśveśvaro jagannātho nirvikāraḥ parātparaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. You are the primordial Being. You have no beginning. You are the Puruṣa beyond the Prakṛti. You are the lord of the universe. You are the lord of the world. You are free from aberrations. You are greater than the greatest.

## \|\| 4.49.22 \|\|

*yo'yaṃ brahmāsti' rajasā viśvamūrtiḥ pitāmahaḥ \|*  
*tvatprasādātprabho viṣṇussattvena puruṣottamaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Your Rājasika manifestation is Brahmā, the grandfather. O lord, thanks to your grace, Viṣṇu is Puruṣottama by your Sāttvika nature.

## \|\| 4.49.24 \|\|

*vyaktaṃ mahacca bhūtādistanmātrāṇīndriyāṇi ca \|*  
*tvayaivādhiṣṭhitānyeva viśvamūrte maheśvara \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. O great lord of universal form, the manifest, the great principle, the elements, the Tanmātras, and the sense-organs are presided over by you.

## \|\| 4.49.25 \|\|

*mahādeva pareśāna karuṇākara śaṃkara \|*  
*prasīda devadeveśa prasīda puruṣottama \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. O supreme lord, O merciful Śiva, O lord of gods, be pleased, O best of Beings, be pleased.

## \|\| 4.49.26 \|\|

*vāsāṃsi sāgarāssapta diśaścaiva mahābhujāḥ \|*  
*dyaurmūrddhā te vibhornābhiḥ khaṃ vāyurnāsikā tataḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. The seven oceans are your clothes. The quarters are your long arms. The firmament is your head, O allpervasive. The sky is your navel. The wind is your nose.

## \|\| 4.49.27 \|\|

*cakṣūṃṣyagnī ravissomaḥ keśā meghāstava prabho \|*  
*nakṣatratārakādyāśca grahāścaiva vibhūṣaṇam \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. O lord, the fire, the sun and the moon are your eyes. The clouds are your hair. The planets and the stars are your ornaments.

## \|\| 4.49.28 \|\|

*kathaṃ stoṣyāmi deveśa tvāṃ vibho parameśvara \|*  
*vācāmagocaro'si tvaṃ manasā cāpi śaṃkara \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. O lord of gods, how shall I eulogise you? O supreme lord, you are beyond description. O Śiva, you are incomprehensible to the mind.

## \|\| 4.49.29 \|\|

*pañcāsyāya ca rudrāya pañcāśatkoṭimūrtaye \|*  
*tryadhipāya variṣṭhāya vidyātattvāya te namaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Obeisance to Thee, the five-faced Rudra. Obeisance to thee, with fifty crores of forms. Obeisance to thee, the lord of three deities. Obeisance to the most excellent one. Obeisance to the principle of learning.

## \|\| 4.49.30 \|\|

*anideṃśyāya nityāya vidyujjvālāya rūpiṇe \|*  
*agnivarṇāya devāya śaṃkarāya namonamaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Obeisance, Obeisance to the inexpressible, the eternal, the lightning-flamed, the flame-coloured. Obeisance to lord Śiva.

## \|\| 4.49.31 \|\|

*vidyutkoṭipratīkāśamaṣṭakoṇaṃ suśobhanam \|*  
*rūpamāsthāya loke'sminsaṃsthitāya namo namaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Obeisance, obeisance to thee stationed in the world with the form resembling a crore of lightning streaks, consisting of eight corners and very lustrous.

## \|\| 4.49.32 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*ityākarṇya vacasteṣāṃ prasannaḥ parameśvaraḥ \|*  
*brahmaṇo me dadau śīghramabhayaṃ bhaktavatsalaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

32\. On hearing their words, lord Śiva was delighted. Favourably disposed to his devotees he offered me freedom from fear.

## \|\| 4.49.33 \|\|

*atha sarve surāstatra viṣṇvādyā munayastathā \|*  
*abhavansusmitāstāta cakruśca paramotsavam \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. O dear, then Viṣṇu, the other gods and the sages began to smile and became merry.

## \|\| 4.49.34 \|\|

*mama tadretasā tāta marditena muhurmuhuḥ \|*  
*abhavankaṇakāstatra bhūriśaḥ paramojjvalāḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. O dear, my semen pressed very frequently, turned into several sparkling drops.

## \|\| 4.49.35 \|\|

*ṛṣayo bahavo jātā vālakhilyāssahasraśaḥ \|*  
*kaṇakaistaiśca vīryasya prajvaladbhiḥ svatejasā \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Thousands of sages called Vālakhilyas sprang up from the sparkling drops.

## \|\| 4.49.36 \|\|

*atha te hyṛṣayassarve upatasthustadā mune \|*  
*mamāntikaṃ paraprītyā tāta tāteti cābruvan \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. O sage, then the sages, gathered near me with great pleasure and said—“O father O father”.

## \|\| 4.49.37 \|\|

*īśvarecchāprayuktena proktāste nāradena hi \|*  
*vālakhilyāstu te tatra kopayuktena cetasā \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. They were then sternly told by you urged by Śiva’s wish. The Vālakhilyas were rebuked angrily by you.

## \|\| 4.49.38 \|\|

*\|\| nārada uvāca \|*  
*gacchadhvaṃ saṃgatā yūyaṃ parvataṃ gandhamādanam \|*  
*na sthātavyambhavadbhiśca na hi vo'tra prayojanam \|\| 38 \|\|*

Nārada said:—

38\. All of you together go to the mountain Gandhamādana. You shall not stay here. No purpose shall be served by your staying here.

## \|\| 4.49.39 \|\|

*tatra taptvā tapaścāti bhavitāro munīśvarāḥ \|*  
*sūryyaśiṣyāśśivasyaivājñayā me kathitantvidam \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. After performing great penance you will become great sages and disciples of the sun. This has been said by me at the behest of Śiva.

## \|\| 4.49.40 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*ityuktāste tadā sarve bālakhilyāśca parvatam \|*  
*satvaramprayayurnatvā śaṃkaraṃ gandhamādanam \|\| 40 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

40\. Thus addressed, all the Vālakhilyas went immediately to the mountain Gandhamādana after bowing to Śiva.

## \|\| 4.49.41 \|\|

*viṣṇvādibhistadābhūvaṃ śvāsitohaṃ munīśvara \|*  
*nirbhayaḥ parameśānapreritaistairmahātmabhiḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. O excellent sage, I was able to breathe fearlessly, thanks to Viṣṇu and others, the noble souls urged by lord Śiva.

## \|\| 4.49.42 \|\|

*astavañcāpi sarveśaṃ śaṃkarambhaktavatsalam \|*  
*sarvakāryakaraṃ jñātvā duṣṭagarvāpahārakam \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. After knowing that Śiva favourably disposed to His devotees can do everything and dispel the pride of the wicked, I eulogised Him, the lord of all.

## \|\| 4.49.43 \|\|

*devadeva mahādeva karuṇāsāgara prabho \|*  
*tvameva kartā sarvasya bhartā harttā ca sarvathā \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. O great God, O lord of gods, the ocean of mercy, you are the creator, the sustainer and the annihilator of everything.

## \|\| 4.49.44 \|\|

*tvadicchayā hi sakalaṃ sthitaṃ hi sacarācaram \|*  
*tantyāṃ yathā balīvardā mayā jñātaṃ viśeṣataḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. It is at your will that the entire world including the mobile and immobile is kept checked as the bulls amongst a series of cows.

## \|\| 4.49.45 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā sohaṃ vai praṇāmaṃ ca kṛtāñjaliḥ \|*  
*anye'pi tuṣṭuvussarve viṣṇvādyāstaṃ maheśvaram \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. After saying so I bowed to Him with palms joined in reverence. Viṣṇu and others too eulogised lord Śiva.

## \|\| 4.49.46 \|\|

*athākarṇya nutiṃ śuddhāṃ mama dīnatayā tadā \|*  
*viṣṇvādīnāñca sarveṣāṃ prasanno'bhūnmaheśvaraḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. On hearing the piteous eulogies made by me as well as by Viṣṇu and others lord Śiva became delighted.

## \|\| 4.49.47 \|\|

*dadau sotivaraṃ mahyamabhayaṃ prītamānasaḥ \|*  
*sarve sukhamatīvāpuratyamodamahaṃ mune \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. He granted me the boon of fearlessness delightedly. All were happy, O sage, and I rejoiced much.

## Chapter 50 - Description of fun and frolic

## \|\| 4.50.1 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*tataścāhaṃ munigaṇaiśśeṣakṛtyaṃ śivājñayā \|*  
*akārṣaṃ nārada prītyā śivāśivavivāhataḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

1\. O Nārada, thereafter at the bidding of Śiva, I carried out the concluding ceremonies of the wedding of Śiva and Pārvatī joyously through the sages.

## \|\| 4.50.2 \|\|

*tayośśiro'bhiṣekaśca babhūvādaratastataḥ \|*  
*dhruvasyadarśanaṃ viprāḥ kārayāmāsurādarāta \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Their ceremonial head-bath\[1\] was respectfully gone through. The brahmins showed the Pole star Dhruva with respect.

## \|\| 4.50.3 \|\|

*hṛdayālambhanaṃ karma babhūva tadanantaram \|*  
*svastipāṭhaśca viprendra mahotsavapurassaraḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Thereafter the rite of Hṛdayālambhana\[3\] was performed. O great brahmin, then Svastipāṭha was jubilantly celebrated.

## \|\| 4.50.4 \|\|

*śivāśirasi sindūraṃ dadau śambhurdvijājñayā \|*  
*tadānīṃ girijābhikhyādbhutāvarṇyā babhūva ha \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. At the behest of the brahmins, Śiva applied Red powder on the head of Pārvatī. The lustre of Pārvatī at that time was beyond description and very wondrous.

## \|\| 4.50.5 \|\|

*tato viprājñayā tau dvāvekāsanasamāsthitau \|*  
*lebhāte paramāṃ śobhāṃ bhaktacitta mudāvahām \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Thereafter at the bidding of the brahmins both sat on the same cushion and attained such a lustre as accentuated joy in the hearts of the devotees.

## \|\| 4.50.6 \|\|

*tataḥ svasthānamāgatya saṃsravaprāśanaṃ mudā \|*  
*cakratustau nideśānme'dbhutalīlākarau mune \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. O sage, then they returned to their apartment and, at my behest performed the rite of Saṃsrava Prāśana, of wonderful sportive nature that they were.

## \|\| 4.50.7 \|\|

*itthaṃ nivṛtte vidhivadyājñe vaivāhike śivaḥ \|*  
*brahmaṇe pūrṇapātraṃ me dadau lokakṛte prabhuḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. When the sacrificial rites in marriage ceremony were thus concluded duly, lord Śiva gave the Pūrṇapātra to me, the creator of the worlds.

## \|\| 4.50.8 \|\|

*godānaṃ vidhivacchambhurācāryāya dadau tataḥ \|*  
*mahādānāni ca prītyā yāni maṅgaladāni vai \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Śiva then made the gift of cows to the presiding priest. Other gifts of auspicious nature were also made.

## \|\| 4.50.9 \|\|

*tataśśatasuvarṇaṃ ca viprebhyassa dadau pṛthak \|*  
*bahubhyo ratnakoṭīśca nānādravyāṇyanekaśaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. He gave the brahmins a hundred gold pieces each. A crore of gems and other articles were distributed among the people as gifts.

## \|\| 4.50.10 \|\|

*tadānīmamarāssarve pare jīvāścarācarāḥ \|*  
*mumuduścetasātīva jayadhvaniḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. The Gods, mobile and immobile creatures, rejoiced much. Shouts of victory rose up.

## \|\| 4.50.11 \|\|

*maṅgaladhvanigānaśca babhūva bahu sarvataḥ \|*  
*vādyadhvanirabhūdramyo sarvānandapravarddhanaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Auspicious sounds of music were heard everywhere. The sound of the musical instruments was pleasing and increased the joy of everyone.

## \|\| 4.50.12 \|\|

*harirmayātha devāśca munayaścāpare'khilāḥ \|*  
*girimāmantrya suprītyā svasthānamprayayurdrutam \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Viṣṇu accompanied by me, all the gods and sages took leave of the mountain and returned to their abodes.

## \|\| 4.50.13 \|\|

*tadānīṃ śailanagare striyaśca muditā varam \|*  
*śivāśivau samānīya yayuḥ kuha varālayam \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. The ladies in the city of the mountain then took Śiva and Pārvatī to the abode of Kubera.

## \|\| 4.50.14 \|\|

*laukikācāramājahrustāḥ striyastatra cādṛtāḥ \|*  
*mahotsāho babhūvātha sarvataḥ pramudāvahaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. There several social customs and conventions were gone through by the ladies. All round, there was great jubilation.

## \|\| 4.50.15 \|\|

*atha tāstau samānīya dampatī janaśaṃkarau \|*  
*vāsālayammahādivyaṃ bhavācāraṃ vyadhurmudā \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Then the couple, benefactors of the people, were led near the bed chamber. It was exquisitely decorated according to convention.

## \|\| 4.50.16 \|\|

*atho samīpamāgatya śailendranagarastriyaḥ \|*  
*nirvṛtya maṅgalaṃ karma prāpayandampatī gṛham \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. The ladies of the city of Himavat approached them and performed the customary auspicious rites.

## \|\| 4.50.17 \|\|

*kṛtvā jayadhvaniṃ cakrurgranthinirmocanādikam \|*  
*sasmitāssakaṭākṣāśca pulakāñcitavigrahāḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Shouting cries of victory they untied the knot. They were smiling and ogling at one another with hairs standing on their ends due to pleasure.

## \|\| 4.50.18-20 \|\|

*vāsagehaṃ sampraviśya mumuhuḥ kāminīvarāḥ \|*  
*prasaṃśantyassvabhāgyāni paśyantaḥ parameśvaram \|\| 18 \|\|*

*mahāsurūpaveṣaśca sarva lāvaṇyasaṃyutam \|*  
*navīnayauvanasthañca kāminīcittamohanam \|\| 19 \|\|*

*īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyaṃ sakaṭākṣaṃ susundaram \|*  
*susūkṣmavāso bibhrāṇaṃ nānāratna vibhūṣitam \|\| 20 \|\|*

18-20. Entering the bedchamber and gazing at lord Śiva, the beautiful damsels were much fascinated and they praised their good luck. He was gorgeously dressed in fine clothes. He was bedecked in gemset ornaments. He appeared to be in the prime of youth. He fascinated the ladies with charming loveliness. He was smiling gently and glancing at everyone lovingly.

## \|\| 4.50.21-23 \|\|

*tadānīndivyanāryaśca ṣoḍaśāraṃ samāyayuḥ \|*  
*tau dampatī ca saṃdraṣṭuṃ mahādarapurassaram \|\| 21 \|\|*

*sarasvatī ca lakṣmīśca sāvitrī jāhnavī tathā \|*  
*aditiśca śacī caiva lopāmudrāpyarundhatī \|\| 22 \|\|*

*ahalyā tulasī svāhā rohiṇī ca vasundharā \|*  
*śatarūpā ca saṃjñā ca ratiretāssurastriyaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

21-23. Then the sixteen celestial ladies arrived there and saw the couple with great respect. They were Sarasvatī, Lakṣmī, Sāvitrī, Jāhnavī, Aditi, Śacī, Lopāmudrā, Arundhatī, Ahalyā, Tulasī, Svāhā, Rohiṇī, Vasundharā, Śatarūpā, Saṃjñā and Rati.

## \|\| 4.50.24 \|\|

*devakanyā nāgakanyā munikanyā manoharāḥ \|*  
*tatra yā yāḥ sthitāstāsāṃ saṅkhyāṃ kartuṃ ca kaḥ kṣamaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. There were several virgins of the gods, Nāgas, and the sages. They were charming and attractive. Who can enumerate them?

## \|\| 4.50.25 \|\|

*tābhī ratnāsane datte tatrovāsa śivo mudā \|*  
*tamūcuḥ kramato devyassuhāsa madhuraṃ vacaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. A gemset throne was offered to Śiva who sat on it joyously. The celestial ladies made these sweet witty remarks to Him one by one.

## \|\| 4.50.26 \|\|

*sarasvatyuvāca \|*  
*prāptā satī mahādevādhunā prāṇādhikā mudā \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā priyāsyañcandrābhaṃ santāpantyaja kāmuka \|\| 26 \|\|*

Sarasvatī said:—

26\. O great lord, Satī who was more than your life to you has now joyously rejoined you. O lover, seeing the face of your beloved of moonlike splendour, cast off the heat of your distress.

## \|\| 4.50.27 \|\|

*kālaṃ gamaya kāleśa satīsaṃśleṣapūrvakam \|*  
*viśleṣaste na bhavitā sarvakālaṃ mamāśritā \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Spend your time, O lord of time, in the close embrace of Satī. Thanks to my fervent wish, there will be no separation at any time between you both.

## \|\| 4.50.28 \|\|

*lakṣmīruvāca \|*  
*lajjāṃ vihāya deveśa satīṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi \|*  
*tiṣṭha tāmprati kā lajjā prāṇā yānti yayā vinā \|\| 28 \|\|*

Lakṣmī said:—

28\. O lord of gods, leave off your shyness. Take Satī to your bosom and stand close to her. Why do you feel shy of her without whom your vital airs may go off.

## \|\| 4.50.29 \|\|

*sāvitryuvāca \|*  
*bhojayitvā satī śambho śīghraṃ tvaṃ bhuṃkṣva mā khida \|*  
*tadācamya sakarpūrantāṃbūlaṃ dehi sādaram \|\| 29 \|\|*

Sāvitrī said:—

29\. O Śiva, give the sweets to Śatī and eat them yourself. Do not be in a flutter. Perform Ācamana and offer her betel leaves along with camphor.

## \|\| 4.50.30 \|\|

*jāhnavyuvāca \|*  
*svarṇakāṃtikarāṃ dhṛtvā keśānmārjaya yoṣitaḥ \|*  
*kāminyāssvāmisaubhāgyasukhaṃ nātaḥ paraṃ bhavet \|\| 30 \|\|*

Jāhnavī said:—

30\. Take hold of the hand of your beloved wife glittering with gold and stroke her hair. There is no higher pleasure at the hands of her lover to a loving maiden than this.

## \|\| 4.50.31 \|\|

*aditiruvāca \|*  
*bhojanānte śivaḥ śambhuṃ mukhaṃ śuddhyarthamādarāt \|*  
*jalaṃ dehi mahāprītyā dampatiprema durlabham \|\| 31 \|\|*

Aditi said:—

31\. At the conclusion of the meal, for the purity of the mouth, please give water. The love of this pair is very rare to be seen.

## \|\| 4.50.32 \|\|

*śacyuvāca \|*  
*kṛtvā vilāpaṃ yaddhetoḥ śivāṃ kṛtvā ca vakṣasi \|*  
*yo babhrāmāniśaṃ mohāt kā lajjā te priyāmprati \|\| 32 \|\|*

Śacī said:—

32\. Why should you be shy of your beloved for whom you lamented and roamed here and there always keeping her in your heart?

## \|\| 4.50.33 \|\|

*lopāmudrovāca \|*  
*vyavahāro'sti ca strīṇāṃ bhuktvā vāsagṛhe śiva \|*  
*dattvā śivāyai tāmbūlaṃ śayanaṃ kartumarhasi \|\| 33 \|\|*

Lopāmudrā said:—

33\. O Śiva, a duty shall be performed by women in the bedchamber after the meal. Hence give Tāmbūla (betel leaves with spices) to Śivā and go to bed.

## \|\| 4.50.34 \|\|

*arundhatyuvāca \|*  
*mayā dattāṃ satīmenāṃ tubhyandātumanīpsitām \|*  
*vividhaṃ bodhayitvemāṃ suratiṃ kartumarhasi \|\| 34 \|\|*

Arundhatī said:—

34\. This lady was not intended at first to be given to you. But it is after my efforts that she has been given to you. Hence you must have a good dalliance with her.

## \|\| 4.50.35 \|\|

*ahalyovāca \|*  
*vṛddhāvasthāmparityajya hyatīva taruṇo bhava \|*  
*yena menānumanyeta tvāṃ sutārpitamānasā \|\| 35 \|\|*

Ahalyā said:—

35\. Leave off your old age. Be extremely youthful so that Menā whose mind is fixed in her daughter may approve of you.

## \|\| 4.50.36 \|\|

*tulasyuvāca \|*  
*satī tvayā parityaktā kāmo dagdhaḥ purā kṛtaḥ \|*  
*kathantadā vasiṣṭhaśca prabho prasthāpito'dhunā \|\| 36 \|\|*

Tulasī said:—

36\. Satī was formerly abandoned by you. Kāma too was burnt. Then O lord, how is it that Vasiṣṭha is sent as an emissary now.

## \|\| 4.50.37 \|\|

*svāhovāca \|*  
*sthiro bhava mahādeva strīṇāṃ vacasi sāmpratam \|*  
*vivāhe vyavahāro'sti purandhrīṇāṃ pragalbhatā \|\| 37 \|\|*

Svāhā said:—

37\. Now, O great lord, be steady in the words of women. There is a duty for women after marriage, maturity and loftiness of demeanour.

## \|\| 4.50.38 \|\|

*rohiṇyuvāca \|*  
*kāmampūraya pārvatyāḥ kāmaśāstraviśārada \|*  
*kuru pāraṃ svayaṃ kāmī kāminīkāmasāgaram \|\| 38 \|\|*

Rohiṇī said:—

38\. O lord, expert in erotic science and technique, fulfil the desire of Pārvatī. Loving that you are, try to cross the ocean of the love of your beloved.

## \|\| 4.50.39 \|\|

*\|\| vasundharovāca \|*  
*jānāsi bhāvaṃ bhāvajña kāmārtānāṃ ca yoṣitām \|*  
*na ca svaṃ svāminaṃ śambho īśvaraṃ pāti santatam \|\| 39 \|\|*

Vasundharā said:—

39\. O lord, the knower of innermost thoughts, you know the emotions of love-oppressed maidens. It is not only the husband that she cherishes in her heart but she keeps the supreme lord too there for ever.

## \|\| 4.50.40 \|\|

*śatarūpovāca \|*  
*bhogaṃ divyaṃ vinā bhuktvā na hi tuṣyetkṣudhāturaḥ \|*  
*yena tuṣṭirbhavecchaṃbho tatkartumucitaṃ striyāḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

Śatarūpā said:—

40\. A hungry person will not be satisfied until he partakes of a sweet hearty meal. O Śiva do everything whereby the woman will be satiated.

## \|\| 4.50.41 \|\|

*\|\| saṃjñovāca \|*  
*tūrṇaṃ prasthāpaya prītyā pārvatyā saha śaṅkaram \|*  
*ratnapradīpantāmbūlaṃ talpaṃ nirmāya nirjane \|\| 41 \|\|*

Saṃjñā said:—

41\. Now please send off Śiva along with Pārvatī to a secluded spot after making the bed, giving them betal and keeping the gem-bedecked lamp ready near by.

## \|\| 4.50.42 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*strīṇāntadvacanaṃ śrutvā tā uvāca śivaḥ svayam \|*  
*nirvikāraśca bhagavānyogīndrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

42\. On hearing these words of the women, lord Śiva, who was free from aberrations and was the supreme preceptor of great Yogins spoke to them.

## \|\| 4.50.43 \|\|

*śaṃkara uvāca \|*  
*devyo na brūta vacanamevaṃbhūtaṃ mamāntikam \|*  
*jagatāṃ mātaraḥ sādhvyaḥ putre capalatā katham \|\| 43 \|\|*

Śiva said:—

43\. O dignified ladies, do not utter such words to me. You are the chaste mothers of the worlds, how do you speak so trivially in regard to your son?

## \|\| 4.50.44 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*śaṅkarasya vacaḥ śrutvā lajjitāssurayoṣitaḥ \|*  
*babhūvuḥ sambhramāttūṣṇīṃ citraputtalikā yathā \|\| 44 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

44\. On hearing the words of Śiva, the celestial ladies were ashamed. In their excitement they became motionless like dolls in a picture.

## \|\| 4.50.45 \|\|

*bhuktvā miṣṭānnamācamya maheśo hṛṣṭamānasaḥ \|*  
*sakarpūraṃ ca tāṃbūlaṃ bubhuje bhārya yā saha \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Eating the sweets and performing Ācamana lord Śiva was much delighted. In the company of His wife He chewed the betal with camphor.

## Chapter 51 - The resuscitation of Kāma

## \|\| 4.51.1 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*tasminnavasare jñātvānukūlaṃ samayaṃ ratiḥ \|*  
*suprasannā ca tamprāha śaṅkaraṃ dīnavatsalam \|\| 1 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

1\. At that time, thinking that the hour was favourable, Rati hopefully spoke to Śiva who is favourably disposed towards depressed people.

## \|\| 4.51.2 \|\|

*ratiruvāca \|*  
*gṛhītvā pārvatīṃ prāptaṃ saubhāgyamatidurlabham \|*  
*kimarthaṃ prāṇanātho me nissvārthaṃ bhasmasātkṛtaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

Rati said:—

2\. Why did you reduce my beloved husband to ashes without gaining any interest when he had come near you with Pārvatī? He was my only fortunate possession very rare to get.

## \|\| 4.51.3 \|\|

*jīvayātrā patiṃ me hi kāmavyā pāramātmani \|*  
*kuru dūraṃ ca santāpaṃ samaviśleṣahetukam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Give me back my husband, the lord of my journey of life who used to work lovingly with me. Remove my distress caused by separation.

## \|\| 4.51.4 \|\|

*vivāhotsava etasmin sukhino nikhilā janāḥ \|*  
*ahamekā maheśāna duḥkhinī svapatimvinā \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. O lord Śiva, in the great festival of your marriage, all people are happy. I alone am unhappy without my husband.

## \|\| 4.51.5 \|\|

*sanāthāṃ kuru māndeva prasanno bhava śaṅkara \|*  
*svoktaṃ satyamvidhehi tvaṃ dīnabandho para prabho \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. O lord, make me possessed of my husband. O Śiva, be pleased. O lord, friend of the distressed, please make your words true.

## \|\| 4.51.6 \|\|

*tvāmvinā kassamarthotra trailokye sacarācare \|*  
*nāśane mama duḥkhasya jñātveti karuṇāṃ kuru \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Excepting you, who is there in the three worlds including the mobile and immobile creatures who can destroy my sorrow. Knowing this, be merciful.

## \|\| 4.51.7 \|\|

*sotsave svavivāhe'sminsarvānanda pradāyinī \|*  
*sotsavāmapi māṃ nātha kuru dīnakṛpākara \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. O lord, merciful to the depressed, make me jubilant at the jubilant celebration of your marriage that gives pleasure to everyone.

## \|\| 4.51.8 \|\|

*jīvite mama nāthe hi pārvatyā priyayā saha \|*  
*suvihāraḥ prapūrṇaśca bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. There is no doubt in this, that only when my lord is resuscitated will your sportive dalliance with your beloved Pārvatī be complete and perfect.

## \|\| 4.51.9 \|\|

*sarvaṃ kartuṃ samarthosi yatastvaṃ parameśvaraḥ \|*  
*kimbahūktyātra sarveśa jīvayāśu patiṃ mama \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. You are competent to do everything because you are the supreme lord. O lord of all, of what avail is this talk. Please resuscitate my husband quickly.

## \|\| 4.51.10 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*tadityuktvā kāmabhasma dadau sagrandhibandhanam \|*  
*ruroda purataśśambhornātha nāthetyudīryya ca \|\| 10 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—-

10\. After saying thus she gave him the ashes of the cupid along with the bag in which they had been contained. “O lord, O lord”, saying thus she lamented much in front of Śiva.

## \|\| 4.51.11 \|\|

*ratirodanamākarṇya sarasvatyādayaḥ striyaḥ \|*  
*rurudussakalā devyaḥ procurdīnataraṃ vacaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. On hearing the lamentation of Rati, Sarasvatī and other celestial ladies wept bitterly and spoke in piteous tones.

## \|\| 4.51.12 \|\|

*\|\| devya ūcuḥ \|*  
*bhaktavatsalanāmā tvaṃ dīnabandhurdayānidhiḥ \|*  
*kāma jīvaya sotsāhāṃ rati kuru namo'stu te \|\| 12 \|\|*

The celestial ladies said:—

12\. Obeisance to you, O lord, you are known as favourably disposed to your devotees. You are friend of the distressed, storehouse of mercy. Resuscitate the cupid. Make Rati jubilant.

## \|\| 4.51.13 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā prasanno'bhūnmaheśvaraḥ \|*  
*kṛpādṛṣṭiṃ cakārāśu karuṇāsāgaraḥ prabhuḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

13\. On hearing their words, lord Śiva was delighted. The lord, the ocean of mercy, glanced compassionately.

## \|\| 4.51.14 \|\|

*sudhādṛṣṭyā śūlabhṛto bhasmato nirgataḥ smaraḥ \|*  
*tadrūpaveṣacihnātmā sundarodbhutamūrtimān \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Thanks to the nectarine glance of the Tridentbearing lord, Kāma came out of the ashes, a comely wonder-inspiring body with splendid dress and features.

## \|\| 4.51.15 \|\|

*tadrūpaśca tadākārasaṃsmitaṃ sadhanuśśaram \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā patiṃ ratistaṃ ca praṇanāma maheśvaram \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. On seeing her husband in the same form as before, wielding the bow and the arrows and smiling, Rati bowed to lord Śiva.

## \|\| 4.51.16 \|\|

*kṛtārthābhūcchivaṃ devaṃ tuṣṭāva ca kṛtāñjaliḥ \|*  
*prāṇanāthapradaṃ patyā jīvitena punaḥpunaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. She became contented. With her husband resuscitated and with palms joined in reverence she eulogised the lord, the bestower of her husband, frequently.

## \|\| 4.51.17 \|\|

*kāmasya stutimākarṇya sanārīkasya śaṅkaraḥ \|*  
*prasanno'bhavadatyaṃtamuvāca karuṇārdradhīḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. On hearing the eulogy of Kāma and his wife, Śiva was delighted and he spoke with his heart melting with pity.

## \|\| 4.51.18 \|\|

*śaṅkara uvāca \|*  
*prasannohaṃ tava stutyā sanārīkasya cittaja \|*  
*svayaṃbhava varambūhi vāñchitaṃ taddadāmi te \|\| 18 \|\|*

Śiva said:—

18\. O Kāma, I am delighted by your eulogy in the company of your wife. O self-born, tell me the boon you desire. I shall grant it.

## \|\| 4.51.19 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*iti śambhuvacaḥ śrutvā mahānadanssmarastataḥ \|*  
*uvāca sāñjalirnamro gadgadākṣarayā girā \|\| 19 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

19\. On hearing these words of Śiva, Kāma was highly delighted. Humbly and in faltering accents he spoke with palms joined in reverence.

## \|\| 4.51.20 \|\|

*\|\| kāma uvāca \|*  
*devadeva mahādeva karuṇāsāgara prabho \|*  
*yadi prasannassarveśaḥ mamānandakaro bhava \|\| 20 \|\|*

Kāma said:—

20\. O lord of gods, O ocean of mercy, if you, the lord of all, are pleased with me please be delightful to me.

## \|\| 4.51.21 \|\|

*kṣamasva me'parādhaṃ hi yatkṛtaśca purā prabho \|*  
*svajaneṣu parāmprītiṃ bhaktindehi svapādayoḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. O lord, please forgive my fault formerly perpetrated by me. Please grant me great affection towards my people and devotion to your feet.

## \|\| 4.51.22 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*ityākarṇya smaravacaḥ prasannaḥ parameśvaraḥ \|*  
*oṃ mityuktvā'bravīttaṃ vai vihasankaruṇānidhiḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

22\. On hearing the words of Kāma, lord Śiva was delighted. Giving consent, the lord of mercy laughingly said.

## \|\| 4.51.23 \|\|

*\|\| īśvara uvāca \|*  
*he kāmāhaṃ prasanno'smi bhayantyaja mahāmate \|*  
*gaccha viṣṇusamīpañca bahisthāne sthito bhava \|\| 23 \|\|*

Lord Śiva said:—

23\. O Kāma, I am delighted. O intelligent one, do not fear. Go near Viṣṇu and wait outside.

## \|\| 4.51.24 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*tacchrutvā śirasā natvā parikramya stuvanvibhum \|*  
*bahirgatvā harindevānpraṇamya samupāsta saḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

24\. On hearing these words he bowed to, circumambulated and eulogised the lord. Then he went out and bowed to Viṣṇu and gods.

## \|\| 4.51.25 \|\|

*kāmaṃ sambhāṣya devāśca dadustasmai śubhāśiṣam \|*  
*viṣṇvādayaḥ prasannāste procuḥ smṛtvā śivaṃ hṛdi \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Addressing Kāma, the gods congratulated him and offered him their auspicious blessings. Remembering Śiva, Viṣṇu and others spoke to him.

## \|\| 4.51.26 \|\|

*\|\| devā ūcuḥ \|*  
*dhanyastvaṃ smara sandagdhaḥ śivenānugrahīkṛtaḥ \|*  
*jīvayāmāsa sattvāṃśakṛpādṛṣṭyā khileśvaraḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

The gods said:—

26\. O Kāma, you are blessed. Burnt by Śiva you have been blessed by Him. The lord of all has resuscitated you by means of his sympathetic glance, the Sāttvika part.

## \|\| 4.51.27 \|\|

*sukhaduḥkhado na cānyo'sti yatassvakṛtabhṛk pumān \|*  
*kāle rakṣā vivāhaśca niṣekaḥ kena vāryate \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. No man causes happiness or sorrow to another man. Man experiences the fruits of what he does. Who can ward off the destined protection, marriage or consummation at the proper time?

## \|\| 4.51.28 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*ityuktvā te ca sammānya taṃ sukhenāmarāstadā \|*  
*santasthustatra viṣṇvādyāssarve labdhamanorathāḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

28\. After saying thus, the gods happily honoured him. Viṣṇu and other gods who had realised their desire stayed there with pleasure.

## \|\| 4.51.29 \|\|

*sopi pramuditastatra samuvāsa śivājñayā \|*  
*jayaśabdo namaśśabdassādhuśabdo babhūva ha \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. He too remained there, at the bidding of Śiva, with great delight. There were shouts of “Victory” “Obeisance” and “well-done”.

## \|\| 4.51.30 \|\|

*tataśśambhurvāsagehe vāme saṃsthāpya pārvatīm \|*  
*miṣṭānnaṃ bhojayāmāsa taṃ ca sā ca mudānvitā \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. At the bed-chamber Śiva placed Pārvatī on His left side and fed her with sweets. She too delightedly fed him with sweets in return.

## \|\| 4.51.31 \|\|

*atha śambhurbhavācārī tatra kṛtyamvidhāya tat \|*  
*menāmāmaṃtrya śailaṃ ca janavāsaṃ jagāma saḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Śiva according to the conventions of the world performed the customary rites. Taking leave of Menā and the mountain He came to the audience hall.

## \|\| 4.51.32 \|\|

*mahotsavastadā cāsīdvedadhvanirabhūnmune \|*  
*vādyāni vādayāmāsurjanāścaturvidhāni ca \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. O sage, there was great jubilation then. Sounds of Vedic chants rose up. People played on the four kinds of musical instruments.

## \|\| 4.51.33 \|\|

*śambhurāgatya svasthānaṃ vavande ca munīṃstadā \|*  
*hariṃ ca māṃ bhavācārādvandito'bhūtsurādibhiḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Coming back to His apartment, Śiva saluted the sages, Viṣṇu and me according to the worldly convention. He was duly saluted by the gods and others.

## \|\| 4.51.34 \|\|

*jayaśabdo babhūvātha nama śśabdastathaiva ca \|*  
*vedadhvaniśca śubhadaḥ sarvavighnavidāraṇaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Shouts of “Victory” and “Obeisance” rose up along with the sound of Vedic mantras which were auspicious and which removed all obstacles.

## \|\| 4.51.35 \|\|

*atha viṣṇurahaṃ śakrassarve devāśca sarṣayaḥ \|*  
*siddhā upasurā nāgāstuṣṭuvuste pṛthakpṛthak \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Then Viṣṇu, I (Indra), gods, sages, Siddhas, secondary gods and the Nāgas eulogised Him severally.

## \|\| 4.51.36 \|\|

*devā ūcuḥ \|*  
*jaya śambho'khilādhāra jaya nāma maheśvara \|*  
*jaya rudra mahādeva jaya viśva mbhara prabho \|\| 36 \|\|*

The gods said:—

36\. O śiva, be victorious. O lord Śiva, the support of all, be victorious. O Rudra, O great lord, the supporter of the world, be victorious.

## \|\| 4.51.37 \|\|

*jaya kālīpate svāmiñjayānandapravardhaka \|*  
*jaya tryambaka sarveśa jaya māyāpate vibho \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. O Pārvatī’s lord, O lord, accentuator of pleasure, O three-eyed one, O lord of all, the lord of illusion, be victorious, be victorious.

## \|\| 4.51.38 \|\|

*jaya nirguṇa niṣkāma kāraṇātīta sarvaga \|*  
*jaya līlākhilādhāra dhṛtarūpa namo'stu te \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. O lord, devoid of attributes, bereft of desires, O lord beyond all causes, O omnipresent, O playful support of all, O assumer of forms, Obeisance to you, be victorious.

## \|\| 4.51.39-40 \|\|

*jaya svabhaktasatkāmapradeśa karuṇākara \|*  
*jaya sānandasadrūpa jaya māyāguṇākṛte \|\| 39 \|\|*

*jayogra mṛḍa sarvātman dīnabandho dayānidhe \|*  
*jayāvikāra māyeśa vāṅmanotītavigraha \|\| 40 \|\|*

39-40. O lord, bestower of good desires to your devotees, O merciful one, O bliss-formed, assuming forms through magic illusions, be victorious. Be victorious, O kind, O All-souled one, friend of the distressed, storehouse of mercy, O lord of illusion, free from aberrations, whose body is beyond the reach of speech and mind.

## \|\| 4.51.41 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*iti stutvā maheśānaṃ girijānāyakamprabhum \|*  
*siṣevire paraprītyā viṣṇvādyāste yathocitam \|\| 41 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

41\. Eulogising thus, Viṣṇu and others joyously served lord Śiva, the husband of Pārvatī duly, and with great love.

## \|\| 4.51.42 \|\|

*atha śambhurmaheśāno līlāttatanurīśvaraḥ \|*  
*dadau mānavaranteṣāṃ sarveṣāntatra nārada \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. O Nārada, Śiva, the lord who had assumed body sportively, granted boons and honour to all present there.

## \|\| 4.51.43 \|\|

*viṣṇvādyāste'khilāstāta prāpyājñāmparameśituḥ \|*  
*atihṛṣṭāḥ prasannāsyāḥ svasthānañjagmurādṛtāḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. O dear one, Viṣṇu and others taking leave of the great lord delightedly returned to their respective places. They were duly honoured and their faces beamed with pleasure.

## Chapter 52 - The bridegroom’s party is fed and Śiva retires to bed

## \|\| 4.52.1 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*atha śailavarastāta himavānbhāgyasattamaḥ \|*  
*prāṅgaṇaṃ racayāmāsa bhojanārthaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

1\. O dear one, then the clever chief of mountains caused suitable arrangements to be made in the courtyard for feeding the visitors.

## \|\| 4.52.2 \|\|

*mārjanaṃ lepanaṃ samyakkārayāmāsa tasya saḥ \|*  
*sa sugandhairalañcakre nānāvastubhirādarāt \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. He caused the ground to be swept clean and scrubbed well. Different kinds of fragrant stuffs were used to make the place attractive and pleasing.

## \|\| 4.52.3 \|\|

*atha śailassurānsarvānanyānapi ca seśvarān \|*  
*bhojanāyāhvayāmāsa putraiśśailaiḥ parairapi \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Then the mountain invited all the gods and others along with the lord for taking food, through his sons and others.

## \|\| 4.52.4 \|\|

*śailāhvānamathākarṇya sa prabhussācyuto mune \|*  
*sarvaissurādibhistatra bhojanāya yayau mudā \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. O sage, on hearing the invitation of the mountain, the lord accompanied by Viṣṇu, the gods and others went gladly to take His meal.

## \|\| 4.52.5 \|\|

*giriḥ prabhuṃ ca sarvāṃstānsusatkṛtya yathāvidhi \|*  
*mudopaveśayāmāsa satpīṭheṣu gṛhāntare \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The mountain received the lord and all those duly and made them sit in good seats in the inner apartment.

## \|\| 4.52.6 \|\|

*nānāsubhojyavastūni pariviṣya ca tatpunaḥ \|*  
*sāñcalirbhojanāyājñāṃ cakre vijñaptimānataḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. After serving sweet and well-cooked delicious foodstuffs, he requested them to take their food with palms joined in reverence and head bent down.

## \|\| 4.52.7 \|\|

*atha sammānitāstatra devā viṣṇupurogamāḥ \|*  
*sadāśivaṃ puraskṛtya bubhujussakalāśca te \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Then duly honoured, Viṣṇu and other gods keeping Sadāśiva at the head took their food.

## \|\| 4.52.8 \|\|

*tadā sarve hi militā aikapadyena sarvaśaḥ \|*  
*paṃktibhūtāśca bubhuju rvihasantaḥ pṛthakpṛthak \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. They sat in rows together, took their food simultaneously laughing (and talking).

## \|\| 4.52.9 \|\|

*nandibhṛṃgivīrabhadravīrabhadragaṇāḥ pṛthak \|*  
*bubhujuste mahābhāgāḥ kutūhalasamanvitāḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Nandin, Bhṛṅgi, Vīrabhadra and his Gaṇas took their meals separately. The fortunate people took food enthusiastically.

## \|\| 4.52.10 \|\|

*devāssendrā lokapālā nānāśobhāsamanvitāḥ \|*  
*bubhujuste mahābhāgā nānāhāsyarasaissaha \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. The gods, with Indra, the guardians of the quarters all forunate and brilliant took their food cracking jokes and talking.

## \|\| 4.52.11 \|\|

*sarve ca munayo viprā bhṛgvādyā ṛṣayastathā \|*  
*bubhuju prītitassarve pṛthak paṃktigatāstadā \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. The sages and brahmins, Bhṛgu and other sages sat in separate rows and took their food with pleasure.

## \|\| 4.52.12 \|\|

*tathā caṇḍīgaṇāssarve bubhujuḥ kṛtabhājanāḥ \|*  
*kutūhalaṃ prakurvanto nānāhāsyakarā mudā \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. The Gaṇas of Caṇḍī took their meals and then cracked jokes and talked merrily.

## \|\| 4.52.13 \|\|

*evante bhuktavantaścācamya sarve mudānvitāḥ \|*  
*viśrāmārthaṃ gatāḥ prītyā viṣṇvādyāssvasvamāśramam \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. After taking meals and rinsing their mouths Viṣṇu and others went to their apartments for rest.

## \|\| 4.52.14 \|\|

*menājñayā striyassādhvya śśivaṃ samprārthya bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*gehe nivāsayāmāsurvāsākhye paramotsave \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. At the bidding of Menā, the chaste ladies requested Śiva humbly and made Him stay in the bedchamber where great festivities were going on.

## \|\| 4.52.15 \|\|

*ratnasiṃhāsane śambhurmenādatte manohare \|*  
*sannidhāya mudā yukto dadṛśe vāsamandiram \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Seated on a gemset throne offered by Menā, Śiva surveyed the bedchamber with pleasure.

## \|\| 4.52.16 \|\|

*ratnapradīpaśatakairjvaladbhirjvalitaṃ śriyā \|*  
*ratnapātraghaṭākīrṇaṃ muktāmaṇivirājitam \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. It was brightly illuminated with hundreds of gemset lamps. There were many gemset vessels. Pearls etc. were gorgeously displayed.

## \|\| 4.52.17 \|\|

*ratnadarppaṇaśobhāḍhyaṃ maṇḍitaṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ \|*  
*muktāmaṇisumālābhirveṣṭitaṃ paramarddhimat \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Gemset mirrors, white chowries, pearl necklaces and gorgeous things were richly displayed.

## \|\| 4.52.18 \|\|

*anūpamammahādivyaṃ vicitraṃ sumanoharam \|*  
*cittāhlādakaraṃ nānāracanāracitasthalam \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. It was unequalled in its divine exquisiteness highly pleasing and richly decorated.

## \|\| 4.52.19 \|\|

*śivadattavarasyaiva prabhāvamatulamparam \|*  
*darśayantaṃ samullāsi śivalokābhidhānakam \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. It was evincing the powerful influence of the boon granted by Śiva. It appeared to be a replica of Śiva Loka itself.

## \|\| 4.52.20 \|\|

*nānāsugandhasaddravyairvāsitaṃ suprakāśakam \|*  
*candanāgurusaṃyuktaṃ puṣpaśayyāsamanvitam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. It was richly rendered fragrant with various sweet smelling substances. It was very bright. There was sandal paste and aguru. Beds were richly strewn with flowers.

## \|\| 4.52.21 \|\|

*nānācitravicitrāḍhyaṃ nirmitaṃ viśvakarmmaṇā \|*  
*ratnendrasāraracitairācitaṃ hārakairvaraiḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Many wondrous things of variegated colours and shapes were displayed there. It had been constructed in gems by Viśvakarman himself.

## \|\| 4.52.22 \|\|

*kutracitsuranirmāṇaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ sumanoharam \|*  
*kutracicca brahmalokaṃ lokapālapuraṃ kvacit \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. In some places replicas of Vaikuṇṭha, Brahmaloka and the cities of the guardians of the quarters were seen.

## \|\| 4.52.23 \|\|

*kailāsaṃ kutracidramyaṃ kutracicchakramandiram \|*  
*kutracicchivalokaṃ ca sarvopari virājitam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. In a certain place the beautiful Kailāsa was represented. In another place Indra’s palace was depicted. Over all was represented the Śivaloka.

## \|\| 4.52.24 \|\|

*etādṛśagṛhaṃ sarvadṛṣṭāścaryyaṃ maheśvaraḥ \|*  
*praśaṃsan himaśaileśaṃ parituṣṭo babhūva ha \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Seeing all these wonderful representations lord Śiva praised Himavat and was very glad.

## \|\| 4.52.25 \|\|

*tatrātiramaṇīye ca ratnaparyyaṃka uttame \|*  
*aśayiṣṭa mudā yukto līlayā parameśvaraḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. In that bedchamber, in a beautiful gemset couch lord Śiva lay down with pleasure.

## \|\| 4.52.26 \|\|

*himācalaśca svabhrātṝnbhojayāmāsa kṛtsnaśaḥ \|*  
*sarvānanyāṃśca suprītyā śeṣakṛtyaṃ cakāra ha \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Himavat fed all his brothers and others with pleasure and attended to the subsequent duties.

## \|\| 4.52.27 \|\|

*evaṃ kurvati śaileśe svapati preṣṭha īśvare \|*  
*vyatītā rajanī sarvā prātaḥkālo babhūva ha \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. While the supreme lord had his sleep and the lord of the mountains was engaged in these duties, the night passed away giving place to dawn.

## \|\| 4.52.28 \|\|

*atha prabhātakāle ca dhṛtyutsāhaparāyaṇāḥ \|*  
*nānāprakāravādyāni vādayāñcakrire janāḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. In the morning the enthusiastic people began to play on different kinds of musical instruments.

## \|\| 4.52.29 \|\|

*sarve surāssamuttasthurviṣṇvādyāssumudānvitāḥ \|*  
*sveṣṭaṃ saṃsmṛtya deveśaṃ sajjibhūtāssasaṃbhramāḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Viṣṇu and the other gods got up with joy, remembered the lord of gods and excitedly got ready.

## \|\| 4.52.30 \|\|

*svavāhanāni sajjāni kailāsaṅgantumutsukāḥ \|*  
*kṛtvā sampreṣayāmāsurdharmaṃ śivasamīpataḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. They got their vehicles ready for the departure to Kailāsa and sent Dharma to Śiva.

## \|\| 4.52.31 \|\|

*vāsagehamathāgatya dharmo nārāyaṇājñayā \|*  
*uvāca śaṃkaraṃ yogī yogīśaṃ samayocitam \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. At the bidding of Viṣṇu, Dharma went near the bed chamber. The Yogin Dharma addressed Śiva, the lord of Yogins, in a manner befitting the context.

## \|\| 4.52.32 \|\|

*\|\| dharma uvāca \|*  
*uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha bhadrante bhava naḥ pramathādhipa \|*  
*janāvāsaṃ samāgaccha kṛtārthaṃ kuru tatra tān \|\| 32 \|\|*

Dharma said:—

32\. Get up, get up O Śiva, O lord of the Pramathas. Please come over to the audience hall. Make the assembled people gratified.

## \|\| 4.52.33 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*iti dharmavacaḥ śrutvā vijahāsa maheśvaraḥ \|*  
*dadarśa kṛpayā dṛṣṭyā talpamujjhāñcakāra ha \|\| 33 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

33\. On hearing these words of Dharma lord Śiva laughed. He surveyed him with sympathetic looks and got up from the bed.

## \|\| 4.52.34 \|\|

*uvāca vihasan dharma tvamagre gaccha tatra ha \|*  
*ahamapyāgamiṣyāmi drutameva na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. He laughingly said to Dharma—“You go ahead. I shall come there presently. There is no doubt in this matter.

## \|\| 4.52.35 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*ityuktaśśaṃkareṇātha janāvāsaṃ jagāma saḥ \|*  
*svayaṅgantumanā āsīttatra śambhurapi prabhuḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Thus addressed by Śiva, he returned to the audience hall. The lord Śiva too wanted to go.

## \|\| 4.52.36 \|\|

*tajjñātvā strīgaṇassosau tatrāgacchanmahotsavaḥ \|*  
*cakre maṃgalagānaṃ hi paśyanśambhupadadvayam \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. On coming to know of it the ladies came enthusiastically. With their eyes fixed on the feet of Śiva, they sang auspicious songs.

## \|\| 4.52.37 \|\|

*atha śaṃmbhurbhavācārī prātaḥkṛtyaṃ vidhāya ca \|*  
*menāmāntrya kudhraṃ ca janāvāsaṃ jagāma saḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Śiva then, in accordance with the worldly customs, went through his morning routine. He took leave of Menā and the mountain and went to the audience hall.

## \|\| 4.52.38 \|\|
