*mahotsavastadā cāsīdvedadhvanirabhūnmune \|*  
*vādyāni vādayāmāsurjanāścāturvidhāni ca \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. There was great jubilation there, O sage. Vedic mantras were recited loudly. The people played on the four kinds of musical instruments.

## \|\| 4.52.39 \|\|

*śambhurāgatya svasthānaṃ vavande ca munīṃstadā \|*  
*hariṃ ca māṃ bhavācārāt vandito'bhūtsurādibhiḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Śiva came to His apartment and bowed to the sages, Viṣṇu and me in accordance with the worldly conventions and was saluted by the gods and others.

## \|\| 4.52.40 \|\|

*jayaśabdo babhūvātha namaśśabdastathaiva ca \|*  
*vedadhvaniśca śubhado mahākolāhalo'bhavat \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Shouts of Victory and Obeisance rose up along with the auspicious sound of Vedic chants. There was great tumult.

## Chapter 53 - Description of Śiva’s return journey

## \|\| 4.53.1 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*atha viṣṇvādayo devā munayaśca tapodhanāḥ \|*  
*kṛtvāvaśyakakarmāṇi yātrāṃ santenire gireḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

1\. Then Viṣṇu and other gods, the sages and ascetics sent message to the mountain about their intention to leave after finishing their immediate duties.

## \|\| 4.53.2 \|\|

*tato girivaraḥ snātvā sveṣṭaṃ sampūjya yatnataḥ \|*  
*paurabandhūnsamāhūya janavāsaṃ yayau mudā \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Then the lord of mountains finished his ceremonial ablution and the worship of his favourite deity. Calling his kinsmen in the city, he came to the audience hall joyously.

## \|\| 4.53.3 \|\|

*tatra prabhumprapūjyātha cakre samprārthanāṃ mudā \|*  
*kiyaddināni santiṣṭha madgehe sakalaissaha \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. There he worshipped the lord with pleasure and requested him to stay in his house for a few days more along with all the people.

## \|\| 4.53.4 \|\|

*vilokanena te śambho kṛtārthohaṃ na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*dhanyaśca yasya madgehe āyāto'si suraissaha \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. “O Śiva” he said “I am contented by your sight. I am blessed since you came here with the gods”.

## \|\| 4.53.5 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*ityuktvā bahu śaileśaḥ karau baddhvā praṇamya ca \|*  
*prabhunnimantrayāmāsa saha viṣṇusurādibhiḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Saying these words and many more, the lord of mountains pleaded with palms joined in reverence to the lord along with Viṣṇu and other gods.

## \|\| 4.53.6 \|\|

*atha te manasā gatvā śiva saṃyutamādarāt \|*  
*pratyūcurmunayo devā hṛṣṭā viṣṇusurādibhiḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Then the gods and sages remembered Śiva and spoke with delight.

## \|\| 4.53.7 \|\|

*\|\| devā ūcuḥ \|*  
*dhanyastvaṃ giriśārdūla tava kīrtirmahīyasī \|*  
*tvatsamo na trilokeṣu kopi puṇyatamo janaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

The gods said:—

7\. O lord of the mountains, you are blessed. Your glory is great. Even in the three worlds, there is none equal to you in merit.

## \|\| 4.53.8 \|\|

*yasya dvāri maheśānaḥ parabrahma satāṃ gatiḥ \|*  
*samāgatassadāsaiśca kṛpayā bhaktavatsalaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. At your very door, lord Śiva, the supreme Brahman, the goal of the good and favourably disposed to His devotees, has deigned to come along with us, His slaves.

## \|\| 4.53.9 \|\|

*janāvāsotiramyaśca sammāno vividhaḥ kṛtaḥ \|*  
*bhojanāni tvapūrvāṇi na varṇyāni girīśvara \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. O lord of mountains, this audience hall is very excellent. You have honoured us in diverse ways. The foodstuffs served to us were extraordinary. It is impossible to describe them suitably.

## \|\| 4.53.10 \|\|

*citranna khalu tatrāsti yatra devī śivāmbikā \|*  
*paripūrṇamaśeṣañca yavaṃ dhanyā yadāgatāḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. It is no wonder that everything is perfect where the goddess Pārvatī is present. We too are blessed since we came.

## \|\| 4.53.11 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*itthamparasparantatra praśaṃsābhavaduttamā \|*  
*utsavo vividho jāto vedasādhujayadhvaniḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

11\. Thus there was mutual admiration and glorification of an enlightened nature. There was great jubilation. The sound of Vedic chant and shouts of victory were heard every where.

## \|\| 4.53.12 \|\|

*abhūnmaṅgalagānañca nanartāpsarasāṃgaṇaḥ \|*  
*nutiñcakrurmāgadhādyā dravyadānamabhūdbahu \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. There were auspicious songs. The celestial damsels danced. The bards sang songs of praise. There was a liberal exchange of monetary gifts.

## \|\| 4.53.13 \|\|

*tata āmantraya deveśaṃ svagehamagamadgiriḥ \|*  
*bhojanotsavamārebhe nānāvidhividhānataḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Then the mountain took leave of the lord of gods and went home. He made arrangements for a joyous feast with all paraphernalia in accordance with the rules.

## \|\| 4.53.14 \|\|

*bhojanārthaṃ prabhumprītyānayāmāsa yathocitam \|*  
*parivārasametaṃ ca sakutūhalamīśvaram \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. He brought the lord with all his attendants and followers for the feast. He was very enthusiastic.

## \|\| 4.53.15-16 \|\|

*prakṣālya caraṇau śambhorviṣṇormama varādarāt \|*  
*sarveṣāmamarāṇāñca munīnāñca yathārthataḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*pareṣāñca gatānāñca girīśo maṇḍapāntare \|*  
*āsayāmāsa suprītyā tāṃstānbandhubhiranvitaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. He washed the feet of Śiva, Viṣṇu and mine with reverence. He seated all of us, including the gods, the sages and others in the altar. The lord of mountains was assisted by his kinsmen.

## \|\| 4.53.17 \|\|

*surasairvividhānnaiśca tarpayāmāsa tāngiriḥ \|*  
*bubhujurnikhilāste vai śambhunā viṣṇunā mayā \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. The mountain satiated them with various kinds of juicy foodstuffs. All of them took food including Śiva, Viṣṇu and me.

## \|\| 4.53.18 \|\|

*tadānīmpuranāryaśca gālīdānamvyadhurmudā \|*  
*mṛduvāṇyā hasantyaśca paśyantyo yatnataśca tān \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Then the ladies of the city indulged in the customary utterance of foul abusive words laughing, jingling and peeping at all of them.

## \|\| 4.53.19 \|\|

*te bhuktvācamya vidhivadgirimāmantrya nārada \|*  
*svasthānamprayayussarve muditāstṛptimāgatāḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. O Nārada, they took their food and rinsed their mouths. Taking leave of the mountain they returned to their apartments fully satisfied and pleased.

## \|\| 4.53.20 \|\|

*itthantṛtīye ghasre'pi mānitāste'bhavanmune \|*  
*girīśvareṇa vidhivaddānamānādarādibhiḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. O sage, on the third day similarly they were thus duly honoured by the lord of mountains with customary gifts.

## \|\| 4.53.21 \|\|

*caturthe divase prāpte caturthīkarma śuddhitaḥ \|*  
*babhūva vidhivadyena vinā khaṇḍita eva saḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. On the fourth day, the rite of Caturthīkarman was performed with due observance. Without this the marriage rites would have been incomplete.

## \|\| 4.53.22 \|\|

*utsavo vividhaścāsītsādhuvādajayadhvaniḥ \|*  
*bahudānaṃ sugānañca narttanamvividhantathā \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. There was diverse jubilant festivity. Shouts of “well-done”, “Victory” etc were heard. There were exchanges of gifts, sweet music and different kinds of dances.

## \|\| 4.53.23 \|\|

*pañcame divase prāpte sarve devā mudānvitāḥ \|*  
*vijñaptiñcakrire śailaṃ yātrārthamatipremataḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. On the fifth day the delighted gods lovingly intimated to the mountain about their desire to go back.

## \|\| 4.53.24 \|\|

*tadākarṇya girīśaścovāca devān kṛtāñjaliḥ \|*  
*kiyaddināni tiṣṭhantu kṛpāṅkurvantu māṃ surāḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. On hearing that, the lord of mountains spoke to the gods with palms joined in reverence “O gods, please stay a few days more”.

## \|\| 4.53.25 \|\|

*ityuktvā snehatastāṃśca prabhumviṣṇuñca māmparān \|*  
*vāsayāmāsa divasān bahūnnityaṃ samādarāt \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Saying thus with great love he made all of us, the lord, Viṣṇu and others stay there for many days, honouring us duly every day.

## \|\| 4.53.26 \|\|

*itthamvyatīyurdivasā bahavo vasatāṃ ca tat \|*  
*saptarṣīnpreṣayāmāsurgirīśānte tatassurāḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Thus many days elapsed as the gods continued to stay there. Then the gods sent the seven sages to the lord of the mountains.

## \|\| 4.53.27 \|\|

*te taṃ sambodhayāmāsurmenāñca samayocitam \|*  
*śivatattvamparamprocuḥ praśaṃsanvidhivanmudā \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. They enlightened the mountain and Menā with what was relevant to the occasion. They told them about Śiva’s principles with due praise.

## \|\| 4.53.28 \|\|

*aṅgīkṛtaṃ pareśena tattadbodhanato mune \|*  
*yātrārthamagamacchambhuśśaileśaṃ sāmarādikaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. O sage, the proposal was agreed to by the great lord. Then Śiva went to the mountain to tell him about the intended journey, along with the gods and others.

## \|\| 4.53.29 \|\|

*yātrāṅkurvati deveśe svaśailaṃ sāmare śive \|*  
*uccai ruroda sā menā tamuvāca kṛpānidhim \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. When the lord of gods started on his journey towards his mountain along with the gods, Menā cried aloud and told the merciful lord.

## \|\| 4.53.30 \|\|

*menovāca \|*  
*kṛpānidhe kṛpāṅkṛtvā śivāṃ sampālayiṣyasi \|*  
*sahasradoṣaṃ pārvatyā āśutoṣaḥ kṣamiṣyasi \|\| 30 \|\|*

Menā said:—

30\. O merciful lord, do mercifully protect Pārvatī. You are quickly pleased. Hence you will please forgive even a thousand faults in her.

## \|\| 4.53.31 \|\|

*tvatpādāmbujabhaktā ca madvatsā janmajanmani \|*  
*svapne jñāne smṛtirnāsti mahādevaṃ prabhumbinā \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. My dear daughter is devoted to your lotus-like feet in every birth. Even sleeping or awake she does not think about anything else.

## \|\| 4.53.32 \|\|

*tvadbhaktiśrutimātreṇa harṣāśrupulakānvitā \|*  
*tvannindayā bhavenmaunā mṛtyuṃjaya mṛtā iva \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. O conqueror of death, even on hearing about your devotion she is filled with tears of pleasure and horripilation. On hearing your censure she becomes silent as though dead.

## \|\| 4.53.33 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*ityuktvā menakā tasmai samarpya svasutāntadā \|*  
*atyuccai rodanaṅkṛtvā mūrcchāmāpa tayoḥ puraḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

33\. Saying this, Menakā dedicated her daughter to Him and crying aloud became unconscious in front of them.

## \|\| 4.53.34 \|\|

*atha menāmbodhayitvā tāmāmantrya giristathā \|*  
*cakāra yātrāndevaiśca mahotsavapurassaram \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. When she regained consciousness, Śiva took leave of her and the mountain and set on journey with the gods jubilantly.

## \|\| 4.53.35 \|\|

*atha te nirjarāssarve prabhuṇā svagaṇaissaha \|*  
*yātrāmpracakrire tūṣṇīṃ girimprati śivaṃ dadhuḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. The gods with the lord and His Gaṇas started on their journey silently. They wished the mountain well.

## \|\| 4.53.36-37 \|\|

*himācalapurībāhyopavane harṣitāssurāḥ \|*  
*seśvarāssotsavāstasthuḥ paryaiṣanta śivāgamam \|\| 36 \|\|*

*ityuktā śivasadyātrā devaissaha munīśvara \|*  
*ākarṇaya śivayātrāṃ virahotsavasaṃyutām \|\| 37 \|\|*

36-37. The lord and the gods waited in a part outside the city of Himavat for the arrival of Pārvatī there. O great sage, thus I have narrated the journey of Śiva. Now listen to the journey of Pārvatī and of her departure with festivities.

## Chapter 54 - Description of the duties of the chaste wife (Pativratādharma)

## \|\| 4.54.1 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*atha saptarṣayaste ca procurhimagirīśvaram \|*  
*kāraya svātmajā devyā yātrāmadyocitāṃ gire \|\| 1 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

1\. Then the seven sages spoke to the lord of the mountains—“O mountain, make arrangements for the journey of your daughter today itself.”

## \|\| 4.54.2 \|\|

*iti śrutvā girīśo hi buddhvā tadvirahamparam \|*  
*viṣaṇṇobhūnmahāpremṇā kiyatkālaṃ munīśvara \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. O great sage, on hearing these words and knowing her pangs of separation, the lord of mountains was greatly affected by his love towards her and remained silent for a short while.

## \|\| 4.54.3 \|\|

*kiyatkālena samprāpya cetanāṃ śailarāṭ tataḥ \|*  
*tathāstviti girāmuktvā menāṃ sandeśamabravīt \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. After some time, the lord of the mountains regained his consciousness and said—“Let it be so”. He then sent the message to Menā.

## \|\| 4.54.4 \|\|

*śailasandeśamākarṇya harṣaśokavaśā mune \|*  
*menā saṃyāpayāmāsa karttumāsītsamudyatā \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. O sage, on hearing the message of the mountain, Menā was both delighted and sorry. She immediately set about arranging for her journey.

## \|\| 4.54.5 \|\|

*śrutisvakulajācāraṃ cacāra vidhivanmune \|*  
*utsavamvividhantatra sā menā kṣitibhṛtpriyā \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. O sage, Menā, the beloved of the mountain, made arrangements for all kinds of festivities in accordance with the tradition of her family and the injunctions of the Vedas.

## \|\| 4.54.6 \|\|

*girijāmbhūṣayāmāsa nānāratnāṃśukairvaraiḥ \|*  
*dvādaśābharaṇaiścaiva śṛṃgārairnṛpasammitaiḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. She bedecked Pārvatī with twelve kinds of ornaments and good silken garments of nice border. All kinds of embellishments befitting her royal state were made.

## \|\| 4.54.7 \|\|

*menāmanogambuddhvā sādhvyekā dvijakāminī \|*  
*girijāṃ śikṣayāmāsa pātivratyavratamparam \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Realising Menā’s inclinations a chaste brahmin lady instructed Pārvatī in the duties of a chaste wife.

## \|\| 4.54.8 \|\|

*\|\| dvijapatnyuvāca \|*  
*girije śṛṇu suprītyā madvaco dharmavarddhanam \|*  
*ihāmutrānandakaraṃ śṛṇvatāṃ ca sukhapradam \|\| 8 \|\|*

The brahmin lady said:—

8\. O Pārvatī, listen to my words with love that accentuate righteousness, that increase the pleasure here and hereafter and afford happiness to those who pay heed to them.

## \|\| 4.54.9 \|\|

*dhanyā pativratā nārī nānyā pūjyā viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*pāvanī sarvalokānāṃ sarvapāpaughanāśinī \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. A chaste lady sanctifies the worlds, destroys sins and is blessed. None else is so worthy of respect.

## \|\| 4.54.10 \|\|

*sevate yā patimpremṇā parameśvaravacchive \|*  
*iha bhuktvākhilāmbhogāna nte patyā śivāṃ gatim \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. O Pārvatī, she who serves her husband with love and considers him her sole lord, enjoys all pleasures here and obtains salvation hereafter along with her husband.

## \|\| 4.54.11-13 \|\|

*pativratā ca sāvitrī lopāmudrā hyarundhatī \|*  
*śāṇḍilyā śatarūpānusūyā lakṣmīssvadhā satī \|\| 11 \|\|*

*saṃjñā ca sumatiśśraddhā menā svāhā tathaiva ca \|*  
*anyā bahvyo'pi sādhvyo hi noktā vistarajādbhayāt \|\| 12 \|\|*

*pātivratyavṛṣeṇaiva tā gatāssarvapūjyatām \|*  
*brahmaviṣṇuharaiścāpi mānyā jātā munīśvaraiḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

11-13. The chaste ladies—Sāvitrī, Lopāmudrā, Arundhatī, Śāṇḍilyā, Śatarūpā, Anasūyā, Lakṣmī, Svadhā, Satī, Saṃjña, Sumati, Śraddhā, Menā, Svāhā and several others whose names are not mentioned lest the list should be too detailed have attained adoration from all people by their virtue of chastity. They have been honoured by Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śiva and great sages.

## \|\| 4.54.14 \|\|

*sevyastvayā patistasmātsarvadā śaṅkaraḥ prabhuḥ \|*  
*dīnānugrahakartā ca sarvasevyassatāṃ gatiḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Lord Śiva, benefactor of the depressed, worthy of worship and the goal of the good shall be served by you always.

## \|\| 4.54.15 \|\|

*mahānpativratādharmmaśśrutismṛtiṣu noditaḥ \|*  
*yathaiṣa varṇyate śreṣṭho na tathānyo'sti niścitam \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The duty of a chaste lady is very important and it has been mentioned in the Vedas and Smṛtis. No other duty is so admirable as this.

## \|\| 4.54.16 \|\|

*bhuṃjyādbhukte priye patyau pātivratyaparāyaṇā \|*  
*tiṣṭhettasmiṃñchive nārī sarvathā sati tiṣṭhati \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. A chaste lady shall take food only after her husband has taken it. O Śivā, if he stands, the woman too shall remain standing.

## \|\| 4.54.17 \|\|

*svapyātsvapiti sā nityaṃ budhyettu prathamaṃ sudhīḥ \|*  
*sarvadā taddhitaṃ kuryādakaitavagatiḥ priyā \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. When he sleeps she can also sleep. But she must intelligently wake up before him. She shall do what is beneficial to him. She shall love him without any sort of deception.

## \|\| 4.54.18 \|\|

*analaṃkṛtamātmānandarśayenna kvacicchive \|*  
*kāryārthamproṣite tasminbhavenmaṇḍanavarjitā \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. O Śivā, she shall never show herself unembellished to him. If for any important work he is on exile she shall never adorn herself.

## \|\| 4.54.19 \|\|

*patyurnāma na gṛhṇīyāt kadācana pativratā \|*  
*ākruṣṭāpi na cākrośetprasīdettāḍitāpi ca \|*  
*hanyatāmiti ca brūyātsvāminniti kṛpāṃ kuru \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. A chaste lady shall never mention her husband’s name. If the husband scolds or rebukes her she shall not abuse him in return. Even when beaten by him she shall remain glad and say “I may even be killed, O lord. Be kind to me.”

## \|\| 4.54.20 \|\|

*āhūtā gṛha kāryāṇi tyaktvā gacchettadantikam \|*  
*satvaraṃ sāñjaliḥ prītyāṃ supraṇamya vadediti \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. When called by him she shall leave the work she is engaged in and approach him immediately. With palms joined in reverence and love she shall bow to him and say as follows.

## \|\| 4.54.21 \|\|

*kimarthaṃ vyāhṛtā nātha sa prasādo vidhīyatām \|*  
*tadādiṣṭā caretkarma suprasannena cetasā \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. “O lord, be pleased to say what I have been called for.” Whenever ordered by him to do any job she shall do it gladly.

## \|\| 4.54.22 \|\|

*cirantiṣṭhenna ca dvāre gacchennaiva parālaye \|*  
*ādāya tattvaṃ yatkiṃcitkasmai cinnārpayetkvacit \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. She shall not stand near the entrance for a long time. She shall not go to other people’s house. She shall not take his money, even though it be a little, and give it to others.

## \|\| 4.54.23 \|\|

*pūjopakaraṇaṃ sarvamanuktā sādhayetsvayam \|*  
*pratīkṣamāṇāvasaraṃ yathākālocitaṃ hitam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Without being told she shall arrange the necessary requisities for his daily worship. She shall wait for the opportunity to do him a timely service.

## \|\| 4.54.24 \|\|

*na gacchettīrthayātrāṃ vai patyājñāṃ na vinā kvacit \|*  
*dūrato varjayetsā hi samājotsavadarśanam \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Without the permission of her husband she shall not go even on pilgrimage. She shall eschew the desire to attend social festivities.

## \|\| 4.54.25 \|\|

*tīrthārthinī tu yā nārī patipādodakampibet \|*  
*tasminsarvāṇi tīrthāni kṣetrāṇi ca na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. If a women wants holy water she shall drink the same with which her husband’s feet have been washed. All holy rivers are present in that water.

## \|\| 4.54.26 \|\|

*bhuṃjyātsā bharturucchiṣṭamiṣṭamannādikaṃ ca yat \|*  
*mahāprasāda ityuktvā patidattampativratā \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. She shall partake of the leavings of her husband’s food or whatever is given by him saying “This is thy great grace.”

## \|\| 4.54.27 \|\|

*avibhajya na cāśnīyāddeva pitratithiṣvapi \|*  
*paricārakavargeṣu goṣu bhikṣukuleṣu ca \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. She shall never take food without first offering due share to the gods, the Pitṛs, the guests, the servants, cows and saintly mendicants.

## \|\| 4.54.28 \|\|

*saṃyatopaskarā dakṣā hṛṣṭā vyayaparāṅmukhī \|*  
*bhavetsā sarvadā devī pativrataparāyaṇā \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. A gentle lady of chaste rites shall always be clever to manage the household with limited requisites. She shall be averse to spend unnecessarily.

## \|\| 4.54.29 \|\|

*kuryātpatyananujñātā nopavāsavratādikam \|*  
*anyathā tatphalaṃ nāsti paratra narakamvrajet \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Without being permitted by her husband she shall not observe fast and other rites. Should it be so, she will derive no benefit. She may fall into hell in other worlds.

## \|\| 4.54.30 \|\|

*sukhapūrvaṃ sukhāsīnaṃ ramamāṇaṃ yadṛcchayā \|*  
*āntareṣvapi kāryeṣu patiṃ notthāpayetkvacit \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. While the husband is sportively engaged or seated comfortably she shall not worry him to get up under the pretext of attending to some household work.

## \|\| 4.54.31 \|\|

*klībamvā duravasthamvā vyādhitaṃ vṛddhameva ca \|*  
*sukhitaṃ duḥkhitaṃ vāpi patimekaṃ na laṃghayet \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Whether he is impotent, distressed, sick or senile, happy or unhappy, the husband shall never be transgressed.

## \|\| 4.54.32 \|\|

*strīdharmiṇī trirātraṃ ca svamukhaṃ naiva darśayet \|*  
*svavākyaṃ śrāvayennāpi yāvatsnānānna śudhyati \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. During the three days of her monthly course she shall neither show her face nor speak to him. She shall not speak within his hearing till she becomes pure after her bath.

## \|\| 4.54.33 \|\|

*susnātā bhartṛvadanamīkṣetānyasya na kvacit \|*  
*athavā manasi dhyātvā patimbhānumvilokayeta \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. After her bath she shall see her husband’s face and not that of anyone else. Or after thinking on her husband she shall then gaze at the sun.

## \|\| 4.54.34-35 \|\|

*haridrākuṅkumaṃ caiva sindūraṃ kajjalādikam \|*  
*kūrpāsakañca tāmbūlaṃ māṃgalyābharaṇādikam \|\| 34 \|\|*

*keśasaṃskārakabarīkarakarṇādibhūṣaṇam \|*  
*bharturāyuṣyamicchantī dūrayenna pativratā \|\| 35 \|\|*

34-35. If a chaste lady wishes for the longevity of her husband she shall not forsake turmeric, vermilion, saffron, collyrium, a blouse, the betel, the necklace, ornaments, brushing and plaiting the hair bangles and earrings.

## \|\| 4.54.36 \|\|

*na rajakyā na bandhakyā tathā śravaṇayā na ca \|*  
*na ca durbhagayā kvāpi sakhitvaṃ kārayetkvacit \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. A chaste woman shall never associate intimately with a washerwoman, a harlot, a female ascetic or a fallen woman.

## \|\| 4.54.37 \|\|

*patividveṣiṇīṃ nārīṃ na sā saṃbhāṣayetkvacit \|*  
*naikākinī kvacittiṣṭhennagnā snāyānna ca kvacit \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. She shall not talk to any woman who disparages or hates her husband. She shall not stand alone anywhere nor shall she take bath in the nude.

## \|\| 4.54.38 \|\|

*nolūkhale na musale na varddhanyāṃ dṛṣadyapi \|*  
*na yaṃtrake na dehalyāṃ satī ca pravasetkvacit \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. A chaste lady shall never sleep on a mortar threshing rod, a broom, a grinding stone, a machine or on the threshold.

## \|\| 4.54.39 \|\|

*vinā vyavāyasamayaṃ prāgalbhyaṃ nācaretkvacit \|*  
*yatrayatra rucirbhartustatra premavatī bhavet \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Except at the time of sexual intercourse she shall never show her maturity and initiative. She shall like whatever her husband is interested in.

## \|\| 4.54.40 \|\|

*hṛṣṭāhṛṣṭe viṣaṇṇā syādviṣaṇṇāsye priye priyā \|*  
*pativratā bhaveddevī sadā patihitaiṣiṇī \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. A chaste lady shall be delighted when her husband is delighted and dejected when he is dejected. She shall always wish for his benefit.

## \|\| 4.54.41 \|\|

*ekarūpā bhavetpuṇyā saṃpatsu ca vipatsu ca \|*  
*vikṛtiṃ svātmanaḥ kvāpi na kuryāddhairyyadhāriṇī \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. She shall be virtuous and equanimous in affluence and adversity. She shall have fortitude and shall never go astray.

## \|\| 4.54.42 \|\|

*sarpirlavaṇatailādikṣayepi ca pativratā \|*  
*patiṃ nāstīti na brūyādāyāseṣu na yojayet \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Even when ghee, salt, oil or other things are exhausted she shall not tell her husband openly about it lest he should be subjected to undue strain.

## \|\| 4.54.43 \|\|

*vidherviṣṇorharādvāpi patirekodhiko mataḥ \|*  
*pativratāyā deveśi svapatiśśiva eva ca \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. O Goddess, the husband is superior to Brahmā, Viṣṇu or Śiva, for a chaste lady her husband is on a par with Śiva.

## \|\| 4.54.44 \|\|

*vratopavāsaniyamampatimullaṃghya yā caret \|*  
*āyuṣyaṃ harate bharturmṛtā nirayamṛcchati \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. She who transgresses her husband and observes fast and other rites wrecks the longevity of her husband and after death goes to hell.

## \|\| 4.54.45 \|\|

*uktā pratyuttarandadyādyā nārī krodhatatparā \|*  
*saramā jāyate grāme śṛgālī nirjane vane \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. If she furiously retorts to her husband she is born as a bitch in a village or as a vixen in a secluded place.

## \|\| 4.54.46 \|\|

*uccāsanaṃ na seveta na vrajedduṣṭasannidhau \|*  
*na ca kātaravākyāni vadennārī patiṃ kvacit \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. The chaste lady shall never take a higher seat never approach a defiled person, never speak to her husband in agitation.

## \|\| 4.54.47 \|\|

*apavādaṃ na ca brūyātkalahaṃ dūratastyajet \|*  
*gurūṇāṃ sannidhau kvāpi noccairbrūyānna vai haset \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. She should avoid slanderous words, shun quarrels and shall not speak aloud or laugh in the presence of elders.

## \|\| 4.54.48-49 \|\|

*bāhyādāyāntamālokya tvaritānnajalāśanaiḥ \|*  
*tāmbūlairvasanaiścāpi pādasamvāhanādibhiḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

*tathaiva cāṭuvacanaiḥ svedasannodanaiḥ paraiḥ \|*  
*yā priyaṃ prīṇayetprītā trilokī prīṇatā tayā \|\| 49 \|\|*

48-49. She who delights her husband delights all the worlds. When she sees her husband coming home she shall hasten to serve him food and water, hand him betel and change of garments, and serve him by massaging his feet. By pleasing words she shall fascinate him and dispel his gloom.

## \|\| 4.54.50 \|\|

*mitandadāti janako mitaṃ bhrātā mitaṃ sutaḥ \|*  
*amitasya hi dātāraṃ bhartārampūjayetsadā \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. What father gives is limited, what brother gives is limited and what the son gives is also limited. A chaste lady shall worship her husband who gives what has no limit.

## \|\| 4.54.51 \|\|

*bhartā devo gururbhartā dharmatīrthavratāni ca \|*  
*tasmātsarvamparityajya patimekaṃ samarcayet \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. To a wife the husband is god, preceptor, virtue, holy centre and sacred rite. She should cast off everything and adore him alone.

## \|\| 4.54.52 \|\|

*yā bhartāramparityajya rahaścarati durmatiḥ \|*  
*ulūkī jāyate krūrā vṛkṣa koṭaraśāyinī \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. She who forsakes her husband and secretly violates her fidelity is born as a she-owl of cruel nature wasting its days in the hollow of a tree.

## \|\| 4.54.53 \|\|

*tāḍitā tāḍituṃ cecchetsā vyāghrī vṛṣadaṃśikā \|*  
*kaṭākṣayati yānyamvai kekarākṣī tu sā bhavet \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. If she desires to beat her husband in retaliation, she becomes a tiger or a wild cat. She who ogles at another man becomes squint-eyed.

## \|\| 4.54.54 \|\|

*yā bhartāramparityajya miṣṭamaśnāti kevalam \|*  
*grāme vā sūkarī bhūyādvalgurvāpi svaviḍbhujā \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. She who partakes of sweet dish denying the same to her husband becomes a pig in the village or a wild goat eating its own dung.

## \|\| 4.54.55 \|\|

*yā tukṛtya priyambrūyānmūkā sā jāyate khalu \|*  
*yā sapatnī saderṣyeta durbhagā sā punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. She who addresses her husband in singular becomes dumb. She who is jealous of a co-wife becomes ill-fated in matrimony again and again.

## \|\| 4.54.56 \|\|

*dṛṣṭimvilupya bhartturyā kaścidanyaṃ samīkṣate \|*  
*kāṇā ca vimukhī cāpi kurūpāpi ca jāyate \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. She who casts glance on another person hiding it from her husband becomes one-eyed, twisted-faced or ugly.

## \|\| 4.54.57 \|\|

*jīvahīno yathā dehaḥ kṣaṇādaśucitāmvrajet \|*  
*bhartṛhīnā tathā yoṣitsusnātāpyaśucissadā \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. Just as a body bereft of the soul becomes unclean in a moment, similarly a woman without a husband is always unclean even though she may take a neat bath.

## \|\| 4.54.58 \|\|

*sā dhanyā jananī loke sa dhanyo janakaḥ pitā \|*  
*dhanyassa ca patiryasya gṛhe devī pativratā \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. The mother, the father and the husband are blessed if there is a chaste lady in the house.

## \|\| 4.54.59 \|\|

*pitṛvaṃśyāḥ mātṛvaṃśyāḥ pativaṃśyāstrayastrayaḥ \|*  
*pativratāyāḥ puṇyena svarge saukhyāni bhuṃjate \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. The three families—that of the father, that of the mother and that of the husband—enjoy the pleasures of heaven due to the merit of the chaste woman.

## \|\| 4.54.60 \|\|

*śīlabhaṅgena durvṛttāḥ pātayanti kulatrayam \|*  
*piturmātustathā patyurihāmutrāpi duḥkhitāḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. Disloyal women cause the downfall of the three families, that of the father, mother and husband and become distressed here and hereafter.

## \|\| 4.54.61 \|\|

*pativratāyāścaraṇo yatra yatra spṛśedbhuvam \|*  
*tatra tatra bhavetsā hi pāpahantrī supāvanī \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. Wherever the chaste lady sets her foot, the sin is dispelled therefrom and the place is sanctified.

## \|\| 4.54.62 \|\|

*vibhuḥ pativratāsparśaṃ kurute bhānumānapi \|*  
*somo gandhavahaścāpi svapāvitryāya nānyathā \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. Even the sun, moon and wind touch the chaste woman to sanctify themselves and not otherwise.

## \|\| 4.54.63 \|\|

*āpaḥ pativratāsparśamabhilaṣyanti sarvadā \|*  
*adya jāḍyavināśo no jātastvadyānyapāvanāḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Waters desire the touch of the chaste lady thinking—“Now our sluggishness is gone. Now we are able to purify others”.

## \|\| 4.54.64 \|\|

*bhāryā mūlaṃ gṛhasthāsya bhāryā mūlaṃ sukhasya ca \|*  
*bhāryā dharmaphalāvāptyai bhāryā santānavṛddhaye \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. Wife is the root of the household, and of its happiness; she is the source of the fruit of virtue and for the flourishing of the family.

## \|\| 4.54.65 \|\|

*gṛhe gṛhe na kiṃ nāryyo rūpalāvaṇyagarvitāḥ \|*  
*paramviśveśabhaktyaiva labhyate strī pativratā \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. In every house there are women proud of their exquisite beauty and comely appearance. But it is only due to the devotion of Śiva that a chaste lady is obtained.

## \|\| 4.54.66 \|\|

*paralokastvayaṃ loko jīyate bhārya yā dvayam \|*  
*devapitratithījyādi nābhāryaḥ karma cārhati \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. The present and the next world can be won through her. A wifeless man is not authorized to perform the rites of gods, Pitṛs guests and sacrifices.

## \|\| 4.54.67 \|\|

*gṛhasthassa hi vijñeyo yasya gehe pativratā \|*  
*grasyate'nyānpratidinaṃ rākṣasyā jarayā yathā \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. He alone is the true householder in whose house there is a chaste lady. The others are devoured by an ogress or old age.

## \|\| 4.54.68 \|\|

*yathā gaṃgāvagāhena śarīraṃ pāvanaṃ bhavet \|*  
*tathā pativratāṃ dṛṣṭvā sakalampāvanaṃ bhavet \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. Just as the body is purified by a plunge in the Gaṅgā, so everything is sanctified on seeing a chaste woman.

## \|\| 4.54.69 \|\|

*na gaṅgāyā tayā bhedo yā nārī patidevatā \|*  
*umāśivasamau sākṣāttasmāttau pūjayedbudhaḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. A chaste lady is not different from Gaṅgā. She and her husband are like Pārvatī and Śiva. Hence a sensible man shall worship them.

## \|\| 4.54.70 \|\|

*tāraḥ patiśśrutirnārī kṣamā sā sa svayantapaḥ \|*  
*phalampatiḥ satkriyā sā dhanyau tau dampatī śive \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. The husband is the high tone and the wife is the quarter tone. The husband is austerity and the woman is forbearance. The husband is the fruit and the wife is a sacred rite. O Pārvatī, such a pair is blessed.

## \|\| 4.54.71 \|\|

*evampativratādharmo varṇitaste girīndraje \|*  
*tadbhedāñ śṛṇu suprītyā sāvadhānatayā'dya me \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. O daughter of the lord of mountains, thus the duty of a chaste wife is described to you. Now, listen to their classifications with attention and love.

## \|\| 4.54.72 \|\|

*caturvidhāstāḥ kathitā nāryo devi pativratāḥ \|*  
*uttamādivibhedena smaratāṃ pāpahārikāḥ \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. O gentle lady, the chaste ladies can be divided into four classes. Even when they are remembered they dispel sins. The divisions comprise of the superior etc.

## \|\| 4.54.73 \|\|

*uttamā madhyamā caiva nikṛṣṭātinikṛṣṭikā \|*  
*bruve tāsāṃ lakṣaṇāni sāvadhānatayā śṛṇu \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. They are superior, middling, inferior and very inferior. I shall explain their characteristics. Listen with attention.

## \|\| 4.54.74 \|\|

*svapnepi yanmano nityaṃ svapatiṃ paśyati dhruvam \|*  
*nānyamparapatiṃ bhadre uttamā sā prakīrtitā \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. O gentle lady, she whose mind is not aware of any one else and who is conscious of her husband even in her dreams is the noblest of all.

## \|\| 4.54.75 \|\|

*yā pitṛbhrātṛsutavat parampaśyati saddhiyā \|*  
*madhyamā sā hi kathitā śailaje vai pativratā \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. O daughter of the mountain, she who sees another man as her father, brother or son with a clean conscience is the middling among chaste ladies.

## \|\| 4.54.76 \|\|

*buddhvā svadharmaṃ manasā vyabhicāraṃ karoti na \|*  
*nikṛṣṭā kathitā sā hi sucaritrā ca pārvati \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. O Pārvatī, she who ponders over her duty mentally and desists from going astray is inferior among the chaste. Of course she is pure in conduct.

## \|\| 4.54.77 \|\|

*patyuḥ kulasya ca bhayādvyabhicāraṃ karoti na \|*  
*pativratā'dhamā sā hi kathitā pūrvasūribhiḥ \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. She who remains chaste for fear of her husband or the family is very inferior among the chaste ladies, so say the ancient poets.

## \|\| 4.54.78 \|\|

*caturvidhā api śive pāpahantryaḥ pativratāḥ \|*  
*pāvanāssarvalokānāmihāmutrāpi harṣitāḥ \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. O Pārvatī, these four types of chaste ladies dispel sins. They sanctify all the worlds. They are delighted here and hereafter.

## \|\| 4.54.79 \|\|

*pātivratyaprabhāveṇātristriyā trisurārthanāt \|*  
*jīvito vipra eko hi mṛto vārāhaśāpataḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. A brahmin who died due to the curse of Varāha (Boar), was at the request of the three deities, resuscitated by Atri’s wife (Anasūyā), thanks to the power of chastity.

## \|\| 4.54.80 \|\|

*evaṃ jñātvā śive nityaṃ kartavyampatisevanam \|*  
*tvayā śailātmaja prītyā sarvakāmapradaṃ sadā \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. O Śiva, O daughter of the mountain, knowing this well, you shall render service to your husband every day with pleasure as it bestows all desires.

## \|\| 4.54.81 \|\|

*jagadambā maheśī tvaṃ śivassākṣātpatistava \|*  
*tava smaraṇato nāryo bhavanti hi pativratāḥ \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. You are the Goddess and the mother of the universe. Śiva Himself is your husband. By remembering you women become chaste.

## \|\| 4.54.82 \|\|

*tvadagre kathanenānena kiṃ devi prayojanam \|*  
*tathāpi kathitaṃ me'dya jagadācārataḥ śive \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. O Pārvatī, O gentle lady, what avails mentioning all this to you. Still I mention this just to follow the worldly convention.

## \|\| 4.54.83 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*ityuktvā virarāmāsau dvijastrī supraṇamya tām \|*  
*śivā mudamatiprāpa pārvatī śaṅkarapriyā \|\| 83 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

83\. Saying this, the brahmin lady stopped and bowed to her. Pārvatī, the beloved of Śiva, derived great pleasure.

## Chapter 55 - Śiva returns to Kailāsa

## \|\| 4.55.1 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*atha sā brāhmaṇī devyai śikṣayitvā vratañca tat \|*  
*provāca menāmāmantrya yātrāmasyāśca kāraya \|\| 1 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

1\. Thus instructing the goddess in the rites of a chaste lady, the brahmin lady told Menā while taking leave of her “Make arrangements for her journey”.

## \|\| 4.55.2 \|\|

*tathāstviti ca samprocya premavaśyā babhūva sā \|*  
*dhṛtindhṛtvāhūya kālīṃ viśleṣavirahā kulā \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Saying “So be it” she became exasperated by her affection. Controlling herself a little she called Pārvatī to her when her agitation due to imminent separation became all the more unbearable.

## \|\| 4.55.3 \|\|

*atyuccai rodanaṃ cakre saṃśliṣya ca punaḥ punaḥ \|*  
*pārvatyapi rurodoccairuccarantī kṛpāvacaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Embracing her she cried loudly and frequently. Pārvatī too cried uttering piteous words.

## \|\| 4.55.4 \|\|

*śailapriyā śivā cāpi mūrcchāmāpa śucārditā \|*  
*mūrcchāmprāpurdevapatnyaḥ pārvatyā rodanena ca \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. The beloved of the mountain as well as her daughter became unconscious due to grief. The wives of the gods too fainted on hearing Pārvatī cry.

## \|\| 4.55.5 \|\|

*sarvāśca rurudurnāryyassarvamāsīdacetanam \|*  
*svayaṃ ruroda yogīśo gacchankonya paraḥ prabhuḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. All the ladies cried. Everything became senseless. Who else, even the great lord, the leader of Yogins, cried at the time of departure.

## \|\| 4.55.6 \|\|

*etasminnantare śīghramājagāma himālayaḥ \|*  
*sasarvatanayastatra sacivaiśca dvijaiḥ paraiḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. In the meantime, Himavat came hurriedly along with his sons, ministers and brahmins.

## \|\| 4.55.7 \|\|

*svayaṃ ruroda mohena vatsāṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi \|*  
*kva yāsītyevamuccārya śūnyaṃ kṛtvā muhurmuhuḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Holding his dear daughter to his bosom and saying “Where are you going?” with frequent vague vacant glances, he cried due to his fascination.

## \|\| 4.55.8 \|\|

*tataḥ purohito viprairadhyātmavidyayā sukham \|*  
*sarvānprabodhayāmāsa kṛpayā jñānavattaraḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Then the chief priest in the company of other brahmins enlightened everyone. The wise priest by his spiritual discourse was able to convince them easily.

## \|\| 4.55.9 \|\|

*nanāma pārvatī bhaktyā mātarampitaraṃ gurum \|*  
*mahāmāyā bhavācārādrurodoccairmuhurmuhuḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. With great devotion Pārvatī bowed to her parents and the preceptor. Following the worldly convention she cried aloud frequently.

## \|\| 4.55.10 \|\|

*pārvatyā rodanenaiva rurudussarvayoṣitaḥ \|*  
*nitarāṃ jananī menā yāmayo bhrātarastathā \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. When Pārvatī cried the ladies cried too, particularly the mother Menā, sisters and brothers.

## \|\| 4.55.11 \|\|

*punaḥ punaḥ śivāmātā yāmayo'nyāśca yoṣitaḥ \|*  
*bhrātaro janakaḥ premṇā rurudurbaddhasauhṛdāḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Her mother, sister, brothers, father and the other ladies who were affectionately attached to her cried frequently.

## \|\| 4.55.12 \|\|

*tadā viprāḥ samāgatya bodhayāmāsurādarāt \|*  
*lagnannivedayāmāsuryātrāyāssukhadamparam \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Then the brahmins respectfully intimated to them the auspicious hour for the starting of the journey and consoled them.

## \|\| 4.55.13 \|\|

*tato himālayo menāṃ dhṛtvā dhairyyamvivekataḥ \|*  
*śibikāmānayāmāsa śivārohaṇahetave \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Then Himavat and Menā composed themselves and caused the palanquin to be brought for Pārvatī to get in.

## \|\| 4.55.14 \|\|

*śivāmārohayāmāsustatra viprāṅganāśca tām \|*  
*āśiṣampradadussarvāḥ pitā mātā dvijāstathā \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. The brahmin ladies helped her to get into the palanquin. They gave their blessings. Her parents and the brahmins too offered their blessings.

## \|\| 4.55.15 \|\|

*mahārājñyupacārāṃśca dadau menā giristathā \|*  
*nānādravyasamūhaṃ ca pareṣāndurlabhaṃ śubham \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Menā and the lord of mountains gave her a royal send-off with various auspicious rare presents not accessible to common people.

## \|\| 4.55.16 \|\|

*śivā natvā gurūnsarvāñ janakaṃ jananīntathā \|*  
*dvijānpurohitaṃ yāmīstrīstathānyā yayau mune \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. O sage, Pārvatī started after bowing to the preceptors, elders, father, mother, the brahmins, the chief priest, sisters and the other women.

## \|\| 4.55.17 \|\|

*himācalo'pi sasuto'gacchatsnehavaśī budhaḥ \|*  
*prāptastatra prabhuryatra sāmaraḥ prītimāvahan \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Himavat, the sensible affectionate father with his sons accompanied her as far as the place where the lord was waiting joyously along with the gods.

## \|\| 4.55.18 \|\|

*prītyābhirebhire sarve mahotsavapura ssaram \|*  
*prabhumpraṇemuste bhaktyā praśaṃsanto'viśanpurīm \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Everyone was jubilant and jolly with love. They bowed to the lord with devotion. Praising Him they returned to Kailāsa.

## \|\| 4.55.19 \|\|

*jātismarāṃ smārayāmi nityaṃ smarasi cedvada \|*  
*līlayā tvāñca deveśi sadā prāṇapriyā mama \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Then Śiva told Pārvatī—“I am reminding you although you know the previous birth. If you remember, speak out. In my divine sport you are always my beloved.”

## \|\| 4.55.20 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*ityākarṇya maheśasya svanāthasyātha pārvatī \|*  
*śaṅkarasya priyā nityaṃ sasmitovāca sā satī \|\| 20 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

20\. On hearing the words of Śiva, Satī Pārvatī the beloved of Śiva replied smiling.

## \|\| 4.55.21 \|\|

*pārvatyuvāca \|*  
*sarvaṃ smarāmi prāṇeśa maunī bhūto bhaveti ca \|*  
*prastāvocitamadyāśu kāryaṃ kuru namo'stu te \|\| 21 \|\|*

Pārvatī said:—

21\. O dear lord, I remember everything as well as the fact that you became a silent ascetic. Obeisance to you. Please do everything necessary now befitting the occasion.

## \|\| 4.55.22 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*ityākarṇya priyāvākyaṃ sudhādhārāśatopamam \|*  
*mumude'tīva viśveśo laukikācāratatparaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

22\. On hearing her words as pleasing as the steady flow of nectar, Śiva rejoiced much, eagerly devoted to the way of the world.

## \|\| 4.55.23 \|\|

*śivaḥ sambhṛtasambhāro nānāvastumanoharam \|*  
*bhojayāmāsa devaśca nārāyaṇapurogamān \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Getting every requisite thing ready, he fed the gods including Viṣṇu and others with various pleasant things.

## \|\| 4.55.24 \|\|

*tathānyānnikhilānprītyā svavivāhasamāgatān \|*  
*bhojayāmāsa surasamannambahuvidhamprabhuḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. He fed all the others who had attended His marriage with juicy cooked food of various sorts.

## \|\| 4.55.25 \|\|

*tato bhuktvā ca te devā nānāratna vibhūṣitāḥ \|*  
*sastrīkāssagaṇāssarve praṇemuścaṃdraśekharam \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. After taking food the gods and the Gaṇas, with their womenfolk fully bedecked in gems and jewels bowed to the moon-crested lord.

## \|\| 4.55.26 \|\|

*saṃstutya vāgbhiriṣṭābhiḥ parikramya mudānvitāḥ \|*  
*praśaṃsanto vivāhañca svadhāmāni yayustataḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. After eulogising Him with pleasing words and circumambulating Him with joy they praised the marriage celebration and returned to their abodes.

## \|\| 4.55.27 \|\|

*nārāyaṇaṃ mune māṃ ca praṇanāma śivassvayam \|*  
*laukikācāramāśritya yathā viṣṇuśca kaśyapam \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. O sage, Śiva Himself bowed to me and to Viṣṇu following the worldly convention as Viṣṇu had bowed to Kaśyapa.

## \|\| 4.55.28 \|\|

*mayāśliṣyāśiṣandattvā śivasya punaragrataḥ \|*  
*matvā vai taṃ paraṃ brahma cakre ca stutiruttamā \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Considering Him the supreme Brahman I eulogised him in the excellent manner after embracing him and offering him my benediction.

## \|\| 4.55.29 \|\|

*tamāmantrya mayā viṣṇussāñjaliśśivayormudā \|*  
*praśaṃsaṃstadvivāhañca jagāma svālayamparam \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Viṣṇu and I with palms joined in reverence, took leave of them and praising the marriage of Śiva and Pārvatī went back to Viṣṇu’s abode.

## \|\| 4.55.30 \|\|

*śivo'pi svagirau tasthau pārvatyā viharanmudā \|*  
*sarve gaṇāssukhaṃ prāpuratīva svabhajañchivau \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. On the mountain, Śiva stayed with Pārvatī and continued his divine sports with joy. The Gaṇas too were happy and they worshipped the married couple.

## \|\| 4.55.31 \|\|

*ityevaṅka thitastāta śivodvāhassumaṃgalaḥ \|*  
*śokaghno harṣajanaka āyuṣyo dhanavarddhanaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. O dear, I have thus narrated the auspicious story of the marriage of Śiva, that dispels sorrow, generates delight and increases wealth and longevity.

## \|\| 4.55.32 \|\|

*ya imaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ śucistadgatamānasaḥ \|*  
*śrāvayedvātha niyamācchivalokamavāpnuyāt \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. He who hears this story with pure mind fixed on them or narrates the same, shall attain Śivaloka.

## \|\| 4.55.33 \|\|

*idamākhyānamākhyātamadbhutaṃ maṃgalāyanam \|*  
*sarvavighnapraśamanaṃ sarvavyādhivināśanam \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. This narrative is said to be wondrous and the cause of everything auspicious. It quells all hindrances and ailments.

## \|\| 4.55.34 \|\|

*yaśasyaṃ svargyamāyuṣyaṃ putrapautrakaramparam \|*  
*sarvakāmapradaṃ ceha bhuktidaṃ muktidaṃ sadā \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. It is conducive to glory and the attainment of heaven. It bestows longevity, sons and grandsons, all cherished desires, worldly pleasures and salvation too.

## \|\| 4.55.35 \|\|

*apamṛtyupraśamanaṃ mahāśāntikaraṃ śubham \|*  
*sarvadussvapnapraśamanaṃ buddhiprajñādisādhanam \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. It wards off premature death. It is auspicious and it causes peace. It makes bad dreams subside. It is an instrument for the acquisition of keen intellect.

## \|\| 4.55.36 \|\|

*śivotsaveṣu sarveṣu paṭhitavyamprayatnataḥ \|*  
*śubhepsubhirjanaiḥ prītyā śivasantoṣakāraṇam \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. It shall be read on all occasions of Śiva’s festivals by the people who desire auspicious results. It gives satisfaction to Śiva.

## \|\| 4.55.37 \|\|

*paṭhetpratiṣṭhākāle tu devādīnāṃ viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*śivasya sarvakāryasya prārambhe ca suprītitaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. At the installation of the idols of the deities this shall be particularly read. At the beginning of all auspicious rites it shall be read with pleasure.

## \|\| 4.55.38 \|\|

*śṛṇuyādvā śucirbhūtvā caritaṃ śivayośśivam \|*  
*sidhyanti sarvakāryāṇi satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. With purity in mind and body it shall be heard. All affairs become fruitful thereby. This is true, really true.

## Section 5 - Rudra-saṃhitā (4): Kumāra-khaṇḍa

## Chapter 1 - The dalliance of Śiva

## \|\| 5.1.1 \|\|

*\|\| śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ \|*  
*\|\| śrīgaurīśaṃkarābhyāṃ namaḥ \|*  
*atha rudrasaṃhitāṃtargataścaturthaḥ kumārakhaṇḍaḥ prārabhyate \|*  
*vande nandanatuṣṭamāna samati premapriyaṃ premadaṃ pūrṇaṃ pūrṇakaraṃ prapūrṇanikhilaiśvaryaikavāsaṃ śivam \|*  
*satyaṃ satyamayaṃ trisatyavibhavaṃ satyapriyaṃ satyadaṃ viṣṇubrahmanutaṃ svakīyakṛpayopāttākṛtiṃ śaṃkaram \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. I salute Śiva who is satisfied with salutation, who loves great devotion, who bestows affection, who makes others too perfect and complete and who is the abode of all fortune and achievements. I salute Śiva who is eulogised by Viṣṇu and Brahmā, who urged by His sympathy assumes visible forms, who bestows truth, who loves truth, whose assets are the threefold truths and who is identical with truth.

## \|\| 5.1.2 \|\|

*\|\| nārada uvāca \|*  
*vivāhayitvā girijāṃ śaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ \|*  
*gatvā svaparvataṃ brahman kimakārṣiddhi tadvada \|\| 2 \|\|*

Nārada said:—

2\. O Brahmā, after marrying Pārvatī and returning to His mountain what did Śiva the benefactor of the worlds do? Please narrate it to me.

## \|\| 5.1.3 \|\|

*kathaṃ hi tanayo jajñe śivasya paramātmanaḥ \|*  
*yadarthamātmārāmo'pi samuvāha śivāṃ prabhuḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Who was the son born to Śiva, the great soul, for which purpose the lord, though He rests and revels in Himself, married Pārvatī?

## \|\| 5.1.4 \|\|

*tārakasya kathaṃ brahman vadho'bhūddevaśaṃkaraḥ \|*  
*etatsarvamaśeṣeṇa vada kṛtvā dayāṃ mayi \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. O Brahmā, the benefactor of the gods, how was Tāraka slain? Please have pity on me and narrate all this in full.

## \|\| 5.1.5 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*ityākarṇya vacastasya nāradasya prajāpatiḥ \|*  
*suprasannamanāḥ smṛtvā śaṃkaraṃ pratyuvāca ha \|\| 5 \|\|*

Sūta said:—

5\. On hearing these words of Nārada, Prajāpati was highly delighted and he replied after thinking on Śiva.

## \|\| 5.1.6 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*caritaṃ śṛṇu vakṣyāmi śaśimaulestu nārada \|*  
*guhajanmakathāṃ divyāṃ tārakāsurasadvadham \|\| 6 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

6\. O Nārada, listen to the tale of Śiva, the moon-crested lord. I shall narrate the story of Guha’s birth and the slaying of the demon Tāraka.

## \|\| 5.1.7 \|\|

*śrūyatāṃ kathayāmyadya kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm \|*  
*yāṃ śrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate mānavo dhruvam \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Let it be heard. I shall tell you the story that destroys all sins, on hearing which a man is freed from all sins.

## \|\| 5.1.8 \|\|

*idamākhyānamanaghaṃ rahasyaṃ paramādbhutam \|*  
*pāpasaṃtāpaharaṇaṃ sarvavighnavināśanam \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. This narrative is sinless. It is a wonderful secret. It dispels the distress caused by sin and wards off all obstacles.

## \|\| 5.1.9 \|\|

*sarvamaṃgaladaṃ sāraṃ sarvaśrutimanoharam \|*  
*sukhadaṃ mokṣabījaṃ ca karmamūlanikṛṃtanam \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. It bestows everything auspicious. It is the essence of the Vedas and is pleasing to the ears. It is conducive to happiness. It is the cause of liberation and cuts off the roots of all actions.

## \|\| 5.1.10 \|\|

*kailāsamāgatya śivāṃ vivāhya śobhāṃ prapede nitarāṃ śivo'pi \|*  
*vicārayāmāsa ca devakṛtyaṃ pīḍāṃ janasyāpi ca devakṛtye \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Returning to Kailāsa after marrying Pārvatī, Śiva attained added lustre. He thought over the task of the gods and the pain of the people involved in the fulfilment of that task.

## \|\| 5.1.11 \|\|

*śivassa bhagavān sākṣātkailāsamagamadyadā \|*  
*saukhyaṃ ca vividhaṃ cakrurgaṇāssarve suharṣitāḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. When Śiva returned to Kailāsa, the joyful Gaṇas made all arrangements for His happiness.

## \|\| 5.1.12 \|\|

*mahotsavo mahānāsīcchive kailāsamāgate \|*  
*devāssvaviṣayaṃ prāptā harṣanirbharamānasāḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. When Śiva returned to Kailāsa, there was great jubilation there. The gods returned to their realms with their minds full of joy.

## \|\| 5.1.13 \|\|

*atha śaṃbhurmahādevo gṛhītvā girijāṃ śivām \|*  
*jagāma nirjanaṃ sthānaṃ mahādivyaṃ manoharam \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Then taking Pārvatī, the daughter of the mountain, with Him, Śiva, the great Lord, went to a delightful brilliant isolated place.

## \|\| 5.1.14-15 \|\|

*śayyāṃ ratikarīṃ kṛtvā puṣpacandanacarcitām \|*  
*adbhutāṃ tatra paramāṃ bhogavastvanvitāṃ śubhām \|\| 14 \|\|*

*sa reme tatra bhagavāñśaṃbhugirijayā saha \|*  
*sahasravarṣaparyantaṃ devamānena mānadaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. Making a wonderful bed conducive to good sexual pleasure, rendered smooth and fragrant with flowers and sandal paste and auspiciously supplemented with objects of enjoyment, lord ‘Śiva’ the bestower of honour, indulged in dalliance with Pārvatī for a thousand years of god.

## \|\| 5.1.16 \|\|

*durgāṃgasparśamātreṇa līlayā mūrcchitaḥ śivaḥ \|*  
*mūrcchitā sā śivasparśādbubudhe na divāniśam \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. In that divine sport at the mere contact with Pārvatī, Śiva lapsed in unconsciousness. She too lapsed into unconsciousness due to the contact with Śiva. She neither knew the day nor the night.

## \|\| 5.1.17 \|\|

*hare bhogapravṛtte tu lokadharma pravartini \|*  
*mahān kālo vyatīyāya tayoḥ kṣaṇa ivānagha \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. When Śiva following the worldly way began his enjoyment of pleasures, O sinless one, a great length of time passed by as though it was a mere moment in their awareness.

## \|\| 5.1.18 \|\|

*atha sarve surāstāta ekatrībhūya caikadā \|*  
*maṃtrayāṃcakrurāgatya merau śakrapurogamāḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Then, O dear, Indra and the gods gathered together on the mountain Meru and began their mutual discussion.

## \|\| 5.1.19 \|\|

*surā ūcuḥ \|*  
*vivāhaṃ kṛtavāñchaṃbhurasmatkāryārthamīśvaraḥ \|*  
*yogīśvaro nirvikāro svātmārāmo niraṃjanaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

The gods said:—

19\. It is for the fulfilment of our task that Lord Śiva, the leader of Yogins, free from aberrations, the unsullied, revelling and resting in his own Self, has married.

## \|\| 5.1.20 \|\|

*notpannastanayastasya na jānāmo'tra kāraṇam \|*  
*vilaṃbaḥ kriyate tena kathaṃ deveśvareṇa ha \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. No son is born to Him. We do not know the reason. How is it that the lord of gods is delaying the action?

## \|\| 5.1.21 \|\|

*etasminnaṃtare devā nāradāddevadarśanāt \|*  
*bubudhustanmitaṃ bhogaṃ tayośca ramamāṇayoḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

21\. In the meantime, from Nārada who has the divine vision the gods came to know of the extent of the enjoyment of the couple engaged in dalliance.

## \|\| 5.1.22 \|\|

*ciraṃ jñātvā tayorbhogaṃ ciṃtāmāpussurāśca te \|*  
*brahmāṇaṃ māṃ puraskṛtya yayurnārāyaṇāṃtikam \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Realising that their enjoyment had extended over a long time, the gods became worried. Making me Brahmā as their leader they approached Viṣṇu Nārāyaṇa.

## \|\| 5.1.23 \|\|

*taṃ natvā kathitaṃ sarvaṃ mayā vṛttāṃtamīpsitam \|*  
*santasthire sarvadevā citre puttalikā yathā \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. After bowing to him I narrated to him all the details we desired to convey. The gods stood steady and silent like dolls painted in a picture.

## \|\| 5.1.24 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*sahasravarṣa paryyantaṃ devamānena śaṃkaraḥ \|*  
*ratau rataśca niśceṣṭo yogī viramate na hi \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. For a thousand years according to the calculation of the gods, Śiva the Yogin has been engaged in sexual dalliance. He does not desist from it.

## \|\| 5.1.25 \|\|

*bhagavānuvāca \|*  
*cintā nāsti jagaddhātassarvaṃ bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati \|*  
*śaraṇaṃ vraja deveśa śaṃkarasya mahāprabhoḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

Lord Viṣṇu said:—

25\. O creator of the universe, there is nothing to worry about. Everything will be well. O lord of gods, seek refuge in the great lord Śiva.

## \|\| 5.1.26 \|\|

*maheśaśaraṇāpannā ye janā manasā mudā \|*  
*teṣāṃ prajeśabhaktānāṃ na kutaścidbhayaṃ kvacit \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. O lord of subjects, the people who dedicate their minds to and seek refuge in Him joyously and devoutly have nothing to fear from any quarter.

## \|\| 5.1.27 \|\|

*śṛṃgārabhaṃgassamaye bhavitā nādhunā vidhe \|*  
*kālaprayuktaṃ kāryaṃ ca siddhiṃ prāpnoti nānyathā \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. The interruption to amorous dalliance will take place at the proper time, not now, O Brahmā. Any task carried out at the proper time shall be crowned with success, not otherwise.

## \|\| 5.1.28 \|\|

*śambhossambhogamiṣṭaṃ ko bhedaṃ kartumiheśvaraḥ \|*  
*pūrṇe varṣasahasre ca svecchayā hi viraṃsyati \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. If the enjoyment is desired by Śiva who can check it? When another thousand years are completed He will desist from it, out of his own will.

## \|\| 5.1.29 \|\|

*strīpuṃso rativicchedamupāyena karoti yaḥ \|*  
*tasya strīputrayorbhedo bhavejjanmani janmani \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. If any one separates the copulated pair by a tricky expedient, he will have the pangs of separation from his wife and sons in every birth.

## \|\| 5.1.30 \|\|

*bhraṣṭajñāno naṣṭakīrttiralakṣmīko bhavediha \|*  
*prayātyaṃte kālasūtra varṣalakṣaṃ sa pātakī \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. He will fall from perfect wisdom. His glory will be destroyed. He will lose his fortune. That sinner after his death will suffer the tortures of the hell Kālasūtra for a hundred thousand years.

## \|\| 5.1.31 \|\|

*raṃbhāyuktaṃ śakramimaṃ cakāra virataṃ ratau \|*  
*mahāmunīndro durvāsāstatstrībhedo babhūva ha \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. The sage Durvāsas\[6\] separated Indra in copulation with Rambhā and the sage got separation from his wife as a result thereof.

## \|\| 5.1.32 \|\|

*punaranyāṃ sa saṃprāpya viṣevya śubhapāṇikām \|*  
*divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ ca vijahau virahajvaram \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. He took another woman as his wife and thus put an end to the pangs of separation lasting for a thousand years of the gods.

## \|\| 5.1.33 \|\|

*ghṛtācyā saha saṃśliṣṭaṃ kāmaṃ vāritavān guruḥ \|*  
*ṣaṇmāsābhyaṃtare candrastasya patnīṃ jahāra ha \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Bṛhaspati hindered Kāma in copulation with Ghṛtācī but within six months the moon abducted his wife.

## \|\| 5.1.34 \|\|

*punaśśivaṃ samārādhya kṛtvā tārāmayaṃ raṇam \|*  
*tārāṃ sagarbhāṃ saṃprāpya vijahau virahajvaram \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. He then propitiated Śiva, fought a battle over Tārā, enjoyed her even as she was pregnant and tried to dispel his pangs of separation.

## \|\| 5.1.35 \|\|

*mohinīsahitaṃ candraṃ cakāra virataṃ ratau \|*  
*maharṣirgautamastasya strīvicchedo babhūva ha \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. The sage Gautama forced the moon in the company of Rohiṇī to desist from sexual dalliance and he suffered the pangs of separation from his wife.

## \|\| 5.1.36-37 \|\|

*hariścandro hālikaṃ ca vṛṣalyāsaha saṃyutam \|*  
*cārayāmāsa niśceṣṭaṃ nirjanaṃ tatphalaṃ śṛṇu \|\| 36 \|\|*

*bhraṣṭaḥ strīputrarājyebhyo viśvāmitreṇa tāḍitaḥ \|*  
*tataśśivaṃ samārādhya mukto bhūto hi kaśmalāt \|\| 37 \|\|*

36-37. Hariścandra expelled a ploughman in copulation with a Śūdra woman, to wander in a lonely forest. Listen to the effect thereof. He lost his wife, son and kingdom. He was tarmented by Viśvāmitra. It was only after propitiating Śiva that he could get released from that sin.

## \|\| 5.1.38 \|\|

*ajāmilaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ vṛṣalyā saha saṃyutam \|*  
*na bhiyā vārayāmāsussurāstāṃ cāpi kecana \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Though Ajāmila, a noble brahmin, was in copulation with a Śūdra woman, gods did not interfere due to this fear.

## \|\| 5.1.39 \|\|

*sarvaṃ niṣekasādhyaṃ ca niṣeko balavān vidhe \|*  
*niṣekaphalado vai sa niṣekaḥ kena vāryyate \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Everything can be achieved through the discharge of the semen. O Brahmā, the process of discharge is very effective. The discharge that is fruitful none can withhold.

## \|\| 5.1.40-41 \|\|

*divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ ca śaṃbhoḥ saṃbhogakarma tat \|*  
*pūrṇe varṣasahasre ca gatvā tatra sureśvarāḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*yena vīryaṃ patedbhūmau tat kariṣyatha niścitam \|*  
*tatra vīryye ca bhavitā skandanāmā prabhossutaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

40-41. O gods, Śiva’s act of enjoyment will extend to a thousand years of celestial calculation. After that period is over, you can go there and do such things as will necessitate the fall of the semen on the ground. The son of the lord named Skanda will be born of that.

## \|\| 5.1.42 \|\|

*adhunā svagṛhaṃ gaccha vidhe suragaṇaissaha \|*  
*karotu śaṃbhussaṃbhogaṃ pārvatyā saha nirjane \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. O Brahmā, return to your abode along with the gods. Let Śiva carry on enjoyment in the isolated place m the company of Pārvatī.

## \|\| 5.1.43 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*ityuktvā kamalākāntaḥ śīghraṃ svantaḥ puraṃ yayau \|*  
*svālayaṃ prayayurdevā mayā saha munīśvara \|\| 43 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

43\. After saying this, the lord of Lakṣmī immediately returned to his harem. O great sage, the gods too returned to their abodes along with me.

## \|\| 5.1.44 \|\|

*śaktiśaktimatoścā'tha vihāreṇā'ti ca kṣitiḥ \|*  
*bhārākrāṃtā cakaṃpe sā saśeṣā'pi sakacchapā \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. On account of the dalliance of Śiva and Pārvatī, the earth quaked with the weight along with Śeṣa (the serpent) and Kacchapa (the tortoise).

## \|\| 5.1.45 \|\|

*kacchapasya hi bhāreṇa sarvādhārassamīraṇaḥ \|*  
*staṃbhito'tha trilokāśca babhūvurbhayavihvalāḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. By the weight of Kacchapa, the cosmic air, the support of everything, was stunned and the three worlds became terrified and agitated.

## \|\| 5.1.46 \|\|

*atha sarve mayā devā hareśca śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ \|*  
*sarvaṃ nivedayāṃcakrustadvṛttaṃ dīnamānasāḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Then the gods along with me sought refuge in Viṣṇu and in our depression intimated to him the news.

## \|\| 5.1.47 \|\|

*devā ūcuḥ \|*  
*devadeva ramānātha sarvā'vanakara prabhoḥ \|*  
*rakṣa naḥ śaraṇāpannān bhayavyākulamānasān \|\| 47 \|\|*

The gods said:—

47\. O Viṣṇu, the lord of the gods, O lord and protector of all, save us who have sought refuge in you and whose minds are acutely terrified.

## \|\| 5.1.48 \|\|

*staṃbhitastrijagatprāṇo na jāne kena hetunā \|*  
*vyākulaṃ munibhirlekhaistrailokyaṃ sacarācaram \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. The vital air of the three worlds is stunned. We do not know wherefore. The three worlds including the mobile and immobile as well as the gods and the sages are excited.

## \|\| 5.1.49 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*ityuktvā sakalā devā mayā saha munīśvara \|*  
*dīnāstasthuḥ puro viṣṇormaunībhūtāssu duḥkhitāḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

49\. After saying this, O great sage, all the depressed gods, stood silent along with me in front of Viṣṇu with great misery.

## \|\| 5.1.50 \|\|

*tadākarṇya samādāya surānnaḥ sakalān hariḥ \|*  
*jagāma parvataṃ śīghraṃ kailāsaṃ śivavallabham \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. On hearing those words, Viṣṇu took us all immediately to the mountain Kailāsa, the favourite haunt of Śiva.

## \|\| 5.1.51 \|\|

*tatra gatvā harirdevairmayā ca suravallabhaḥ \|*  
*yayau śivavarasthānaṃ śaṃkaraṃ draṣṭukāmyayā \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. After going there in the company of the gods and me, the favourite deity of the gods went to the excellent resort of Śiva with a desire to see Śiva.

## \|\| 5.1.52 \|\|

*tatra dṛṣṭvā śivaṃ viṣṇurnasurairvismito'bhavat \|*  
*tatra sthitāñ śivagaṇān papraccha vinayānvitaḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. Unable to see Him there, Viṣṇu and the gods became surprised. With humility he asked the Gaṇas of Śiva who were there.

## \|\| 5.1.53 \|\|

*viṣṇuruvāca \|*  
*he śaṃkarāḥ śivaḥ kutra gatassarvaprabhurgaṇāḥ \|*  
*nivedayata naḥ prītyā duḥkhitānvai kṛpālavaḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

Viṣṇu said:—

53\. O Gaṇas of Śiva, where has Śiva, the lord of all gone? Sympathetically intimate this to us who are depressed.

## \|\| 5.1.54 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*ityākarṇya vacastasya sāmarasya harerguṇāḥ \|*  
*procuḥ prītyā gaṇāste hi śaṃkarasya ramāpatim \|\| 54 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

54\. On hearing these words of Viṣṇu in the company of the gods, the Gaṇas of Śiva lovingly replied to Viṣṇu.

## \|\| 5.1.55 \|\|

*śivagaṇā ūcuḥ \|*  
*hare śṛṇu śivaprītyā yathārthaṃ brūmahe vayam \|*  
*brahmaṇā nirjaraissārddhaṃ vṛttāntamakhilaṃ ca yat \|\| 55 \|\|*

The Gaṇas of Śiva said:—

55\. O Viṣṇu, please listen along with Brahmā and the gods, we shall tell you the truth and the details out of love for Śiva.

## \|\| 5.1.56 \|\|

*sarveśvaro mahādevo jagāma girijālayam \|*  
*saṃsthāpya no'tra suprītyā rānālīlāviśāradaḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. Śiva, the lord of all, had gone into the apartment: of Pārvatī after stationing us here with love. He is an expert in indulging in divine sports.

## \|\| 5.1.57 \|\|

*tadguhābhyantare śaṃbhuḥ kiṃ karoti maheśvaraḥ \|*  
*na jānīmo ramānātha vyatīyurbahavassamāḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. O lord of Lakṣmī, many years have gone by. We do not know what Śiva, the great lord, is doing within her apartment.

## \|\| 5.1.58 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*śrutveti vacanaṃ teṣāṃ sa viṣṇussāmaro mayā \|*  
*vismito'ti muniśreṣṭha śivadvāraṃ jagāma ha \|\| 58 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

58\. On hearing their words, O excellent sage, Viṣṇu, the gods and I were perplexed and went to the doorway of Śiva’s apartment.

## \|\| 5.1.59 \|\|

*tatra gatvā mayā devaissa harirdevavallabhaḥ \|*  
*ārtavāṇyā mune proce tārasvaratayā tadā \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. After going there along with me and the gods, Viṣṇu, the favourite deity of the gods, spoke in dejection but with joy in the heart.

## \|\| 5.1.60 \|\|

*śaṃbhumastaunmahāprītyā sāmaro hi mayā hariḥ \|*  
*tatra sthito muniśreṣṭha sarvalokaprabhuṃ haram \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. O excellent sage, standing there, along with me and the gods, he eulogised Śiva, the lord of all the worlds with great pleasure.

## \|\| 5.1.61 \|\|

*\|\| viṣṇuruvāca \|*  
*kiṃ karoṣi mahādevā'bhyantare parameśvara \|*  
*tārakārtānsurānsarvānpāhi naḥ śaraṇāgatān \|\| 61 \|\|*

Viṣṇu said:—

61\. O great lord, what are you doing there inside? Save us who are harassed by Tāraka and who have sought refuge in you.

## \|\| 5.1.62 \|\|

*ityādi saṃstuvañ śaṃbhuṃ bahudhā somarairmayā \|*  
*rurodāti haristatra tārakārtairmunīśvara \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. O great sage, praising and pleading like this to Śiva, Viṣṇu wept bitterly along with the gods harassed by Tāraka.

## \|\| 5.1.63 \|\|

*duḥkhakolāhalastatra babhūva tridivaukasām \|*  
*miśritaśśiva saṃstutyā'surārttānāṃ munīśvara \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. O great sage, the tumultuous cry of the heaven-dwellers distressed by the demon got mingled with the sound of eulogy to Śiva.

## Chapter 2 - The birth of Śiva’s son

## \|\| 5.2.1 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*tadākarṇya mahādevo yogajñānaviśāradaḥ \|*  
*tyaktakāmo na tatyāja saṃbhogaṃ pārvatībhayāt \|\| 1 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

1\. On hearing that, the great lord, an expert in Yogic theory, though free from lust, did not emit the semen, fearing to offend Pārvatī.

## \|\| 5.2.2 \|\|

*ājagāma gṛhadvāri surāṇāṃ nikaṭaṃ śivaḥ \|*  
*daityena pīḍitānāṃ ca śaṃkaro bhaktavatsalaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. He came to the door, near the gods distressed by the demon. Śiva is the benefactor favourably disposed to His devotees.

## \|\| 5.2.3 \|\|

*devāssarve prabhuṃ dṛṣṭvā hariṇā ca mayā śivam \|*  
*babhūbussukhinaścāti tadā vai bhaktavatsalam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. On seeing lord Śiva, favourably disposed to His devotees, the gods including me and Viṣṇu became extremely happy.

## \|\| 5.2.4 \|\|

*ityākarṇya vacasteṣāṃ surāṇāṃ bhagavānbhavaḥ \|*  
*pratyuvāca viṣaṇṇātmā dūyamānena cetasā \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. O sage, bowing down with stooping shoulders the gods along with me and Viṣṇu eulogised Śiva with great pleasure.

## \|\| 5.2.5 \|\|

*praṇamya sumahāprītyā nataskaṃdhāśca nirjarāḥ \|*  
*tuṣṭuvuḥ śaṃkaraṃ sarve mayā ca hariṇā mune \|\| 5 \|\|*

The gods said:—

5\. “O great God, O lord of gods, O ocean of mercy,

O Śiva, you are the immanent soul of all. You know everything.

## \|\| 5.2.6 \|\|

*devā ūcuḥ \|*  
*devadeva mahādeva karuṇāsāgara prabho \|*  
*antaryāmī hi sarveṣāṃ sarvaṃ jānāsi śaṃkara \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. O lord, carry out the task of the gods. O great lord, save the gods. Slay Tāraka and other demons and take pity on us.”

## \|\| 5.2.7 \|\|

*devakāryaṃ kuru vibho rakṣa devān maheśvara \|*  
*jahi daityān kṛpāṃ kṛtvā tārakādīn mahāprabhūn \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. On hearing these words of the gods, lord Śiva agitated in soul and dispirited in the mind, replied.

## \|\| 5.2.8 \|\|

*\|\| śiva uvāca \|*  
*he viṣṇo he vidhe devāssarveṣāṃ vo manogatiḥ \|*  
*yadbhāvi tadbhavatyeva ko'pi no tannivārakaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

Śiva said:—

8\. “O Viṣṇu, O Brahmā, O gods, you are the goal of everybody’s mind. What should happen necessarily must happen. There is none to stop it.

## \|\| 5.2.9-11 \|\|

*yajjātaṃ tajjātameva prastutaṃ śṛṇutā'marāḥ \|*  
*śirastaskhalitaṃ vīryaṃ ko grahīṣyati me'dhunā \|\| 9 \|\|*

*sa gṛhṇīyāditi procya pātayāmāsa tadbhuvi \|*  
*agnirbhūtvā kapoto hi preritassarvanirjaraiḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*abhakṣacchāṃbhavaṃ vīryaṃ caṃcvā tu nikhilaṃ tadā \|*  
*etasminnaṃtare tatrā''jagāma girijā mune \|\| 11 \|\|*

9-11. What has happened has already happened. Now O gods, listen to what is relevant to the context. Let him who will, take up this discharged semen”. After saying this He let it fall on the ground. Urged by the gods Agni became a dove and swallowed it with his beak. O sage, in the meantime Pārvatī came there.

## \|\| 5.2.12 \|\|

*śivāgamavilaṃbe ca dadarśa surapuṃgavān \|*  
*jñātvā tadvṛttamakhilaṃ mahākrodhayutā śivā \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. When Śiva took a long time to return, she hastened there and saw the gods. On coming to know of the incident she became very furious.

## \|\| 5.2.13 \|\|

*uvāca tridaśān sarvān hariprabhṛtikāṃstadā \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. She told Viṣṇu and the gods as follows.

## \|\| 5.2.14 \|\|

*devyuvāca \|*  
*re re suragaṇāssarve yūyaṃ duṣṭā viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*svārthasaṃsādhakā nityaṃ tadarthaṃ paraduḥkhadāḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

The goddess said:—

14\. Hi Hi, O gods, you are wicked and particularly selfish and for that purpose you give pain to others.

## \|\| 5.2.15 \|\|

*svārthahetormaheśānamārādhya paramaṃ prabhum \|*  
*naṣṭaṃ cakrurmadvihāraṃ vaṃdhyā'bhavamahaṃ surāḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. O gods, for the sake of realising your self-interests you all propitiated the lord and spoilt my dalliance. I have become a barren woman therefore.

## \|\| 5.2.16 \|\|

*māṃ virodhya sukhaṃ naiva keṣāṃcidapi nirjarāḥ \|*  
*tasmādduḥkhaṃ bhavedvo hi duṣṭānāṃ tridivaukasām \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. O gods, after offending me none can be happy. Hence O wicked heaven-dwellers, you will remain unhappy.

## \|\| 5.2.17 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*ityuktvā viṣṇupramukhān surānsarvān śaśāpa sā \|*  
*prajvalaṃtī prakopena śailarājasutā śivā \|\| 17 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

17\. After saying these words Pārvatī, the daughter of the king of mountains, blazing with fury cursed Viṣṇu and all other gods.

## \|\| 5.2.18 \|\|

*\|\| pārvatyuvāca \|*  
*adyaprabhṛti devānāṃ vaṃdhyā bhāryā bhavantviti \|*  
*devāśca duḥkhitāssaṃtu nikhilā madvirodhinaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

Pārvatī said:—

18\. From now onwards let the wives of the gods be utterly barren and let the gods who offended me be unhappy.

## \|\| 5.2.19 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*iti śaptvākhilāndevān viṣṇvādyānsakaleśvarī \|*  
*uvāca pāvakaṃ kruddhā bhakṣakaṃ śivaretasaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

19\. Cursing Viṣṇu and other gods, Pārvatī furiously told Agni who had swallowed Śiva’s semen.

## \|\| 5.2.20 \|\|

*pārvatyuvāca \|*  
*sarvabhakṣī bhava śuce pīḍitātmeti nityaśaḥ \|*  
*śivatattvaṃ na jānāsi mūrkho'si surakāryakṛt \|\| 20 \|\|*

Pārvatī said:—

20\. O Agni, be the devourer of everything and let your soul be afflicted. You are a fool. You do not know Śiva’s fundamental principles. You have come forward to carry out the task of the gods.

## \|\| 5.2.21 \|\|

*re re śaṭha mahāduṣṭa duṣṭānāṃ duṣṭabodhavān \|*  
*abhakṣaśśivavīryaṃ yannākārṣīrucitaṃ hi tat \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. It is neither proper nor beneficent to you to have eaten up Śiva’s semen. You are a rogue, a wretched vile, paying heed to the wicked counsel of the wicked.

## \|\| 5.2.22 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*iti śaptvā śivā vahniṃ saheśena nagātmajā \|*  
*jagāma svālayaṃ śīghramasaṃtuṣṭā tato mune \|\| 22 \|\|*

Brahmā said:

22\. After cursing the fire thus, O sage, Pārvatī, the daughter of the mountain, immediately returned to her apartment along with Śiva, dissatisfied that she was.

## \|\| 5.2.23 \|\|

*gatvā śivā śivaṃ samyak bodhayāmāsa yatnataḥ \|*  
*ajījanatparaṃ putraṃ gaṇeśākhyaṃ munīśvara \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. O great sage, after returning she persistently pleaded with Śiva and bore a son named Gaṇeśa.

## \|\| 5.2.24 \|\|

*tadvṛttāṃtamaśeṣaṃ ca varṇayiṣye mune'grataḥ \|*  
*idānīṃ śṛṇu suprītyā guhotpattiṃ vadāmyaham \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. O sage, the details of that story I shall narrate to you later on. Now listen to the story of the birth of Guha which I am going to narrate.

## \|\| 5.2.25 \|\|

*pāvakāditamannādi bhuṃjate nirjarāḥ khalu \|*  
*vedavāṇyeti sarve te sagarbhā abhavansurāḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. The gods are wont to partake of the offerings of food etc. consigned to the fire in accordance with the Vedic text. Hence the gods became pregnant.

## \|\| 5.2.26 \|\|

*tato'sahaṃtastadvīryaṃ pīḍitā hyabhavan surāḥ \|*  
*viṣṇvādyā nikhilāścāti śivā''jñā naṣṭabuddhayaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Unable to endure the force of the semen they became afflicted. Viṣṇu and other gods had already lost their sense at the curse of Pārvatī.

## \|\| 5.2.27 \|\|

*atha viṣṇuprabhṛtikāssarve devā vimohitāḥ \|*  
*dahyamānā yayuḥ śīghraṃ śaraṇaṃ pārvatīpateḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Then Viṣṇu and other gods were overwhelmed and scorched. In this state they sought refuge in Śiva.

## \|\| 5.2.28 \|\|

*śivālayasya te dvāri gatvā sarve vinamrakāḥ \|*  
*tuṣṭuvussaśivaṃ śaṃbhuṃ prītyā sāṃjalayassurāḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. After reaching the threshold of Śivā’s apartment, the gods humbly eulogised Pārvatī and Śiva with pleasure and with palms joined in reverence.

## \|\| 5.2.29 \|\|

*\|\| devā ūcuḥ \|*  
*devadeva mahādeva girijeśa mahāprabho \|*  
*kiṃ jātamadhunā nātha tava māyā duratyayā \|\| 29 \|\|*

The gods said:—

29\. O lord of gods, O great lord, consort of Pārvatī, what has happened now? Your magical power is incapable of being transgressed.

## \|\| 5.2.30 \|\|

*sagarbhāśca vayaṃ jātā dahyamānāśca retasā \|*  
*tava śaṃbho kuru kṛpāṃ nivāraya daśāmimām \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. We have become pregnant and also scorched by your semen. O Śiva, take pity on us. Remove our miserable plight.

## \|\| 5.2.31 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*ityākarṇyā'maranutiṃ parameśaśśivāpatiḥ \|*  
*ājagāma drutaṃ dvāri yatra devāḥ sthitā mune \|\| 31 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

31\. O sage, on hearing the eulogy of the gods, Śiva, the lord of Pārvatī came immediately to the threshold where the gods stood waiting.

## \|\| 5.2.32 \|\|

*āgataṃ śaṃkaraṃ dvāri sarve devāśca sācyutāḥ \|*  
*praṇamya tuṣṭuvuḥ prītyā nartakā bhaktavatsalam \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. The gods including Viṣṇu bowed humbly with great devotion and eulogised Śiva who is favourably disposed to His devotees, who came near the entrance.

## \|\| 5.2.33 \|\|

*\|\| devā ūcuḥ \|*  
*śaṃbho śiva maheśāna tvāṃ natāssma viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*rakṣa naśśaraṇāpannāndahyamānāṃśca retasā \|\| 33 \|\|*

The gods said:—

33\. O Śiva, O great lord, we bow to you particularly, save us seeking refuge in you on being scorched by your semen.

## \|\| 5.2.34 \|\|

*idaṃ duḥkhaṃ hara hara bhavāmo hi mṛtā dhruvam \|*  
*tvāṃ vinā kassamartho'dya devaduḥkhanivā raṇe \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. O Śiva, please remove our misery. We will certainly die otherwise. Save you, none can remove the misery of the gods.

## \|\| 5.2.35 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*iti dīnataraṃ vākyamākarṇya surarāṭ prabhuḥ \|*  
*pratyuvāca vihasyā'tha sa surān bhaktavatsalaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

35\. On hearing these piteous words, the lord of the gods laughingly replied to the gods with his usual sympathy towards his devotees.

## \|\| 5.2.36 \|\|

*\|\| śiva uvāca \|*  
*he hare he vidhe devāssarve śṛṇuta madvacaḥ \|*  
*bhaviṣyati sukhaṃ vo'dya sāvadhānā bhavantu hi \|\| 36 \|\|*

Śiva said:—

36\. O Viṣṇu, O Brahmā, O gods, all of you listen to my words with attention. You will be happy. Be careful.

## \|\| 5.2.37 \|\|

*etadvamata madvīryaṃ drutamevā'khilāssurāḥ \|*  
*sukhinastadviśeṣeṇa śāsanānmama suprabho \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. At my behest you shall vomit this semen virile of mine. You will be happy thereby.

## \|\| 5.2.38 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*ityājñāṃ śirasā'dhāya viṣṇvādyāssakalāssurāḥ \|*  
*akārṣurvamanaṃ śīghraṃ smaraṃtaśśivamavyayam \|\| 38 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

38\. Accepting this command with bent head Viṣṇu and the other gods immediately vomitted it out after duly remembering Śiva the imperishable.

## \|\| 5.2.39 \|\|

*tacchaṃbhuretassvarṇābhaṃ parvatākāramadbhutam \|*  
*abhavatpatitaṃ bhūmau spṛśad dyāmeva suprabham \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. The semen of Śiva lustrous and golden in colour falling on the ground seemed to touch the heaven as it was as huge as a mountain.

## \|\| 5.2.40 \|\|

*abhavansukhinassarve surāssarve'cyutādayaḥ \|*  
*astuvan parameśānaṃ śaṃkaraṃ bhaktavatsalam \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Viṣṇu and other gods became relieved and they eulogised the great lord Śiva who is favourably disposed to His devotees.

## \|\| 5.2.41 \|\|

*pāvakastvabhavannaiva sukhī tatra munīśvara \|*  
*tasyājñāṃ paramo'dādvai śaṃkaraḥ parameśvaraḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. O great sage, only Agni did not become happy. Śiva, the great lord, gave a separate hint to him.

## \|\| 5.2.42 \|\|

*tatassavahnirvikalassāṃjalirnatako mune \|*  
*astaucchivaṃ sukhī nātmā vacanaṃ cedamabravīt \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Then the distressed fire, O sage, eulogised Śiva with palms joined in reverence and piteously spoke these words.

## \|\| 5.2.43-44 \|\|

*\|\| agniruvāca \|*  
*devadeva maheśāna mūḍho'haṃ tava sevakaḥ \|*  
*kṣamasva me'parādhaṃ hi mama dāhaṃ nivāraya \|\| 43 \|\|*

*tvaṃ dīnavatsala svāmiñśaṃkaraḥ parameśvaraḥ \|*  
*pratyuvāca prasannātmā pāvako dīnavatsalam \|\| 44 \|\|*

Agni said:—

43-44. O lord of gods, I am a stupid and deluded servant of yours. Forgive me my fault. Please remove my burning sensation. O lord, you are the benefactor and sympathetic to the distressed.

## \|\| 5.2.45 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*ityākarṇya śucervāṇīṃ sa śaṃbhuḥ parameśvaraḥ \|*  
*pratyuvāca prasannātmā pāvakaṃ dīnavatsalaḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

45\. On hearing the words of Agni, Śiva the great lord spoke delightedly to Agni. He is favourably disposed to His devotees.

## \|\| 5.2.46 \|\|

*śiva uvāca \|*  
*kṛtaṃ tvanucitaṃ karma madreto bhakṣitaṃ hi yat \|*  
*ato'nivṛttaste dāhaḥ pāpādhikyānmadājñayā \|\| 46 \|\|*

Śiva said:—

46\. An improper action has been committed by you in swallowing my semen. Hence your sin has become formidable at my bidding and the burning sensation has not been cured.

## \|\| 5.2.47 \|\|

*idānīṃ tvaṃ sukhī nāma śuce maccharaṇāgataḥ \|*  
*ataḥ prasanno jāto'haṃ sarvaṃ duḥkhaṃ vinaśyati \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Now that you have sought refuge in me you are sure to be happy. I am pleased with you. All your misery will be dissolved.

## \|\| 5.2.48 \|\|

*kasyāścitsustriyāṃ yonau madretastyaja yatnataḥ \|*  
*bhaviṣyati sukhī tvaṃ hi nirdāhātmā viśeṣataḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Deposit carefully that semen in the womb of some good woman. You will become happy and particularly relieved of the burning sensation.

## \|\| 5.2.49 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*śaṃbhuvākyaṃ niśamyeti pratyuvāca śanaiḥ śuciḥ \|*  
*sāṃjalirnatakaḥ prītyā śaṃkaraṃ bhaktaśaṃkaram \|\| 49 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

49\. On hearing these words of Śiva, Agni replied to Śiva, the benefactor of the devotees with pleasure and bowing down with palms joined in reverence.

## \|\| 5.2.50 \|\|

*durāsadamidaṃ tejastava nātha maheśvara \|*  
*kācinnāsti vinā śaktyā dhartuṃ yonau jagattraye \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. “O lord Śiva, this splendour of yours is inaccessible and unbearable. There is no woman in the three worlds except Pārvatī to hold it in her womb.”

## \|\| 5.2.51 \|\|

*itthaṃ yadā'bravīdvahnistadā tvaṃ munisattama \|*  
*śaṃkarapreritaḥ prāttha hṛdāgnimupakārakaḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. O excellent sage, when fire said like this, you, urged by Śiva, said thus in order to help Agni.

## \|\| 5.2.52 \|\|

*\|\| nārada uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu madvacanaṃ vahne tava dāhaharaṃ śubham \|*  
*paramānaṃdadaṃ ramyaṃ sarvakaṣṭanivārakam \|\| 52 \|\|*

Nārada said:—

52\. “O Agni, listen to my words that will dispel your burning sensation. It will yield great pleasure and ward off your pains.

## \|\| 5.2.53 \|\|

*kṛtvopāyamimaṃ vahne sukhī bhava vidāhakaḥ \|*  
*śivecchayā mayā samyaguktaṃ tātedamādarāt \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. O Agni, taking recourse to the following expedient you will be relieved of the burning sensation and be happy. O dear, this has been explained by me well at the will of Śiva.

## \|\| 5.2.54 \|\|

*tapomāsasnānakartryastriyo yāssyuḥ prage śuce \|*  
*taddeheṣu sthāpaya tvaṃ śivaretastvidaṃ mahat \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. O Agni, you shall deposit this semen of Śiva in the bodies of the ladies who take their morning baths in the month of Māgha.”

## \|\| 5.2.55 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*tasminnavasare tatrā 'gatāssaptamunistriyaḥ \|*  
*tapomāsi snānakāmāḥ prātassanniyamā mune \|\| 55 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

55\. O sage, meanwhile the wives of the seven celestial sages came there desirous of taking their early morning bath in the month of Māgha with other observances of rites.

## \|\| 5.2.56 \|\|

*snānaṃ kṛtvā striyastā hi mahāśītārdditāśca ṣaṭ \|*  
*gaṃtukāmā mune yātā vahnijvālāsamīpataḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. After the bath, six of them were distressed by the chillness and were desirous of going near the flame of fire.

## \|\| 5.2.57 \|\|

*vimohitāśca tā dṛṣṭvārundhatī giriśājñayā \|*  
*niṣiṣedha viśeṣeṇa sucaritra subodhinī \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. Arundhatī of good conduct and perfect knowledge saw them deluded and dissuaded them at the behest of Śiva.

## \|\| 5.2.58 \|\|

*tāḥ ṣaḍ munistriyo mohāddhaṭhāttatra gatā mune \|*  
*svaśītavinivṛttyarthaṃ mohitāḥ śivamāyayā \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. O sage, the six ladies stubbornly insisted on going there to ward off their chillness because they were deluded by Śiva’s magical art.

## \|\| 5.2.59 \|\|

*tadretaḥkaṇikāssadyastaddehān viviśurmune \|*  
*romadvārā'khilā vahnirabhūddāhavivarjitaḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. Immediately the particles of the semen entered their bodies through the pores of hairs, O sage. The fire was relieved of their burning sensation.

## \|\| 5.2.60 \|\|

*aṃtardhāya drutaṃ vahnirjvālārūpo jagāma ha \|*  
*sukhī svalokaṃ manasā smaraṃstvāṃ śaṃkaraṃ ca tam \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. Vanishing immediately from the scene, Agni in the form of a flame, went back happily to his region, mentally remembering you and Śiva.

## \|\| 5.2.61 \|\|

*sagarbhāstāḥ striyassādho'bhavan dāhaprapīḍitāḥ \|*  
*jagmussvabhavanaṃ tātāruṃdhatī duḥkhitā'gninā \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. O saintly one, the women became pregnant and were distressed by the burning sensation. They went home. O dear, Arundhatī was displeased with fire.

## \|\| 5.2.62 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā svastrīgatiṃ tāta nāthāḥ krodhākulā drutam \|*  
*tatyajustāḥ striyastāta susaṃmaṃtrya parasparam \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. O dear, the husbands on seeing the plight of their wives became furious. They consulted one another and discarded them.

## \|\| 5.2.63 \|\|

*atha tāḥ ṣaṭ striyassarvā dṛṣṭvā svavyabhicārakam \|*  
*mahāduḥkhānvitāstātā'bhavannākulamānasāḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. O dear, on seeing their own state the six ladies felt very miserable and distressed.

## \|\| 5.2.64 \|\|

*tatyajuśśiva retastadgarbharūpaṃ munistriyaḥ \|*  
*tā himācalapṛṣṭhe'thābhavan dāhavivarjitāḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. The wives of the sages cast off their semen in the form of a foetus at the top of Himavat. They felt then relieved of their burning sensation.

## \|\| 5.2.65 \|\|
