38\. When this man belonging to us is taunted, it amounts to our being taunted. Hence, O gentle lady, you shall not abandon your prestige of high order.

## \|\| 5.14.39 \|\|

*śivo markaṭavatte'dya vartate sarvadā sati \|*  
*kiṃ kariṣyatyahaṃkāramānukūlyaṃ bhaviṣyati \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Śiva always squeezes you like a crab, O Satī. What will he do now? His pride will take a favourable turn for us.

## \|\| 5.14.40 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*aho kṣaṇaṃ sthitā tatra śivecchāvaśatassatī \|\| 40 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

40\. Alas, being subservient to Śiva’s wish, Pārvatī stood there for a moment.

## \|\| 5.14.41 \|\|

*manasyuvāca sā bhūtvā māninī pārvatī tadā \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Then taking up a haughty mood she spoke to herself.

## \|\| 5.14.42 \|\|

*śivovāca \|*  
*aho kṣaṇaṃ sthito naiva haṭhātkāraḥ kathaṃ kṛtaḥ \|*  
*kathaṃ caivātra karttavyaṃ vinayenātha vā punaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

Pārvatī said:—

42\. “Alas, he did not wait for a moment. Why should he force his way in? What shall be done now? Or shall I adopt a humble attitude.

## \|\| 5.14.43 \|\|

*bhaviṣyati bhavatyeva kṛtaṃ naivānyathā punaḥ \|*  
*ityuktvā tu sakhī tatra preṣitā priyayā tadā \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. What is to happen happens. What is done cannot be altered?” After saying this, Pārvatī sent her again lovingly.

## \|\| 5.14.44 \|\|

*samāgatyā'bravītsā ca priyayā kathitaṃ hi yat \|*  
*tamācaṣṭa gaṇeśaṃ taṃ girijātanayaṃ tadā \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. The friend came to the door and told Gaṇeśa what Pārvatī had said with affection.

## \|\| 5.14.45 \|\|

*sakhyuvāca \|*  
*samyakkṛtaṃ tvayā bhadra balātte praviśaṃtu na \|*  
*bhavadagre gaṇā hyete kiṃ jayaṃtu bhavādṛśam \|\| 45 \|\|*

The friend said:—

45\. O gentle sir, well done. Let them not enter forcibly. What are these Gaṇas before you? Can they win a person like you?

## \|\| 5.14.46 \|\|

*kṛtaṃ cedvākṛtaṃ caiva karttavyaṃ kriyatāṃ tvayā \|*  
*jito yastu punarvāpi na vairamatha vā dhruvam \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Whether good or bad let your duty be done. If you are conquered there will be no further enmity at all.

## \|\| 5.14.47 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*iti śrutvā vacastasyā mātuścaiva gaṇeśvaraḥ \|*  
*ānandaṃ paramaṃ prāpa balaṃ bhūri mahonnatim \|\| 47 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

47\. On hearing the words of the friend and his mother Gaṇeśvara became highly delighted, strengthened and lifted up.

## \|\| 5.14.48 \|\|

*baddhakakṣastathoṣṇīṣaṃ baddhvā jaṃghoru saṃspṛśan \|*  
*uvāca tāngaṇān sarvānnirbhayaṃ vacanaṃ mudā \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Girting up his loins, tying his turban firmly and clapping his calves and thighs, he spoke fearlessly to all the Gaṇas.

## \|\| 5.14.49 \|\|

*gaṇeśa uvāca \|*  
*ahaṃ ca girijāsūnuryūyaṃ śivagaṇāstathā \|*  
*ubhaye samatāṃ prāptāḥ kartavyaṃ kriyatāṃ punaḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

Gaṇeśa said:—

49\. I am the son of Pārvatī. You are the Gaṇas of Śiva. Both of us are thus equal. Let your duty be done, now.

## \|\| 5.14.50 \|\|

*bhavaṃto dvārapālāśca dvārapohaṃ kathaṃ na hi \|*  
*bhavaṃtaśca sthitāstatrā'haṃ sthitotreti niścitam \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. You are all doorkeepers. How is it that I am not? You are standing there and I am standing here. This is certain.

## \|\| 5.14.51 \|\|

*bhavadbhiśca sthitaṃ hyatra yadā bhavati niścitam \|*  
*tadā bhavadbhiḥ karttavyaṃ śivājñāparipālanam \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. When it is certain that you are standing here, you must carry out the directions of Śiva.

## \|\| 5.14.52 \|\|

*idānīṃ tu mayā cātra śivājñāparipālanam \|*  
*satyaṃ ca kriyate vīrā nirṇītaṃ me yathocitam \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. O heroes, now I have to carry out the orders of Pārvatī faithfully. I have decided what is proper.

## \|\| 5.14.53 \|\|

*tasmācchivagaṇāssarve vacanaṃ śṛṇutādarāt \|*  
*haṭhādvā vinayādvā na gaṃtavyaṃ mandire punaḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Hence, O Gaṇas of Śiva, you shall listen with attention. You shall not enter the apartment either forcibly or humbly.

## \|\| 5.14.54 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*ityuktāste gaṇenaiva sarve te lajjitā gaṇāḥ \|*  
*yayuśśivāṃtikaṃ taṃ vai namaskṛtya puraḥ sthitāḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

54\. The Gaṇas when decisively told by Gaṇeśa became ashamed. They went to Śiva. After bowing to him they stood in front of him.

## \|\| 5.14.55 \|\|

*sthitvā nyavedayansarve vṛttāṃtaṃ ca tadadbhutam \|*  
*karau baddhvā nataskaṃdhāśśivaṃ stutvā puraḥ sthitāḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. Then they acquainted him with that news of wonderful nature. They joined their palms, stooped their shoulders, eulogised Śiva and stood in front of him.

## \|\| 5.14.56 \|\|

*tatsarvaṃ tu tadā śrutvā vṛttaṃ tatsvagaṇoditam \|*  
*laukikīṃ vṛttimāśritya śaṃkaro vākyamabravīt \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. On hearing the detailed news mentioned by his Gaṇas, Śiva replied following the worldly conventions.

## \|\| 5.14.57 \|\|

*śaṃkara uvāca \|\| śrūyatāṃ ca gaṇāssarve yuddhaṃ yogyaṃ bhavennahi \|*  
*yūyaṃ cātrāsmadīyā vai sa ca gaurīgaṇastathā \|\| 57 \|\|*

Śiva said:—

57\. O Gaṇas, hear you all. A battle may not be a proper course. You are all my own. He is Pārvatī’s Gaṇa.

## \|\| 5.14.58 \|\|

*vinayaḥ kriyate cedvai vaśyaśśaṃbhuḥ striyā sadā \|*  
*iti khyātirbhavelloke garhitā me gaṇā dhuvam \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. But if we are going to be humble, there is likely to be a rumour: “Śiva is subservient to his wife.” O Gaṇas, this is certainly derogatory to me.

## \|\| 5.14.59 \|\|

*kṛte caivātra kartavyamiti nītirgarīyasī \|*  
*ekākī sa gaṇo bālaḥ kiṃ kariṣyati vikramam \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. The policy of meeting an action with another (Tit for tat) is a weighty one. That single-handed Gaṇa is a mere boy. What valour can be expected of him?

## \|\| 5.14.60 \|\|

*bhavaṃtaśca gaṇā loke yuddhe cāti viśāradāḥ \|*  
*madīyāśca kathaṃ yuddhaṃ hitvā yāsyatha lāghavam \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. O Gaṇas, you are all experts in warfare and reputed to be so in the world. You are my own men. How can you forsake war and demean yourselves?

## \|\| 5.14.61 \|\|

*striyā grahaḥ kathaṃ kāryo patyuragre viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*kṛtvā sā girijā tasya nūnaṃ phalamavāpsyati \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. How can a woman be obdurate especially with her husband? Pārvatī will certainly derive the fruit of what she has done.

## \|\| 5.14.62 \|\|

*tasmātsarve ca madvīrāḥ śṛṇutādarato vacaḥ \|*  
*karttavyaṃ sarvathā yuddhaṃ bhāvi yattadbhavatviti \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. Hence, my heroic men, listen to my words with attention. This war has to be fought by all means. Let what is in store happen.”

## \|\| 5.14.63 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*ityuktvā śaṃkaro brahman nānālīlāviśāradaḥ \|*  
*virarāma muniśreṣṭha darśayaṃllaukikīṃ gatim \|\| 63 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

63\. O excellent sage, O brahmin, after saying thus, Śiva an adept in various divine sports became silent observing the ways of the world.

## Chapter 15 - Gaṇeśa’s battle

## \|\| 5.15.1 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*ityuktā vibhunā tena niścayaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ \|*  
*sannaddhāstu tadā tatra jagmuśca śivamandiram \|\| 1 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

1\. When Śiva told them thus, they came to a decisive resolution. They got ready and went to Śiva’s palace.

## \|\| 5.15.2 \|\|

*gaṇeśo'pi tathā dṛṣṭvā hyāyātāngaṇasattamān \|*  
*yuddhā''ṭopaṃ vidhāyaiva sthitāṃścaivābravīdidam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. On seeing the excellent Gaṇas, fully equipped for war, coming, Gaṇeśa spoke thus to them.

## \|\| 5.15.3 \|\|

*gaṇeśa uvāca \|*  
*āyāṃtu gaṇapāssarve śivājñāpa ripālakāḥ \|*  
*ahamekaśca bālaśca śivājñāparipālakaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

Gaṇeśa said:—

3\. Welcome to the leaders of Gaṇas, carrying out the behests of Śiva. I am only one and that too a mere boy carrying out the directions of Pārvatī.

## \|\| 5.15.4 \|\|

*tathāpi paśyatāṃ devī pārvatī sūnujaṃ balam \|*  
*śivaśca svagaṇānāṃ tu balaṃ paśyatu vai punaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Yet let the goddess see the strength of her son. Let Śiva see the strength of his Gaṇas too.

## \|\| 5.15.5 \|\|

*balavadbālayuddhaṃ ca bhavānīśiva pakṣayoḥ \|*  
*bhavadbhiśca kṛtaṃ yuddhaṃ pūrvaṃ yuddhaviśāradaiḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The fight between the parties of Pārvatī and Śiva is the one between a strong army and a boy. You are all experts in warfare and have fought in many a battle.

## \|\| 5.15.6 \|\|

*mayā pūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ naiva bālosmi kriyate'dhunā \|*  
*tathāpi bhavatāṃ lajjā girijāśivayoriha \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. I have never fought in a battle before. I am a mere boy. I am going to fight now. Still if you are put to shame, it will be shameful to Śiva and Pārvatī.

## \|\| 5.15.7 \|\|

*mamaivaṃ tu bhavennaiva vaiparītyaṃ bhaviṣyati \|*  
*mamaiva bhavatāṃ lajjā girijāśivayoriha \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. But that will not happen to me. If I am put to shame, the contrary will happen to me. Pārvatī and Śiva will be put to shame but not I.

## \|\| 5.15.8 \|\|

*evaṃ jñātvā ca karttavyaḥ samaraśca gaṇeśvarāḥ \|*  
*bhavadbhissvāminaṃ dṛṣṭvā mayā ca mātaraṃ tadā \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. O leader of the Gaṇas, the war shall be fought after realising this. You shall look up to your lord and I to my mother.

## \|\| 5.15.9 \|\|

*kriyate kīdṛśaṃ yuddhaṃ bhavitavyaṃ bhavatviti \|*  
*tasya vai vāraṇe ko'pi na samarthastrilokake \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. What sort of a fight shall be fought? Let what is destined to occur, occur. No one in the three worlds can ward it off.

## \|\| 5.15.10 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*ityevaṃ bhartsitāste tu daṃḍabhūṣitabāhavaḥ \|*  
*vividhānyāyudhānyevaṃ dhṛtvā te ca samāyayuḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

10\. When thus taunted and rebuked they rushed towards him with big batons, decorating their arms and taking up different kinds of weapons.

## \|\| 5.15.11 \|\|

*gharṣayantastathā daṃtān huṃkṛtya ca punaḥpunaḥ \|*  
*paśya paśya bruvaṃtaśca gaṇāste samupāgatāḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Gnashing their teeth, grunting and bellowing and calling out “See, See”, the Gaṇas rushed at him.

## \|\| 5.15.12 \|\|

*naṃdī prathamamāgatya dhṛtvā pādaṃ vyakarṣayat \|*  
*dhāvanbhṛṃgī dvitīyaṃ ca pādaṃ dhṛtvā gaṇasya ca \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Nandin came first and caught hold of his leg. He pulled at it. Bhṛṅgin then rushed at him and caught hold of his other leg.

## \|\| 5.15.13 \|\|

*yāvatpāde vikarṣantau tāvaddhastena vai gaṇaḥ \|*  
*āhatya hastayostābhyāmutkṣiptau pādakau svayam \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Before the Gaṇas of Śiva had time to pull his legs Gaṇeśa struck a blow at their hands and got his legs free.

## \|\| 5.15.14 \|\|

*atha devīsuto vīrassagṛhya parighaṃ bṛhat \|*  
*dvārasthito gaṇapatiḥ sarvānāpothayattadā \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Then seizing a big iron club and standing at the doorway he smashed the gaṇas.

## \|\| 5.15.15 \|\|

*keṣāṃcitpāṇayo bhinnāḥ keṣāṃcitpṛṣṭha kāni ca \|*  
*keṣāṃcicca śirāṃsyeva keṣāṃcinmastakāni ca \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Some got their hands broken, others got their backs smothered. The heads of others were shattered and the foreheads of some were crushed.

## \|\| 5.15.16 \|\|

*keṣāṃcijānunī tatra keṣāṃcitskaṃdhakāstathā \|*  
*sammukhe cāgatā ye vai te sarve hṛdaye hatāḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. The knees of some were fractured, the shoulders of others were blasted. Those who came in front were hit in the chest.

## \|\| 5.15.17 \|\|

*kecicca patitābhūmau kecicca vidiśo gatāḥ \|*  
*keṣāṃciccaraṇau chinnau keciccharvāntikaṃ gatāḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Some fell on the ground, some fled in various directions, some got their legs broken and some fled to Śiva.

## \|\| 5.15.18-19 \|\|

*teṣāṃ madhye tu kaścidvai saṃgrāme sammukho na hi \|*  
*siṃhaṃ dṛṣṭvā yathā yāṃti mṛgāścaiva diśo daśa \|\| 18 \|\|*

*tathā te ca gaṇāssarve gatāścaiva sahasraśaḥ \|*  
*parāvṛtya tathā sopi sudvāri samupasthitaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. Now none among them stood face to face. Just as deer flee to any direction on seeing a lion, the Gaṇas, who were thousands in number fled in that manner. Then Gaṇeśa returned to doorway and stood there.

## \|\| 5.15.20 \|\|

*kalpāṃtakaraṇe kālo dṛśyate ca bhayaṃkaraḥ \|*  
*yathā tathaiva dṛṣṭassa sarveṣāṃ pralayaṃkaraḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. He was seen as the annihilator of all in the manner of Yama, the terrible god of death at the end of a Kalpa.

## \|\| 5.15.21 \|\|

*etasminsamaye caiva sarameśasureśvarāḥ \|*  
*preritā nāradeneha devāssarve samāgaman \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. At this time, urged by Nārada, all the gods including Viṣṇu and Indra came there.

## \|\| 5.15.22 \|\|

*samabruvaṃstadā sarve śiva sya hitakāmyayā \|*  
*puraḥsthitvā śivaṃ natvā hyājñāṃ dehi prabho iti \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Standing in front of Śiva and bowing to him with a desire to secure good for him they said—“O lord, be pleased to command us.

## \|\| 5.15.23 \|\|

*tvaṃ parabrahma sarveśassarve ca tava sevakāḥ \|*  
*sṛṣṭeḥ kartā sadā bhartā saṃhartā parameśvaraḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. You are the great Brahman, the lord of all, the creator, the sustainer and the annihilator of all created things. All are your servants.

## \|\| 5.15.24 \|\|

*rajassattvatamorūpo līlayā nirguṇaḥ svataḥ \|*  
*kā līlā racitā cādya tāmidānīṃ vada prabho \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. You are intrinsically devoid of attributes but by means of your sports you assume Rājasika, Sāttvika and Tāmasika forms. O lord, what sort of sport you are indulging in, now?”

## \|\| 5.15.25 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*ityākarṇya vacasteṣāṃ muniśreṣṭha maheśvaraḥ \|*  
*gaṇān bhinnāṃstadā dṛṣṭvā tebhyassarvaṃ nyavedayat \|\| 25 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

25\. O excellent sage, on hearing their words and seeing the Gaṇas completely shattered, lord Śiva told them everything.

## \|\| 5.15.26 \|\|

*atha sarveśvarastatra śaṃkaro munisattama \|*  
*vihasya girijānātho brahmāṇaṃ māmuvāca ha \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. O excellent sage, Śiva, the lord of all, the consort of Pārvatī, then laughingly told me, Brahmā.

## \|\| 5.15.27 \|\|

*śiva uvāca \|*  
*brahmañchṛṇu mama dvāri bāla ekassamāsthitaḥ \|*  
*mahābalo yaṣṭipāṇirgehāveśanivārakaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

Śiva said:—

27\. O Brahmā, listen. A boy is standing at the entrance to my house. He is very strong. He has a staff in his hand. He prevents me from entering the house.

## \|\| 5.15.28 \|\|

*mahāprahārakartā'sau matpārṣadavighātakaḥ \|*  
*parājayaḥ kṛtastena madgaṇānāṃ balādiha \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. He strikes very dexterously. He has destroyed many of my Pārṣadas. He has forcefully defeated my Gaṇas.

## \|\| 5.15.29 \|\|

*brahman tvayaiva gaṃtavyaṃ prasādyo'yaṃ mahābalaḥ \|*  
*yathā brahmannayaḥ syādvai tathā kāryaṃ tvayā vidhe \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. O Brahmā, you alone should go there. This strong boy shall be propitiated. O Brahmā, you shall do everything to bring him under control.

## \|\| 5.15.30 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*ityākarṇya prabhorvākyamajñātvā'jñānamohitaḥ \|*  
*tadīyanikaṭaṃ tāta sarvairṛṣivarairayām \|\| 30 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

30\. On hearing the words of the lord and unable to know the reality, being deluded by ignorance, O dear, I went near Gaṇeśa accompanied by the sages.

## \|\| 5.15.31 \|\|

*samāyāntaṃ ca māṃ dṛṣṭvā sa gaṇeśo mahābalī \|*  
*krodhaṃ kṛtvā samabhyetya mama śmaśrūṇyavākirat \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. On seeing me approaching, the powerful Gaṇeśa came to me very furiously and plucked my moustache and beard.

## \|\| 5.15.32 \|\|

*kṣamyatāṃ kṣamyatāṃ deva na yuddhārthaṃ samāgataḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇohamanugrāhyaḥ śāṃtikartānupadravaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. “Forgive me. Forgive me, O lord. I have not come for fighting. I am a brahmin and shall be blessed. I have come to make peace and I will cause no harm.”

## \|\| 5.15.33 \|\|

*ityevaṃ bruvati brahmaṃstāvatparighamādade \|*  
*sa gaṇeśo mahāvīro bālo'bālaparākramaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. While I said thus, O brahmin, the heroic Gaṇeśa, the boy of great valour uncommon to the boys took up the iron club.

## \|\| 5.15.34 \|\|

*gṛhītaparighaṃ dṛṣṭvā taṃ gaṇeśaṃ mahābalam \|*  
*palāyanaparo yātastvahaṃ drutataraṃ tadā \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. On seeing the powerful Gaṇeśa seizing the iron club I began to run away immediately.

## \|\| 5.15.35 \|\|

*yāta yāta bruvaṃtaste parighena hatāstadā \|*  
*svayaṃ ca patitāḥ kecitkecittena nipātitāḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. The others too who were shouting “Go, Go” were struck down with the iron club. Some fell themselves and some were felled by him.

## \|\| 5.15.36 \|\|

*kecicca śivasāmīpyaṃ gatvā tatkṣaṇamātrataḥ \|*  
*śivaṃ vijñāpayāṃcakrustadvṛttāṃ tamaśeṣataḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Some of them fled to Śiva in a trice and intimated to him the details of the incident.

## \|\| 5.15.37 \|\|

*tathāvidhāṃśca tān dṛṣṭvā tadvṛttāṃtaṃ niśamya saḥ \|*  
*apāramādadhe kopaṃ haro līlāviśāradaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. On seeing them in that plight and on hearing the news, Śiva, an adept in sports became very angry.

## \|\| 5.15.38 \|\|

*iṃdrādikāndevagaṇān ṣaṇmukhapravarān gaṇān \|*  
*bhūtapretapiśācāṃśca sarvānādeśayattadā \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. He issued directives to Indra and other gods, to the Gaṇas led by the six-faced Kumāra and to goblins, ghosts and spirits.

## \|\| 5.15.39 \|\|

*te sarve ca yathāyogyaṃ gatāste sarvato diśam \|*  
*taṃ gaṇaṃ haṃtukāmā hi śivājñātā udāyudhāḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. At the bidding of Śiva they all desired to kill Gaṇeśa. Lifting up their weapons in a suitable manner they came there from all directions.

## \|\| 5.15.40 \|\|

*yasya yasyāyudhaṃ yacca tattatsarvaṃ viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*tadgaṇeśopari balātsamāgatya vimocitam \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Whatever weapon they had was hurled on Gaṇeśa with force.

## \|\| 5.15.41 \|\|

*hāhākāro mahānāsīttrailokye sacarācare \|*  
*trilokasthā janāssarve saṃśayaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. There was a great hue and cry in all the three worlds consisting of the mobile and immobile. The inhabitants of the worlds were in a great fix and uncertainty.

## \|\| 5.15.42 \|\|

*na yātaṃ brahmaṇo'pyāyurbrahmāṃḍa kṣayameti hi \|*  
*akāle ca tathā nūnaṃ śivecchāvaśataḥ svayam \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. “Brahma’s life span is not over, but the whole universe is undergoing untimely destruction. Certainly it is due to Śiva’s wish.

## \|\| 5.15.43 \|\|

*te sarve cāgatāstatra ṣaṇmukhādyāśca ye punaḥ \|*  
*devā vyarthāyudhā jātā āścaryaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. The sixfaced deity and the other gods who came there failed to use their weapons effectively. They were very much surprised.

## \|\| 5.15.44 \|\|

*etasminnantare devī jagadambā vibodhanā \|*  
*jñātvā taccaritaṃ sarvamapāraṃ krodhamādadhe \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. In the meantime, goddess, the mother of the universe, of special knowledge, came to know of the entire incident and was very furious.

## \|\| 5.15.45 \|\|

*śaktidvayaṃ tadā tatra tayā devyā munīśvara \|*  
*nirmitaṃ svagaṇasyaiva sarvasāhāyyahetave \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. O great sage, the goddess created two Śaktis then and there for the assistance of her own Gaṇa.

## \|\| 5.15.46 \|\|

*ekā pracaṃḍarūpaṃ ca dhṛtvātiṣṭhanmahāmune \|*  
*śyāmaparvatasaṃkāṃśaṃ vistīrya mukhagahvaram \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. O great sage, one Śakti assumed a very fierce form and stood there opening her mouth as wide as the cavern of a dark mountain.

## \|\| 5.15.47 \|\|

*ekā vidyutsvarūpā ca bahuhastasamanvitā \|*  
*bhayaṃkarā mahādevī duṣṭadaṃḍavidhāyinī \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. The other assumed the form of lightning. She wore many arms. She was a huge and terrible goddess ready to punish the wicked.

## \|\| 5.15.48 \|\|

*āyudhāni ca sarvāṇi mocitāni surairgaṇaiḥ \|*  
*gṛhītvā svamukhe tāni tābhyāṃ śīghraṃ ca cikṣipe \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. The weapons hurled by the gods and the Gaṇas were caught in the mouth and hurled back at them.

## \|\| 5.15.49 \|\|

*devāyudhaṃ na dṛśyeta parighaḥ paritaḥ punaḥ \|*  
*evaṃ tābhyāṃ kṛtaṃ tatra caritaṃ paramādbhutam \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. None of the weapons of the gods was seen anywhere around the iron club of Gaṇeśa. This wonderful feat was performed by them.

## \|\| 5.15.50 \|\|

*eko bālo'khilaṃ sainyaṃ loḍayāmāsa dustaram \|*  
*yathā girivareṇaiva loḍitassāgaraḥ purā \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. A single boy stirred and churned the vast impassable army in the same manner as great mountain churned the ocean of milk formerly.

## \|\| 5.15.51 \|\|

*ekena nihatāssarve śakrādyā nirjarāstathā \|*  
*śaṃkarasya gaṇāścaiva vyākulāḥ abhavaṃstadā \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Indra and other gods were struck by him, singlehanded. The Gaṇas of Śiva became agitated and distressed then.

## \|\| 5.15.52 \|\|

*atha sarve militvā te niśśvasya ca muhurmuhuḥ \|*  
*parasparaṃ samūcuste tatprahārasamākulāḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. Gasping frequently for their breath, being utterly shaken by his blows they gathered together and spoke to one another.

The gods and Gaṇas said'.—

## \|\| 5.15.53 \|\|

*devagaṇā ūcuḥ \|*  
*kiṃ kartavyaṃ kva gaṃtavyaṃ na jñāyaṃte diśo daśa \|*  
*parighaṃ bhrāmayatyeṣa savyāpasavyameva ca \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. “What shall be done? Where should we go? The ten directions have become visible. He is whirling the iron club right and left.”

## \|\| 5.15.54-55 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*etatkāle'psaraśreṣṭhāḥ puṣpacandanapāṇayaḥ \|*  
*ṛṣayaśca tvadādyā hi ye'tiyuddhetilālasāḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

*te sarve ca samājagmuryuddhasaṃdarśanāya vai \|*  
*pūrito vyoma sanmārgastaistadā munisattama \|\| 55 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

54-55. In the meantime the excellent nymphs came there with flowers and sandal paste in their hands. You and other gods who were eager to witness the fight came there. O excellent sage, the excellent pathway of the firmament was entirely filled by them.

## \|\| 5.15.56 \|\|

*tāste dṛṣṭvā raṇaṃ taṃ vai mahāvismayamāgatāḥ \|*  
*īdṛśaṃ paramaṃ yuddhaṃ na dṛṣṭaṃ caikadāpi hi \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. Seeing the battle they were much surprised. Such a battle had never been witnessed by them before.

## \|\| 5.15.57 \|\|

*pṛthivī kaṃpitā tatra samudrasahitā tadā \|*  
*parvatāḥ patitāścaiva cakruḥ saṃgrāmasaṃbhavam \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. The earth with all the oceans quaked. As a result of the violent battle even mountains fell down.

## \|\| 5.15.58 \|\|

*dyaurgraharkṣagaṇairghūrṇṇā sarve vyākulatāṃ gatāḥ \|*  
*devāḥ palāyitāssarve gaṇāśca sakalāstadā \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. The sky whirled with the planets and the stars. Everything was agitated. The gods fled. The Gaṇas too did likewise.

## \|\| 5.15.59 \|\|

*kevalaṃ ṣaṇmukhastatra nāpalāyata vikramī \|*  
*mahāvīrastadā sarvānāvārya purataḥ sthitaḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. The valorous sixfaced deity alone did not flee. The great warrior stopped everyone and stood in front.

## \|\| 5.15.60 \|\|

*śaktidvayena tadyuddhe sarve ca niṣphalīkṛtāḥ \|*  
*sarvāstrāṇi nikṛttāni saṃkṣiptānyamarairgaṇaiḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. But the Gaṇas fought in vain with the two Śaktis. The weapons of the gods and the Gaṇas were broken and hence withdrawn by them.

## \|\| 5.15.61 \|\|

*ye'va sthitāśca te sarve śivasyāṃtikamāgatāḥ \|*  
*devāḥ palāyitāssarve gaṇāśca sakalāstadā \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. Those that tarried went to Śiva. All the gods and Gaṇas fled.

## \|\| 5.15.62 \|\|

*te sarve militāścaiva muhurnatvā śivaṃ tadā \|*  
*abruvanvacanaṃ kṣipraṃ ko'yaṃ gaṇavaraḥ prabho \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. Those who went in a body to Śiva bowed to him again and again and asked Śiva immediately “O lord who is that excellent Gaṇa?”

## \|\| 5.15.63 \|\|

*purā caiva śrutaṃ yuddhamidānīṃ bahudhā punaḥ \|*  
*dṛśyate na śrutaṃ dṛṣṭamīdṛśaṃ tu kadācana \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. We have heard that battles used to be fought formerly. Even now many battles are being fought. But never was such a battle seen or heard.

## \|\| 5.15.64 \|\|

*kiṃcidvicāryatāṃ deva tvanyathā na jayo bhavet \|*  
*tvameva rakṣakassvāminbrahmāṃḍasya na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. O lord, let this be pondered over a little. Otherwise no victory is possible. O lord, you alone are the saviour of the universe. There is no doubt about it.”

## \|\| 5.15.65 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*ityevaṃ tadvacaḥ śrutvā rudraḥ paramakopanaḥ \|*  
*kopaṃ kṛtvā ca tatraiva jagāma svagaṇaissaha \|\| 65 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

65\. On hearing their words, the furious Rudra became more furious and went there along with his Gaṇas.

## \|\| 5.15.66 \|\|

*devasainyaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ viṣṇunā cakriṇā saha \|*  
*samutsavaṃ mahatkṛtvā śivasyānujagāma ha \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. The entire army of the gods along with the discusbearing Viṣṇu shouted in jubilation and followed Śiva.

## \|\| 5.15.67 \|\|

*etasminnaṃtare bhaktyā namaskṛtya maheśvaram \|*  
*abravīnnārada tvaṃ vai devadevaṃ kṛtāṃjaliḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. In the meantime, bowing to Śiva, the lord of the gods with palms joined in reverence, O Nārada, you spoke as follows.

## \|\| 5.15.68 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*devadeva mahādeva śṛṇu madvacanaṃ vibho \|*  
*tvameva sarvagassvāmī nānālīlāviśāradaḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

Nārada said:—

68\. “O lord of the gods, please listen to my words. You are the all-pervading lord and expert in various sports.

## \|\| 5.15.69 \|\|

*tvayā kṛtvā mahālīlāṃ gaṇagarvo'pahāritaḥ \|*  
*asmai dattvā balaṃ bhūri devagarvaśca śaṃkara \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. By indulging in a great sport, the arrogance of the Gaṇas has been removed by you. O Śaṅkara, the impudence of the gods too has been removed by giving this (Gaṇeśa) much strength.

## \|\| 5.15.70 \|\|

*darśitaṃ bhuvane nātha svameva balamadbhutam \|*  
*svataṃtreṇa tvayā śaṃbho sarvagarvaprahāriṇā \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. O lord Śiva, your own wonderful strength has been known to the worlds, you who independently remove the haughtiness of everyone.

## \|\| 5.15.71 \|\|

*idānīṃ na kuruṣveśa tāṃ līlāṃ bhaktavatsalaḥ \|*  
*svagaṇānamarāṃścāpi susanmānyābhivarddhaya \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. O lord who are favourably disposed to your devotees, do not indulge in that sport. Please honour your own Gaṇas and the gods suitably and make them flourish.

## \|\| 5.15.72 \|\|

*na khelayedānīṃ jahi brahmapadaprada \|*  
*ityuktvā nārada tvaṃ vai hyaṃtarddhānaṃ gatastadā \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. O bestower of the region of Brahman, please do not treat him leisurely but kill him in your play now.” O Nārada, after saying this, you vanished from the place.

## Chapter 16 - The head of Gaṇeśa is chopped off during the battle

## \|\| 5.16.1 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*iti śrutvā maheśāno bhaktānugrahakārakaḥ \|*  
*tvadvācā yudakāmobhūttena bālena nārada \|\| 1 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

1\. O Nārada, on hearing your words, the great lord who grants benediction to his devotees became desirous of fighting with the boy.

## \|\| 5.16.2 \|\|

*viṣṇumāhūya saṃmaṃtrya balena mahatā yutaḥ \|*  
*sāmarassammukhastasyāpyabhūddevastrilocanaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. He called Viṣṇu and consulted him. Then with a great army and the gods, He, the three-eyed lord, stood face to face with him.

## \|\| 5.16.3 \|\|

*devāśca yuyudhustena smṛtvā śivapadāmbujam \|*  
*mahābalā mahotsāhāśśivasaddṛṣṭilokitāḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. After remembering the lotuslike feet of Śiva, the gods possessing great strength, kindly glanced at by Śiva and highly jubilant, fought with him.

## \|\| 5.16.4 \|\|

*yuyudhe'tha haristena mahābalaparākramaḥ \|*  
*mahādevyāyudho vīraḥ pravaṇaḥ śivarūpakaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Viṣṇu of great strength, valour and skill and possessing great divine weapons and Śiva’s form fought with him.

## \|\| 5.16.5 \|\|

*yaṣṭyā gaṇādhipassotha jaghānāmarapuṅgavān \|*  
*hariṃ ca sahasā vīraśśaktidattamahābalaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Gaṇeśa hit all the chief gods with his staff. He hit Viṣṇu too, all of a sudden. The hero had been conferred great strength by the Śaktis.

## \|\| 5.16.6 \|\|

*sarve'maragaṇāstatra vikuṃṭhitabalā mune \|*  
*abhūvan viṣṇunā tena hatā yaṣṭyā parāṅmukhāḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. O sage, all the gods including Viṣṇu were hit by him with the stick. They were turned back with their strength sapped.

## \|\| 5.16.7 \|\|

*śivopi saha sainyena yuddhaṃ kṛtvā ciraṃ mune \|*  
*vikarālaṃ ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. O sage, after fighting for a long time along with the army and seeing him terrific, even Śiva was greatly surprised.

## \|\| 5.16.8 \|\|

*chalenaiva ca haṃtavyo nānyathā hanyate punaḥ \|*  
*iti buddhiṃ samāsthāya sainyamadhye vyavasthitaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Thinking within himself “He has to be killed only by deception and not otherwise” he stayed in the midst of the army.

## \|\| 5.16.9-10 \|\|

*śive dṛṣṭe tadā deve nirguṇe guṇarūpiṇi \|*  
*viṣṇau caivātha saṃgrāme āyāte sarvadevatāḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*gaṇāścaiva maheśasya mahāharṣaṃ tadā yayuḥ \|*  
*sarve parasparaṃ prītyā militvā cakrurutsavam \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. When lord Śiva who though devoid of attributes had assumed the attributive form was seen in the battle, when Viṣṇu too had come thither, the gods and Gaṇas of Śiva were highly delighted. They joined together and became jubilant.

## \|\| 5.16.11 \|\|

*atha śaktisuto vīro vīragatyā svayaṣṭitaḥ \|*  
*prathama pūjayāmāsa viṣṇuṃ sarvasukhāvaham \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Then Gaṇeśa the heroic son of Śakti following the course of heroes, at first worshipped (i.e struck) Viṣṇu with his staff, Viṣṇu who confers happiness to all.

## \|\| 5.16.12-13 \|\|

*ahaṃ ca mohayiṣyāmi hanyatāṃ ca tvayā vibho \|*  
*chalaṃ vinā na vadhyo'yaṃ tāmasoyaṃ durāsadaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*iti kṛtvā matiṃ tatra susaṃmaṃtrya ca śaṃbhunā \|*  
*ājñāṃ prāpyā'bhavacchaivī viṣṇurmohaparāyaṇaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. “I shall cause him delusion. Then let him be killed by you, O lord. Without deception he cannot be killed. He is of Tāmasika nature and inaccessible.” Thinking thus and consulting Śiva, Viṣṇu secured Śiva’s permission and was engaged in the activities of delusion.

## \|\| 5.16.14 \|\|

*śaktidvayaṃ tathā līnaṃ hariṃ dṛṣṭvā tathāvidham \|*  
*dattvā śaktibalaṃ tasmai gaṇeśāyābhavanmune \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. O sage, on seeing Viṣṇu in that manner, the two Śaktis handed over their power to Gaṇeśa and became submerged.

## \|\| 5.16.15 \|\|

*śaktidvaye'tha saṃlīne yatra viṣṇuḥ sthitassvayam \|*  
*parighaṃ kṣiptavāṃstatra gaṇeśo balavattaraḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. When the two Śaktis became submerged, Gaṇeśa with more strength infused in him hurled the iron club in the place where Viṣṇu stood.

## \|\| 5.16.16 \|\|

*kṛtvā yatnaṃ kimapyatra vaṃcayāmāsa tadgatim \|*  
*śivaṃ smṛtvā maheśānaṃ svaprabhuṃ bhaktavatsalam \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Viṣṇu strenuously dodged the same after remembering Śiva, the great lord, favourably disposed towards His devotees.

## \|\| 5.16.17 \|\|

*ekatastanmukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā śaṃkaropyājagāma ha \|*  
*svatriśūlaṃ samādāya sukruddho yuddhakāmyayā \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Seeing his face on a side, the infuriated Śiva took up his trident with a desire to fight and came there.

## \|\| 5.16.18 \|\|

*sa dadarśāgataṃ śaṃbhuṃ śūlahstaṃ maheśvaram \|*  
*haṃtukāmaṃ nijaṃ vīraśśivāputro mahābalaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Pārvatī’s son of great strength and heroism, saw Śiva arrived there with desire to fight him to a finish, the great lord with the trident in his hand.

## \|\| 5.16.19 \|\|

*śaktyā jaghāna taṃ haste smṛtvā mātṛpadāṃbujam \|*  
*sa gaṇaśo mahāvīraśśivaśaktipravarddhitaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Gaṇeśa, the great hero, who had been rendered more powerful by Pārvatī and the Śaktis remembered the lotuslike feet of his mother and struck him in his hand with his Śakti.

## \|\| 5.16.20 \|\|

*triśūlaṃ patitaṃ hastācchivasya paramātmanaḥ \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā sadūtikastaṃ vai pinākaṃ dhanurādade \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Thereupon the trident fell from the hand of Śiva of supreme soul. Seeing this, Śiva the source of great enjoyment and protection took up his bow Pināka.

## \|\| 5.16.21 \|\|

*tamapyapātayadbhūmau parigheṇa gaṇeśvaraḥ \|*  
*hatāḥ paṃca tathā hastāḥ pañcabhiśśūlamādade \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Gaṇeśa felled that to the ground by means of his iron club. Five of his hands too were struck. He took up the trident with the other five hands.

## \|\| 5.16.22 \|\|

*aho duḥkhataraṃ nūnaṃ saṃjātamadhunā mama \|*  
*bhavetpunargaṇānāṃ kiṃ bhavācārī jagāviti \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. “Alas, this has been more distressing even to me. What may not happen to the Gaṇas? Śiva who followed the worldly conventions cried out like this.

## \|\| 5.16.23 \|\|

*etasminnaṃtare vīraḥ parigheṇa gaṇeśvaraḥ \|*  
*jaghāna sagaṇān devānśaktidattabalānvitaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. In the meantime the heroic Gaṇeśa endowed with the surplus power bestowed by the Śaktis struck the gods and the Gaṇas with his iron club.

## \|\| 5.16.24 \|\|

*gatā daśadiśo devāssagaṇā parighārdditāḥ \|*  
*na tasthussamare kepi tenādbhutaprahā riṇā \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. The gods and the Gaṇas smothered by that wonderful striker with the iron club went away to the ten directions. None of them remained in the battlefield.

## \|\| 5.16.25-27 \|\|

*viṣṇustaṃ ca gaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā dhanyoyamiti cābravīt \|*  
*mahābalo mahāvīro mahāśūro raṇapriyaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*bahavo devatāścaiva mayā dṛṣṭāstathā punaḥ \|*  
*dānavā bahavo daityā yakṣagaṃdharvarākṣasāḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*naitena gaṇanāthena samatāṃ yāṃti kepi ca \|*  
*trailokye'pyakhile tejo rūpaśauryaguṇādibhiḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

25-27. On seeing Gaṇeśa, Viṣṇu said—“He is blessed. He is a great hero of great strength. He is valorous and fond of battle. Many gods, Danavas, Daityas, Yakṣas, Gandharvas, and Rakṣasas I have seen. In the entire extent of the three worlds, none of them can equal Gaṇeśa in regard to brilliance, form, features, valour and other qualities.”

## \|\| 5.16.28 \|\|

*evaṃ saṃbruvate'muṣmai parighaṃ bhrāmayan sa ca \|*  
*cikṣepa viṣṇave tatra śaktiputro gaṇeśvaraḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Gaṇeśa, son of the Śaktis whirled the iron club and hurled it at Viṣṇu even as he was saying so.

## \|\| 5.16.29 \|\|

*cakraṃ gṛhītvā hariṇā smṛtvā śivapadāmbujam \|*  
*tena cakreṇa parigho drutaṃ khaṃḍīkṛtastadā \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. After remembering the lotus-like feet of Śiva, Viṣṇu took up his discus and split the iron club by means of discus.

## \|\| 5.16.30 \|\|

*khaṃḍaṃ tu parighasyāpi haraye prākṣipadgaṇaḥ \|*  
*gṛhītvā garuḍenāpi pakṣiṇā viphalīkṛtaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Gaṇeśa hurled the piece of iron club at Viṣṇu which was caught by the bird Garuḍa and rendered futile.

## \|\| 5.16.31 \|\|

*evaṃ vicaritaṃ kālaṃ mahāvīrāvubhāvapi \|*  
*viṣṇuścāpi gaṇaścaiva yuyudhāte parasparam \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Thus for a long time the two heroes Viṣṇu and Gaṇeśa fought with each other.

## \|\| 5.16.32 \|\|

*punarvīravaraśśaktisutassmṛtaśivo balī \|*  
*gṛhītvā yaṣṭimatulāṃ tayā viṣṇuṃ jaghāna ha \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Again the foremost among heroes, the son of Pārvatī took up his staff of unrivalled power remembering Śiva and struck Viṣṇu with it.

## \|\| 5.16.33 \|\|

*aviṣahya prahāraṃ taṃ sa bhūmau nipapāta ha \|*  
*drutamutthāya yuyudhe śivāputreṇa tena vai \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Struck with that unbearable blow he fell on the ground. But he got up, quickly and fought with Pārvatī’s son.

## \|\| 5.16.34 \|\|

*etadaṃtaramāsādya śūlapāṇistathottare \|*  
*āgatya ca triśūlena tacchiro nirakṛṃtata \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Securing this opportunity, the Trident-bearing deity came there and cut off his head with his trident.

## \|\| 5.16.35 \|\|

*chinne śirasi tasyaiva gaṇanāthasya nārada \|*  
*gaṇasainyaṃ devasainyamabhavacca suniścalam \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. O Nārada, when the head of Gaṇeśa was cut off, the armies of the gods and the Gaṇas stood still.

## \|\| 5.16.36 \|\|

*nāradena tvayā''gatya devyai sarvaṃ niveditam \|*  
*mānini śrūyatāṃ mānastyājyo naiva tvayādhunā \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. You, Nārada, then came and acquainted Pārvatī with the matter—“O proud woman, listen. You shall not cast off your pride and prestige.”

## \|\| 5.16.37 \|\|

*ityuktvā'ntarhitastatra nārada tvaṃ kalipriyaḥ \|*  
*avikārī sadā śaṃbhurmanogatikaro muniḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. O Nārada, saying this, you, fond of quarrels, vanished from there. You are the unchanging sage and a follower of the inclinations of Śiva.

## Chapter 17 - The Resuscitation of Gaṇeśa

## \|\| 5.17.1 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*brahman vada mahāprājña tadvṛttāntekhile śrute \|*  
*kimakārṣīnmahādevī śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

Nārada said:—

1\. O Brahmā, of great intellect, please narrate. When the entire news was heard what did the great goddess Pārvatī do? I wish to hear all in fact.

## \|\| 5.17.2 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*śrūyatāṃ muniśārdūla kathayāmyadya taddhruvam \|*  
*caritaṃ jagadaṃbāyā yajjātaṃ tadanaṃtaram \|\| 2 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

2\. O foremost among sages, listen. I shall mention the story of the mother of the universe in the manner that it happened afterwards.

## \|\| 5.17.3 \|\|

*mṛdaṃgānpaṭahāṃścaiva gaṇāścāvādayaṃstathā \|*  
*mahotsavaṃ tadā cakrurhate tasmingaṇādhipe \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. When Gaṇeśa was killed, the Gaṇas were very jubilant. They played on Mṛdaṅgas and Paṭahas.

## \|\| 5.17.4 \|\|

*śivopi tacchiraśchitvā yāvadduḥkhamupādade \|*  
*tāvacca girijā devī cukrodhāti munīśvara \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. After cutting off the head of Gaṇeśa even as Śiva became sorry, goddess Pārvatī became furious, O great sage.

## \|\| 5.17.5 \|\|

*kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi hāhāduḥkhamupāgatam \|*  
*kathaṃ duḥkhaṃ vinaśyetāsyā'tidukhaṃ mamādhunā \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. “O what shall I do? Where shall I go? Alas, great misery has befallen me. How can this misery, this great misery be dispelled now?

## \|\| 5.17.6 \|\|

*matsuto nāśitaścādya devessarvairgaṇaistathā \|*  
*sarvāṃstānnāśayiṣyāmi pralayaṃ vā karomyaham \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. “My son has been killed by all the gods and the Gaṇas. I shall destroy them all or create a deluge.”

## \|\| 5.17.7 \|\|

*ityevaṃ duḥkhitā sā ca śaktīśśatasahasraśaḥ \|*  
*nirmame tatkṣaṇaṃ kruddhā sarvalokamaheśvarī \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Lamenting thus, the great goddess of all the worlds angrily created in a moment hundreds and thousands of Śaktis.

## \|\| 5.17.8 \|\|

*nirmitāstā namaskṛtya jagadaṃbāṃ śivāṃ tadā \|*  
*jājvalyamānā hyavadanmātarādiśyatāmiti \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Śaktis who were thus created, bowed to Pārvatī, the mother of the universe and blazing brilliantly spoke—“O mother, be pleased to command.”

## \|\| 5.17.9 \|\|

*tacchutvā śaṃbhuśaktissā prakṛtiḥ krodhatatparā \|*  
*pratyuvāca tu tāssarvā mahāmāyā munīśvara \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. O great sage, on hearing that, Pārvatī, the Śakti of Śiva, the Prakṛti, the great Māyā, spoke to them all in great fury.

## \|\| 5.17.10 \|\|

*devyuvāca \|*  
*he śaktayo'dhunā devyo yuṣmābhirmannideśataḥ \|*  
*pralayaścātra karttavyo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā \|\| 10 \|\|*

The goddess said:—

10\. O Śaktis, O goddesses, now a great deluge shall be created by you at my bidding. You need not hesitate in this regard.

## \|\| 5.17.11 \|\|

*devāṃścaiva ṛṣīṃścaiva yakṣarākṣasakāṃstathā \|*  
*asmadīyānparāṃścaiva sakhyo bhakṣata vai haṭhāt \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. “O friends, devour forcibly all these sages, gods, Yakṣas, Rākṣasas belonging to us and others.”

## \|\| 5.17.12 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*tadājñaptāśca tāssarvāśśaktayaḥ krodhatatparāḥ \|*  
*devādīnāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ saṃhāraṃ kartumudyatāḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

12\. On being commanded by her, the infuriated Śaktis got ready to destroy the gods and others.

## \|\| 5.17.13 \|\|

*yathā ca tṛṇasaṃhāramanalaḥ kurute tathā \|*  
*evaṃ tāśśaktayassarvāssaṃhāraṃ kartumudyatāḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Just as the fire consumes dry grass so also these Śaktis attempted to destroy.

## \|\| 5.17.14-15 \|\|

*gaṇapo vātha viṣṇurvā brahmā vā śaṃkarastathā \|*  
*indro vā yakṣarājo vā skaṃdo vā sūrya eva vā \|\| 14 \|\|*

*sarveṣāṃ caiva saṃhāraṃ kurvaṃti sma niraṃtaram \|*  
*yatrayatra tu dṛśyeta tatratatrāpi śaktayaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. Leaders of Gaṇas or Viṣṇu, Brahmā or Śiva, Indra or Kubera, Skanda or the Sun—Śaktis began to destroy them. Wherever one looked, Śaktis were present.

## \|\| 5.17.16 \|\|

*karālī kubjakā khaṃjā laṃbaśīrṣā hyanekaśaḥ \|*  
*haste dhṛtvā tu devāṃśca mukhe caivākṣipaṃstadā \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Karālīs (the Terrific), Kubjakās (the humpbacked), Khañjās (the lame), Lambaśīrṣās (the tall-headed) the innumerable Śaktis took up the gods with their hands and threw them in their own mouths.

## \|\| 5.17.17-18 \|\|

*taṃ saṃhāraṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā haro brahmā tathā hariḥ \|*  
*indrādayo'khilāḥ devā gaṇāśca ṛṣayastathā \|\| 17 \|\|*

*kiṃ kariṣyati sā devī saṃhāraṃ vāpyakālataḥ \|*  
*iti saṃśayamāpannā jīvanāśā hatā'bhavat \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. On seeing that Śiva, Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Indra, the other gods, Gaṇas and the sages began to doubt what the Goddess Pārvatī would be doing, whether she would create an untimely dissolution. Their hopes and aspirations for life were quelled.

## \|\| 5.17.19 \|\|

*sarve ca militāśceme ki karttavyaṃ viciṃtyatām \|*  
*evaṃ vicārayantaste tūrṇamūcuḥ parasparam \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. They all gathered together and discussed—“What shall be done now? Let us ponder.” Discussing thus they spoke to one another.

## \|\| 5.17.20 \|\|

*yadā ca girijā devī prasannā hi bhavediha \|*  
*tadā caiva bhavetsvāsthyaṃ nānyathā koṭiyatnataḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. “Only when the goddess Pārvatī is pleased can there be a relief; not otherwise, even with our maximum efforts.

## \|\| 5.17.21 \|\|

*śivopi duḥkhamāpanno laukikīṃ gatimāśritaḥ \|*  
*mohayansakalāṃstatra nānālīlāviśāradaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Even Śiva who is an expert in different sports and is deluding us all, seems distressed like an ordinary man.

## \|\| 5.17.22 \|\|

*sarveṣāṃ caiva devānāṃ kaṭirbhagnā yadā tadā \|*  
*śivā krodhamayī sākṣādgaṃtuṃ na pura utsahet \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. When the hips of all the gods are broken and Pārvatī is fiery in rage, none of them dare stand before her.

## \|\| 5.17.23-24 \|\|

*svīyo vā parakīyo vā devo vā dānavopi vā \|*  
*gaṇo vāpi ca dikpālo yakṣo vā kinnaro muniḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*viṣṇurvāpi tathā brahmā śaṃkaraśca tathā prabhuḥ \|*  
*na kaścidgirijāgre ca sthātuṃ śakto'bhavanmune \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. Whether a person belonging to her or to others, whether a god, a demon, a Gaṇa, a guardian of the quarters, a Yakṣa, a Kinnara, a Sage, Brahmā, Viṣṇu or even lord Śiva himself, none could stand before Śiva.

## \|\| 5.17.25 \|\|

*jājvalyamānaṃ tattejassarvatodāhi te'khilāḥ \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā bhītatarā āsan sarve dūrataraṃ sthitāḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. On seeing her dazzling brilliance, burning all round, all of them were frightened and they stayed far away.

## \|\| 5.17.26 \|\|

*etasminsamaye tatra nārado divyadarśanaḥ \|*  
*āgatastvaṃ mune devagaṇānāṃ sukhahetave \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. In the meantime, O sage Nārada, you of divine vision came there for the happiness of the gods and Gaṇas.

## \|\| 5.17.27 \|\|

*brahmāṇaṃ māṃ bhavaṃ viṣṇuṃ śaṃkaraṃ ca praṇamya sāḥ \|*  
*samāgatya militvoce vicārya kāryameva vā \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. After bowing to me, Brahmā, Viṣṇu and Śiva and discussing jointly, he said—“Let us think and act together.”

## \|\| 5.17.28 \|\|

*sarve saṃmaṃtrayāṃ cakrustvayā devā mahātmanā \|*  
*duḥkhaśāṃtiḥ kathaṃ syādvai samūcustata eva te \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. The gods then discussed with you of noble soul “How could our misery be quelled.” They then said.

## \|\| 5.17.29 \|\|

*yāvacca girijā devī kṛpāṃ naiva kariṣyati \|*  
*tāvannaiva sukhaṃ syādvai nātra kāryā vicāraṇā \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. As long as the goddess Pārvatī does not favour us there will be no happiness. No suspicion need be entertained in this matter.

## \|\| 5.17.30 \|\|

*ṛṣayo hi tvadādyāśca gatāste vai śivāntikam \|*  
*sarve prasādayāmāsuḥ krodhaśāntyai tadā śivām \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. You and other sages went to Pārvatī in order to appease her anger. They then propitiated her.

## \|\| 5.17.31 \|\|

*punaḥ punaḥ praṇemuśca stutvā stotrairanekaśaḥ \|*  
*sarve prasādayanprītyā procurdevagaṇājñayā \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. They bowed to her again and again. They eulogised her with many hymns. They tried to please her with devotion and at the behest of the gods and Gaṇas spoke thus.

## \|\| 5.17.32 \|\|

*surarṣaya ūcuḥ \|*  
*jagadamba namastubhyaṃ śivāyai te namostu te \|*  
*caṃḍikāyai namastubhyaṃ kalyāṇyai te namostu te \|\| 32 \|\|*

The celestial sages said:—

32\. O Mother of the universe, obeisance to you. Obeisance to you, O Śivā. Obeisance to you. O Caṇḍikā. Obeisance to you, Kalyāṇī.

## \|\| 5.17.33 \|\|

*ādiśaktistvamevāṃba sarvasṛṣṭikarī sadā \|*  
*tvameva pālinī śaktistvameva pralayaṃkarī \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. O mother, you alone are the primordial Śakti. You are the eternal cause of creation. You alone are the sustaining power. You alone are the cause of dissolution.

## \|\| 5.17.34 \|\|

*prasannā bhava deveśi śāṃtiṃ kuru namostu te \|*  
*sarvaṃ hi vikalaṃ devi trijagattava kopataḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. O goddess, be pleased. Spread peace. Obeisance be to you. O goddess, the three worlds are agitated by your fury.

## \|\| 5.17.35 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*evaṃ stutā parā devī ṛṣibhiśca tvadādibhiḥ \|*  
*kruddhadṛṣṭyā tadā tāśca kiṃcinnovāca sā śivā \|\| 35 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

35\. The great goddess Pārvatī thus eulogised by you and other sages glanced at them furiously. She did not say anything.

## \|\| 5.17.36 \|\|

*tadā ca ṛṣayassarve natvā taccaraṇāṃbujam \|*  
*punarūcuśśivāṃ bhaktyā kṛtāṃjalipuṭāśśanaiḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Then the sages bowed at her lotus like feet and spoke to her in low voice with devotion joining their palms in reverence.

## \|\| 5.17.37 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ \|\| kṣamyatāṃ devi saṃhāro jāya te'dhunā \|*  
*tava svāmī sthitaścātra paśya paśya tamaṃbike \|\| 37 \|\|*

The sages said:—

37\. O goddess, forgive, forgive. The final dissolution seems near at hand. Your lord is standing here. O mother, you see him.

## \|\| 5.17.38 \|\|

*vayaṃ ke ca ime devā viṣṇubrahmādayastathā \|*  
*prajāśca bhavadīyāśca kṛtāṃjalipuṭāḥ sthitāḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. What are we, the gods, Viṣṇu, Brahmā and others? We are only your subjects. We stand here with palms joined in reverence.

## \|\| 5.17.39 \|\|

*kṣaṃtavyaścāparādho vai sarveṣāṃ parameśvari \|*  
*sarve hi vikalāścādya śāṃtiṃ teṣāṃ śive kuru \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. O great goddess, our guilts shall be forgiven. We are agitated and distressed. O Pārvatī give us peace.

## \|\| 5.17.40 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*ityuktvā ṛṣayassarve sudīnataramākulāḥ \|*  
*saṃtasthire caṃḍikāgre kṛtāṃjalipuṭāstadā \|\| 40 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

40\. After saying this, the agitated and distressed sages stood in front of her with palms joined in reverence.

## \|\| 5.17.41 \|\|

*evaṃ śrutvā vacasteṣāṃ prasannā caṃḍikā'bhavat \|*  
*pratyuvāca ṛṣīṃstānvai karuṇāviṣṭamānasā \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. On hearing their words Pārvatī was pleased and she replied to the sages with her mind full of compassion.

## \|\| 5.17.42-43 \|\|

*devyuvāca \|*  
*matputro yadi jīveta tadā saṃharaṇaṃ nahi \|*  
*yathā hi bhavatāṃ madhye pūjyo'yaṃ ca bhaviṣyati \|\| 42 \|\|*

*sarvādhyakṣo bhavedadya yūyaṃ kuruta tadyadi \|*  
*tadā śāṃtirbhavelloke nānyathā sukhamāpsyatha \|\| 43 \|\|*

The goddess said:—

42-43. If my son regains life there may not be further annihilation. If you can arrange for him an honourable status and position among you as the chief presiding officer, there may be peace in the world. Otherwise you will never be happy.

## \|\| 5.17.44 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*ityuktāste tadā sarve ṛṣayo yuṣmadādayaḥ \|*  
*tebhyo devebhya āgatya sarvaṃ vṛttaṃ nyavedayan \|\| 44 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

44\. Thus warned, you and other sages returned and intimated to all the gods everything in detail.

## \|\| 5.17.45 \|\|

*te ca sarve tathā śrutvā śaṃkarāya nyavedayan \|*  
*natvā prāṃjalayo dīnāḥ śakraprabhṛtayassurāḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. On hearing that, Indra and other gods joined their palms in reverence and piteously intimated to Śiva what had transpired there.

## \|\| 5.17.46 \|\|

*provāceti surāñchrutvā śivaścāpi tathā punaḥ \|*  
*karttavyaṃ ca tathā sarvalokasvāsthyaṃ bhavediha \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. On hearing what the gods said, Śiva spoke thus—“It shall be done accordingly so that there may be peace over all the worlds.”

## \|\| 5.17.47 \|\|

*uttarasyāṃ punaryāta prathamaṃ yo milediha \|*  
*tacchiraśca samāhṛtya yojanīyaṃ kalevare \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. “You shall go to the northern direction and whatever person you meet at first you cut off his head and fit it to this body.”

## \|\| 5.17.48 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*tatastaistatkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ śivājñāpratipālakaiḥ \|*  
*kalevaraṃ samānīya prakṣālya vidhivacca tat \|\| 48 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

48\. Then they carried out Śiva’s behests and acted accordingly. They brought the headless body of Gaṇeśa and washed it well.

## \|\| 5.17.49 \|\|

*pūjayitvā punaste vai gatāścodaṅmukhāstadā \|*  
*prathamaṃ militastatra hastī cāpyekadaṃtakaḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. They paid homage to it and started towards the north. It was a single-tusked elephant that they met.

## \|\| 5.17.50-51 \|\|

*tacchiraśca tadā nītvā tatra te'yojayan dhruvam \|*  
*saṃyojya devatāssarvāḥ śivaṃ viṣṇuṃ vidhiṃ tadā \|\| 50 \|\|*

*praṇamya vacanaṃ procurbhavaduktaṃ kṛtaṃ ca naḥ \|*  
*anaṃtaraṃ ca tatkāryaṃ bhavatādbhavaśeṣitam \|\| 51 \|\|*

50-51. They took the head and fitted it to the body. After joining it, the gods bowed to Śiva, Viṣṇu and Brahmā and spoke—“What has been ordered by you has been carried out by us. Let the task left incomplete be performed now.”

## \|\| 5.17.52 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*tataste tu virejuśca pārṣadāśca surāḥ sukham \|*  
*atha tadvacanaṃ śrutvā śivoktaṃ paryapālayan \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. Then the Pārṣadas shone happily. After hearing those words they awaited eagerly what Śiva would say.

## \|\| 5.17.53 \|\|

*ūcuste ca tadā tatra brahmaviṣṇusurāstathā \|*  
*praṇamyeśaṃ śivaṃ devaṃ svaprabhuṃ guṇavarjitam \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Then Brahmā, Viṣṇu and other gods spoke after bowing to lord Śiva who is free from the ill effects of the attributes.

## \|\| 5.17.54 \|\|

*yasmāttvattejasassarve vayaṃ jātā mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*tvattejastatsamāyātu vedamaṃtrābhiyogataḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. They said:—“Since we all are born out of your brilliant Energy let that Energy come into it by the recitation of the Vedic mantras.

## \|\| 5.17.55 \|\|

*ityevamabhimaṃtreṇa maṃtritaṃ jalamuttamam \|*  
*smṛtvā śivaṃ sametāste cikṣipustatkalevare \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. Saying so, they jointly sprinkled the holy water, invoked by the mantras on that body after remembering Śiva.

## \|\| 5.17.56 \|\|

*tajjalasparśamātreṇa cidyuto jīvito drutam \|*  
*tadottasthau supta iva sa bālaśca śivecchayā \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. Immediately after the contact of the holy water the boy was resuscitated to life and joined with consciousness. As Śiva willed, the boy woke up as from a sleep.

## \|\| 5.17.57 \|\|

*subhagassundarataro gajavaktrassuraktakaḥ \|*  
*prasannavadanaścātisuprabho lalitākṛtiḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. He was handsome, extremely comely. He had the face of an elephant. He was red-complexioned. He was delighted with face beaming. He was brilliant and had fine features.

## \|\| 5.17.58 \|\|

*taṃ dṛṣṭvā jīvitaṃ bālaṃ śivāputraṃ munīśvara \|*  
*sarve mumudire tatra sarvaduḥkhaṃ kṣayaṃ gatam \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. O great sage, on seeing the son of Pārvatī resuscitated to life, they all rejoiced and their miseries came to an end.

## \|\| 5.17.59 \|\|

*devyai saṃdarśayāmāsuḥ sarve harṣasamanvitāḥ \|*  
*jīvitaṃ tanayaṃ dṛṣṭvā devī hṛṣṭatarābhavat \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. They showed him delightfully to the goddess. On seeing her restored to life, the goddess was greatly delighted.

## Chapter 18 - Gaṇeśa crowned as the chief of Gaṇas

## \|\| 5.18.1 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*jīvite girijāputre devyā dṛṣṭe prajeśvara \|*  
*tataḥ kimabhavattatra kṛpayā tadvadādhunā \|\| 1 \|\|*

Nārada said:—

1\. O lord of subjects, when the son of Pārvatī was resuscitated and seen by.the goddess, what happened then? Please narrate to me now.

## \|\| 5.18.2 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*jīvite girijāputre devyā dṛṣṭe munīśvara \|*  
*yajjātaṃ tacchṛṇuṣvādya vacmi te mahadutsavam \|\| 2 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

2\. O great sage, when the son of Pārvatī was resuscitated and seen by the goddess, listen to what happened there. I shall narrate the jubilation that ensued.

## \|\| 5.18.3 \|\|

*jīvitassa śivāputro nirvyagro vikṛto mune \|*  
*abhiṣiktastadā devairgaṇādhyakṣairgajānanaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. O sage, that son of Pārvatī was resuscitated. He was free from distress and perturbation. Then he was crowned by the gods and the leaders of Gaṇas.

## \|\| 5.18.4 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā svatanayaṃ devī śivā harṣasamanvitā \|*  
*gṛhītvā bālakaṃ dorbhyāṃ pramudā pariṣasvaje \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. On seeing her son, Pārvatī was highly delighted. Taking him up with both her hands she embraced him joyously.

## \|\| 5.18.5 \|\|

*vastrāṇi vividhānīha nānālaṃkaraṇāni ca \|*  
*dadau prītyā gaṇeśāya svaputrāya mudāṃbikā \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. She then lovingly gave him different clothes and ornaments.

## \|\| 5.18.6 \|\|

*pūjayitvā tayā devyā siddhibhiścāpyanekaśaḥ \|*  
*kareṇa sparśitassotha sarvaduḥkhahareṇa vai \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. He was honoured by the goddess who bestowed all Siddhis on him and touched him with her hand that removes all distress.

## \|\| 5.18.7 \|\|

*pūjayitvā sutaṃ devī mukhamācumbya śāṃkarī \|*  
*varāndadau tadā prītyā jātastvaṃ duḥkhito'dhunā \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. After worshipping her son, and kissing his face, she granted him boons with affection and said—“You have had great distress since your very birth.

## \|\| 5.18.8 \|\|

*dhanyosi kṛtakṛtyosi pūrvapūjyo bhavādhunā \|*  
*sarveṣāmamarāṇāṃ vai sarvadā duḥkhavarjitaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. You are blessed and contented now. You will receive worship before all the gods. You will be free from distress.

## \|\| 5.18.9 \|\|

*ānane tava sindūraṃ dṛśyate sāṃprataṃ yadi \|*  
*tasmāttvaṃ pūjanīyosi sindūreṇa sadā naraiḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Vermillion is visible on your face now. Hence you will be worshipped with vermillion by all men always.

## \|\| 5.18.10-12 \|\|

*puṣpairvā candanairvāpi gandhenaiva śubhena ca \|*  
*naivedye suramyeṇa nīrājena vidhānataḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*tāṃmbūlairatha dānaiśca tathā prakramaṇairapi \|*  
*namaskāravidhānena pūjāṃ yaste vidhāsyati \|\| 11 \|\|*

*tasya vai sakalā siddhirbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*vighnānyanekarūpāṇi kṣayaṃ yāsyaṃtyasaṃśayam \|\| 12 \|\|*

10-12. All achievements certainly accrue to him who performs your worship with flowers, sandal paste, scents, auspicious food offerings Nīrājana rites, betel leaves, charitable gifts, circumambulations and obeisance. All kinds of obstacles will certainly perish.

## \|\| 5.18.13 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*ityuktvā ca tadā devī svaputraṃ taṃ maheśvaro \|*  
*nānāvastubhirutkṛṣṭaṃ punarapyarcayattathā \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. After saying this, she worshipped her good son with various articles, once again.

## \|\| 5.18.14 \|\|

*tatassvāsthyaṃ ca devānāṃ gaṇānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*girijākṛpayā vipra jātaṃ tatkṣaṇamātrataḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. O Brahmin, then with the graceful blessings of

Pārvatī, instantly peace reigned upon gods and particularly on the Gaṇas.

## \|\| 5.18.15 \|\|

*etasmiṃśca kṣaṇe devā vāsavādyāḥ śivaṃ mudā \|*  
*stutvā prasādya taṃ devaṃ bhaktā ninyuḥ śivāṃtikam \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. In the meantime, Indra and other gods eulogised and propitiated Śiva joyously and brought him devoutly near Pārvatī.

## \|\| 5.18.16 \|\|

*saṃsādya giriśaṃ paścādutsaṃge sannyaveśayan \|*  
*bālakaṃ taṃ maheśānyāstrijagatsukhahetave \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. After pleasing her they placed the boy in her lap for the happiness of the three worlds.

## \|\| 5.18.17 \|\|

*śivopi tasya śirasi dattvā svakarapaṃkajam \|*  
*uvāca vacanaṃ devān putro'yamiti me'paraḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Placing his lotus-like hand on his head, Śiva told the gods. “This is another son of mine.”

## \|\| 5.18.18-19 \|\|

*gaṇeśopi tadotthāya namaskṛtya śivāya vai \|*  
*pārvatyai ca namaskṛtya mahyaṃ vai viṣṇave tathā \|\| 18 \|\|*

*nārādādyānṛṣīnsarvānsatvāsthāya puro'bravīt \|*  
*kṣaṃtavyaścāparādho me mānaścaivedṛśo nṛṇām \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. Getting up and bowing to Śiva, Pārvatī, Viṣṇu and me, Gaṇeśa stood in front of Nārada and other sages and said—“My guilt shall be forgiven. Arrogance is the characteristic of Man’s nature.”

## \|\| 5.18.20 \|\|

*ahaṃ ca śaṃkaraścaiva viṣṇuścaite trayassurāḥ \|*  
*pratyūcuryugapatprītyā dadato varamuttamam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. We three Śiva, Viṣṇu and I said to the gods simultaneously with pleasure, after granting him excellent boons

## \|\| 5.18.21 \|\|

*trayo vayaṃ suravarā yathāpūjyā jagattraye \|*  
*tathāyaṃ gaṇanāthaśca sakalaiḥ pratipūjyatām \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. “O great gods, just as we three are worshipped in all the three worlds, so also he shall be worshipped by all of you.”

## \|\| 5.18.22 \|\|

*vayaṃ ca prākṛtāścāyaṃ prākṛtaḥ pūjya eva ca \|*  
*gaṇeśo vighnahartā hi sarvakāmaphalapradaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. We are the offsprings of primordial nature. He is also the same and hence worthy of worship. He is the remover of all obstacles and the bestower of the fruits of all rites.

## \|\| 5.18.23 \|\|

*etatpūjāṃ purā kṛtvā paścātpūjyā vayaṃ naraiḥ \|*  
*vayaṃ ca pūjitāssarve nāyaṃ cāpūjito yadā \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. He shall be worshipped first and we shall be worshipped afterwards. If he is not worshipped, we too are not worshipped.

## \|\| 5.18.24 \|\|

*asminnapūjite devāḥ parapūjākṛtā yadi \|*  
*tadā tatphalahāniḥ syānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. If the other deities are worshipped when he is not worshipped, the fruit of that rite will be lost. There is no doubt in this matter.

## \|\| 5.18.25-26 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*ityuktvā sa gaṇeśāno nānāvastubhirādarāt \|*  
*śivena pūjitaḥ pūrvaṃ viṣṇunānu prapūjitaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*brahmaṇā ca mayā tatra pārvatyā ca prapūjitaḥ \|*  
*sarvairdevairgaṇaiścaiva pūjitaḥ parayā mudā \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. After saying this we worshipped him. Śiva worshipped Gaṇeśa with various articles of worship. Viṣṇu worshipped him afterwards. I, Brahmā, and Pārvatī too worshipped him. He was then worshipped by all the gods and Gaṇas with great joy.

## \|\| 5.18.27 \|\|

*savairmilitvā tatraiva brahmaviṣṇuharādibhiḥ \|*  
*sagaṇeśaśśivātuṣṭyai sarvādhyakṣo niveditaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. In order to gratify Pārvatī, Gaṇeśa was proclaimed as the presiding officer by all, Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śiva and others.

## \|\| 5.18.28 \|\|

*punaścaiva śivenāsmai suprasannena cetasā \|*  
*sarvadā sukhadā loke varā dattā hyanekaśaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Again, with a joyful mind, several boons were granted by Pārvatī to him, always favourable to all in the world.

## \|\| 5.18.29 \|\|

*śiva uvāca \|*  
*he girīndrasutāputra saṃtuṣṭohaṃ na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*mayi tuṣṭe jagattuṣṭaṃ viruddhaḥ kopi no bhavet \|\| 29 \|\|*

Śiva said:—

29\. “O son of Pārvatī, I am pleased, there is no doubt about it. When I am pleased the entire universe is pleased. None will be against the same.

## \|\| 5.18.30 \|\|

*bālarūpopi yasmāttvaṃ mahāvikramakārakaḥ \|*  
*śaktiputrassutejasvī tasmādbhava sadā sukhī \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Since, even as a boy you showed great valour as Pārvatī’s son, you will remain brilliant and happy always.

## \|\| 5.18.31 \|\|

*tvannāma vighnahaṃtṛtve śreṣṭhaṃ caiva bhavatviti \|*  
*mama sarvagaṇādhyakṣaḥ saṃpūjyastvaṃ bhavādhunā \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Let your name be the most auspicious in the matter of quelling obstacles. Be the presiding officer of all my Gaṇas and worthy of worship now.”

## \|\| 5.18.32 \|\|

*evamuktvā śaṃkareṇa pūjāvidhiranekaśaḥ \|*  
*āśiṣaścāpyanekā hi kṛtāstasmiṃstu tatkṣaṇāt \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. After saying this, Śiva laid down several modes of worship and granted benedictions instantaneously.

## \|\| 5.18.33 \|\|

*tato devagaṇāścaiva gīta vādyaṃ ca nṛtyakam \|*  
*mudā te kārayāmāsustathaivapsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. The gods, the Gaṇas and the celestial damsels sang songs joyously, danced and played on instruments.

## \|\| 5.18.34 \|\|

*punaścaiva varo dattassuprasannena śaṃbhunā \|*  
*tasmai ca gaṇanāthāya śivenaiva mahātmanā \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Another boon was granted to Gaṇeśa by the delighted Śiva of great soul.

## \|\| 5.18.35-37 \|\|

*caturthyāṃ tvaṃ samutpanno bhādre māsi gaṇeśvara \|*  
*asite ca tathā pakṣe caṃdrasyodayane śubhe \|\| 35 \|\|*

*prathame ca tathā yāme girijāyāssucetasaḥ \|*  
*āvirbabhūva te rūpaṃ yasmātte vratamuttamam \|\| 36 \|\|*

*tasmāttaddinamārabhya tasyāmeva tithau mudā \|*  
*vrataṃ kāryaṃ viśeṣeṇa sarvasiddhyai suśobhanam \|\| 37 \|\|*

35-37. O Gaṇeśa, you are born in the first Prahara on the fourth day in the dark half of the Bhādra mouth at the auspicious hour of the moonrise. Since your form manifested itself from the good mind of Pārvatī, your excellent Vrata shall be performed on that Tithi itself or beginning from that day. It will be very auspicious and conducive to the achievement of all Siddhis.

## \|\| 5.18.38 \|\|

*yāvatpunassamāyāti varṣānte ca caturthikā \|*  
*tāvadvrataṃ ca kartavyaṃ tava caiva mamājñayā \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. At the bidding of us both the Vrata shall be performed till the fourth day at the end of a year.

## \|\| 5.18.39 \|\|

*saṃsāre sukhamicchanti ye'tulaṃ cāpyanekaśaḥ \|*  
*tvāṃ pūjayantu te bhaktyā caturthyāṃ vidhipūrvakam \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Let those who yearn for unequalled happiness in the world worship you devoutly in various ways on the fourth day in accordance with the rules.

## \|\| 5.18.40 \|\|

*mārgaśīrṣe tathā māse ramā yā vai caturthikā \|*  
*prātaḥsnānaṃ tadā kṛtvā vrataṃ viprānnivedayeta \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. On the fourth day of Lakṣmī in the month of Mārgaśīrṣa he shall perform early morning ablution and entrust the Vrata to the brahmins.

## \|\| 5.18.41 \|\|

*dūrvābhiḥ pūjanaṃ kāryamupavāsastathāvidhaḥ \|*  
*rātreśca prahare jāte snātvā saṃpūjayennaraḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. He shall perform worship with the Dūrvā grass and observe fast. After a Prahara has elapsed in the night the devotee shall take bath and worship.

## \|\| 5.18.42-43 \|\|

*mūrtiṃ dhātumayīṃ kṛtvā pravālasaṃbhavāṃ tathā \|*  
*śvetārkasaṃbhavāṃ cāpi mārddikāṃ nirmitāṃ tathā \|\| 42 \|\|*

*pratiṣṭhāpya tadā tatra pūjayetprayataḥ pumān \|*  
*gaṃdhairnānāvidhairdivyaiścandanaiḥ puṣpakairiha \|\| 43 \|\|*

42-43. The idol shall be made of metal, coral, white Arka flowers or clay. It shall be installed and worshipped by the devotee with all purity, with scents of various kinds, divine sandal paste and flowers.

## \|\| 5.18.44-45 \|\|

*vitastimātrā dūrvā ca vyaṃgā vai mūlavarjitā \|*  
*īdṛśānāṃ tadbalānāṃ śatenaikottareṇa ha \|\| 44 \|\|*

*ekaviṃśatikenaiva pūjayetpratimāṃ sthitām \|*  
*dhūpairdīpaiśca naivedyairvividhairgaṇanāyakam \|\| 45 \|\|*

44-45. A handful of Dūrvā grass having three knots and without roots shall be used for worship. The shoots shall be hundred and one in number. With twentyone the idol shall be worshipped. Gaṇeśa shall be adored with incense, lamps and different kinds of food-offerings.

## \|\| 5.18.46 \|\|

*tāmbūlādyarghasaddravyaiḥ praṇipatya stavaistathā \|*  
*tvāṃ tatra pūjayitvetthaṃ bālacaṃdraṃ ca pūjayet \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. After worshipping you with various articles of worship like betel etc. and eulogising you with hymns, the devotee shall worship the crescent moon.

## \|\| 5.18.47 \|\|

*paścādviprāṃśca saṃpūjya bhojayenmadhurairmudā \|*  
*svayaṃ caiva tato bhuṃjyānmadhuraṃ lavaṇaṃ vinā \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Afterwards, he shall feed the brahmins joyously with sweets with due honour. He himself shall take sweets and avoid salt.

## \|\| 5.18.48 \|\|

*visarjayettataḥ paścānniyamaṃ sarvamātmanaḥ \|*  
*gaṇeśasmaraṇaṃ kuryyātsaṃpūrṇaṃ syādvrataṃ śubham \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Then the rites shall formally be dismissed. Then he shall remember Gaṇeśa. Thus the Vrata shall be concluded auspiciously.

## \|\| 5.18.49 \|\|

*evaṃ vratena saṃpūrṇe varṣe jāte narastadā \|*  
*udyāpanavidhiṃ kuryādvratasampūrttihetave \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. When thus the Vrata is duly completed in a year, the devotee shall perform the rite of formal dismissal for the completion of the Vrata.

## \|\| 5.18.50 \|\|

*dvādaśa brāhmaṇāstatra bhojanīyā madājñayā \|*  
*kuṃbhamekaṃ ca saṃsthāpya pūjyā mūrtistvadīyikā \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. At my bidding twelve brahmins shall be fed. After placing a jar your image shall be worshipped.

## \|\| 5.18.51 \|\|

*sthaṇḍileṣṭapalaṃ kṛtvā tadā vedavidhānataḥ \|*  
*homaścaivātra kartavyo vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaiḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. After making the eight-petalled lotus diagram on the ground in accordance with Vedic injunctions a sacrifice shall be performed by the liberal people who have no disinclination to spend money.

## \|\| 5.18.52 \|\|

*strīdvayaṃ ca tathā cātra baṭukadvayamādarāt \|*  
*bhojayetpūjayitvā vai mūrtyagre vidhipūrvakam \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. Two women and two students shall be worshipped and fed in front of the idol duly.

## \|\| 5.18.53 \|\|

*niśi jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ punaḥ prātaḥ prapūjayet \|*  
*visarjanaṃ tataścaiva punarāgamanāya ca \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. The devotee shall keep awake at night and perform worship in the morning. After that the rites of formal dismissal with the mantra “Kṣemāya Punarāgamanāya Ca.” (For welfare and return again) shall be performed.

## \|\| 5.18.54 \|\|

*bālakāccāśiṣo grāhyāssvastivācanameva ca \|*  
*puṣpāṃjaliṃ pradadyācca vratasaṃpūrṇa hetave \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. The benediction as well as good wishes shall be received from the boy. In order to make the Vrata complete, handfuls of flowers shall be offered.

## \|\| 5.18.55 \|\|

*namaskārāṃstataḥ kṛtvā nānākāryaṃ prakalpayet \|*  
*evaṃ vrataṃ kṛtaṃ yena tasyepsitaphalaṃ bhavet \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. After prostrations, various routines shall be carried on. He who performs Vratas like this can secure the desired fruits.

## \|\| 5.18.56 \|\|

*yo nityaṃ śraddhayā sārddhaṃ pūjāṃ caiva sva śaktitaḥ \|*  
*kuryyāttava gaṇeśāna sarvakāmaphalāptaye \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. O Gaṇeśa, he who performs your worship upto his ability, with faith, shall derive the fruit of all desires.

## \|\| 5.18.57 \|\|

*sindūraiścandanaiścaiva taṃḍulaiḥ ketakaistathā \|*  
*upacārairanekaiśca pūjayettvāṃ gaṇe śvaram \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. The devotee shall worship you, the lord of Gaṇas with vermillion, sandal paste, raw rice grains and Ketaka flowers as well as with other services.

## \|\| 5.18.58 \|\|

*evaṃ tvāṃ pūjayeyurye bhaktyā nānopacārataḥ \|*  
*teṣāṃ siddhirbhavennityaṃ vighnanāśo bhavediha \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. They who devoutly worship you with acts of service will achieve success. Their obstacles will be quelled.

## \|\| 5.18.59 \|\|

*sarvairvarṇaiḥ prakarttavyā strībhiścaiva viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*udayābhimukhaiścaiva rājabhiśca viśeṣataḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. These Vratas shall be performed by the people of all castes, particularly by women as well as kings aiming and beginning to be prosperous and flourishing.

## \|\| 5.18.60 \|\|

*yaṃ yaṃ kāmayate yo vai taṃtamāpnoti niścitam \|*  
*ataḥ kāmayamānena tena sevyassadā bhavān \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. He will certainly derive whatever he desires. Hence you shall always be served by him whoever he is who desires fruits.

## \|\| 5.18.61-62 \|\|

*\|\| brahmovāca \|*  
*śivenaiva tadā proktaṃ gaṇeśāya mahātmane \|*  
*tadānīṃ daivataiścaiva sarvaiśca ṛṣisattamaiḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

*tathetyuktvā tu taissarvairgaṇaiśśaṃbhupriyairmune \|*  
*pūjito hi gaṇādhīśo vidhinā parameṇa saḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

61-62. When this was mentioned by Śiva to Gaṇeśa of great soul, O sage, the gods, the sages and the Gaṇas, favourites of Śiva said “So be it” and worshipped Gaṇeśa according to prescribed rules.

## \|\| 5.18.63 \|\|

*tataścaiva gaṇāssarve praṇemuste gaṇeśvaram \|*  
*samānarcurviśeṣeṇa nānāvastubhirādarāt \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. All the Gaṇas, particularly bowed to Gaṇeśa and adored him respectfully with various articles.

## \|\| 5.18.64 \|\|

*girijāyāssamutpanno yaśca harṣo munīśvara \|*  
*caturbhirvadanairvai tamavarṇyaṃ ca kathaṃ bruve \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. O great sage, how can I describe even with my four mouths the indescribable delight of Pārvatī.

## \|\| 5.18.65 \|\|

*devaduṃdubhayo nedurnanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ \|*  
*jagurgaṃdharvamukhyāśca puṣpavarṣaṃ papāta ha \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. The divine drums were sounded. The celestial damsels danced. The Gandharva chiefs sang. Flowers were showered upon him.

## \|\| 5.18.66 \|\|

*jagatsvāsthyaṃ tadā prāpa gaṇādhīśe pratiṣṭhite \|*  
*mahotsavo mahānāsītsarvaṃ duḥkhaṃ kṣayaṃ gaṇam \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. When Gaṇeśa was installed, the whole universe attained peace and normalcy. There was great jubilation. All miseries ended.

## \|\| 5.18.67 \|\|

*śivāśivau ca modetāṃ viśeṣeṇāti nārada \|*  
*āsītsumaṃgalaṃ bhūri sarvatra sukhadāyakam \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. O Nārada, Pārvatī and Śiva rejoiced in particular. Good and plentiful auspiciousness was conducive to happiness everywhere.

## \|\| 5.18.68-69 \|\|

*tato devagaṇāḥ sarve ṛṣīṇāṃ ca gaṇāstathā \|*  
*samāgatāśca ye tatra jagmuste tu śivājñayā \|\| 68 \|\|*

*praśaṃsaṃtaśśivā tatra gaṇeśaṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ \|*  
*śivaṃ caiva tathā stutvā kīdṛśaṃ yuddhameva ca \|\| 69 \|\|*

68-69. The gods and the sages, who had come there, returned at the bidding of Śiva praising Pārvatī and Gaṇeśa again and again, eulogising Śiva and saying “O what a battle!”

## \|\| 5.18.70 \|\|

*yadā sā girijā devī kopahīnā babhūva ha \|*  
*śivo'pi girijāṃ tatra pūrvavatsaṃprapadya tām \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. When Pārvatī became free from fury, Śiva and Pārvatī behaved as before.

## \|\| 5.18.71 \|\|

*cakāra vividhaṃ saukhyaṃ lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā \|*  
*svātmārāmo'pi paramo bhaktakāryodyataḥ sadā \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. With a desire for the welfare of the worlds, the great deity relaxing in his own soul and engaged in the activities of the devotees conferred different kinds of happiness.

## \|\| 5.18.72 \|\|

*viṣṇuśca śivamāpṛcchya brahmāhaṃ taṃ tathaiva hi \|*  
*āgacchāva svadhāmaṃ ca śivau saṃsevya bhaktitaḥ \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. Both Viṣṇu and I took leave of Śiva and after paying homage to both Pārvatī and Śiva returned to our abodes.

## \|\| 5.18.73 \|\|

*nārada tvaṃ ca bhagavansaṃgīya śivayoryaśaḥ \|*  
*āgamo bhavanaṃ svaṃ ca śivau pṛṣṭvā munīśvara \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. O holy sage Nārada, after singing the glory of Pārvatī and Śiva and taking leave of them you too returned to your abode.

## \|\| 5.18.74 \|\|

*etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ mayā vai śivayoryaśaḥ \|*  
*bhavatpṛṣṭena vighneśa yaśassaṃmiśramādarāt \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. Thus requested by you, I have narrated the glorious story of Pārvatī and Śiva along with that of Gaṇeśa with great reverence.

## \|\| 5.18.75 \|\|

*idaṃ sumaṃgalākhyānaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti susaṃyataḥ \|*  
*sarvamaṃgala saṃyuktassa bhavenmaṃgalālayaḥ \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. Whoever hears this narrative auspiciously with pure mind shall have everything auspicious and be the abode of auspiciousness.

## \|\| 5.18.76 \|\|

*aputro labhate putraṃ nirdhano labhate dhanam \|*  
*bhāyārthī labhate bhāryāṃ prajārthī labhate prajām \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. The childless will get a son, the indigent wealth; the seeker of a wife will get a wife and the seeker of issues will get children.

## \|\| 5.18.77 \|\|

*ārogyaṃ labhate rogī saubhāgyaṃ durbhago labhet \|*  
*naṣṭaputraṃ naṣṭadhanaṃ proṣitā ca patiṃ labhet \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. The sick will regain health; the miserable will have good fortune. The sonless, impoverished, banished wife will be reunited with her husband.

## \|\| 5.18.78-79 \|\|

*śokāviṣṭaśśokahīnassa bhavennātra saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*idaṃ gāṇeśamākhyānaṃ yasya gehe ca tiṣṭhati \|\| 78 \|\|*

*sadā maṃgalasaṃyuktassa bhavennātra saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*yātrākāle ca puṇyāhe yaśśṛṇoti samāhitaḥ \|*  
*sarvābhīṣṭaṃ sa labhate śrīgaṇeśaprasādataḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

78-79. The sorrowing will be relieved of sorrow, undoubtedly. The house that contains this story shall certainly be auspicious. He who listens to this narrative at the time of travel or on holy occasions, with a pure mind shall get all desires, thanks to the grace of lord Gaṇeśa.

## Chapter 19 - Gaṇapati’s marriage

## \|\| 5.19.1 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*gaṇeśasya śrutā tāta samyagjaniranuttamā \|*  
*caritramapi divyaṃ vai suparākramabhūṣitam \|\| 1 \|\|*

Nārada said:—

1\. O dear father, the excellent story of the nativity and the divine conduct embellished by valour, of Gaṇeśa has been heard well.

## \|\| 5.19.2 \|\|

*tataḥ kimabhavattāta tattvaṃ vada sureśvaraḥ \|*  
*śivāśivayaśassphītaṃ mahānandapradāyakam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. O dear father, O lord of gods, what happened thereafter? Please narrate it. The great glory of Pārvatī and Śiva confers great delight.

## \|\| 5.19.3 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|\| sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ muniśreṣṭha bhavatā karuṇātmanā \|*  
*śrūyatāṃ dattakarṇaṃ hi vakṣye'haṃ ṛṣisattama \|\| 3 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

3\. O excellent sage, you have asked well with a sympathetic mind. Listen attentively, O excellent sage, I shall narrate.

## \|\| 5.19.4 \|\|

*śivā śivaśca viprendra dvayośca sutayoḥ param \|*  
*darśaṃdarśaṃ ca tallīlāṃ mahatprema samāvahat \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. O excellent brahmin, seeing frequently the divine sports of both the sons, Pārvatī and Śiva had their love increased.

## \|\| 5.19.5 \|\|

*pitrorlālayatostatra sukhaṃ cāti vyavarddhata \|*  
*sadā prītyā mudā cātikhelanaṃ cakratussutau \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The happiness of the parents knew no bounds. The son too used to sport in joy and love.

## \|\| 5.19.6 \|\|

*tāveva tanayau tatra mātā pitrormunīśvara \|*  
*mahābhaktyā yadā yuktau paricaryāṃ pracakratuḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. O great sage, the sons rendered great service to their parents with great devotion.

## \|\| 5.19.7 \|\|

*ṣaṇmukhe ca gaṇeśe ca pitrostadadhikaṃ sadā \|*  
*sneho vyavarddhata mahāñcchuklapakṣe yathā śaśī \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. The love and affection of the parents towards the six-faced lord and Gaṇeśa increased to a great extent like the moon in the bright half of the month.

## \|\| 5.19.8 \|\|

*kadācittau sthitau tatra rahasi premasaṃyutau \|*  
*śivā śivaśca devarṣe suvicāraparāyaṇau \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. O celestial sage, once the loving parents Pārvatī and Śiva held a secret talk and discussion.

## \|\| 5.19.9 \|\|

*śivā śivāvūcatuḥ \|*  
*vivāhayogyau saṃjātau sutāviti ca tāvubhau \|*  
*vivāhaśca kathaṃ kāryaḥ putrayorubhayoḥ śubham \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. They thought that the two sons had attained to marriageable age and how best their marriage should be celebrated now.

I 0. The sixfaced lord Kārttikeya was their great beloved son. Gaṇeśa too was likewise. Thinking thus they were worried as well as delighted.

## \|\| 5.19.11 \|\|

*svapitrormatamājñāya tau sutāvapi saṃspṛhau \|*  
*tadicchayā vivāhārthaṃ babhūvaturatho mune \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. O sage, coming to know of their parents’ opinion, the sons too were eager to get married.

## \|\| 5.19.12 \|\|

*ahaṃ ca pariṇeṣyāmi hyahaṃ caiva punaḥ punaḥ \|*  
*parasparaṃ ca nityaṃ vai vivāde tatparāvubhau \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. “I shall marry, I shall marry” saying thus to each other they always quarrelled with each other.

## \|\| 5.19.13 \|\|

*śrutvā tadvacanaṃ tau ca daṃpatī jagatāṃ prabhū \|*  
*laukikācāramāśritya vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatau \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. The couple, the rulers of the worlds, on hearing their words, were very much surprised, following the worldly conventions.

## \|\| 5.19.14 \|\|

*kiṃ kartavyaṃ kathaṃ kāryo vivāhavidhiretayoḥ \|*  
*iti niścitya tābhyāṃ vai yuktiśca racitādbhutā \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. A wonderful expedient was devised by them after thinking about the course to be followed in the celebration of their marriage.

## \|\| 5.19.15 \|\|

*kadācitsamaye sthitvā samāhūya svaputrakau \|*  
*kathayāmāsatustatra putrayoḥ pitarau tadā \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Once they called the sons to them and spoke as follows.

## \|\| 5.19.16 \|\|

*śivāśivāvūcatuḥ \|*  
*asmākaṃ niyamaḥ pūrvaṃ kṛtaśca sukhado hi vām \|*  
*śrūyatāṃ susutau prītyā kathayāvo yathārthakam \|\| 16 \|\|*

Śiva and Pārvatī said:—

16\. O good sons, we have framed the rules conducive to your happiness. Listen lovingly. We shall tell you the truth.

## \|\| 5.19.17 \|\|

*samau dvāvapi satputrau viśeṣo nātra labhyate \|*  
*tasmātpaṇaḥ kṛtaśśaṃdaḥ putrayorubhayorapi \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Both of you are good sons and equal in our eyes. There is no difference. Hence a condition that is beneficial to both of you has been made.

## \|\| 5.19.18 \|\|

*yaścaiva pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ krāṃtvā pūrvamupāvrajet \|*  
*tasyaiva prathamaṃ kāryo vivāhaśśubhalakṣaṇaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. The auspicious marriage will be celebrated of that boy who comes here first after going round the entire earth.

## \|\| 5.19.19 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*tayorevaṃ vacaḥ śrutvā śarajanmā mahābalaḥ \|*  
*jagāma mandirāttūrṇaṃ pṛthivīkramaṇāya vai \|\| 19 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

19\. On hearing their words, the powerful Kumāra started immediately from the fixed point in order to go round the earth.

## \|\| 5.19.20 \|\|

*gaṇanāthaśca tatraiva saṃsthito buddhisattamaḥ \|*  
*subuddhyā saṃvicāraryeti citta eva punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Gaṇeśa of excellent intellect stood there itself after pondering in his mind frequently with his keen intellect.

## \|\| 5.19.21 \|\|

*kiṃ kartavyaṃ kva gaṃtavyaṃ laṃghituṃ naiva śakyate \|*  
*krośamātraṃ gataḥ syādvai gamyate na mayā punaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. “What shall be done? Where am I to go? I cannot cross the earth. At best it may be possible to go a Krośa. I cannot go beyond it.

## \|\| 5.19.22 \|\|

*kiṃ punaḥ pṛvivīmetāṃ krāṃtvā copārjitaṃ sukham \|*  
*vicāryeti gaṇeśastu yaccakāra śṛṇuṣva tat \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. What avails that happiness which is achieved after going round the earth?” Please listen to what Gaṇeśa did after thinking thus.

## \|\| 5.19.23 \|\|

*snānaṃ kṛtvā yathānyāyaṃ samāgatya svayaṃ gṛham \|*  
*uvāca pitaraṃ tatra mātaraṃ punareva saḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. He performed the ceremonial ablution and returned, home. He then spoke to his father and mother.

## \|\| 5.19.24 \|\|

*gaṇeśa uvāca \|*  
*āsane sthāpite hyatra pūjārthaṃ bhavatoriha \|*  
*bhavaṃtau saṃsthitau tātau pūryyatāṃ me manorathaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

Gaṇeśa said:—

24\. For your worship two seats have I placed here. Please be seated, dear parents. Let my desire be fulfilled.

## \|\| 5.19.25 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*iti śrutvā vacastasya pārvatīparameśvarau \|*  
*asthātāmāsane tatra tatpūjāgrahaṇāya vai \|\| 25 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

25\. On hearing his words, Pārvatī and Śiva sat on the seats for receiving worship.

## \|\| 5.19.26 \|\|

*tenātha pūjitau tau ca prakrāntau ca punaḥ punaḥ \|*  
*evaṃ ca kṛtavān sapta praṇāmāstu tathaiva saḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. They were worshipped by him and circumambulated seven times and bowed too seven times.

## \|\| 5.19.27 \|\|

*baddhāṃjalirathovāca gaṇeśo buddhisāgaraḥ \|*  
*stutvā bahu tithastāta pitarau premavihvalau \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Joining his palms in reverence and eulogising his parents agitated by love and affection, many times, Gaṇeśa the ocean of intelligence, spoke thus.

## \|\| 5.19.28 \|\|

*gaṇeśa uvāca \|*  
*bho mātarbho pitastvaṃ ca śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ \|*  
*śīghraṃ caivātra kartavyo vivāhaśśobhano mama \|\| 28 \|\|*

Gaṇeśa said:—

28\. “O mother, O father, you please listen to my weighty words. My auspicious marriage shall be celebrated quickly.”

## \|\| 5.19.29 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*ityevaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā gaṇeśasya mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*mahābuddhinidhiṃ taṃ tau pitarāvūcatustadā \|\| 29 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

29\. On hearing the words of the noble-minded Gaṇeśa, the parents spoke to him, the storehouse of great intellect.

## \|\| 5.19.30 \|\|

*śivā śivāvūcatuḥ \|*  
*prakrāmeta bhavānsamyakpṛthivīṃ ca sakānanām \|*  
*kumāro gatavāṃstatra tvaṃ gaccha pura āvraja \|\| 30 \|\|*

Śiva and Pārvatī said:—

30\. You shall circumambulate the earth with all its forests. Kumāra has already gone. You too start and return first.

## \|\| 5.19.31 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*ityevaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā pitrorgaṇapati drutam \|*  
*uvāca niyatastatra vacanaṃ krodhasaṃyutaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

31\. On hearing the words of his parents, Gaṇeśa spoke immediately and furiously but with some restraint.

## \|\| 5.19.32 \|\|

*gaṇeśa uvāca \|*  
*bho mātarbho pitardharmarūpau prājñau yuvāṃ matau \|*  
*dharmataḥ śrūyatāṃ samyak vacanaṃ mama sattamau \|\| 32 \|\|*

Gaṇeśa said:—

32\. O mother, O father, you two are intelligent and embodied virtue. Hence O excellent ones, you may be pleased to hear my virtuous words.

## \|\| 5.19.33 \|\|

*mayā tu pṛthivī krāṃtā saptavāraṃ punaḥ punaḥ \|*  
*evaṃ kathaṃ bruvāte vai punaśca pitarāviha \|\| 33 \|\|*
